Artists in Mozambique draw inspiration from their country's rich and complex history. From the nation’s colonial era to its hard-won independence and the turbulent years of civil war, many Mozambicans turn to art as a form of expression. Today, Mozambique's art scene is gaining international recognition.

Goncalo Mabunda is among these artists, using remnants of conflict as both muse and material. His intricate sculptures—masks, thrones, and figurines—are crafted from decommissioned weapons and military equipment, including landmines, AK-47s, and rocket launchers. Mabunda’s work was enabled by the Christian Council of Mozambique, which created the 'Transforming Guns into Hoes Program.' This initiative allows people to exchange recovered weapons for tools and building materials. "The war is over. Why do we still need weapons? Let’s destroy them. And I’m glad the government agreed," Mabunda said.

Other artists, like muralist Naguib Elias Abdula, found inspiration in the nation’s newfound independence. In 1975, after Mozambique ended its decade-long fight against Portuguese rule, the landscape was scattered with debris—a blank canvas for Abdula. His murals, spanning half a mile across Maputo, served as a means of educating the public, especially when literacy rates were low. "At the time, it was important to teach people about independence and what Mozambique meant. We conveyed these ideas through paintings since many could not read," he explained. Today, according to UNESCO, the literacy rate has improved to 58.6%, up from 38.7% in 1997.

Like Mabunda, Abdula has received international attention, exhibiting at United Nations headquarters in 1996 and participating in shows around the world. This growing global interest has helped establish Mozambique as a developing center for the arts. Arturo Vicente, president of Maputo’s Nucleo di Arte—an esteemed exhibition space supporting emerging artists—confirms, "There is an artistic movement."

For more: Watch a feature on Mozambique’s elusive coffee plant, or read about Africa’s mythical beasts.

Mosambiigi kunstnikud leiavad inspiratsiooni oma maa rikkalikust ja keerulisest ajaloost. Koloniaalajastust, iseseisvumisest ja kodusõja tormilistest aastatest innustatuna väljendavad paljud mosambiiklased end kunsti kaudu. Täna kogub Mosambiigi kunstimaastik rahvusvahelist tunnustust.

Goncalo Mabunda on üks neist kunstnikest, kes kasutab konfliktijäänuseid nii inspiratsiooniks kui materjaliks. Tema keerukad skulptuurid – maskid, troonid ja figuriinid – on valmistatud demineeritud relvadest ja sõjavarustusest, sealhulgas miinidest, AK-47 automaatidest ja raketiheitjatest. Mabunda looming sai võimalikuks tänu Mosambiigi Kristlikule Nõukogule, mis algatas programmi „Relvad kõplateks“. See algatus võimaldab inimestel vahetada tagastatud relvi tööriistade ja ehitusmaterjalide vastu. „Sõda on läbi. Miks meil on veel relvi vaja? Hävitage need. Ja mul on hea meel, et valitsus oli nõus,“ ütles Mabunda.

Teised kunstnikud, nagu muralist Naguib Elias Abdula, leidsid inspiratsiooni riigi uuest iseseisvusest. 1975. aastal, pärast kümnendipikkust võitlust Portugali ülemvõimu vastu, oli maastik täis rususid – see oli Abdulale kui puhas lõuend. Tema poole miili pikkused muralid Maputos aitasid avalikkust harida, eriti ajal, mil kirjaoskus oli madal. „Siis oli oluline õpetada inimestele, mida tähendab iseseisvus ja Mosambiik. Kuna paljud ei osanud lugeda, andsime need ideed edasi maalide abil,“ selgitas ta. Täna on UNESCO andmetel kirjaoskuse tase tõusnud 58,6 protsendini võrreldes 38,7 protsendiga 1997. aastal.

Nagu Mabunda, on ka Abdula saanud rahvusvahelist tähelepanu, esinedes ÜRO peakorteris 1996. aastal ja näitustel üle maailma. See kasvav üleilmne huvi on aidanud Mosambiigil kujuneda arenevaks kunstikeskuseks. Arturo Vicente, Maputo prestiižse kunstikeskuse Nucleo di Arte president, kinnitab: „Toimub kunstiline liikumine.“

article_content: The Karnataka government has introduced AVGC - XR Policy 3.0 (2023-28), setting a goal of creating 30,000 quality jobs over the next five years. This policy is focused on boosting the animation, visual effects, gaming, comics, and extended reality sectors, aiming for these industries to derive 80% of their revenue from exports. To support companies in the AVGC sector, the state will set up the AVGC Venture Fund (Kitven AVGC Fund-4). The policy introduces a tiered incentives system that rewards sustainable practices and innovation. It includes funding for skill development, assistance with job creation, and support for early-stage startups such as help with marketing, infrastructure, and compliance costs. Grants are also available for producing animation films, series, VR/AR/VFX projects, and game development. There are further incentives for research and development targeting emerging tech. IT and BT Minister Priyank Kharge stated that Karnataka is the first state to implement its third AVGC policy. He called the AVGC-XR Policy a significant step in cementing Karnataka’s role as a leader in animation, gaming, and technology innovation, all rooted in sustainability and inclusivity. The policy especially supports startups, MSMEs, and entrepreneurs from SC/ST and women’s groups through dedicated funding and support schemes. This comprehensive approach—involving skill building, infrastructure upgrades, financial incentives, and inclusivity—aims to drive sustained growth and global recognition for Karnataka’s AVGC-XR industry.
translated_content: Karnataka valitsus võttis vastu AVGC - XR poliitika 3.0 (2023–28), mille eesmärk on luua järgmise viie aasta jooksul 30 000 kvaliteetset töökohta. See poliitika keskendub animatsiooni, visuaalefektide, mängude, koomiksite ja laiendatud reaalsuse valdkondadele ning püüab saavutada, et 80% nende tööstusharude tulust tuleks ekspordist. Et toetada AVGC-sektori ettevõtteid, luuakse riiklik AVGC riskikapitalifond (Kitven AVGC Fund-4). Uus poliitika rakendab mitmetasandilist stiimulite süsteemi, mis tunnustab jätkusuutlikku arengut ja innovatsiooni. Toetused hõlmavad rahastamist oskuste arendamiseks, töökohtade loomiseks ja alustavatele ettevõtetele, sealhulgas turundus- ning infrastruktuuritoetused ja nõuetele vastavuse kulude hüvitamine. Toetusi saab taotleda ka animatsioonifilmide, -sarjade, VR/AR/VFX projektide ja mängude tootmiseks. Lisaks toetatakse teadus- ja arendustegevust, mis keskendub uutele tehnoloogiatele. IT- ja BT-minister Priyank Kharge sõnul on Karnataka esimene osariik, kes rakendab juba kolmandat AVGC poliitika versiooni. Ta nimetas seda olulise sammuna Karnataka positsiooni kindlustamisel animatsiooni, mängude ja tehnoloogia valdkonna liidrina, rõhutades poliitika põhialustena jätkusuutlikkust ja kaasatust. Poliitika pöörab erilist tähelepanu idufirmadele, VKEdele ning SC/ST ja naistetegijatele, pakkudes neile sihitud rahastust ja tugiprogramme. See terviklik lähenemine—oskuste arendamine, infrastruktuuri parandamine, rahalised stiimulid ja kaasatus—on suunatud Karnataka AVGC-XR sektori jätkusuutlikule kasvule ja ülemaailmsele tuntusele.

article_content: By Dr. Tristha Ramamurthy. What is the true purpose and measure of learning? Can learning be reduced to just a grade at the end of a unit or term? It is time to reflect on these questions and reconsider the practice of prioritizing grades above all else. We should not limit student and school success to numbers or letters on a report card. This narrow focus overlooks the diverse intelligences and potential in every student. To move beyond this limited view, we can create immersive learning experiences that encourage students to step out of their comfort zones and engage more deeply with content. We need to enrich teaching and learning in ways that grades alone cannot capture. Immersive learning transforms classrooms into dynamic spaces of experimentation and exploration. Rather than only writing reports on Shakespeare, students can act out plays, embodying characters to explore complex stories and language. Science becomes hands-on, with students conducting experiments to see reactions firsthand. Mathematics is used to solve puzzles and games reflecting real-life scenarios, making abstract concepts tangible. This active involvement not only deepens understanding but also creates excitement and a stronger connection to the subject, which traditional methods often lack. The teacher's role is central in this evolving approach. No longer only transmitters of knowledge, teachers now guide learning experiences that reflect the world outside the classroom. They curate relevant content, incorporate real-world problems, and design interdisciplinary projects that build higher-order thinking skills. Creating a responsive and supportive learning environment, teachers inspire enthusiasm and curiosity in students. When students experience this educational model, they become energized, asking questions and seeking new ideas. Their enthusiasm leads to higher engagement and transforms learning into an intrinsic motivation, not just a requirement. As a result, students are not only ready for academic challenges, but are also equipped for lifelong learning, approaching the world with curiosity and confidence. I encourage every educator to infuse their teaching with the joy of learning. Make your classroom a place of active discovery rather than passive memorization. Let’s commit to educational journeys that value immersive and engaging learning alongside academic rigor. When students take joy in learning, they develop a lasting love for education that prepares them to become lifelong learners and innovators. This is more than a change in teaching style—it is a cultural shift towards nurturing passionate, capable learners who seek knowledge continuously. Let’s celebrate learning as an adventure for both mind and spirit. (Dr. Tristha Ramamurthy is the founder of Ekya Schools and Provost at CMR University.)
translated_content: Autor: Dr. Tristha Ramamurthy. Mis on õppimise tõeline eesmärk ja mõõdupuu? Kas õppimist saab taandada ainult hindele, mis pannakse perioodi lõpus? On aeg nendele küsimustele mõelda ja kaaluda uuesti, miks eelistame hindeid kõigele muule. Me ei tohiks piirata õpilaste ega kooli edu ainult numbrite ja tähtedega tunnistusel. Selline kitsas lähenemine jätab kahe silma vahele igas õpilases peituva mitmekülgsuse ja potentsiaali. Selle piiratud vaate ületamiseks saame luua kaasahaaravaid õppimiskogemusi, mis kutsuvad õpilasi mugavustsoonist välja astuma ja süvitsi sisuga tegelema. Õpetamist ja õppimist peab rikastama nii, et seda ei saa ainult hinnetega mõõta. Kaasahaarav õppimine muudab klassiruumid dünaamilisteks katsetuste ja avastuste paikadeks. Shakespeare’i raportite kirjutamise asemel võivad õpilased lavastada näidendeid ning kehastada tegelasi, et mõista keerulisi lugusid ja keelt. Teadustunnid muutuvad praktiliseks, kui õpilased teostavad ise katseid ja näevad tulemusi oma silmaga. Matemaatikas lahendatakse mõistatusi ja mänge, mis peegeldavad päriselu olukordi, muutes abstraktsed mõisted käegakatsutavaks. Selline aktiivne osalus mitte ainult ei süvenda arusaamist, vaid toob elevust ja tugevama sideme õppeainega, mida traditsioonilised meetodid tihti ei paku. Õpetaja roll on selles arenevas lähenemises keskne. Nad pole enam ainult teadmiste edastajad, vaid juhivad õppimiskogemusi, mis peegeldavad pärismaailma. Õpetajad koostavad asjakohast sisu, kaasates päriselulisi probleeme ja interdistsiplinaarseid projekte, mis arendavad kõrgema tasandi mõtlemisoskusi. Toetava ja paindliku õpikeskkonna loomise kaudu inspireerivad õpetajad õpilastes entusiasmi ja uudishimu. Kui õpilased kogevad seda uut õpikäsitlust, muutuvad nad aktiivsemaks, esitavad küsimusi ja otsivad uusi ideid. Nende entusiasm viib suurema kaasatuseni ning muudab õppimise sisemiseks motivaatoriks, mitte ainult kohustuseks. Tulemuseks on õpilased, kes pole vaid valmis akadeemilisteks väljakutseteks, vaid ka elukestvaks õppeks, lähenedes maailmale uudishimu ja enesekindlusega. Kutsun iga õpetajat üles tooma õpetamisse õppimisrõõmu ning muutma klassiruum avastamispaigaks, mitte pelgalt passiivse õppimise kohaks. Pühendugem sellisele õpiteele, mis hindab kaasahaaravat ja rõõmsat õppimist sama kõrgelt kui akadeemilist põhjalikkust. Kui õpilased tunnevad õppimisest rõõmu, kujuneb neist elukestvaid õppijaid ja innovaatorid. See pole pelgalt õpetamisviisi muutus – see on kultuurimuutus suunas, mis soodustab kirglikke, võimekaid õppijaid, kes janunevad teadmiste järele. Tähistagem õppimist kui vaimu ja hinge seiklust. (Dr. Tristha Ramamurthy on Ekya Koolide asutaja ja CMR Ülikooli prorektor.)

article_content: A vibrant photograph of an olive tree surrounded by tulips has won the Royal Horticultural Society’s annual photographic competition, standing out among thousands of entries worldwide. Josie Elias, from Sherborne, Dorset, received a £1,000 prize for her winning image, which she captured at Plantas Distintas in Marnes, Spain after discovering the iris garden there. This year’s competition received a record number of entries. Other top images included John Cocks’s expertly-timed photo of a leaping mouse (Wildlife in the Garden category), Tim Hunt’s striking image of a skeletal tree in a snowy landscape (Plant Portrait category), and close-up shots of insects on plants. Josie Elias said she was drawn to the contrast between the ancient olive tree and the colorful spring flowers, and was encouraged by the nursery owners to submit the photograph. She expressed her excitement and honor at winning the competition. Judge Chris Young, editor of The Garden magazine, praised the photograph for its beautiful composition and vibrant portrayal of springtime. He commented that Josie’s image perfectly captured the spirit of a spring garden. Competition organiser James Arnold noted the record-breaking number of entries, which doubled last year’s figures. He remarked that the judges were amazed by the exceptional quality of photographs submitted from around the globe. Other noteworthy entries included Martin Snelson’s highly commended wildlife photo, Hansa Tangmanpoowadol’s image in the People in the Garden category, Amber Rose Amos’s winning entry in the Under-11’s category, and Alex Berryman, aged 15, who was named RHS Young Photographer of the Year for his photo of a baby robin’s first flight.

Josie Elias Sherbornest, Dorsetist, sai oma võidupildi eest 1 000 naela suuruse auhinna. Ta pildistas selle Hispaanias, Marnes’s asuvas Plantas Distintas aiakeskuses pärast iiriste aia avastamist. article_content: The annual WOMAD festival unites musicians and audiences from around the world for a celebration of global music. Scheduled for July 24–27 at Charlton Park in Wiltshire, this year’s edition features about 100 acts from 40 countries, offering genres ranging from folk and African rhythms to soul, reggae, Indian classical music, and experimental sounds. Headliners include legendary soul singer Bobby Womack, Senegalese star Youssou N’Dour, Alice Russell, Nitin Sawhney, New Zealand’s Fat Freddy’s Drop, renowned folk musician Richard Thompson, and sarod virtuoso Amjad Ali Khan performing with sons Amaan and Ayaan. The program further showcases Kathryn Williams, Public Service Broadcasting, Les Ambassadeurs, and more. WOMAD is designed to be family-friendly, with workshops in arts, crafts, and cooking—including live demonstrations and a children’s cookery workshop. The Taste the World area spotlights a wide variety of international and local cuisine, making the event a culinary as well as musical journey. Festival-goers are encouraged to explore the grounds and discover both mainstage stars and hidden gems. WOMAD has a daily attendance cap of 40,000 and three-day tickets are £160. Children under 13 attend free with a ticketed adult.

article_content: Once a lively community, Toomsboro, Georgia has faced economic struggles since its local school and most businesses closed down decades ago. Today, a real estate developer has put nearly all of the town’s noteworthy, century-old buildings up for sale with an asking price of $2.5 million. The properties on the market include a restored hotel, a train depot, an old bank, a grit mill, a restaurant, a 500-seat opera house, and more—each reflecting Toomsboro’s long history. An artesian well is even part of the package. Local legend suggests the hotel once provided shelter to Civil War General Sherman. Despite the prominent ‘for sale’ signs, not everything in Toomsboro is up for grabs. Several core businesses, such as the convenience store, post office, and a flower shop, remain privately owned and are not included in the sale. Resident Clarice Harrison clarified, ‘It’s not the entire town. Where I live isn’t for sale at all.’ Around 700 people call Toomsboro home, many with lifelong connections to the area and memories of a busier time. The town began to decline in the late 1950s after losing its main employer, which led other businesses to leave. Mayor Roger Smith acknowledges Toomsboro’s untapped potential, describing it as a small, overlooked community. Developer David Bumgardner bought over 50 acres from preservationist Bill Lucado about ten years ago, with the idea of creating a tourist attraction. Those efforts shifted, and now both men are marketing the properties, hoping to attract buyers—particularly from film or music companies—who might appreciate the historic charm. This approach has some precedent: Actress Kim Basinger famously purchased the town of Braselton, Georgia as a film set in 1989. While that deal didn’t turn out profitably, Bill Lucado points out that Toomsboro is unique for its well-preserved buildings and enduring sense of community, something he hopes won’t be lost. Efforts are also underway to build a website for interested parties to learn more about the available buildings. Bumgardner and Lucado remain optimistic that Toomsboro’s character and potential will attract the right buyer seeking a distinctive setting, either for film, music, or other creative projects.

Linnapea Roger Smith peab Toomsborot suure potentsiaaliga paigaks, kirjeldades linna kui väikest ja tähelepanuta jäänut. Arendaja David Bumgardner ostis umbes kümme aastat tagasi üle 20 hektari säilitamishuvilise Bill Lucadolt, eesmärgiga muuta linn turismiobjektiks. See plaan aga muutus ja nüüd müüvad mõlemad mehed ajaloolisi hooneid, lootes leida ostjaid — eriti filmi- või muusikatööstusest —, kes hindaksid ajaloolist võlu. Samuti on töös koduleht, kus huvilised saavad müüdavate hoonete kohta rohkem teavet. Bumgardner ja Lucado jäävad optimistlikuks, et just Toomsboro iseloom ja võimalused köidavad õige ostja — olgu selleks siis film, muusika või mõni muu loomeprojekt.

article_content:
Lobbyists for major emitters from the Global North should not be allowed to advance ineffective climate solutions at COP28. The 2023 United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP28) is scheduled for late November in Dubai, ending a year of record-breaking heat. The conference aims to galvanize global action to cut greenhouse gas emissions and strengthen climate adaptation. However, climate activists and civil society groups caution that unless there is a significant shift in approach, COP28 could fail to achieve substantive progress.

There is ongoing concern in the Global South that wealthy nations and multinational corporations will push for self-serving policies, leaving responsibility and hardship with poorer countries, which contribute the least to climate change. This pattern was apparent at the Africa Climate Summit in Nairobi in September 2023, where leaders from governments, business, international organizations, and civil society sought to unify Africa’s stance on critical issues such as loss-and-damage compensation, climate mitigation, and finance ahead of COP28. Nevertheless, the summit’s outcome—the Nairobi Declaration—did not embody consensus or put African priorities first, largely due to the considerable influence of Global North and corporate lobbyists who promoted questionable solutions.

At the same time, many activists and civil society delegates championing the interests of African communities encountered restricted access and felt marginalized. Rather than adopting policies requiring Global North nations to compensate Africa for historic emissions, the summit favored approaches likely to disadvantage African nations. The Nairobi Declaration endorsed controversial practices—including carbon credits, offsetting, and trading—criticized by many as ineffective. These mechanisms allow wealthy countries to persist in polluting while maintaining control over African land, often undermining local communities who rely on these lands for survival.

For instance, carbon trading permits large polluters to 'offset' their emissions by supporting carbon capture efforts elsewhere, such as reforestation or forest preservation. Although this provides funding to biodiverse countries in the Global South, it often overlooks the rights of local populations who depend on forested areas for their livelihoods. Consequently, carbon trading can lead to displacement and disenfranchisement of these communities in the name of environmental preservation. Research indicates these schemes have failed to significantly lower emissions globally and have become tools for corporations and wealthy nations to avoid making genuine reductions—a phenomenon known as 'greenwashing.'

An alternative gaining support among activists is the 'cap and share' model. This approach proposes a global carbon tax that would hold polluters—mainly fossil fuel producers and major consumers in the Global North—financially accountable for their emissions. Revenue collected would support a global Green New Deal, fund renewable energy transitions, ensure universal energy access, and provide loss-and-damage, adaptation, and mitigation grants to the Global South. Research suggests a global carbon tax could have progressive economic effects, even eradicating extreme poverty across participating African nations.

As COP28 approaches, it is crucial to learn from the shortcomings of previous climate summits, especially the Africa Climate Summit. The perspectives of climate activists and civil society from the Global South must be amplified. There is a clear rejection of carbon markets and the commodification of African land and carbon for the benefit of the North. Advocates are instead calling for unconditional climate finance and true climate justice.

Suuremate saastajate, eriti Põhja riikide lobistidel, ei tohiks lubada COP28 kliimakonverentsil ebatõhusaid lahendusi esile tõsta. 2023. aasta ÜRO kliimamuutuste konverents (COP28) toimub novembri lõpus Dubais ning see märgib rekordkuumusega aasta lõppu. Konverentsi eesmärk on tõhustada ülemaailmseid samme kasvuhoonegaaside vähendamiseks ja kliimamuutustega kohanemiseks. Kuid kliimaaktivistid ja kodanikuühiskonna rühmitused hoiatavad, et ilma põhjaliku paradigma muutuseta võib COP28 jääda ilma tõelisest edust.

Lõunariikides kardetakse jätkuvalt, et jõukad riigid ja rahvusvahelised korporatsioonid suruvad läbi enda huvidele vastavaid poliitikaid, jättes suurema vastutuse ning raskuse vaesematele riikidele, kes kliimamuutustesse kõige vähem panustavad. Sarnast olukorda nähti ka septembris 2023 Nairobis Aafrika kliimatippkohtumisel, kus valitsuste, ettevõtete, rahvusvaheliste organisatsioonide ja kodanikuühiskonna esindajad otsisid ühist seisukohta peamistes küsimustes enne COP28: nagu kaotuste ja kahjude hüvitamine, kliimamuutuste leevendamine ning kliimaraha. Tippkohtumise tulemus – Nairobi deklaratsioon – ei peegeldanud siiski konsensust ega seadnud esikohale Aafrika huve, kuna Põhja riikide ja suurkorporatsioonide lobistidel oli märkimisväärne mõju ning nad surusid läbi küsitavaid lahendusi.

Samal ajal jäi paljudel aktivistidel ja kodanikuühiskonna esindajatel, kes seisid Aafrika kogukondade eest, ligipääs piiratud ning nad tundsid end kõrvalejäetuna. Selle asemel, et propageerida poliitikat, mis kohustaks põhjariike Aafrikat kompenseerima ajalooliste heitmete eest, eelistati hoopis neid lahendusi, mis võivad Aafrika riikidele kahju tuua. Nairobi deklaratsioon toetab vastuolulisi meetodeid – nagu süsinikukrediite, kompenseerimis- ja kauplemissüsteemid –, mida kriitikud nimetavad ebatõhusateks. Sellised mehhanismid võimaldavad rikastel riikidel jätkata saastamist, kontrollides samal ajal Aafrika maad ja kahjustades kohalikke kogukondi, kelle elatis sõltub neist aladest.

Näiteks süsinikukaubandus võimaldab suurte saastajatel "kompenseerida" oma heitmeid toetades süsiniku sidumist mujal, nagu metsade istutamise või säilitamise kaudu. Ka see raha liigub bioloogiliselt mitmekesistesse lõunariikidesse, kuid tihti ei arvestata kohalike inimeste õigusi ja elatusvahendeid. Seega võib süsinikukaubandus põhjustada nende kogukondade tõrjumist ja õiguste võõrandamist looduskaitse nime all. Uuringud näitavad, et sellised süsteemid pole suutnud globaalset heitmete taset märkimisväärselt vähendada ning neid kasutatakse tihti rohepesuks ehk ettevõtete ja rikaste riikide jaoks, kes väldivad tegelikke kärpeid.

Alternatiivina kogub üha rohkem toetust nn cap and share ehk ülemaailmne süsinikumaks, kus suurimad saastajad, eriti põhjariikides, maksavad oma heitmete eest. Saadud tulu suunataks globaalse rohelise kokkuleppe ning taastuvenergia arendamise rahastamiseks, universaalse energia kättesaadavuse tagamiseks ja lõunariikidele kahjude hüvitamiseks ning kohanemise toetuseks. Uuringud näitavad, et globaalne süsinikumaks võiks anda olulist majanduslikku kasu ning aidata likvideerida äärmuslikku vaesust Aafrika riikides.

COP28 eel on oluline võtta õppust senistest kliimasündmustest, eeskätt Aafrika kliimatippkohtumisest. Globaalse lõuna kliimaaktivistide ja kodanikuühiskonna hääled peavad olema esindatud. article_content: On Thursday, numerous wildfires swept across parts of Oklahoma and Texas, destroying a town and damaging several neighborhoods, including one in Oklahoma City. Hurricane-strength winds fueled the flames, making containment efforts challenging. In Bowie, Texas—roughly 70 miles northwest of Fort Worth—firefighters struggled to control a grass fire, while blazes were reported throughout the region. The fires covered vast areas, with flying embers sparking additional outbreaks. By Thursday afternoon, safety officials had yet to determine the total number of active fires. According to Texas Forest Service spokeswoman Misty Wilburn, the 100-resident town of Stoneburg, located northwest of Dallas near the Oklahoma border, was 'burned over' by a 25,000-acre fire, prompting a full evacuation. In Oklahoma, an estimated 75 to 100 homes were destroyed, and 13 people were reported injured, with two critically hurt, according to emergency officials. Wilburn reported that Texas authorities were battling at least nine major fires Thursday evening—seven in the state's west and two in the north. 'Everything we have is committed to fires,' she said. 'Everyone is maxed out.' High winds, gusting up to 76 mph—equivalent to a Category 1 hurricane—fueled the fires and hindered emergency aircraft operations. In southwest Oklahoma City, fires engulfed eight homes, with many more threatened. In Choctaw, Oklahoma, dozens of homes were destroyed, and the local high school was at risk, according to police dispatcher Silva Schneider. Aerial footage from Oklahoma City, home to about 9,000 people, showed multiple neighborhoods consumed by flames. Mandatory evacuations were ordered in the Oklahoma towns of Velma, Sparks, Wellston, Healdton, and Midwest City as dry, windy conditions provided ample fuel for the wildfires. Albert Ashwood, director of Oklahoma's emergency management department, called it 'a bad day in Oklahoma.' Grass fires were also reported west of Dallas-Fort Worth, with smoke drifting into the cities. Ashwood noted that weather experts feared the fires could spread into more populated areas as windy conditions persist into the night. Texas Forest Service reported fires in several counties near Fort Worth, Wichita Falls, and Amarillo. The number of fires overwhelmed some firefighters, forcing them to prioritize the most critical blazes while strong winds grounded most firefighting aircraft. The National Weather Service labeled much of Texas and Oklahoma as an 'extremely critical fire weather area' Thursday due to ongoing drought and severe winds, with large portions of both states experiencing drought conditions. A firefighter near Lindsey, Oklahoma sustained third-degree burns on 35% of his body and remains in critical condition, according to hospital officials. An Oklahoma motorist was also hospitalized after driving into dense smoke. Despite these challenges, firefighters achieved some success in containment. In Breckenridge, Texas, a landfill fire that burned several hundred acres was contained north of city limits, only for another blaze to be reported soon after. As night fell, improved conditions allowed some firefighting aircraft to resume operations, and five fires in Texas were at least partially contained. CNN's Hank Bishop and Aaron Cooper contributed to this report.

Oklahoma City edelaosas põles maha kaheksa maja, ohus olid paljud teisedki. Oklahomas Choctaw's hävis mitukümmend kodu ning kohalik keskkool oli samuti ohus, ütles politsei dispetšer Silva Schneider. Ashwood tõi välja, et ilmaekspertide kinnitusel võib öine tugev tuul kanda põlengud ka tihedamad asustusega aladele. USA Ilmateenistus kuulutas suure osa Texasest ja Oklahomast neljapäeval „äärmiselt kriitiliseks tuleohu piirkonnaks” seoses kestvate põudade ja tugevate tuultega – mõlemas osariigis esineb suures ulatuses põuda. Õhtu saabudes võimaldasid paremad olud mõningate päästelennukite töö ning viiest Texase põlengust said vähemalt osaliselt kontrolli alla. CNN-i panustasid sellesse loosse Hank Bishop ja Aaron Cooper.

In response to the conflict in Syria, Israeli officials are reportedly preparing to accept Syrian Alawites if President Bashar al-Assad's regime falls. Israel's military chief of staff, Benny Gantz, recently told a Knesset committee that Alawites could be permitted to settle in the Golan Heights, according to a spokesman for lawmaker Avi Dichter. The Golan Heights, under Israeli control since capture from Syria in 1967 and subsequent annexation, is still regarded internationally as occupied territory. The area is home to about 41,000 residents, among them Jewish settlers, Druze, and some Alawites. 

Israeli authorities believe Assad’s regime, primarily composed of Alawites—a minority offshoot of Shiite Islam—is likely to collapse soon, as the Sunni majority drives the opposition. As a result, Israel is considering the possibility that many Alawites may flee toward the Golan and wants to be ready. 

Jonathan Spyer, from the Global Research in International Affairs Center in Herzliya, noted that Defense Minister Ehud Barak recently predicted Assad’s imminent fall. Spyer commented that Israel’s traditionally hands-off approach regarding internal Arab affairs makes the decision to admit refugees a significant shift. He also questioned the timing of these predictions, suggesting Israel’s intelligence may be ahead of public information.

article_content: Abbas-Mustan’s film Baazigar recently marked its 30th anniversary since release. Starring Shah Rukh Khan, Shilpa Shetty, and Kajol, the movie was a major box office success when it premiered in 1993. Baazigar featured Shah Rukh Khan in his first anti-hero role and has remained one of his most discussed films. During the movie’s trial screenings, audiences were confused about Ajay Sharma’s (Shah Rukh Khan) motive for killing Seema (Shilpa Shetty). To address this, directors Abbas-Mustan altered the storyline, introducing a revenge angle tied to Ajay's father. Actor Ananth Narayan Mahadevan, who played Shah Rukh Khan’s father in the film, recently shared how his role was added after filming was completed. He recalled that Abbas-Mustan had promised to cast him after their movie Khiladi (1992), but he was not called for Baazigar initially. Unexpectedly, he later received a call from their assistant asking him to meet with the directors. "I wondered why I was being called, since the film was already finished," Ananth told Bollywood Hungama. He explained, "They said after the trial show, people questioned why Shah Rukh Khan’s character was killing girls without any apparent reason. So, they wrote the father’s backstory to give motive and sympathy for his actions, and wanted me to play the father alongside Rakhee Gulzar as the mother." Ananth said he felt grateful to be remembered, and his scenes were added to the film. According to him, the new storyline helped evoke sympathy for Shah Rukh’s character, making the narrative more convincing. For more updates and the latest Bollywood news, follow The Indian Express.

Baazigar tõi Shah Rukh Khani esmakordselt anti-kangelase rolli ning sellest on saanud üks tema kõige rohkem kõneainet pakkunud filme. Näitleja Ananth Narayan Mahadevan, kes kehastas Shah Rukh Khani isa, rääkis hiljuti, kuidas tema roll filmile pärast võtteid lisati. Ootamatult sai ta siiski nende assistendilt kutse kohtumiseks. "Imestasin, miks mind kutsutakse, kui film on juba valmis," rääkis Ananth väljaandele Bollywood Hungama. At RAF Waddington’s International Airshow in Lincolnshire, university lecturer and amateur photographer David Sleight captured a striking image of two Red Arrows jets seemingly coming dangerously close mid-air. This occurred during a synchronized, high-speed manoeuvre that thrilled the crowd as the jets dramatically crossed paths just in time. Sleight, aged 51 and Dean of Public Engagement at the University of Lincoln, attended as a guest of honour, thanks to his RAF connections.

He described the photo as a ‘once-in-a-lifetime’ moment, noting he had taken several pictures throughout the spectacle, but none as rare as this. The Red Arrows, renowned for their disciplined aerobatic displays, marked their 50th anniversary by painting the sky in red, white, and blue. The RAF Waddington airshow draws over 140,000 visitors and is the largest of its kind in the UK.

Sleight rushed to show the unedited photograph to his friends, explaining how unusual it was to capture the jets almost nose-to-nose. He called it a ‘golden moment.’

The Red Arrows fly modified BAE Hawk T1 jets outfitted to emit coloured smoke during their displays. The RAF clarified that the photo showed their synchro pair performing a practiced, safe manoeuvre, underscoring the pilots’ skill in routinely executing such stunts.

See juhtus sünkroonse, suure kiirusega manöövri ajal, mis pakkus publikule põnevust, kui lennukid üksteisest viimasel hetkel üle lendasid. 51-aastane Sleight, Lincolni ülikooli avaliku kaasamise dekaan, oli tänu sidemetele RAF-iga kutsutud peakülaliseks.

Ta nimetas seda fotot „elu jooksul vaid korra tehtavaks kaadriks“, öeldes, et oli kogu ürituse jooksul teinud palju pilte, aga selline haruldane hetk oli erakordne. Kuulus Red Arrowsi meeskond tähistas oma 50. aastapäeva, värvides taeva punase, valge ja sinise suitsuga. RAF Waddingtoni lennushow on Suurbritannia suurim ja toob kokku üle 140 000 külastaja.

Pärast pildistamist kiirustas Sleight seda sõpradele näitama, et tõestada, et tegemist pole fototöötlusega – nii lähedalt jäädvustada lennukite „ninapidi“ möödumist on väga haruldane. Ta nimetas seda hetke „kuldseks hetkeks“.

Red Arrowsi piloodid lendavad kohandatud BAE Hawk T1 reaktiivlennukitega, mis suudavad luua eri värvi suitsuribasid. RAF täpsustas, et fotol on kujutatud nende synchro pair’i harjutatud ja turvaline manööver, rõhutades lendurite oskusi ning igapäevast kogemust selliste trikkide sooritamisel.

article_content: Ahmed Dangiwa, Nigeria’s Housing and Urban Development Minister, has set up a panel of experts from various sectors to lead comprehensive reforms aimed at making housing more affordable and effective in Nigeria. Badamasi Haiba, the Ministry’s Director of Information, stated that this panel will analyze and propose updates to important laws—such as the Land Use Act (1978), National Housing Fund Act (1992), Federal Mortgage Bank of Nigeria Establishment Act (1993), and Federal Housing Authority Act (1973)—to reflect current needs. The announcement was made during a meeting at the Ministry’s headquarters in Abuja, attended by a group from the Housing Development Advocacy Network (HDAN), headed by Ugochukwu Obiora Chime. The new team consists of representatives from HDAN, various agencies, professional groups, and universities. Their assignment is to evaluate and merge earlier reform plans, identify gaps in the sector, and propose legislative improvements to boost efficiency, transparency, and accountability in housing administration. The Minister also revealed that a specialized team is working with the National Population Commission on new tools for gathering housing data during the upcoming national census. Dangiwa mentioned recent collaborations with the Presidential Technical Committee on Land Reforms, which brought access to over a decade of research. An internal committee is now considering the creation of a National Land Commission to oversee Land Use Act regulation as part of a broader land policy strategy. The Renewed Hope Cities project aims to deliver 34,500 new homes for lower- and middle-income Nigerians, while also providing terraces, bungalows, and duplexes for the affluent, across all six geopolitical zones, including the Federal Capital Territory. Additionally, 500 site-based affordable housing units (1-3 bedrooms) are being developed in the other thirty states under the Renewed Hope Estates program. These projects will be funded through the Ministry's budget, support from the Federal Mortgage Bank of Nigeria, and collaborations with private developers, with options for mortgages, rent-to-own, or outright purchase for buyers. HDAN leader Ugochukwu Chime acknowledged the crucial role housing can play in sparking employment and economic growth, urging deeper reforms to recognize shelter’s impact beyond just providing homes. The group also called on the Minister to tackle high fees for land occupancy certificates and form a committee to address lingering housing bills in parliament.
translated_content: Nigeeria elamumajanduse ja linnaplaneerimise minister Ahmed Dangiwa on kokku pannud eksperdid erinevatest valdkondadest, et viia läbi põhjalikke reforme, mis muudaksid riigi elamumajanduse taskukohasemaks ja tõhusamaks. Ministeeriumi teabejuht Badamasi Haiba teatas, et see töörühm hakkab analüüsima ja värskendama olulisi seadusi – nagu maa kasutamise seadus (1978), riiklik elamufondi seadus (1992), Nigeeria Föderaalse Hüpoteegipanga asutamise seadus (1993) ning Föderaalse Elamuameti seadus (1973) –, et need vastaksid tänapäeva vajadustele. See teade tehti ministeeriumi peakorteris Abujas koosolekul, millest võttis osa ka Housing Development Advocacy Network’i (HDAN) delegatsioon eesotsas Ugochukwu Obiora Chime'iga. Uus töörühm koosneb HDANi, erinevate ametite, kutseühenduste ja ülikoolide esindajatest. Neil on ülesandeks hinnata ning ühendada varasemad reformikavad, tuvastada sektori puudujäägid ning teha ettepanekuid õiguslike paranduste kohta, et tõsta elamumajanduse tõhusust, läbipaistvust ja vastutust. Minister avaldas ka, et erimeeskond töötab koos riikliku rahvastikukomisjoniga uute elamumajanduse andmete kogumise tööriistade väljatöötamisel eesootava rahvaloenduse tarbeks. Dangiwa mainis hiljutist koostööd presidendi maareformi tehnilise komisjoniga, mille tulemusena saadi ligipääs üle kümne aasta uuringutele. Sisekomisjon kaalub nüüd riikliku maaameti loomist, mis hakkaks regulatsiooni ja maa kasutuse üle järelevalvet teostama kui osa laiemast maapoliitika strateegiast. Renewed Hope Cities projektiga tahetakse üle riigi kuues geopoliitilises piirkonnas ja föderaalpealinna territooriumil ehitada 34 500 uut kodu madala ja keskmise sissetulekuga inimestele, samuti ridaelamuid, bungalosid ja duplexeid jõukamatele. Lisaks arendatakse ülejäänud kolmekümnes osariigis Renewed Hope Estates programmi all veel ka 500 soodsa hinnaga, 1–3 magamistoaga elamut igale asukohale. Neid projekte rahastatakse ministeeriumi eelarvest, Nigeeria Föderaalse Hüpoteegipanga toel ning koostöös era-arendajatega, pakutakse koduostuks laenu, üürista-osta võimalust või kohest väljaostu. HDANi juht Ugochukwu Chime tõi välja elamumajanduse tähtsa rolli tööhõive ja majanduskasvu edendamisel, kutsudes üles veelgi põhjalikumatele reformidele, mis väärtustaksid eluaset mitte vaid koduna, vaid ka sotsiaalmajandusliku arengu mootorina. Delegatsioon palus ministril tegeleda kõrgete maa kasutussertifikaatide tasudega ning moodustada komisjon, mis lahendaks parlamendis seisvad elamumajanduse seaduseelnõud.

article_content: Pope Francis has provided Christmas packages to 2,000 immigrants at the Dono di Maria shelter near the Vatican. Each package contained a Christmas card signed by the Pope, postage stamps, a pre-paid international calling card, and a free day pass for the Rome metro. These gifts were intended to help recipients reconnect with their families during the festive season. The care packages were distributed by Papal almoner Archbishop Konrad Krajewski and the sisters at the shelter. Sister Michelle, the superior of Mother Teresa’s Missionaries of Charity in Rome, reported that the recipients were very happy. She also noted that Pope Benedict XVI had previously supported those in need through similar, albeit less publicized, efforts, according to the Catholic News Agency. Additionally, Pope Francis recently recorded an amateur video in which he praised the work of 'cartoneros'—poor individuals who collect recyclable materials from waste. He recognized their work as dignified and beneficial for the environment. Francis emphasized that much food discarded each day could feed all the world's hungry and highlighted his long-standing support for the 'cartoneros,' including celebrating Mass for them during his time in Argentina and inviting them on stage at World Youth Day.

article_content: Disney's "Wreck-It Ralph" showed that video game-themed movies can succeed at the box office, debuting with $49.1 million from 3,752 theaters—a record opening for Walt Disney Animation Studios (not including Pixar titles). Previously, Disney's "Tangled" opened with $48.8 million over Thanksgiving 2010, so "Wreck-It Ralph's" $13,086 per theater average and higher overall take mark a major win. Disney is now preparing for the lucrative Thanksgiving and Christmas movie seasons, anticipating strong attendance as families have time off. Dave Hollis, Disney's Executive Vice President of Domestic Distribution, named DreamWorks' "Rise of the Guardians" and Disney's 3-D re-release of "Monsters, Inc." as the leading animated competitors for the rest of 2012. He expressed optimism due to the film's strong word-of-mouth and relatable story. "Wreck-It Ralph" earned an "A" CinemaScore from audiences, increasing its chances for continued success. "Flight," directed by Robert Zemeckis and starring Denzel Washington, took second place with $25 million from 1,884 theaters. With a $31 million budget, it led the Top 20 for per-theater average at $13,275. This is Washington's second box office hit in 2012 after "Safe House," which opened with $40.2 million and finished at $126.2 million. "Flight," which received an "A-" CinemaScore and favorable reviews, is expected to surpass $100 million. "Argo," directed by Ben Affleck, continued its strong performance, adding $10.2 million in its fourth weekend—a modest 15 percent drop—bringing its total to $75.9 million. With a $45 million budget, "Argo" is receiving significant awards buzz and should surpass the $100 million mark soon. Affleck's last film to do this was 2003's "Daredevil" at $102.5 million. "The Man with the Iron Fists" debuted in fourth with $8.2 million, as anticipated. Universal invested $15 million in the film, which was directed by RZA and promoted with producer Quentin Tarantino's name. The audience was 64 percent male and 53 percent under 30, and the movie received a "C+" CinemaScore. "Taken 2" rounded out the top five, earning $6 million in its fifth weekend and totaling $125.7 million in North America. The film has made $336.6 million worldwide, outperforming the original's international take. Internationally, "Skyfall," the 23rd James Bond film, made headlines by earning $156 million over one weekend outside the U.S., totaling $287 million in 10 days—the franchise's best start ever. The film took in $25.7 million its second weekend in the UK for a cumulative $85.8 million, and debuted in Germany with $23.9 million, the country's best opening of 2012. "Skyfall" debuts in the U.S. next weekend, with predictions of a record franchise opening. Top 5 films at the weekend box office: 1. "Wreck-It Ralph" – $49.1M; 2. "Flight" – $25M; 3. "Argo" – $10.2M; 4. "The Man with the Iron Fists" – $8.2M; 5. "Taken 2" – $6M.

article_content: The bidding process for the 2018 and 2022 FIFA World Cups has sparked unprecedented controversy. FIFA’s decision to select both hosts simultaneously has been widely criticized, with many alleging that it encouraged collusion among bidders—a charge denied by FIFA. The situation escalated after the British newspaper The Sunday Times revealed that undercover reporters had secretly filmed two members of FIFA’s 24-member executive committee allegedly offering to sell their votes. Following these revelations, Amos Adamu of Nigeria and Reynald Temarii of Tahiti were suspended by FIFA's ethics panel, reducing the number of voting members to 22. The same ethics panel later cleared the Qatar 2022 and Spain-Portugal 2018 bids of collusion accusations, which had emerged as a result of the Sunday Times investigation. Closer to the final decision, another British media outlet, the BBC, alleged that Issa Hayatou (president of the Confederation of African Football), Nicolas Leoz (head of the South American football confederation), and Ricardo Teixeira (president of the Brazilian football association) had taken bribes in the 1990s. These developments represent the latest chapter in the ongoing scrutiny of the World Cup bid process, culminating in the decisive vote scheduled for Thursday. CNN presents a pictorial timeline of key events since the process began in early 2009.

article_content: Ashton Carter, the newly appointed U.S. Secretary of Defense, arrived in Afghanistan on Saturday morning to meet with American troops and Afghan leaders. Carter, who was confirmed by the Senate on February 12, recently succeeded Chuck Hagel in the position. Speaking to reporters aboard his flight to Kabul, Carter explained that he chose Afghanistan as his first official destination because approximately 10,000 American troops remain stationed there, stating, 'They come first in my mind always.' During his visit, Carter is scheduled to meet U.S. military leaders, Afghan President Ashraf Ghani, and Afghanistan’s Chief Executive Officer Abdullah Abdullah. He will also visit Bagram and Kandahar to meet U.S. troops before departing for Kuwait. In Kuwait, Carter plans to meet with American military leaders, troops, and Kuwaiti officials before leaving the country on Tuesday morning. Carter emphasized his desire to better understand the situation in Afghanistan and America’s ongoing role: 'I have seen reports of all kinds giving assessments of how things are going in Afghanistan and I'm just coming back into the government now and trying to wrap my mind around it.' Addressing reports of ISIS activity in Afghanistan, Carter noted, 'I've seen the reports of people essentially rebranding themselves as ISIL here in Afghanistan as has occurred in other places. The reports I've seen still have them in small numbers and aspirational.' Carter, 60, is a respected technocrat with a background in theoretical physics and medieval history from Yale and Oxford. Prior to this appointment, he held several senior positions at the Pentagon. Chuck Hagel, Carter’s predecessor and a former Republican senator, resigned after less than two years in the role due to challenges integrating with President Barack Obama's national security team at the White House. (Reporting by CNN’s Diane Ruggiero.)

article_content: Local authorities report that a damaged wooden boat containing decomposed bodies was found near Sado Island on Japan’s western coast. Police noted the presence of faint symbols resembling Korean characters, but said they were too unclear to confirm, according to Toshiyuki Kojima, deputy chief of Sado Nishi Police Station. The boat was discovered early Wednesday after drifting onto rocks in Mano Bay, Sado City. The time spent at sea is unknown, and the number of bodies has not been officially disclosed; some remains had decomposed to skeletons. Japanese media reported there were five bodies. Such incidents involving North Koreans attempting to reach Japan by boat are rare, though isolated cases have been recorded, including groups arriving in 1987, 2006, and a group of nine in 2022 who later resettled in South Korea.

An old, battered silver teapot, initially valued at £120, stunned auction-goers when it sold for £2,200. This sale formed part of a family collection that reached a record-breaking total of £140,000. The anonymous owner brought the teapot to the BBC's 'Flog It!' valuation event, where auctioneers Henry Aldridge & Son investigated further. They discovered the teapot belonged to a group of antiques brought back from Tibet by the owner's grandfather, who had joined Colonel Francis Younghusband's 1903 British expedition—the first time British explorers had gained access to Tibet.

The collection featured 140 rare photographs and four statuettes of Tibetan deities. Two statuettes sold for £77,000 and £45,000, while the photographs earned over £12,000. 'Flog It!' presenter Paul Martin and auctioneer Andrew Aldridge highlighted the rarity and historical value of the pieces, noting that the collection had been kept within the family and was previously unknown to collectors.

The Younghusband expedition, lasting from December 1903 to September 1904, was a controversial British-Indian military campaign into Tibet. Led by Colonel Younghusband under Lord Curzon's orders, the mission responded to concerns about threats to British interests in the region. It involved armed conflict, most tragically the violent clash at Guru, and resulted in a treaty favoring British trade in Tibet. The Dalai Lama fled during the incursion.

The BBC confirmed that this exceptional collection set a new auction record for the 'Flog It!' show.
translated_content:
Vana, kulunud hõbekann, mille algseks väärtuseks hinnati vaid 120 naela, üllatas kõiki oksjonil, kui see müüdi 2200 naelaga. Müük oli osa perekonna kollektsioonist, mis kogus kokku rekordilised 140 000 naela. Anonüümne omanik tõi kannu BBC "Flog It!" hindamispäevale, kus oksjonimaja Henry Aldridge & Son süvauuring näitas, et kann kuulus antiikesemete hulka, mille omaniku vanaisa tõi Tiibetist tagasi, olles osalenud kolonel Francis Younghusbandi 1903. aasta Briti ekspeditsioonil—esimest korda said britid pääsu Tiibetisse.

Kollektsioonis oli 140 haruldast fotot ja neli Tiibeti jumalusekuju. Kaks kuju müüdi 77 000 ja 45 000 naela eest, fotod tõid üle 12 000 naela. "Flog It!" saatejuht Paul Martin ja oksjonipidaja Andrew Aldridge rõhutasid, kui haruldased ja ajalooliselt väärtuslikud on need esemed, kuna kogu kollektsioon oli seni pereringis ja kollektsionääridele tundmatu.

Younghusbandi ekspeditsioon kestis 1903. aasta detsembrist kuni 1904. aasta septembrini ning oli vastuoluline Briti-India sõjaline missioon Tiibetisse. Ekspeditsiooni juhtis kolonel Younghusband lord Curzoni käsul, sest kardeti ohte Briti huvidele piirkonnas. Missioon hõlmas relvastatud kokkupõrkeid, neist kurikuulsaim oli Guru lahing, ning lõppes leppega, mis andis britidele Tiibetis kaubanduslikke eeliseid. Dalai-laama põgenes nende sündmuste ajal.

BBC kinnitas, et see erakordne kollektsioon püstitas "Flog It!" saates oksjonirekordi.

article_content: Liverpool Football Club is compiling a report on the fitness issues that have affected Daniel Sturridge's career, following news that he has suffered nine injuries to his left thigh. The England striker is now facing another six-week layoff after sustaining his latest injury in training on Monday. This is the second time this season Sturridge has injured his left thigh. Liverpool’s medical staff are currently reviewing his complete injury history, including periods at his previous clubs, to understand the recurring problems. An operation is also being considered as a possible solution. Liverpool manager Brendan Rodgers is scheduled to meet with Sturridge on Friday to discuss the situation. Rodgers stated, 'Most players want to play through injuries to get onto the field. That’s just what you do.' Sturridge has not played for Liverpool since August and could be sidelined until next year. He was seen arriving at Liverpool's Spire Hospital on Wednesday for further assessment. Last season, Sturridge was in excellent form, scoring 28 goals for club and country. However, he has frequently missed games due to various injuries, including: - Ankle ligament injury (England v Republic of Ireland, May 2013); returned for pre-season - Ankle ligament injury (December 2013); missed nine games - Thigh injury (England training, September 2014); missed six weeks - Calf injury (Liverpool training, October 2014); missed three weeks - Thigh injury (Liverpool training, November 2014); expected to miss six weeks Rodgers described the most recent injury as happening during a training session after a simple action where Sturridge felt pain. Medical scans later showed a minor tear near a previous injury site. Rodgers expressed disappointment about losing such a high-quality player. 'Now we have to focus on the players we currently have. It's that simple, though, of course, it's disappointing to lose a player of that quality.' He pointed out that this is Sturridge’s ninth injury to the same area, highlighting a persistent problem. Liverpool have struggled to score goals in Sturridge's absence. However, Rodgers is not certain that buying new players in the transfer window is the solution. Instead, he said, 'We have to look at the players we have,' as Liverpool prepare to face Crystal Palace on Sunday. Sturridge formed a strong partnership with Luis Suarez last season, but now the team is struggling in his absence. Sturridge has spent most of this season watching from the stands due to his injuries.

Inglismaa ründaja ootab nüüd ees veel üks kuuenädalane paus pärast viimast vigastust esmaspäevasel treeningul. See on juba teine kord sel hooajal, kui Sturridge on vasakut jalga vigastanud. Sturridge moodustas eelmisel hooajal tugeva ründepaarilise Luis Suárezega, kuid nüüd on meeskonnal tema puudumise tõttu raskusi. Sturridge on suure osa hooajast pidanud vigastuse tõttu tribüünil istuma.

article_content: NEW DELHI: Russia has signed an agreement with India to supply Igla hand-held anti-aircraft missiles. The agreement also allows for domestic production of the Igla missile system in India, according to Reuters citing the TASS news agency. (Inputs from Reuters)

article_content: Former International Monetary Fund (IMF) chief Dominique Strauss-Kahn has reportedly traveled to Athens to consult with Greek government ministers about addressing Greece's ongoing financial crisis. According to Greek media sources, Strauss-Kahn, who is 63, may be appointed as an advisor to help guide the nation through its economic difficulties. Despite the professional nature of his visit, local reports noted that Strauss-Kahn also visited a nightclub in Athens, where he was seen socializing with friends, including a woman, until the early hours of the morning. Strauss-Kahn, a well-known French economist, has previously been at the center of several high-profile legal cases involving allegations of sexual misconduct. These included an arrest in New York in 2011 over claims of attempted rape, after which criminal charges were later dropped. He subsequently faced further allegations in France, which were also eventually dismissed. Though some controversy remains over claims related to his personal life, Strauss-Kahn's professional qualifications and experience in international finance continue to be recognized. His lawyer, Richard Malka, has characterized him as an individual whose actions have been misrepresented and affirmed that Strauss-Kahn has not committed crimes. The possible appointment has drawn attention given Greece’s recent economic turmoil and the ongoing public protests.
translated_content: Endine Rahvusvahelise Valuutafondi (IMF) juht Dominique Strauss-Kahn reisis väidetavalt Ateenasse, et konsulteerida Kreeka valitsuse ministritega seoses riigi jätkuva finantskriisi lahendamisega. Kreeka meedia allikate kohaselt võib 63-aastasest Strauss-Kahnist saada nõunik, kes aitab riigil majandusraskustega toime tulla. Vaatamata visiidi ametlikule iseloomule märkisid kohalikud raportid, et Strauss-Kahn külastas ka Ateenasse ööklubi, kus teda nähti koos sõprade ja ühe naisterahvaga varajaste hommikutundideni seltskonda nautimas. Strauss-Kahn, tuntud Prantsuse majandusteadlane, on olnud varem mitmete kõrgetasemeliste kohtuasjade keskmes, mis hõlmasid seksuaalse väärkäitumise süüdistusi. Nende seas oli ka tema arreteerimine New Yorgis 2011. aastal vägistamiskatse kahtluse tõttu, kuid kriminaalsüüdistused tühistati hiljem. Ta seisis silmitsi edasiste väidetega ka Prantsusmaal, kuid needki süüdistused lükati lõpuks tagasi. Kuigi tema eraelu ümber on jätkuvalt vastuolusid, tunnustatakse Strauss-Kahni kutseoskusi ja kogemusi rahvusvahelises finantsvaldkonnas. Tema advokaat Richard Malka on andnud mõista, et Strauss-Kahni tegusid on valesti tõlgendatud ja kinnitus, et ta pole kuritegusid toime pannud. Võimalik ametisse nimetamine on pälvinud tähelepanu seoses Kreeka viimase aja majanduslike probleemide ja kestvate avalike protestidega.

article_content: If investing in financial products like credit default swaps or commodity derivatives doesn't excite you, vintage cars could be an appealing alternative. Recently, classic cars have been breaking auction records. Last week, a 1964 Ferrari sold for $14.4 million at the 'Art of the Automobile' auction, more than doubling the previous record for the same model. Sotheby's auctioned 31 classic and concept cars, along with auto-related memorabilia, totaling nearly $63 million in just over two hours in New York City. Over the past decade, the average value of classic cars has increased by 430%, according to Knight Frank's Luxury Investment Index. Comparatively, gold has risen by 273%, and the FTSE 100 index by just 55% in the same timeframe. In July, a 1954 Mercedes-Benz was sold for $29.6 million, setting a new record for the highest price achieved for a car at public auction, surpassing the previous record by $13.3 million. Just yesterday, Ringo Starr's 1964 Facel Vega was auctioned for $553,000 at Bonhams, contributing to a series of lots that saw the auction house record $27.6 million in sales. Bonhams spokesperson Chloe Ashby noted, 'Celebrity ownership often increases a car’s value, though it depends on the celebrity.' She added that demand for vintage cars is rising and, along with jewelry and Asian art, they are now among the top three collecting categories. Dietrich Hatlapa, founder of the Historical Automobile Group, highlighted that classic cars offer unique appeal, especially following the financial crisis. 'People have gravitated toward tangible assets over the past decade. Classic cars are enjoyable, you can drive them, and they've become a lifestyle. They are also a way to transfer wealth between generations.' According to the Historic Automobile Group Index (HAGI), the value of classic cars has already increased by 39% this year. However, industry experts caution that such rapid growth may not continue. Andrew Shirley, editor of the Wealth Report, said, 'I would be surprised if demand and values continue to rise at this pace over the next 10 years.' There are also risks associated with vintage car investments, especially when compared to more conventional options like bonds. Shirley explained that classic cars lack liquidity—selling them can require significant time and research to find a suitable buyer. Trends in demand also fluctuate, so particular models may not always be popular. 'Maintaining these vehicles can be costly, especially if you wish to keep driving them,' Shirley added. Hatlapa advises enthusiasts not to pursue classic cars purely for financial gain. 'Entering the vintage car market for investment alone isn’t wise; genuine passion for classic cars is important,' he said. 'The greatest return comes from owning something you truly love.'
translated_content: Kui investeerimine krediidivahetuslepingutesse või toormederivaatidesse ei paku sulle erilist põnevust, siis vanad autod võivad olla huvitav alternatiiv. Viimasel ajal püstitatakse klassikaliste autode oksjonitel hinnarekordeid. Näiteks müüdi eelmisel nädalal 1964. aasta Ferrari 'Art of the Automobile' oksjonil 14,4 miljoni dollari eest, mis ületas oluliselt eelmise sama mudeli rekordit. Sotheby’s oksjonil New Yorgis müüdi 31 klassikalist ja kontseptsiooniautot ning autoalast mälestuseset kokku peaaegu 63 miljoni dollari eest vaid natuke rohkem kui kahe tunniga. Viimase kümne aastaga on klassikaliste autode keskmine väärtus Knight Franki luksusinvesteeringute indeksi järgi tõusnud 430%. Võrdluseks – kuld on tõusnud 273% ja FTSE 100 indeks kõigest 55% sama ajaga. Juulis müüdi 1954. aasta Mercedes-Benz 29,6 miljoni dollari eest, püstitades uue oksjonite hinnarekordi, mis ületas eelmist rekordit 13,3 miljoni võrra. Alles eile müüdi Ringo Starri 1964. aasta Facel Vega Bonhamsi oksjonil 553 000 dollari eest, aidates kaasa oksjonimaja kogutulule 27,6 miljonit dollarit. Bonhamsi esindaja Chloe Ashby märkis: 'Kuulsale inimesele kuulunud auto väärtus kasvab sageli, aga see oleneb ikkagi kuulsusest.' Ta lisas, et vanade autode nõudlus kasvab ja need kuuluvad koos ehtekunsti ja Aasia kunsti kõrvale kolme peamise kogumisvaldkonna hulka. Historical Automobile Groupi asutaja Dietrich Hatlapa ütles, et klassikalistel autodel on eriline võlu, eriti pärast finantskriisi. 'Viimase kümne aasta jooksul on inimesed rohkem pöördunud materiaalsete varade poole. Klassikalised autod on nauditavad, neid saab juhtida ja neist on saanud elustiil. Need aitavad ka varandust põlvest põlve edasi anda.' Historic Automobile Group Indeksi (HAGI) järgi on klassikaliste autode väärtus sellel aastal juba 39% kasvanud. Samas hoiatavad eksperdid, et nii kiire kasv ei pruugi jätkuda. Wealth Reporti toimetaja Andrew Shirley sõnas: 'Ma oleksin üllatunud, kui nõudlus ja hinnatõus püsivad samamoodi järgmise kümne aasta jooksul.' Vanade autode kui investeeringu puhul on riskid suuremad, eriti võrreldes tavapärasemate võimalustega nagu võlakirjad. Shirley selgitas, et klassikalistel autodel pole head likviidsust – nende müümine võib võtta palju aega ja vaeva, et leida õige ostja. Nõudlus mudelite vastu võib olla muutuv, mistõttu ei pruugi igal ajal kõik mudelid populaarsed olla. 'Nende autode hooldus võib olla kulukas, eriti kui soovid nendega regulaarselt sõita,' lisas Shirley. Hatlapa soovitab mitte sukelduda klassikaliste autode turule ainult raha pärast. 'Ainult investeerimise eesmärgil sinna minna pole mõistlik; oluline on tõeline kirg autode vastu,' ütles ta. 'Kõige väärtuslikum tulu on see, kui omad midagi, mis sulle tõeliselt meeldib.'

article_content:
In his commentary, LZ Granderson examines how voters contribute to political dysfunction in the United States. He references former Washington, D.C. mayor Marion Barry, who was re-elected after a highly publicized drug scandal and federal imprisonment, illustrating the electorate's willingness to overlook significant issues. Granderson also highlights the careers of figures like Newt Gingrich, who has faced both ethical and personal controversies, and Arizona Governor Jan Brewer, who was involved in making misleading statements to support controversial immigration policies and maintained support despite connections to private prison interests.

Granderson argues these cases exemplify a wider problem: voters often ignore major flaws in leadership, favoring easy narratives and slogans over critical evaluation of candidates. The piece criticizes the spread of misinformation—for instance, Michele Bachmann's unsupported claims about vaccines—and points to political disengagement as a cause of government dysfunction. 

The commentary concludes that meaningful change depends on voters making more informed, deliberate decisions, asserting that public responsibility is essential to improving government.
translated_content:
Oma arvamusloos analüüsib LZ Granderson, kuidas valijad ise aitavad kaasa Ameerika Ühendriikide poliitilise süsteemi probleemidele. Ta toob näiteks endise Washingtoni linnapea Marion Barry, kes valiti pärast suurt narkoskandaali ja vanglakaristust uuesti ametisse – see näitab, kui kergesti valijad olulistele probleemidele läbi sõrmede vaatavad. Granderson märgib ka tuntud poliitikuid, nagu Newt Gingrich, kelle karjääris on olnud nii eetilisi kui isiklikke skandaale, ning Arizona kuberner Jan Breweri, kes esitas vastuolulise immigratsioonipoliitika toetuseks tõestamata väiteid ja säilitas oma toetuse hoolimata sidemetest eravanglate äriga.

Grandersoni sõnul peegeldavad need juhtumid laiemat probleemi: valijad jätavad sageli juhtide olulised puudused tähelepanuta ning eelistavad lihtsaid poliitilisi loosungeid sisulisele hinnangule. Artiklis kritiseeritakse valeinfo levikut – näiteks Michele Bachmanni põhjendamata avaldusi vaktsiinide kohta – ning rõhutatakse poliitilise passiivsuse rolli valitsemiskriisi süvenemisel.

Lõpetuseks leiab autor, et päris muutus saab toimuda vaid siis, kui valijad teevad teadlikumaid ja kaalutletumaid valikuid ning avaliku vastutuse kandmine on olulise tähtsusega valitsemise parandamisel.

article_content: On Monday, New Jersey Governor Chris Christie sharply criticized Democratic gubernatorial candidate Mary Burke after her campaign was found to have included parts of a job plan apparently copied from other politicians. Speaking at a rally for Wisconsin Governor Scott Walker, Christie accused Burke, a Harvard Business School graduate and former Trek Bicycle executive, of inappropriately using others' work as her own. Consultant Eric Schnurer, who had worked for Burke’s campaign, was let go earlier this month following a BuzzFeed report highlighting similarities in Burke’s jobs plan to proposals from other candidates. In response, Burke’s team revised the plan, adding proper attributions and firing Schnurer. Burke has defended herself by saying that sourcing effective ideas from various plans is a common and practical approach in economic development, insisting no principles were violated. She pointed out that using successful strategies from elsewhere is meant to help Wisconsin move forward, and the consultant’s reuse of language was not intended to be misleading. As the election approaches, the race between incumbent Walker and Burke remains tight. National politicians have been campaigning in Wisconsin: First lady Michelle Obama appeared in Milwaukee to endorse Burke, describing her as genuinely motivated and unconcerned with political interests, while Christie joined Walker in Hudson to lend his support. Recent polls show Walker with a slight lead over Burke. Burke's campaign did not respond to media requests for further comment.
translated_content: Eelmisel esmaspäeval esitas New Jersey kuberner Chris Christie terava kriitika Wisconsini kubernerikandidaadi Mary Burke'i suunas pärast seda, kui selgus, et tema kampaania tööhõivekava sisaldas väidetavalt teiste poliitikute plaanidest kopeeritud osi. Wisconsini kuberner Scott Walkeri toetuseks peetud koosolekul süüdistas Christie Harvardi Ärikeskooli lõpetanud ja Trek Bicycle'i endise juhina töötanud Burket selles, et ta esitles teiste tööd enda omana. Konsultant Eric Schnurer, kes töötas Burke'i kampaanias, vabastati ametist sel kuul pärast BuzzFeedi raportit, mis tõi välja Burke'i tööplaani sarnasused teiste kandidaatide ettepanekutega. Burke’i meeskond täiendas plaani viidetega ja lõpetas koostöö Schnureriga. Burke on ennast kaitsnud, selgitades, et edukate ideede kogumine erinevatest plaanidest on majandusarengu puhul tavaline ning ei lähe tema põhimõtetega vastuollu. Ta rõhutas, et teiste edukate strateegiate kasutuselevõtt on mõeldud Wisconsini edasiviimiseks ning konsultandi kasutatud sarnane sõnastus ei olnud eksitav ega tahtlikult petlik. Kuna valimised lähenevad, jätkub tihe heitlus ametis oleva Walkeri ja Burke’i vahel. Riiklikud poliitikud on osalenud kampaaniates Wisconsinis: esileedi Michelle Obama toetas Milwaukee üritusel Burket, kirjeldades teda kui siiraid kavatsusi omavat ja poliitilisi huve mitte järgivaks kandidaadiks, samas kui Christie pakkus Hudsonis toetust Walkerile. Uusimad küsitlused näitavad Walkerile väikest edu Burke’i ees. Burke’i kampaania ei andnud meediale lisakommentaare.

article_content: North Korea carried out several projectile launches into waters off its eastern coast over three consecutive days, according to officials in South Korea. South Korean authorities called on North Korea to avoid actions that could increase regional tensions. North Korea, in turn, described the launches as standard military exercises. A spokesperson for South Korea's Defense Ministry, Choi Yong-su, said the exact type of the fired projectiles remains unclear, as they could be either short-range missiles or new large-caliber rockets. North Korea fired three projectiles on Saturday, one on Sunday, and two more on Monday. These launches have not caused significant distress in Seoul or Washington. The last similar launches by North Korea occurred in March. South Korean President Park Geun-hye’s office urged North Korea not to provoke further unrest, as reported by local media. North Korea’s official news sources labeled the events as routine drills and condemned South Korea's interpretation, comparing it to someone projecting blame. The projectile tests followed North Korea’s public criticism of the US aircraft carrier USS Nimitz visiting the South Korean port of Busan and participating in joint military operations. North Korean state media claimed this display was a direct attempt to heighten tensions and could lead to nuclear confrontation. Additionally, North Korea announced that American citizen Kenneth Bae, known locally as Pae Jun Ho, had begun serving a sentence of hard labor for allegedly trying to destabilize the government. The US and Bae’s family assert that he was in the country as a tour operator. Human rights advocates estimate that up to 200,000 people are detained in North Korea’s network of political prison camps. While tensions have lessened compared to previous months that saw missile tests, nuclear activities, and heightened rhetoric, the international community remains watchful. Those earlier actions resulted in increased UN sanctions. Military exercises involving the US and South Korea continue to be a major irritant for North Korea. Experts note that although recent projectile launches appear less provocative than major missile tests, North Korea’s pursuit of advanced weaponry and its bid to be acknowledged as a nuclear power continue to fuel international apprehension.
translated_content: Põhja-Korea tulistas viimasel kolmel päeval mitmeid mürske oma idarannikult merre, teatasid Lõuna-Korea ametnikud. Lõuna-Korea võimud kutsusid Põhja-Koread üles vältima tegusid, mis võivad piirkonnas pingeid suurendada. Põhja-Korea ise nimetas neid laskeharjutusi tavapärasteks sõjalisteks õppusteks. Lõuna-Korea kaitseministeeriumi pressiesindaja Choi Yong-su sõnul pole veel selge, milliseid mürske tulistati – tegemist võib olla kas lühimaa rakettide või uue suurte kaliibriga raketiga. Põhja-Korea tulistas laupäeval kolm mürsku, pühapäeval ühe ja esmaspäeval veel kaks. Need lasud pole Soulis ega Washingtonis erilist muret tekitanud. Sarnaseid laskeid tegi Põhja-Korea viimati märtsis. Lõuna-Korea presidendi Park Geun-hye büroo kutsus Põhja-Koread üles vältima edasist provotseerimist, vahendas kohalik meedia. Põhja-Korea ametlikud uudisteagentuurid nimetasid sündmusi tavapärasteks õppusteks ja kritiseerisid Lõuna-Korea hinnangut, võrreldes seda süü teistele veeretamisega. Lasuõppused järgnesid Põhja-Korea kriitikale seoses USA lennukikandja USS Nimitzi saabumisega Busani sadamasse ja selle osalemisega ühisõppustel. Põhja-Korea riigimeedia hinnangul oli see jõudemonstratsioon suunatud pinge tõstmisele ning võib viia tuumakonfliktini. Lisaks teatas Põhja-Korea, et USA kodanik Kenneth Bae (kohapeal tuntud kui Pae Jun Ho) on alustanud vanglakaristust raske sunnitööga süüdistatuna riigikorda õõnestamises. USA ja Bae perekond väidavad, et ta oli riigis kui reisikorraldaja. Inimõiguslased hindavad, et Põhja-Korea poliitvangilaagrites võib kinni hoida kuni 200 000 inimest. article_content: The United States is undergoing significant demographic changes, with experts forecasting that white Americans could become a minority by around 2043. This shift has caused unease among segments of the white population, who worry about how the country’s future composition might affect them. Recent statistics underscore this trend: beginning this fall, minority students are expected to outnumber white students in the nation’s public schools for the first time. Whites will remain the largest individual group, but collectively, minorities will form the majority. About 25% of these minority students are Latino, a change already familiar in states like Texas and California. This evolving makeup has important economic, political, and social impacts. Immigration debates, for example, are often as much about cultural change as about border regulation. As Latinos—currently making up 17% of the U.S. population and potentially reaching 25% by 2043—grow in number, attention turns to how this will be expressed politically. Educational shifts mean a higher demand for bilingual teachers, and could also prompt resistance from older taxpayers regarding funding school expansion, despite their reliance on the next generation for programs like Social Security and Medicare. Discussions about shifting demographics can create unnecessary fear or false expectations if not placed in context. Some interpret change as a loss or a promise of swift justice, but these views often overlook the complex, gradual nature of such transitions. Ultimately, the United States is shaped by ongoing mutual influence between immigrants and society. Immigrants adapt quickly, especially by embracing English, while injecting new energy into American life. These changes embody the nation’s enduring story of adaptation and renewal.

Seven teenagers remained at large following a coordinated escape from the Woodland Hills Youth Development Center in Nashville, Tennessee, on Monday night. The group, aged 14 to 19, overpowered staff by storming out of four dormitories and escaping beneath a chain-link fence. Authorities recaptured 23 of the 30 escapees within 24 hours. Some were located by police while others were returned by their families.

LaWanda Knowles, whose nephew was among the escapees, described how her family ensured he returned safely to the facility. Police had arrived at her home, about eight miles from the center, at 5 a.m. Her nephew returned two hours later, and she personally brought him back. "He wanted to see his mom and siblings, so he came home. When we realized he'd run, I brought him back myself," she said.

The escape took place at 11 p.m. on Monday. At the time, there were just 16 unarmed adults on duty for 78 teens, most of whom have been convicted of at least three felonies. The teens reportedly broke dormitory windows and exploited a weak spot in the perimeter fence. Facility officials immediately contacted the Tennessee Highway Patrol for assistance. No staff members or escapees were reported injured, and recaptured teens could face additional charges.

Instead of guard towers or barbed wire, the center has additional security measures comparable to a high school. Each detainee has a single room, which can be opened from the inside, and receives educational and vocational training rather than being held under a strict prison regime.

Earlier this year, incidents at the center included staff sleeping on duty, several assaults among detainees, and staff being assaulted. According to WSMV, a new superintendent was appointed after these events. The Tennessee Department of Children's Services has launched an internal investigation into the incident. As of Tuesday morning, the center was reported to be calm and secure.

Teisipäeva hommikuks oli keskus taas rahulik ja kontrolli all.

article_content: MUMBAI: The Indian government has approved investments totaling 30 billion Indian rupees ($360.4 million) in the IT hardware sector through its flagship manufacturing incentives scheme. According to Information Technology Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw, applications from 27 companies were approved out of 40 submitted. Dell, Hewlett Packard, Foxconn unit Rising Star, and Flextronics are among those receiving approval, as per a government statement. In May, the government expanded its incentive scheme to attract larger investments in IT hardware manufacturing, doubling the scheme's total outlay to $2 billion, aiming to boost domestic production of laptops and tablets. Manufacturers meeting or exceeding annual local sales targets are offered cash-back incentives. India seeks to become a prominent player in the global electronics supply chain, targeting an annual electronics output of $300 billion by 2026.

Info- ja kommunikatsioonitehnoloogia minister Ashwini Vaishnaw sõnul kiideti 40 esitatud taotlusest heaks 27 ettevõtte avaldused. Nende seas on Dell, Hewlett Packard, Foxconni tütarettevõte Rising Star ja Flextronics, nagu on öeldud valitsuse teates. Mais laiendas valitsus toetusskeemi, et tuua IT-riistvara tootmisesse rohkem suurinvesteeringuid, kahekordistades skeemi kogumahu 2 miljardi dollarini ning eesmärgiga suurendada kodumaist sülearvutite ja tahvelarvutite toodangut. Tootjatele, kes ületavad iga-aastase kohalike toodete müügimahu eesmärgi, pakutakse rahalisi boonuspreemiaid.
