article_content: After more than seven weeks of intense conflict, Israel and Hamas have now agreed to an indefinite ceasefire. Announced Tuesday, the truce brings a reprieve from fighting but postpones the resolution of deep-rooted disputes that have claimed approximately 2,200 lives. Egypt, acting as a mediator, facilitated the agreement. According to a senior Egyptian official, Israel will ease Gaza's blockade, open border crossings for increased humanitarian aid, and expand fishing rights up to six miles offshore. Negotiators from both sides are expected to return to Cairo for further discussions. Once again, Hamas celebrated the cessation of hostilities as a victory, while Israel emphasized that Hamas agreed to terms it had rejected earlier in the conflict. Israeli spokesperson Mark Regev expressed hope that the ceasefire would last but lamented the avoidable violence. Israel had previously accepted Egypt's proposed truce and had criticized Hamas for its initial refusal. Some analysts see Egypt's involvement as reflective of a larger struggle for influence in the Middle East. Celebrations erupted in Gaza, with crowds in the streets and gunfire in the air. Hamas spokesperson Fawhi Barhoum commended Gaza's resilience and unity during the negotiations. Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas, from the Fatah party and based in the West Bank, expressed gratitude to Egypt for brokering the deal and spoke about rebuilding and uniting the Palestinian territories. However, the ceasefire fails to address Israel's demand for Gaza’s demilitarization, nor does it include Hamas’ requests for reopening the Gaza airport, establishing a seaport, or the release of prisoners. The blockade—enforced by both Israel and Egypt—remains contentious, with Israelis focusing on security concerns and Palestinians blaming it for economic distress. The United Nations has urged both sides to address the root causes behind the conflict to avoid future violence. UN officials report over 2,130 Palestinian deaths—mostly civilians, according to their estimates—though Israel claims many casualties were militants. Sixty-seven Israelis, most of them soldiers, and an international worker also died. This truce closely resembles the agreement reached after the brief conflict in 2012. An Israeli official disclosed that Israel considered occupying Gaza but ultimately chose the ceasefire, expressing uncertainty about its longevity. During the fighting, Israel destroyed numerous tunnels used by militants to cross the border. US Secretary of State John Kerry welcomed the ceasefire but underscored the necessity for all sides to uphold their commitments, acknowledging that many challenges still remain.

article_content: Mounts Bay Academy, based near Penzance in Cornwall, has decided teachers should no longer use red pens when marking work. The school believes that red ink is a 'very negative colour.' Teachers are now asked to mark using green pens, while students can respond to feedback with purple pens. The Cornishman newspaper reports the new system is designed to help create more positive dialogue between teachers and students. Vice principal Jennie Hick stated that the change is not about being soft, but making feedback more encouraging. She said teachers will give 'two or three positive comments' on each piece of homework, hoping that students will not just focus on their grades but will also reply with their own comments. Chris McGovern, chairman of the Campaign for Real Education, disagrees with the approach. He claims many students find red ink helpful because it makes feedback stand out and is easy to read. He criticized the trend of avoiding criticism in schools, suggesting it may not benefit students.

Õpetajad peavad nüüd kasutama parandamiseks rohelist pastakat ja õpilased saavad vastata tagasisidele lillaga. Ajaleht The Cornishman kirjutab, et uue süsteemi eesmärk on soodustada õpetajate ja õpilaste vahelist positiivset dialoogi. Direktor Jennie Hick rõhutas, et muudatus ei tähenda leebust, vaid toetavamat tagasisidet. Tema sõnul annavad õpetajad iga kodutöö kohta 'kaks või kolm positiivset kommentaari', lootes, et õpilased ei keskendu ainult hinnetele, vaid vastavad ka ise kommentaaridega. Ta kritiseeris kriitika vältimist koolides, öeldes, et see ei pruugi õpilastele kasu tuua.

article_content: Fusilier James Wilkinson, a 21-year-old British soldier, was accidentally shot and killed during a training exercise in Kenya on November 26. He was laid to rest following a funeral at St Thomas and St John Church in Radcliffe, Greater Manchester, the same church where he married his wife Sarah five months earlier. Sarah, also 21 and expecting their daughter Annabel in February, attended the service dressed in black. A message on behalf of her unborn daughter was read at the funeral, expressing love and longing for the father she would never meet. Serving with the 2nd Battalion of the Royal Regiment of Fusiliers, Wilkinson was hit in the neck by a stray bullet on a firing range during the last day of a three-week exercise. Despite immediate medical attention and being airlifted to hospital, he was pronounced dead an hour later. The training accident is currently under investigation. Wilkinson had been due to return to his base in Germany and reunite with his wife on December 17. Family members and colleagues shared tributes during the 90-minute service. Sarah’s son, Connor, whom James had raised as his own, wrote that he was proud to call James 'Daddy.' Sarah’s emotional tribute described James as her 'better half, best friend, and husband.' James was born into an Army family in Germany, grew up in various locations, and settled in Whitefield, Greater Manchester, three years ago. He joined the Army a year ago, completed training in Catterick, North Yorkshire, and was preparing for a tour in Afghanistan next year. His commanding officer, Lt Col Mike Butterwick, described him as dedicated, professional, and popular within the regiment. Sarah and the family expressed their heartbreak at his loss, finding hope in their memories of James and the upcoming birth of Annabel.
translated_content: Fusilier James Wilkinson, 21-aastane Briti sõdur, hukkus õnnetult väljaõppel Keenias 26. novembril. Sarah, samuti 21 ja ootamas nende tütart Annabelit, kelle sünd on planeeritud veebruariks, osales teenistusel mustas. Matustel loeti ette sõnum sündimata tütre nimel – väljendades armastust ja igatsust isa järele, keda ta kunagi ei kohtagi. Wilkinson teenis Kuningliku Rügemendi Fusilieride 2. pataljonis; ta sai kolm nädalat kestnud õppuse viimasel päeval harjutusväljal kaelal haavata eksinud kuulist. Kiirele arstiabile ja helikopteriga haiglasse viimisele vaatamata kuulutati ta tund hiljem surnuks. Õnnetuse asjaolud on uurimisel. Wilkinson pidi peatselt Saksamaale baaslaagrisse naasma ja taasühinema oma abikaasaga 17. detsembril. Tema perekond ja rühmakaaslased mälestasid Jamesi 90-minutilisel talitusel. Sarah' poeg Connor, keda James kasvatas kui oma last, kirjutas, et tal on õnn kutsuda Jamesi „isaks”. Sarah nimetas oma emotsionaalses kirjapöördumises Jamesi oma „paremaks pooleks, parimaks sõbraks ja abikaasaks”. James sündis Saksamaal armeeperes, kasvas üles mitmel pool ning asus kolm aastat tagasi elama Whitefieldi, Suur-Manchesterisse. Ta liitus armeega aasta tagasi, lõpetas väljaõppe Catterickis (North Yorkshire) ja valmistus järgmisel aastal Afganistani missiooniks. Tema ülem, kolonelleitnant Mike Butterwick, kirjeldas teda kui pühendunud, professionaalset ja hinnatud võitlejat. Sarah ja pere väljendasid sügavat kurbust tema kaotuse üle, ent leiavad lootust mälestustes ja varsti sündivas Annabelis.

Everton Football Club has been handed an immediate 10-point deduction for breaching the Premier League’s financial regulations. This penalty is regarded as the most significant sporting sanction in Premier League history. Earlier this year, the Premier League referred Everton to an independent commission, although details of the breach were not initially disclosed. In its official statement, the Premier League announced that following a five-day hearing, the Commission found Everton FC’s Profit and Sustainability Rules (PSR) calculation for the relevant period showed losses of £124.5 million—exceeding the permitted threshold of £105 million. As a result, the Commission decided on a 10-point deduction, effective immediately.

After the decision, Everton responded by stating, “The Club believes that the Commission has imposed a wholly disproportionate and unjust sporting sanction. The Club has already communicated its intention to appeal the decision to the Premier League.” The appeal process will begin, with the case to be heard by an Appeal Board under Premier League rules. Everton also emphasized it had been transparent in all dealings with the Premier League, providing the required information, and added, “The Club will also monitor with great interest the decisions made in any other cases concerning the Premier League's Profit and Sustainability Rules.” The club concluded that it would not make further comments on the matter at this time.
translated_content:
Evertoni jalgpalliklubi karistati kohese 10-punktilise mahaarvamisega, kuna rikuti Premier League'i finantsreegleid. See on seni Premier League'i ajaloo suurim spordisanktsioon. Tänavu kevadel suunas Premier League Evertoni sõltumatu komisjoni ette, kuid rikkumise üksikasju esialgu ei avalikustatud. Ametlikus teates ütles Premier League, et pärast viiepäevast arutelu leidis komisjon, et Evertoni kasumi ja jätkusuutlikkuse reeglite (PSR) arvestus näitas asjakohasel perioodil 124,5 miljoni naela suurust kahjumit – lubatud piirmäär oli 105 miljonit naela. Selle tulemusena määras komisjon kohese 10-punktilise mahaarvamise.

article_content: A dog named Chewy, whose long fur made him resemble Chewbacca from Star Wars, recently began a new chapter at the Blue Cross dog centre in Southampton, Hampshire. The six-year-old Lhasa Apso was brought in after his previous owners could no longer care for him. With his thick, overgrown coat and noticeable underbite, Chewy initially had difficulty attracting attention from those looking to adopt. Staff decided to give him a significant haircut to improve his chances of finding a family. This new look made all the difference: just days after his trim, Chewy was adopted. Laura Boyle, rehoming supervisor at Blue Cross, said, 'When Chewy arrived, he was a ball of hair who definitely needed a trim. Now he looks much smaller, probably feels cooler, and his sweet nature is much easier to see. It’s not surprising he was adopted so quickly.' Because Chewy has a sensitive skin condition, he requires a special diet, but otherwise, he is a cheerful, friendly dog who loves to go for walks. Lhasa Apsos are originally from Tibet, where they were used as watchdogs in monasteries. Their long, thick coats are meant for cold climates and require regular grooming. Trimming their fur in the summertime helps prevent overheating, according to experts.

Töötajad otsustasid talle teha põhjaliku soengu, et suurendada tema võimalusi pere leida. Uus välimus muutis kõik: vaid mõne päeva pärast leidis Chewy uue pere. Blue Crossi ümberpaigutamise juhataja Laura Boyle ütles: 'Kui Chewy saabus, oli ta üks suur karvapall ja kindlasti vajas pügamist. Nüüd näeb ta palju väiksem välja, tõenäoliselt tunneb end ka jahedamalt ning tema armas iseloom tuleb paremini esile. Pole ime, et ta nii kiiresti adopteeriti.' Chewyl on tundlik nahk, mistõttu ta vajab eridieeti, kuid muus osas on ta rõõmsameelne ja sõbralik koer, kes armastab jalutada. Lhasa Apsod pärinevad Tiibetist ja neid kasutati kloostrites valvekoertena. Nende pikad ja tihedad karvad sobivad külmemasse kliimasse ning vajavad regulaarset hooldust. Ekspertide sõnul tuleks suvel neid karvu lühemaks lõigata, et vältida ülekuumenemist.

article_content:
Ryan Ferguson, whose murder conviction was overturned, is now seeking $100 million in damages through a federal civil rights lawsuit filed against seven police detectives, a former prosecutor who is now a judge, and a former police chief. The 50-page lawsuit claims that Columbia, Missouri police fabricated evidence, coerced witnesses, and disregarded other leads during the investigation into the 2001 murder of Kent Heitholt, a sports editor for the Columbia Daily Tribune. Filed in the U.S. District Court for the Western District of Missouri, the lawsuit requests $75 million in actual damages and $25 million in compensatory damages.

The suit was filed on the 10th anniversary of Ferguson’s initial police interrogation. It also lists the city of Columbia, its police department, Boone County, and two investigators from the county prosecutor’s office as defendants. Ferguson spent nearly a decade in prison before being released in November 2013, after an appeals court found that prosecutors had wrongfully withheld evidence from the defense. Missouri's attorney general declined to retry the case, and Ferguson subsequently moved to Florida to escape media attention in his hometown.

Ferguson’s case attracted national attention in part due to testifying by his high school classmate, Chuck Erickson, who years after the murder claimed (through dreams) to recall that he and Ferguson were involved in the killing during a late-night robbery. Erickson later recanted his testimony, though he remains in prison. Ferguson maintains Erickson’s innocence.

Kathleen Zellner, Ferguson's attorney, noted that Ferguson names seven police detectives, a judge who prosecuted him, and a former police chief in his lawsuit. After his release, Ferguson was celebrated in Columbia at a news conference, but the lawsuit details the significant difficulties he faced adjusting to life outside prison, citing his lack of education, employment, health care, and resources for psychological counseling.

Police spokeswoman Latisha Stroer, the only current department employee named in the suit, and Circuit Judge Kevin Crane did not respond to requests for comment. Former police chief Randy Boehm referred inquiries to the city attorney, who was unavailable.

Mirroring Ferguson’s successful appeal, the civil rights suit also raises questions about Michael Boyd, a former Tribune sports writer. Boyd allegedly gave inconsistent statements regarding his whereabouts on the night of the murder and was found to have left some of his papers at the crime scene. The suit notes Boyd had a significant dispute with Heitholt before the murder. Boyd, now sports editor at the Ste. Genevieve Herald, denied any involvement and testified at Ferguson’s appeal only after Zellner agreed not to discuss Boyd as a potential suspect in court.

On his Facebook page, Ferguson described his experience during the initial police interrogation, saying that he was threatened and lied to by people expected to seek justice. He reflected on spending nearly all his twenties in prison for a crime he says he did not commit and expressed that, while nothing could change the past, an apology would be appreciated.

Ferguson was 17 and still in high school at the time of the 2001 murder. He was convicted in 2005 and sentenced to 40 years before his conviction was overturned.

Ryan Ferguson, kelle mõrvasüüdimõistmine tühistati, nõuab nüüd 100 miljoni dollari suurust hüvitist föderaalses tsiviilõiguste hagis, mille ta esitas seitsme politseidetektiivi, endise prokuröri (nüüd kohtunik) ja endise politseiülema vastu. 50-leheküljeline hagi väidab, et Columbia (Missouri) politsei fabritseeris tõendeid, mõjutas tunnistajaid ja ignoreeris muid juhtlõngu uurimisel, mis puudutas 2001. aastal toimunud Kent Heitholti, Columbia Daily Tribune'i sporditoimetaja mõrva. Hagi esitati USA Missouri läänepiirkonna ringkonnakohtusse ning selles nõutakse 75 miljonit dollarit tegelikku kahju ja 25 miljonit dollarit hüvitavat kahju.

Hagi esitati Fergusonile esimese politseiuurimise 10. aastapäeval. Kostjateks on lisaks Columbia linnale, linna politseiosakonnale, Boone'i maakonnale ja kahele maakonnatserkluse uurijale. Ferguson viibis peaaegu kümme aastat vanglas, enne kui ta 2013. aasta novembris vabastati, kuna apellatsioonikohus leidis, et prokurörid olid kaitselt tõendeid varjanud. Missouri peaprokurör keeldus ta uuesti kohtu alla andmast ning Ferguson kolis pärast vabastamist Floridasse, et kodulinna meedia tähelepanust hoiduda.

Fergusoni juhtum pälvis kogu riigi tähelepanu, kuna tema endise klassivenna Chuck Ericksoni tunnistus põhines mälestustel, mis tekkisid alles aastaid hiljem unenäo kaudu ning milles ta väitis, et tema ja Ferguson olid Heitholti tapmisega seotud. Erickson on hiljem oma tunnistusest loobunud, aga viibib siiani vanglas. Ferguson kinnitab, et ta klassivend on samuti süütu.

Fergusoni advokaat Kathleen Zellner tõi välja, et hagi on esitatud seitsme politseinikule, kohtunikuks saanud endisele prokurörile ja endisele politseiülemale. Pärast vabastamist võeti Fergusoni Columbias pressikonverentsil soojalt vastu, kuid hagi kirjeldab suuri raskusi tema kohanemisel vabaduses, sealhulgas hariduse, töökoha, tervishoiu ning psühholoogilise abi puudumist.

Politsei pressiesindaja Latisha Stroer, ainus ametisolev politseinik kohtuasjas, ja ringkonnakohtunik Kevin Crane ei reageerinud kommentaaride päringutele. Endine politseiülem Randy Boehm suunas kõik pöördumised linna advokaadile, kes polnud kättesaadav.

Tsiviilhagi kajastab ka Fergusoni eduka apellatsiooni teemat, tuues taas esile küsimused Michael Boydi, endise Tribune'i spordireporteri võimaliku osaluse kohta. Boyd olevat andnud mõrvaööl oma asukoha kohta erinevaid ütlusi ning tema dokumente leiti kuriteopaigast. Hagis märgitakse, et Boydil oli Heitholtiga enne mõrva tugev tüli tööülesande pärast. Boyd, kes praegu töötab Ste. Genevieve Heraldi sporditoimetajana, on igasuguse seotuse eitanud ning andis Fergusoni apellatsioonis tunnistusi ainult tingimusel, et Zellner ei käsitle teda võimaliku kahtlusalusena.

Facebookis meenutas Ferguson esimest politseiuurimist, kirjeldades, et teda ähvardasid ja eksitasid inimesed, keda peetakse õigusekaitsjateks. Ta ütles, et veetis peaaegu terve oma 20ndad vanglas kuriteo eest, mida ta enda sõnul ei sooritanud, ning lisas, et kuigi minevikku ei saa muuta, oleks vabandus siiski teretulnud.

Ferguson oli 17-aastane keskkooliõpilane Kent Heitholti mõrva toimepanemise ajal 2001. Ta mõisteti süüdi 2005. aastal ja talle määrati 40-aastane vanglakaristus, mis hiljem tühistati.

article_content: Passengers traveling from Yell to Lerwick in Shetland enjoyed an unexpected celebration when an impromptu ceilidh took over the car deck of the MV Daglien ferry. The trip, which is normally uneventful, was transformed by musicians on their way back from the Shetland Folk Festival, who began playing lively music. About 30 passengers gradually joined the dancing, filling the deck with energy and joy. Videos captured ferry workers smiling as they watched the growing crowd of dancers. Adam Holmes, a 23-year-old musician from Edinburgh, noted that the music began on the bus before moving to the ferry, as Saltfish Forty played their playful take on 'Highway to Hell,' renamed 'Highway to Yell' for the occasion. The combination of music, dancing, and a bit of drinking resulted in a festive atmosphere. Holmes described the night as magical, comparing it to a happy scene in a movie before anything goes wrong. Ian Pearson, assistant marine superintendent at Shetland Isles Council, said that such spontaneous musical gatherings are not unusual, especially around festival time. He reassured that dancing on the car deck is safe, particularly during calm summer crossings. Moments like these showcase the friendly and vibrant character of Shetland's community and its visitors.

Tavaliselt rahulik meresõit muutus specialiks, kui Shetlandi Folk Festivalilt naasvad muusikud alustasid elava muusikaga ning umbes 30 inimest liitus tantsuga, täites tekiruumi rõõmu ja energiaga. article_content: It has been reported that Nancy Reagan declined to assist Hollywood star Rock Hudson in securing a bed at a French hospital known for pioneering experimental AIDS treatments. At the time, Hudson’s publicist requested help from the First Lady to have Hudson admitted to a French military hospital in Clamart, where Dr. Dominique Dormant was working on an early experimental drug to strengthen the immune systems of AIDS patients. Photographs from January 1985 show a frail Rock Hudson at the Golden Globes, alongside Liza Minelli and Elizabeth Taylor, just months before his death from AIDS. Hudson’s close connections in Hollywood included friendships with Nancy Reagan and her husband, then-President Ronald Reagan. Though Hudson ultimately did gain admission to Percy Military Hospital due to intervention by French officials, his condition had worsened to a point where even Dr. Dormant’s experimental treatments could not help him. He returned to Los Angeles and died in October 1985. Throughout the 1950s and 1960s, Hudson was a leading Hollywood actor and grew close to Ronald Reagan through entertainment circles. By the mid-1980s, Hudson’s declining health and secret battle with AIDS were closely guarded. In July 1985, he collapsed in the Paris Ritz Hotel and was subsequently taken to the American Hospital in Paris. Dr. Dormant was unable to admit Hudson as a patient or treat him as an outpatient at the military hospital, prompting Hudson’s publicist, Dale Olson, to send a telegram to the Reagan White House asking for assistance in persuading the French authorities. According to the telegram, the head of Percy Hospital turned Hudson down because he was not French, and a request from the White House could have changed the decision. Mrs. Reagan, following advice from Deputy Press Secretary Mark Weinberg, declined the request to ensure equal treatment for all and avoid the appearance of favoritism. Weinberg stated that the decision was not related to AIDS policy but was about fairness. At the time, AIDS was highly stigmatized, and there was widespread homophobia in the U.S. Activist Peter Staley criticized the Reagans’ rationale, noting that they had helped friends in other circumstances and alleging that the decision reflected wider discrimination against those with AIDS.

Sel ajal palus Hudsoni avalikustaja abi esileedilt, et Hudson pääseks Clamarti Prantsuse sõjaväehaiglasse, kus dr Dominique Dormant töötas varajase eksperimentaalravimi kallal, et tugevdada AIDSi patsientide immuunsust. Hudsonil olid lähedased suhted Hollywoodis, sealhulgas Nancy ja Ronald Reaganiga, kellest viimane oli tollal Ameerika Ühendriikide president. Kuigi Hudson sai lõpuks Prantsuse ametnike sekkumise tulemusena koha Percy sõjaväehaiglas, oli tema seisund juba nii tõsine, et isegi dr Dormant'i eksperimentaalne ravi ei suutnud teda aidata. Dr Dormant ei saanud Hudsonit haigla patsiendina vastu võtta ega teda ka ambulatoorselt ravida. Telegrammi järgi keelduse põhjus oli see, et Hudson ei olnud prantslane ning Valge Maja sekkumine oleks võinud otsust muuta. article_content: Muhammad has become the most popular name for baby boys in London for the first time. Combined spellings of the Islamic prophet’s name have made it the most popular name for newborn boys in England for three consecutive years. These names rank higher than other favorites like Harry and Jack according to the top 100 boys’ names from the Office for National Statistics. This year, the single variant Muhammad topped the London list with 768 registered births, ahead of Daniel with 666. When combined with the spelling Mohammed, the name was given to a total of 1,479 boys, more than double any other name. Across England, a total of 7,032 babies were named using the spellings Muhammad (18th most popular), Mohammed (25th), and Mohammad (58th), surpassing the 6,893 babies called Harry. In both boys’ and girls’ top 100 names, there has been a rise in names that were more common in the Edwardian era. While Harry and Amelia remained the most popular baby names in 2012 for the second year running, names like Hugo, Sonny, and Seth for boys, and Ivy, Darcey, Tilly, and Violet for girls, are quickly climbing the lists. Conversely, several modern names—including Ashton and Reece for boys and Nicole and Kayla for girls—have dropped out of the top 100. Lisa Penney, from parenting club Bounty.com, suggests that while celebrity-inspired or unusual names may be fun, many parents believe their children may find it easier with more traditional names. Regarding celebrity influence, Penney said, 'We are now seeing a growing trend for “old man” and “old lady” names. Just a few years ago, names like Ava and Isla were rarely heard, yet now they are in the top 20.' Netmums founder Siobhan Freegard added, 'Many mums are searching their family history for great-grandparents’ names, while others are choosing names that might have seemed outdated a decade ago but now fit with the retro trend in the UK.' It's been suggested that TV shows like Strictly Come Dancing—with former ballerina Darcey Bussell as a judge—may be boosting the popularity of the name Darcey. Since 1999, the number of babies named Mohammed (all spellings) has increased by more than half.

Islami prohveti nime erinevad kirjapildid on teinud sellest kolme järjestikuse aasta jooksul kõige populaarsema vastsündinud poisslaste nime Inglismaal. Need nimed on kantud kõrgemale kui teised lemmikud nagu Harry ja Jack Suurbritannia statistikaameti poistenimede esisaja nimekirjas. Sel aastal tõusis Muhammad üksiku variandina Londoni nimeedetabeli tippu 768 registreeritud sünniga, edestades Danielit, keda oli 666. Kui võtta arvesse ka nimekuju Mohammed, anti seda nime kokku 1 479 poisile – üle kahe korra rohkem kui ühtegi teist nime. Kogu Inglismaa peale nimetati Muhammad (18. koht), Mohammed (25.) ja Mohammad (58.) kirjapildiga 7 032 poissi, mis ületab Harry nime saanud 6 893 beebi arvu. Nii poiste kui tüdrukute nimede esisajas on tõusuteel nimed, mis olid levinud Edwardi ajajärgul. Kuigi Harry ja Amelia olid 2012. aastal teist aastat järjest populaarseimad nimed, liiguvad nagu Hugo, Sonny ja Seth poiste ning Ivy, Darcey, Tilly ja Violet tüdrukute seas järjest kõrgemale. Samas on mitmed moodsad nimed – sh Ashton ja Reece poistel ning Nicole ja Kayla tüdrukutel – esisajast välja langenud. Bounty.com lapsevanemate klubi esindaja Lisa Penney arvates küll inspireerivad kuulsustest või haruldased nimed võivad olla lõbusad, aga paljud vanemad arvavad, et traditsiooniliste nimedega on lastel lihtsam. Kuulsuste mõju kohta ütles Penney: „Näeme kasvavat trendi 'vanameeste' ja 'vanadaamide' nimede osas. Alles paar aastat tagasi polnud nimed nagu Ava ja Isla eriti levinud, aga nüüd on need 20 populaarseima seas.“ Netmums'i looja Siobhan Freegard lisas: „Paljud emad otsivad inspiratsiooni oma sugupuust ja valivad vanavanavanemate nimed, teised valivad aga nimesid, mis tundusid veel kümme aastat tagasi vanamoodsad, aga nüüd sobivad retrohõngulise suunaga Ühendkuningriigis.“ On välja pakutud, et telesaated nagu Strictly Come Dancing, kus endine baleriin Darcey Bussell on kohtunik, võivad suurendada Darcey nime populaarsust. Alates 1999. aastast on Mohammedi nime (kõik kirjutusviisid) kandvate beebide arv kasvanud enam kui poole võrra.

article_content: DALLAS—Just minutes after President John F. Kennedy was fatally shot as his motorcade traveled through downtown Dallas, Associated Press reporter Peggy Simpson rushed to the scene, quickly joining police officers who had converged on the building from which the sniper fired. “I was sort of under their armpit,” Simpson recalled, explaining that whenever she received information from them, she would run to a pay phone to call her editors, then return to the police. Simpson, now 84, is among the last surviving witnesses sharing their stories as the nation marks the 60th anniversary of the Nov. 22, 1963, assassination. “A tangible link to the past will be lost when the last voices from that time are gone,” said Stephen Fagin, curator at The Sixth Floor Museum at Dealey Plaza, which tells the story of the assassination from the Texas School Book Depository, where Lee Harvey Oswald’s sniper’s perch was found. “So many of the voices who were here, even 10 years ago—law enforcement officials, reporters, eyewitnesses—have passed away.” Simpson, former U.S. Secret Service Agent Clint Hill, and others are featured in “JFK: One Day in America,” a National Geographic three-part series released this month that pairs their recollections with archival footage, some colorized for the first time. Director Ella Wright said hearing from those who were there helps reveal the story behind the archival footage. “We wanted people to really understand what it felt like to be there and experience the emotional impact,” Wright said. People still visit Dealey Plaza, where the presidential motorcade was driving when Kennedy was killed. “The assassination certainly defined a generation,” Fagin said. “For those who lived through it and came of age in the 1960s, it marked a significant shift in American culture.” President Joe Biden, who was in college at the time of Kennedy’s death, recalled on Wednesday being “glued to the news in silence” with his fellow students. “On this day, we remember that he saw a nation of light, not darkness; of honor, not grievance; a place where we are unwilling to postpone the work he began, which we must now carry forward,” Biden said in a statement. On the day of the assassination, Simpson had originally been assigned to cover an evening fundraising dinner for Kennedy in Austin. With time before needing to leave Dallas, she was sent to watch the motorcade but wasn’t near Dealey Plaza. Simpson learned of the shooting only after arriving at The Dallas Times Herald’s building, where the AP’s office was located. Stepping off the elevator, she heard a receptionist say, “All we know is the president has been shot,” and then heard the editor brief the staff. She rushed to the AP office to watch the bureau chief file the news, then went to the Texas School Book Depository to gather more information. Later, at police headquarters, Simpson described “a wild, chaotic, unfathomable scene.” Reporters filled the hallways as an officer walked through holding Oswald’s rifle. Oswald’s mother and wife arrived, and at one point authorities held a news conference where reporters questioned Oswald. “I was just with a mass of reporters, trying to find any bit of information,” she said. Two days later, Simpson covered Oswald’s transfer from police headquarters to the county jail, when nightclub owner Jack Ruby emerged from the reporters and shot Oswald. As police wrestled with Ruby, Simpson rushed to the phones to dictate what she saw to AP editors. “As an AP reporter, you just go for the phone, you can’t process anything at that point,” she said. Simpson said she likely heard the gunshot but can’t recall it. “Probably Ruby was 2 or 3 feet away from me, but I didn’t know him, didn’t see him come out of the crowd,” she said. Simpson’s recollections are part of the oral history collection at the Sixth Floor Museum, which now holds about 2,500 recordings, according to Fagin. The curator considers Simpson “a great example of someone who was at the center of history, caught up in truly significant events while doing her job as a journalist.” Oral histories continue to be recorded, including many from people who were children in the '60s and remember hearing about the assassination at school. “It's really a race against time to capture these recollections,” Fagin said.
translated_content: DALLAS — Vaid mõned minutid pärast seda, kui president John F. Kennedy tapeti surmavalt tema autokolonni sõites läbi Dallase kesklinna, sööstis Associated Pressi reporter Peggy Simpson sündmuskohale ning liitus kiiresti politseinikega, kes olid koondunud hoone juurde, kust oli tulistatud. „Ma olin neil justkui kaenla all,“ meenutas Simpson, selgitades, et iga kord, kui ta sai politseinike käest infot, jooksis ta taksofonini, et helistada oma toimetajatele, ning läks siis jälle tagasi politseinike juurde. 84-aastane Simpson on üks viimaseid elusolevaid tunnistajaid, kes jagab oma lugusid ajal, mil riik tähistab 22. novembri 1963. aasta atentaadi 60. aastapäeva. „Käegakatsutav side minevikuga kaob, kui viimasedki tolle aja hääled on kadunud,“ ütles Stephen Fagin, The Sixth Floor Museum'i kuraator Dealey Plazal, mis räägib atentaadist Texas School Book Depository kaudu, kust leiti Lee Harvey Oswaldi snaipripesa. „Paljud tolle aja hääled — nii korrakaitsjad, reporterid kui pealtnägijad — on juba tänaseks lahkunud.“ Simpson, endine USA salateenistuse agent Clint Hill ning teised on esindatud National Geographicu kolmest osast koosnevas sarjas „JFK: One Day in America“, mis ilmus sel kuul ning ühendab nende meenutused arhiivikaadritega, millest osa on esmakordselt värvitud. Režissöör Ella Wright sõnul aitavad kohalolnute meenutused näidata sündmusi uue nurga alt. „Tahtsime, et inimesed tõesti mõistaksid, mis tunne oli sel ajal olla ja kogu emotsionaalset mõju kogeda,“ ütles Wright. Endiselt külastavad inimesed Dealey Plazat, kus presidendi autokolonn sõitis, kui Kennedy tapeti. „Atentaat määras kindlasti ühe põlvkonna,“ ütles Fagin. „Neile, kes elasid selle üle ning sirgusid 1960ndatel, tähendas see kultuurilist nihkumist Ameerikas.“ President Joe Biden, kes oli Kennedy tapmise ajal veel tudeng, meenutas kolmapäeval, et viibis koos kaasõpilastega „täielikus vaikuses uudiste ees“. „Täna meenutame, et tema nägi rahvast valguses, mitte pimeduses; austuses, mitte vimmas; paika, kus me ei ole nõus edasi lükkama tema alustatud tööd, mida peame nüüd kandma edasi,“ ütles Biden oma avalduses. Atentaadi päeval oli Simpsonil esialgu plaan kajastada Kennedy õhtust rahakogumisõhtusööki Austinis. Kuna aega jäi üle Dallases, suunati ta presidendi autokolonni vaatama, kuid ta ei olnud Dealey Plazal. Ta kuulis juhtunust alles The Dallas Times Heraldi hoones, kus asus AP kontor. Liftist väljudes kuulis ta receptionist ütlemas: „Teame vaid, et president on maha lastud,“ ja seejärel toimetaja sündmusi tutvustamas. Ta tormas AP kontorisse, nägi, kuidas büroojuhataja saatis maailmale uudise, ning kihutas siis Texas School Book Depository’sse info järele. Hiljem politsei peakorteris kirjeldas Simpson olukorda kui „metsik, kaootiline ja hoomamatu stseen“. Reporterid täitsid koridorid, kui üks ohvitser tuli läbi käes Oswaldi püss. Saabunud olid Oswaldi ema ja naine ning mingil hetkel toimus pressikonverents, kus reporterid said Oswaldi küsitleda. „Olin lihtsalt suure hulga teiste reporterite seas, otsides kasvõi väikest infokildu,“ rääkis ta. Kaks päeva hiljem kajastas Simpson Oswaldi üleandmist politsei peakorterist maakonna vanglasse, kui ööklubi omanik Jack Ruby ilmus reporterite hulgast ja lasi Oswaldi maha. Kui politsei Rubyt rahustas, jooksis Simpson telefoni juurde, et kirjeldada AP toimetajatele kõike nähtut. „AP reporterina haarad sa kohe telefoni,“ ütles ta. „Sa ei jõua sel hetkel midagi muud mõelda.“ Simpson märkis, et kuulis tõenäoliselt lasku, kuid ei mäleta seda. „Ruby oli ilmselt 2–3 jala kaugusel, aga ma ei tundnud teda ega näinud, kuidas ta rahvahulgast välja tuli,“ lisas ta. Simpsoni meenutused kuuluvad Sixth Floor Museumi suulise ajaloo kogusse, kuhu kuulub praeguseks ligi 2500 salvestist, ütleb Fagin. Kuraator peab Simpsonit „tubliks näiteks inimesest, kes oli sündmuste keskmes ja sattus ajalukku lihtsalt oma tööd tehes ajakirjanikuna“. Suulisi ajalugusid salvestatakse pidevalt juurde, paljud neist inimestelt, kes olid 1960ndatel lapsed ja kuulsid atentaadist koolis. „See on tõeline võidujooks ajaga nende meenutuste talletamiseks,“ sõnas Fagin.

article_content: Pauline Chai, crowned Miss Malaysia in 1969, is at the center of a high-profile divorce dispute with her estranged husband, Khoo Kay Peng, chairman of Laura Ashley Holdings. Chai has requested £85,000 a month in interim maintenance during divorce proceedings, which includes £135,000 a year specifically for holidays—covering first-class flights, five-star hotel suites, and chauffeurs. Mrs Justice Roberts of the High Court described these demands as 'hardly frugal' and 'in excess' of what Chai was likely to spend. The judge ruled that Dr Khoo, 76, should pay £50,000 a month towards Chai’s living expenses until a final settlement is reached regarding their estimated £200 million fortune. Chai's legal team argued that since the separation, she has had to make personal financial sacrifices—ending physiotherapy, doing her own hair, forgoing holidays, and giving up her expensive hobby of renovating dollhouses. They state that these changes have negatively impacted her lifestyle. Justice Roberts remained unconvinced by Chai's claim of living frugally. She noted Chai’s £450 monthly haircare budget as an example, expressing surprise considering the overall size of her demands. The judge stated that while Chai should not be left 'high and dry,' she should also not have 'carte blanche.' Chai claims that she and Khoo moved their home to Berkhamsted, Hertfordshire before separating and wants the divorce case decided in England. Khoo, residing in Malaysia, argues that the proceedings should be heard there, believing English courts may be more generous to his estranged wife. The couple, both originally from Malaysia, were married for 42 years and have five children. In previous hearings, it was revealed Chai received an interim lump sum of £1.85 million and spent £950,000 on living expenses in nine months. The case continues in the High Court.

Chai on lahutusmenetluse ajal taotlenud ajutist elatist summas 85 000 naela kuus, millest 135 000 naela aastas on mõeldud eraldi puhkusteks – hõlmates esimese klassi lende, viietärnihotellide sviite ja autojuhte. article_content: A little-known Facebook folder labeled 'other' could be hiding messages you’ve never seen, including some that may be important. This feature, intended to help protect users from spam, does not send push notifications, which means many of Facebook’s 1.1 billion users may have missed messages relegated to this folder. In a blog post for The New York Times, tech expert David Pogue reported discovering numerous previously unseen messages—ranging from important notes to redundant invitations from friends—stored over several years in his 'other' folder. To check this folder, Facebook users can click on 'messages' and look for the word 'other' in light grey next to 'inbox.' Many may have overlooked it. According to Mr. Pogue, this is where hidden messages are likely stored. This less conspicuous folder is apparently linked to Facebook’s $1 message program. Since this year, Facebook has charged users $1 to send messages directly to someone who isn’t their friend. Otherwise, the message is redirected to the 'other' folder. A pop-up box offers the option to pay or send the message to 'other.' Facebook has stated that the 'other' folder is intended to filter out spam and prevent messages from strangers from cluttering users’ main inboxes.

New York Timesi ajaveebis avaldas tehnoloogiaekspert David Pogue, et leidis selles kaustas palju seni nägemata sõnumeid – olulisest teabest korduvate sõbra kutseteni, mis olid aastate jooksul sinna kogunenud. Kausta leidmiseks tuleb Facebookis klõpsata “sõnumid” ja otsida halli kirjana sõna “muu” rasvases “postkasti” kõrval. Paljud on selle tõenäoliselt kahe silma vahele jätnud. Pogue’i sõnul peituvad kadunud sõnumid ilmselt siin. See varjatum kaust on seotud Facebooki 1-dollarilise sõnumiprogrammiga. Alates sellest aastast küsib Facebook 1 dollari tasu, kui soovid sõnumit saata inimesele, kes pole sõbralistis. Muidu suunatakse sõnum “muu” kausta. Avaneb aken, mis pakub valida maksmise või sõnumi “muu” kausta saatmise vahel. Facebook ütleb, et “muu” kausta eesmärk on rämpsposti filtreerimine ja võõrastelt saadud sõnumite peakausta sattumise takistamine.

article_content: Kenny Miller has expressed his desire to retire as a Rangers player, ideally securing one final top-flight winners’ medal as he aims to achieve more success before hanging up his boots. The 34-year-old has returned to the club for a third spell this summer and hopes this return will mark the 10th and final move of his career. Miller joined Ally McCoist’s squad on a four-game North American tour, including matches in Los Angeles, Vancouver, and Ottawa, revisiting places he played during his time with the Vancouver Whitecaps. For Miller, there is no place like Ibrox, which he considers his football home. However, he does not see this as a comfort zone; he is determined to help Rangers gain promotion to the Premiership and compete for further glory. Miller would like to conclude his playing days with Rangers and, feeling strong at the start of pre-season, is not setting a retirement date. He still has ambitions for another top-flight title and wants to add to his three previous Scottish Premier League medals with the club. His immediate goal is to contribute significantly to a successful promotion campaign against former clubs Hibernian and Hearts, which would activate an optional year on his new contract. After that, he hopes to challenge for more honours. Miller said, 'If I’m let go after a year, I’d still want to keep playing, but my intention is to finish here. I have a one-year contract with an option based on appearances, so it’s largely down to me.' He added, 'As long as I’m fit and performing, hopefully, it will extend. We need a good season to get promoted, then serious competition next year to get back to the top. That’s my goal—to return Rangers to the top of Scottish football. Winning the league in the Premiership would be the ultimate achievement.' Miller believes Rangers should not settle for second best and is motivated to play as long as possible, feeling strong and fit right now. Throughout his previous 147 appearances for Rangers, Miller scored 67 goals, with highlights in both the SPL and Champions League. He is also familiar with Scotland’s second tier, having played there with Hibernian at the start of his career. He recalls the excitement around the First Division in 1998/99, when Hibs bounced back to the Premiership, and expects a similar buzz in the Championship this season, with major teams like Hearts and Hibs also competing. 'I made my debut the season Hibs were relegated and played some games when they were promoted. Bringing players like Latapy and Sauzee to Hibs created a great atmosphere and drew big crowds,' he reminisced. Miller looks forward to a competitive and challenging season, believing it will push the Rangers squad to higher standards. Miller and strike partner Kris Boyd reunited on the pitch during a Highland tour, both scoring in pre-season matches. The North American tour will see Miller return to familiar territory, culminating in games in Vancouver and Ottawa. Reflecting on his time with Vancouver Whitecaps, Miller noted the cultural differences between Scottish and North American football, describing the latter as more relaxed, which he found hard to adjust to. 'In Scotland, losing really affects you, but it’s not the same abroad. Football here is a way of life, and that’s what I wanted to return to at Rangers,' he said. Despite enjoying parts of his experience in Canada and working with British coaches, he missed home and always planned to return, with Rangers as his top choice.

Miller liitus Ally McCoisti meeskonnaga neljamänguliseks Põhja-Ameerika turneeks, mille raames toimuvad kohtumised Los Angeleses, Vancouveris ja Ottawas – linnades, kus ta mängis ka Vancouver Whitecapsi eest. Samas ta ei näe seda kui mugavustsooni: tema kindel plaan on aidata Rangers taas kõrgliigasse ja püüelda uue hiilguse poole. Ta unistab uuest meistritiitlist ning soovib klubis juurde lisada veel ühe auhinna kolmele eelnevale Šoti kõrgliiga medalile. Esimene eesmärk on anda suur panus eduka tõusukampaania nimel Hiberniani ja Heartsi vastu, mis aktiveeriks tema lepingus lisa-aasta valiku. Seejärel loodab ta sihtida veelgi suuremaid saavutusi. Mul on aastane leping võimalusega pikendada, sõltuvalt mängudest, nii et see sõltub minust.' Ta lisas: 'Niikaua kuni olen vormis ja mängin hästi, võib see pikeneda. Vajame head hooaega, et kõrgliigasse tõusta ja järgmisel aastal taas tippu pürgida. Minu eesmärk on tuua Rangers tagasi Šoti jalgpalli tippu. Meistritiitli võitmine Premiershipis oleks parim, mis olla saab.' Miller usub, et Rangers ei tohiks kunagi leppida teise kohaga, ning ta on motiveeritud mängima nii kaua kui võimalik, tundes end praegu tugeva ja vormis olevana. Ta meenutab põnevust esimese divisjoni ümber hooajal 1998/99, kui Hibs naasis kõrgliigasse, ning ootab sarnast elevust tuleval meistriliiga hooajal, kus ka Hearts ja Hibs on suurte konkurentidena platsis. 'Debüteerisin Hibi eest hooajal, mil nad langesid välja, ja mängisin mõned mängud, kui naasime kõrgliigasse. Latapy ja Sauzee klubisse toomine lõi võimsa õhkkonna ning tõi palju pealtvaatajaid,' meenutas ta. Miller ootab põnevat ja väljakutseid pakkuvat hooaega, mis viib Rangersi mängijad uuele tasemele. Miller ja tema ründepartner Kris Boyd naasid koos platsile Highlandi turneel, mõlemad said kirja väravad hooajaeelsetes mängudes. Põhja-Ameerika tuur viib Milleri taas tuttavatesse paikadesse ning lõppeb mängudega Vancouveris ja Ottawas. Vancouver Whitecapsis veedetud aega meenutades märkis Miller, et Šotimaa ja Põhja-Ameerika jalgpallikultuuri vahel on suuri erinevusi – viimast iseloomustab palju lõdvem suhtumine, millega tal oli raske harjuda. 'Šotimaal mõjub kaotus väga tugevalt, kuid välismaal see nii pole. Meil siin on jalgpall eluviis ja just seda ma Rangersisse naastes otsisin,' ütles ta. Kuigi Kanadas oli mõningaid meeldivaid kogemusi ja ta töötas koos Briti treeneritega, hakkas ta siiski kodu igatsema ning Rangers oli alati tema esmane valik.

NEW YORK (CNN) — Horia Cretan, a Bronx electronics store owner, is being celebrated as a hero after he rescued a 4-year-old boy from a burning building. Cretan climbed a fire escape and, assisted by a firefighter, saved the child through a window choked with smoke. The boy, identified as Christopher, was taken to Jacobi Medical Center, where he is expected to recover.

Cretan, who immigrated to the U.S. from Romania 15 years ago, said he was in his store on Wednesday around 4 p.m. when he heard a child's screams—a sound he immediately knew was unlike the usual noise of children playing after school. Rushing to the scene, he reached the fourth floor via a fire escape, where a firefighter handed Christopher, unconscious, to him through a window. "What I was worried about was, is he still alive? Because his head just dropped, and he wasn't helping himself or helping me," Cretan explained.

During the rescue, Christopher’s brother stood below, shouting, as Cretan and the firefighter shielded themselves from falling debris and glass, which cut Christopher's leg. After being given oxygen on the ground, the boy was transported to the hospital.

Cretan shared that this was not the first time he’d saved someone from a fire. At age 12, he rescued his sister from a blaze in Romania that claimed their father’s life. Reflecting on that tragedy, Cretan said, "It was a sad story, a tragic moment at the time. And you know, it had an impact on people around the neighborhood like it does right now. It's amazing. This just skyrocketed."

He has received messages from around the world regarding his actions in the Bronx. "This has become famous because someone happened to be on the corner with a camera. You don’t do things like this for merit. The merit in itself is you save somebody," Cretan said. He expressed gratitude for the community’s support, saying, "The whole community's just being great. Adopting me like a son, and I'm a part of a big family and I'm happy to have them in my life."

NEW YORK (CNN) — Bronxis asuva elektroonikapoe omanik Horia Cretan tunnistati kangelaseks pärast seda, kui ta päästis põlevast hoonest 4-aastase poisi. Cretan ronis mööda tulepääseteid üles ja päästis koos tuletõrjuja abiga lapse suitsu täis akna kaudu. Poiss, kelle nimi on Christopher, viidi Jacobi Meditsiinikeskusesse, kus ta peaks paranema.

Cretan, kes kolis Rumeeniast Ameerikasse 15 aastat tagasi, ütles, et oli kolmapäeval umbes kell 16 oma poes, kui kuulis lapse karjeid – heli, mis tema sõnul erines tavapärasest pärast kooli mängivate laste häält. Kiiresti sündmuskohale tormanud Cretan jõudis mööda tulepääseteid neljandale korrusele, kus tuletõrjuja ulatas talle aknast läbi teadvusetu Christopheri. „Mind muretses kõige rohkem see, kas ta on elus? Tema pea lihtsalt vajus, ta ei aidanud iseennast ega mind,“ selgitas Cretan.

Päästmise ajal seisis Christopheri vend all tänaval ja karjus, samal ajal kui Cretan ja tuletõrjuja varjasid end kukkuva prahi ja klaasi eest, mis lõikas poissi jalga. Pärast hapniku saamist maapinnal viidi poiss haiglasse.

Cretan rääkis, et see polnud esimene kord, kui ta kedagi tulekahjust päästis. 12-aastasena päästis ta oma õe tulekahjust Rumeenias, kuid nende isa hukkus. Tollele tragöödiale tagasi mõeldes ütles Cretan: „See oli kurb lugu, tol ajal traagiline hetk. Ja tead, see mõjutas inimesi ümberkaudu, täpselt nagu praegu. Uskumatu, kuidas see kõik nii suureks paisus.“

Ta on saanud sõnumeid üle maailma seoses Bronxis juhtunuga. „See sai kuulsaks, sest keegi oli juhuslikult kaameraga nurgal. Selliseid asju ei tehta au pärast. Au on see, et päästad kellegi elu,“ ütles Cretan. Ta avaldas oma kogukonnale tänu, öeldes: „Kogu kogukond on olnud suurepärane. Nad on mind vastu võtnud nagu poega ja olen õnnelik, et mul on selline suur pere oma elus.“

article_content: Strong communication is a critical skill for dairy veterinarians, equipping them to clearly share medical advice with their farmer clients and helping foster strong working relationships that ultimately support livestock health. While much has been written about verbal communication, there’s been little research into how body language—such as eye contact, physical stance, and gestures—affects these interactions on dairy farms. A recent study featured in the Journal of Dairy Science and led by Fiona MacGillivray of MacVet Cattle Communications Ltd in Cheshire, UK, shines a spotlight on this overlooked aspect. The research team observed 11 standard dairy farm consultations, capturing each visit with GoPro cameras worn by the veterinarian, the farmer, and an observer. They analyzed interactions during four consultation phases: introductions, cow fertility checks, discussion, and conclusion. From these recordings, the team created a framework to identify and assess types of nonverbal communication between vets and farmers. The framework considered both static elements (such as clothing and equipment) and dynamic ones (distance, orientation, posture, gestures, and differences in height). The study noted trends and explored both the benefits and barriers to effective nonverbal communication on the farm. MacGillivray noted that veterinarians can begin using these insights right away, as greater awareness of nonverbal communication could enhance their effectiveness and facilitate change in farming practices. This study is a first step in connecting these cues with outcomes like increased empathy and satisfaction, and operational improvements. The authors believe that further research and communication training will help veterinarians better interpret and respond to farmers’ emotions, even when unspoken—ultimately enhancing consultations and herd health. As MacGillivray put it, picking up on nonverbal cues can reveal when a farmer may be unconvinced, allowing for improved conversations and healthier outcomes.

Kuigi verbaalsest suhtlusest on palju räägitud, on piimafarmides kehakeele—nagu silmside, rüht ja žestid—tähtsus vähe uuritud. Hiljutine uuring, mis avaldati ajakirjas Journal of Dairy Science ja mille eestvedaja oli Fiona MacGillivray MacVet Cattle Communications Ltd-st Cheshire’ist, Suurbritanniast, keskendub sellele seni vähem käsitletud aspektile. Teadustöös jälgiti 11 tavapärast farmikonsultatsiooni, salvestades iga visiidi GoPro kaameratega, mida kandsid nii veterinaararst, põllumees kui ka vaatleja. Suhtlust analüüsiti neljas faasis: sissejuhatus, lehmade fertiilsuse kontroll, arutelu ja lõpetamine. Salvestiste põhjal töötati välja raamistik veterinaari ja põllumehe vahelise mitteverbaalse suhtluse tuvastamiseks ja hindamiseks. Arvestati nii staatilisi elemente (nt riietus ja varustus) kui ka dünaamilisi tegureid (kaugus, kehahoiak, liigutused, žestid ja pikkuse erinevused). Uuring toob esile mitteverbaalse suhtluse mustrid ning arutab potentsiaalseid väljakutseid ja võimalusi farmis. MacGillivray sõnul saavad veterinaararstid neid teadmisi kohe kasutada, sest mitteverbaalse suhtluse mõjust teadlik olemine võib tõhustada suhtlust ja soodustada positiivseid muutusi põllumajanduses. See uuring on oluline esimene samm, et seostada mitteverbaalseid vihjeid empaatia, kliendirahulolu ja tõhusamate lahendustega. Autorid usuvad, et edasised uuringud ning suhtlemistreening aitavad veterinaaridel paremini märgata ja tõlgendada põllumeeste emotsioone, ka siis kui need pole otsesõnu välja öeldud—muutes konsultatsioonid tulemuslikumaks ning parandades karja tervist. MacGillivray lisas, et mitteverbaalsete vihjete märkamine aitab arstil mõista, kui põllumees pole veendunud, mis võimaldab paremat vestlust ning tulemuslikumat koostööd.

article_content: ROSSTON, Texas — Meredith Ellis begins her mornings by riding her four-wheeler through her herd, counting cows and calves. On her 3,000-acre ranch, she checks their safety, decides when to move them to new pastures, and monitors the health of the grass. “We're looking for the sweet spot where the land and cattle help each other,” Ellis explains. “You want to find that balance.” Ellis builds on her father’s ranching legacy, but has adapted practices to meet current environmental needs. Managing the ranch herself, she adopts methods focused on sustainability, recognizing the stakes for both her livelihood and the planet. Beef has long been central to Texas and American diets, but it also has the largest carbon footprint among proteins and is the world’s biggest agricultural source of greenhouse gases. Climate scientists recommend producing and eating less beef to reduce emissions, but global beef consumption continues to rise. With Texas leading the nation in cattle, Ellis hopes to be a force for change. “I don’t want to do this if it isn’t good for the environment,” she says. “I want ranching to be part of the climate solution.” Her approach is regenerative ranching—a holistic system connecting land, animals, and water. Ellis regularly rotates cattle among pastures to help restore the soil. “My goal is to make a real impact and help redefine the beef industry,” says Ellis, who took over the ranch in 2013 and confronts key issues such as beef’s impact on climate. Cattle produce significant greenhouse gases, notably methane—about 220 pounds per cow yearly, more potent than carbon dioxide. Experts say reducing herd sizes by even 10–20% can help. In the U.S., where beef consumption is high, eating less beef is advised. Some suggest that halving American beef intake and exporting more could ease global impacts on forests and grazing lands. Regenerative practices resemble those of wild bison herds, which once rejuvenated grasslands through natural grazing cycles. Ellis moves her 320 cattle through 58 fenced pastures to encourage deep-rooted grass and boost soil carbon storage. She and her ranch manager check both livestock and vegetation daily. “It’s a state of symbiosis: the cattle benefit from the land, and the land benefits from the cattle,” she says. While regenerative methods are spreading, few ranchers have fully converted their operations. Ellis cooperates with the Ecosystem Services Market Consortium to monitor soil health. Studies show her ranch now sequesters about 2,500 tons of CO2 annually—the equivalent of emissions from approximately 500 cars, and the number is growing as she makes more improvements. Ellis witnesses the effects of global warming on her ranch and sees confronting it as an “existential crisis.” Despite long workdays, the chance to advance sustainability inspires her. She could earn more by targeting niche markets or selling her land, but Ellis focuses on driving industry-wide change toward animal welfare and sustainable land use, aiming for higher prices for ranchers adopting these methods. “That’s the most important thing I could do with my life,” she says. “No amount of money could persuade me otherwise.” The Associated Press Health and Science Department receives funding support from the Howard Hughes Medical Institute’s Science and Educational Media Group. Rantšot ise juhtides kasutab ta jätkusuutlikkusele orienteeritud tavasid, mõistes, et kaalul on nii tema elatus kui ka planeedi tulevik. Veiseliha on olnud Texase ja Ameerika toidulaua keskmes, kuid sellel on ka suurim süsinikujalajälg kõigist valguallikatest ning see on maailma suurim põllumajanduslike kasvuhoonegaaside allikas. Kliimateadlased soovitavad, et veiseliha tootmist ja tarbimist peaks vähendama, kuid ülemaailmne tarbimine kasvab. Texas on USA suurim karjamaaosariik, mistõttu loodab Ellis siin muutusi ellu viia. “Ma ei taha seda teha, kui see pole hea keskkonnale,” ütleb ta. “Soovin, et karjakasvatus oleks osa kliimalahendusest.” Tema lähenemine on taastav karjakasvatus – terviklik süsteem maa, loomade ja vee seostest. Ellis liigutab regulaarselt veiseid erinevate karjamaade vahel, et mullastikku taastada. “Minu eesmärk on anda päriselt panus ja aidata veiselihatööstust ümber kujundada,” ütleb Ellis, kes võttis rantšo üle 2013. aastal ja tegeleb oluliste teemadega nagu veiseliha mõju kliimale. Veised toodavad palju kasvuhoonegaase, eriti metaani – umbes 100 kg aastas iga lehma kohta, mis on süsinikdioksiidist märksa tugevam. Ekspertide hinnangul aitaks ka 10–20% karja vähendamine. USAs soovitatakse veiseliha tarbimist vähendada. Mõned eksperdid pakuvad, et ameeriklased võiksid veiseliha tarbimist poole võrra kärpida ja rohkem eksportida, leevendades nii mõju metsadele ja karjamaadele maailmas. Taastavad tavad on inspireeritud biisonikarjade loomulikest liikumistsüklitest, mis kunagi rohumaid uuendasid. Ellis viib 320-pealist karja läbi 58 aediku, et soodustada sügavate juurtega rohu kasvu ja suurendada süsiniku sidumist mullas. Tema ja rantšojuht kontrollivad igapäevaselt nii loomi kui ka taimi. “See on sümbioos: kari saab kasu maast ja maa karjast,” ütleb ta. Kuigi taastavaid meetodeid võetakse järjest rohkem kasutusele, on vähesed rantšod täielikult selle peale üle läinud. Ellis teeb koostööd Ecosystem Services Market Consortium’iga, et jälgida mullatervist. Uuringud näitavad, et tema rantšo seob aastas umbes 2 500 tonni CO2 – umbes sama palju kui 500 autot, ning see number kasvab tema püüdlemisel veelgi jätkusuutlikuma suunas. Ellis näeb kliimamuutuste mõjusid oma maal ning peab nendega tegelemist “eksistentsiaalseks kriisiks”. Pikad tööpäevad annavad talle siiski motivatsiooni jätkusuutlikkuse nimel pingutada. Ta võiks teenida rohkem nišituru või maa müügi kaudu, kuid Ellis keskendub valdkonna muutmisele, loomaheaolu ja jätkusuutliku maa kasutamise edendamisele ning loodab, et need meetodid tõstavad rancher'ite sissetulekut. “See on kõige olulisem, mida saan oma elus teha,” ütleb ta. “Ükski raha ei suudaks mind vastupidises veenda.” Associated Pressi Tervise ja Teaduse osakond saab rahastuse Howard Hughes Medical Institute’i Science and Educational Media Group’ilt. Mexico's Morena party has unveiled its candidates for eight state governorships and Mexico City's mayoral election. The selection process stirred debate after Omar Garcia Harfuch, the prominent former police chief, was left out of the running for the capital's top spot due to gender equality requirements that mandated a female nominee. Despite being favored in public opinion polls, Garcia Harfuch expressed support for Morena’s gender policy and affirmed his continued loyalty to the party.

Morena, founded by President Andrés Manuel López Obrador and unified largely through his leadership, faces questions about its cohesion as the president approaches the end of his term in ten months and is barred from seeking re-election. Claudia Sheinbaum, former mayor of Mexico City and widely regarded as a close supporter of López Obrador, will represent Morena in the presidential election.

For the mayoral candidacy in Mexico City, Clara Brugada—known for establishing community centers in underserved neighborhoods—was chosen over Garcia Harfuch. Her nomination is favored by Morena’s left wing. Meanwhile, other party members who were passed over are weighing their options: former Foreign Affairs Secretary Marcelo Ebrard is expected to announce his plans soon, and some Senate hopefuls are reconsidering their involvement with Morena.

Senator Lucia Meza, after failing to secure the nomination for governor in Morelos, left Morena to join the opposition. She accused the state’s current governor, Cuauhtemoc Blanco—an ally of López Obrador and former football player who has faced inquiries into alleged criminal connections—of working against her candidacy. Meza’s resignation letter claimed that Morena disregards concerns about criminal influence in Morelos.

article_content: India’s government will not alter its borrowing plan for the fiscal year ending March 31, a senior finance ministry official stated on Wednesday. The government has projected gross market borrowing at Rs 15.43 lakh crore ($185.67 billion) for the current financial year. (Exchange rate: $1 = 83.1025 Indian rupees.) According to a median forecast of 10 economists polled by The Economic Times, India’s GDP is expected to grow by 6.7% in the July-September quarter, boosted by strong services sector performance. Telecom operators, chip makers, network providers, and handset manufacturers have expressed strong opposition to quickly implementing technology that beams TV content directly to mobile phones without cellular data, citing its immaturity. India may raise the threshold for arrests and criminal prosecution in GST evasion cases from ₹2 crore to ₹3 crore, as part of an effort to decriminalize minor offenses and improve ease of doing business.

Journalism is often more complex than a simple right-or-wrong scenario, with many ethical questions arising—particularly around how information is obtained. Recent cases like Sky News's email hacking and the broader News International phone hacking scandal illustrate the challenges of drawing ethical lines in reporting.

The Guardian recently reported that Sky News journalist Gerard Tubb illegally accessed personal emails belonging to John Darwin, the man who famously staged his own death in 2007. The hacking, approved by Sky News managing editor Simon Cole, was intended to gather evidence that could undermine the defense of Darwin’s wife, Anne, who was facing legal charges. The emails were handed over to Cleveland police and played a pivotal role in the prosecution. On the same day The Guardian published its findings, Cole stepped down from his role, stating his retirement was long planned and not linked to the hacking disclosure. Sky News defended its actions, claiming the email breach was justified in the public interest and performed under editorial supervision.

The article highlights how this situation differs from the 'Night Jack' case, where Times journalist Patrick Foster accessed police blogger Richard Horton’s emails without authorization or oversight, exposing his identity without consulting editors.

The much larger-scale News International phone hacking operation involved obtaining private voicemail messages from hundreds of people—often for tabloid stories not serving public interest. Operation Weeting later identified over 580 likely victims, many of whose private communications were used merely to produce sensational news rather than inform the public.

The article argues there’s a crucial distinction between a controlled, transparent decision to break the law for public good and widespread, irresponsible data breaches done solely to drive headlines.

Currently, UK laws such as the Computer Misuse Act offer no public interest defense for journalists. The article advocates for reforms so responsible journalists acting in the public’s interest can be protected, provided transparency and accountability are in place. Campaigns like Hacked Off, founded by Martin Moore and Brian Cathcart and supported by advocates including Hugh Grant and Steve Coogan, continue to push for accountability in journalism — but insist that responsible, public-minded reporting deserves legal safeguards.

Ultimately, the article calls for clearer distinctions between criminal acts and justified investigative reporting, and for laws to reflect those nuances, encouraging responsible transparency in journalism.

Oluliselt suurem News Internationali telefonide häkkimise skandaal hõlmas sadade inimeste kõnepostide ebaseaduslikku kuulamist, sageli üksnes tabloidilugude tootmiseks, millel puudus avalik huvi. Lõppkokkuvõttes soovitab artikkel teha selgem vahe kriminaalse tegevuse ja õigustatud uuriva ajakirjanduse vahel ning täiendada seadusi, et soodustada läbipaistvust ja vastutust ajakirjanduses.

article_content: CVS has officially ended the sale of tobacco products in all its stores, taking a major step towards emphasizing health. By removing cigarettes, cigars, and other tobacco items nearly a month earlier than planned, the pharmacy is reinforcing its dedication to customer well-being. CVS Caremark has also changed its corporate name to CVS Health to signal its expanded focus on health care services. Storefronts will retain the familiar CVS signage, so many shoppers may not immediately recognize the name change. The shift is noticeable at the registers—where tobacco products were once kept, shoppers now find nicotine gum and other smoking cessation aids. The move to eliminate tobacco was originally set for October 1, but CVS implemented it ahead of schedule. Like many drugstores, CVS has been broadening its health care offerings, establishing walk-in clinics and offering more in-store services. These changes cater to a growing, aging population and more Americans obtaining health insurance. Pharmacies now provide services like vaccinations, flu shots, and help with managing chronic health issues like diabetes or high blood pressure. Though going tobacco-free may impact CVS's finances short term, the company expects a long-term advantage over other chains such as Walgreens. CEO Larry Merlo explained that selling tobacco conflicted with their mission and new partnerships with hospitals and doctors. Brand consultant Laura Ries says the rebrand to CVS Health clarifies the company's mission to some degree, but notes 'health' is a common term and the impact may be limited. Still, the steps CVS is taking aim to put it at the forefront of community health care.

Sellegipoolest soovib CVS nende muudatustega olla kogukonna tervishoiu eesliinil.

article_content: Google has expanded its Android 14 beta program to now include the Pixel 8 and Pixel 8 Pro, according to newly updated release notes. Those who have pre-ordered these devices can access the beta version, joining previous Pixel models, as well as Google's foldable devices and tablets eligible up to the Pixel 5a. Factory and OTA images for the Pixel 8 series (version U1B2.230922.006) have been published, the same software released to other supported devices last week via Android 14 QPR1 Beta 2. While the beta patch resolves some prior issues, users may notice persistent bugs—like inaccurate battery percentage readings or difficulties when swapping SIM cards. A redesigned update settings page is now available, intended to help users track their software’s status. Anyone eager to try out new features on the Pixel 8 or Pixel 8 Pro should sign up for the beta program and check for updates in their device's settings. Google plans another round of feature updates in December. By launching Android 14 alongside the Pixel 8, the company is emphasizing incremental improvements—such as more customization options, boosted health and safety features, and better accessibility—over dramatic changes. One highlight for the Pixel 8 Pro is Google's pledge to provide software updates for seven years. The 8 Pro’s striking design, reliable cameras, and integrated AI tools make it particularly notable, whether you’re editing photos or tracking your health.

article_content: Racing at Daytona International Speedway is often compared to playing the lottery, where 43 drivers have an equal chance at winning. While luck plays a part, experience is crucial—something Jimmie Johnson demonstrated as NASCAR’s premier event, the Daytona 500, drew to a close. Johnson secured his second Daytona 500 victory on Sunday, narrowly defeating Dale Earnhardt Jr., who finished runner-up for the third time in four years. Johnson led 17 laps on the restrictor-plate track, where cars race closely together, often separated by just hundredths of a second. The race is famous for late-race wrecks, but drivers were content to maintain single-file formation for the first 180 laps. Johnson later took control. "I had a lot of confidence leading the pack," Johnson said, referring to his time at the front. "I knew I had a fast car." His crew chief, Chad Knaus, praised Johnson for executing their strategy with the new, lighter generation of NASCAR cars. Knaus missed the team’s 2006 Daytona win due to suspension but celebrated this victory. Danica Patrick made history as the first woman to win pole position and to lead green-flag laps at the Daytona 500. She led the race three times, totaling five laps, and finished eighth—the highest-ever Daytona result for a female driver. "It was a solid day. We stayed in the top 10 most of the time," Patrick said. Her crew chief, Tony Gibson, expressed pride in her performance under pressure. Earnhardt Jr. attempted a late push for his second Daytona 500 win. With Mark Martin’s help, the two advanced on the final lap, but Johnson blocked Earnhardt’s move and took the checkered flag. Martin, age 54, finished third. "We just ran out of steam at turn four," Earnhardt said. "We made a good move, but there wasn’t enough track left." Meanwhile, some of the 28 fans injured during Saturday’s Nationwide Series Drive4COPD 300 were expected to attend the Daytona 500, according to speedway president Joie Chitwood. The prior day’s crash involved over a dozen cars, sending debris over and through a 22-foot fence built in 2010. Kyle Larson’s car was torn apart after hitting the barrier, but Larson and the other affected drivers were checked out and released without serious injury.
