article_content: FREDERICKSBURG, Va. — Spotsylvania County, Virginia, known as the “crossroads of the Civil War,” now finds itself at the center of 21st-century cultural conflicts. Once the site of four devastating Civil War battles, today the county faces fierce political and social debates—this time, without weapons. The epicenter of these modern clashes is at school board meetings. What was once routine and vital work has, in Spotsylvania and across the United States, devolved into chaos and confrontation. The structure of local democracy is under strain. In Virginia’s recent elections, far-right groups sought control of local offices, often focusing on school boards, while liberals sounded alarms about rising extremism. Although nearly 600 school board seats in Virginia are technically nonpartisan, political parties and affiliated groups are heavily involved, each seeking to shape the direction of public education. National leaders, including presidential candidates, are closely monitoring the outcomes for indications of voter sentiment leading into 2024. Recent years have seen an energized right targeting public education, advocating for greater parental control over curricula and seeking to remove materials seen as objectionable, challenge equity programs, and limit accommodations for transgender students. This has led to significant backlash from parents and community members who support inclusive public education. Where differences once found resolution through compromise, public meetings now often erupt into shouting matches, legal disputes, and even ejections by deputies. School board members are reluctant to concede, while students contend with ongoing challenges, including pandemic learning loss, mental health concerns, and teacher shortages. In Spotsylvania County, both sides agree the outcome of Tuesday’s election will be decisive for restoring progress—and civility. Two school board meetings, held a month apart, highlight the divide: a contentious five-hour session in September contrasted with a more civil candidates’ forum in October. At the September 11th school board meeting, as members debated repairing a high school auditorium's inadequate sound and lighting, public speakers made inflammatory comments—including false claims about public figures and extreme accusations regarding transgender rights. Board members argued over procedures, and progress stalled. Meetings like these have drawn thousands of online viewers, some lasting up to nine hours. After a particularly tense session in 2022, the sheriff withdrew deputy presence, citing frustration with demands to remove people expressing dissent, leading the board to hire private security. Political tricks have emerged as well. Candidates distributed misleading sample ballots, prompting legal intervention. Dale Swanson, a local GOP leader, remarked on the extreme divisiveness, saying, “We need a better, kinder America.” High-profile groups like Moms for Liberty and teachers’ unions are now major players in school board disputes across the U.S., making local politics increasingly national in scope. Virginia’s Republican Governor Glenn Youngkin, elected on a parents’ rights platform, has influenced local policy, as seen when Spotsylvania County became the first in the state to adopt model policies on transgender students—requiring staff to use only names and pronouns in official records unless parents provide written consent. Other Virginia counties face their own struggles; for example, Rockingham County parents have organized to support transgender students, while ongoing lawsuits in Goochland County illustrate the intensity of board disputes. Veteran educator Frank Morgan voiced concern that partisanship distracts school boards from focusing on effective school operations. Spotsylvania’s current turmoil is a stark contrast to its past. In 2017, meetings were often civil, even when disagreements arose. The COVID-19 pandemic shifted this dynamic, sparking heated debates over masks, virtual schooling, and library books. In November 2021, the board voted to remove books deemed “sexually explicit,” with some members controversially suggesting book burning. After public outcry, the decision was rescinded. That same month, an election gave hard-right members a majority on the school board. They quickly dismissed the sitting superintendent and hired Mark Taylor, who lacked public education experience but had local administrative ties. Taylor proposed controversial budget measures, including possibly cutting libraries and advanced programs, and ordered the removal of several books, including works by Toni Morrison, following a state law on parental notification. Some in the community, including retired principal Tom Eichenberg, expressed frustration about a lack of transparency and limited opportunities for minority board members to participate. Chairman Kirk Twigg was later charged with forgery and tampering with public documents, relating to an attempted raise for an interim superintendent. Twigg has pleaded not guilty and awaits trial. Tension has led to teacher resignations. Award-winning ESL teacher Fabiana Parker left, citing disagreement with new district policies, especially regarding LGBTQ issues and diversity initiatives. Veteran teacher Heather Drane also departed, believing her reassignment was retaliation for voicing dissent. Parents, too, are considering leaving the district if conditions do not improve. Yet, hope for civility remains. At an October 16 forum sponsored by the NAACP, six school board candidates—regardless of party—emphasized respect, adherence to parliamentary procedure, and willingness to compromise on contentious issues like library books. Both conservative and liberal candidates expressed openness to parental rights in library choices and transparency. For at least one evening, rival candidates shared common ground and a neighborly moment. Associated Press journalists contributed to this report. The AP receives support from several foundations for its coverage on democracy, but retains full editorial independence.
translated_content: FREDERICKSBURG, Virginia — Spotsylvania maakond, tuntud kui “Ameerika kodusõja risttee”, seisab nüüd silmitsi 21. sajandi kultuurikonfliktidega. Kui varem peeti siin neli laastavat kodusõja lahingut, siis täna toimuvad maakonnas ägedad poliitilised ja sotsiaalsed vaidlused – seekord ilma relvadeta. Tänapäevased konfliktid keskenduvad eelkõige koolinõukogu koosolekutele. Tavapärane ja oluline töö on Spotsylvanias ning kogu Ameerika Ühendriikides muutunud kaootiliseks ja vastanduvaks. Kohalik demokraatia seisab surve all. Viimastel valimistel Virginias üritasid paremäärmuslikud rühmad võtta kontrolli kohalike ametikohtade – sageli koolinõukogude – üle, samal ajal kui liberaalid hoiatasid äärmusluse kasvu eest. Kuigi peaaegu 600 koolinõukogu kohta Virginias on ametlikult erakondlikult neutraalsed, on poliitilised parteid ja nendega seotud grupid tugevalt kaasatud, soovides mõjutada avaliku hariduse suunda. Riiklikud juhid, sh presidendikandidaadid, jälgivad valimiste tulemusi kui märki valijate hoiakutest enne 2024. aastat. Viimastel aastatel on parempoolsed aktivistid suunanud tähelepanu avalikule haridusele, kutsudes üles suuremale vanemlikule kontrollile õppeainete ja materjalide üle, vaidlustanud võrdõiguslikkuse programme ning piiranud toetusi transsoolistele õpilastele. See on tekitanud tugeva vastuseisu nendelt, kes toetavad kaasavat haridust. Kui eriarvamused lahendati varem kompromissidega, on avalikud koosolekud nüüd sageli valjuhäälsed, täis juriidilisi kaebusi ja vajadusel saadetakse välja korrakaitsjaid. Koolinõukogu liikmed keelduvad järele andmast, samal ajal kui õpilased seisavad silmitsi selliste probleemidega nagu pandeemia tõttu tekkinud õpilüngad, vaimse tervise küsimused ja õpetajate puudus. Spotsylvania maakonnas tunnistavad mõlemad pooled, et teisipäevased valimised on otsustavad võimaliku edasiliikumise ja tsiviilsuse taastamiseks. Kaks ühekuuse vahega toimunud koolinõukogu kohtumist peegeldavad lõhet: pingeline viietunnine istung septembris ning rahumeelsem kandidaatide foorum oktoobris. 11. septembri koosolekul arutati kooliauditooriumi halba heli- ja valgussüsteemi, kuid avalikud esinejad tegid provokatiivseid ja eksitavaid avaldusi, muuhulgas transsooliste õiguste kohta. Nõukogu liikmed vaidlesid protseduuride üle ja areng seiskus. Sellised istungid toovad veebi kaudu tuhandeid vaatajaid, mõned kestavad kuni üheksa tundi. Pärast eriti pingelist koosolekut 2022. aastal loobus šerif edaspidi oma asetäitjatest, kuna ei olnud rahul nõukogu sooviga eemaldada teisiti mõtlevaid kodanikke. Selle tulemusel palkas koolinõukogu eraturva. Poliitilised trikid on samuti esile kerkinud: kandidaadid jagasid eksitavaid näidissedeleid, mille pärast astus vahele kohus. Kohalik GOP-i juht Dale Swanson ütles: “Vajame paremat, lahkemat Ameerikat.” Tuntud grupid, nagu Moms for Liberty ja õpetajate ametiühingud, on nüüd olulised osalised koolinõukogu vaidlustes kogu Ameerikas, muutes kohalikud küsimused üleriigilisteks. Virginia vabariiklasest kuberner Glenn Youngkin, kes valiti vanemate õiguste platvormil, on mõjutanud kohalikke poliitikaid, näiteks kui Spotsylvania maakond võttis esimesena osariigis vastu mudelpoliitikad transsooliste õpilaste kohtlemiseks, nõudes töötajatelt ametlikes dokumentides fikseeritud nime ja asesõnade kasutamist, välja arvatud juhul, kui vanemad annavad kirjaliku loa. Ka teistes maakondades on pingeid: näiteks Rockinghamis on lapsevanemad organiseerunud transnoorte toetuseks, Goochlandi maakonnas käivad kohtuvaidlused koolinõukogu liikmete vahel. Kogenud haridusjuht Frank Morgan avaldas muret, et parteipoliitika segab koolinõukogude keskendumist koolide tõhusale tööle. Spotsylvania olukord erineb selgelt minevikust. 2017. aastal olid koosolekud viisakad ka siis, kui erimeelsusi oli. COVID-19 pandeemia muutis seda dünaamikat, tuues fookusesse vaidlused maskide, kaugõppe ja raamatukogu raamatute teemadel. 2021. aasta novembris hääletas nõukogu “seksuaalselt eksplicit” materjale sisaldavate raamatute kõrvaldamise kasuks, mõned liikmed tegid vastuolulisi ettepanekuid need põletada. Avalik pahameel tõi kaasa otsuse tühistamise. Samal kuul saavutati koolinõukogus konservatiivne enamus. Senine direktor vabastati ametist ja Mark Taylor, kellel puudus varasem kogemus avalikus hariduses, palgati kohalikest sidemetest tulenevalt. Taylor tegi vastuolulisi eelarveettepanekuid raamatukogude ja eriprogrammide kärpimiseks ning käskis eemaldada mitmeid raamatuid, sh Toni Morrisoni teoseid, vastavalt osariigi vanemate teavitust nõudvale seadusele. Mõned kogukonna liikmed, nende seas endine koolijuht Tom Eichenberg, tundsid puudust läbipaistvusest ja vähemusliikmete osalusvõimalustest. Esimees Kirk Twigg sai hiljem süüdistuse võltsimises ja avalike dokumentidega ebaseaduslikult tegelemises. Twigg eitab süüd ning ootab kohtuprotsessi. Pinged on viinud õpetajate lahkumiseni. Aasta õpetajaks nimetatud Fabiana Parker lahkus eriarvamuste tõttu uue poliitikaga, eriti LGBTQ+ ja mitmekesisuse küsimustes. Kogenud õpetaja Heather Drane arvab, et tema töökoha vahetus oli ebaõiglane karistus protesti eest. Ka lapsevanemad kaaluvad lahkumist, kui olukord ei parane. Ometi püsib lootus. 16. oktoobril, NAACP korraldatud foorumil, rõhutasid kuus koolinõukogu kandidaati sõltumata parteist austust, korrektsust ja valmidust kompromissideks päevakajalistes küsimustes nagu raamatukogude valik. Nii konservatiivsed kui liberaalsed kandidaadid toetasid vanemate õigusi ja läbipaistvust. Vähemalt ühel õhtul valitses ühtsus ja naabrus. Sellesse loosse panustasid Associated Pressi ajakirjanikud. AP saab mitmete sihtasutuste toetust demokraatiateemaliseks kajastuseks, kuid säilitab toimetusliku sõltumatuse.

article_content: In North Yorkshire, a family suffered a terrifying ordeal when four masked intruders broke into their £3.5 million home near Harrogate. Armed with a crowbar, the burglars threatened Leigh Kempley and her children, Ben (16) and Abbi (11), demanding valuables. With David Kempley, the family’s father, absent during the incident, the thieves coerced Ben into revealing the locations of valuables under threats against his mother and sister. The robbers stole luxury items including a £250,000 diamond ring, expensive watches (one valued at over £100,000), designer jewelry, and seven shotguns collectively worth £100,000. Escaping in the family's white Porsche 911, which was abandoned later, the criminals locked the victims in a bathroom before fleeing. At the time of the robbery, David Kempley, managing director of Troy Foods, was away in Wales, and the family's two eldest children were not present. The incident left the family deeply traumatized, with Leigh Kempley condemning the burglars' actions and calling for justice. 'They threatened my children's lives. No punishment could be too severe,' she stated. Following the crime, the Kempley family made a public appeal for information on BBC's Crimewatch. Police have reported receiving promising leads since the broadcast.

article_content: Entire families have been killed in Israeli air strikes on the densely populated streets of Gaza, where many Palestinians live in multi-generational homes. Three Palestinians living in the UK told the BBC that over 20 of their relatives had died in a single strike, with many others still trapped under rubble. Ahmed al-Naouq recalls a lazy, sunny Friday afternoon four years ago when he took a selfie with his family. Gathered under olive trees by his father's house in Deir al-Balah, his siblings and their children were enjoying a meal and time together. Now, Ahmed says, most of them are gone. An air strike hit their family home on 22 October, killing 21 people, including his father, three sisters, two brothers, and 14 children. According to Gaza's health ministry, over 11,000 Palestinians have died in Israeli air strikes, which began after the Hamas attack on 7 October that, according to Israel, killed around 1,200 people and saw over 200 taken hostage. Israel says its military actions target Hamas, which it accuses of operating within civilian areas, and claims it seeks to limit civilian casualties. In Ahmed's photo, seven of the children killed are visible; others had not been present or not yet born at the time. Like many Palestinian families, Ahmed's brothers built their homes above their father's, a tradition that has led to multiple generations being lost in a single attack. His sister Aya sought refuge with her children at their father's house after her own apartment was damaged in a previous strike. His other sisters, Walaa and Alaa, were also there with their children. The family thought the home, located in central Gaza's Deir al-Balah, was safe. Ahmed, now living in London, last saw his nieces and nephews over a video call when he treated them to a day at the beach. Many of those children are now among the casualties, including his 13-year-old nephew Eslam, and several younger nieces and nephews. After the strike, Ahmed posted photos of the children to share their stories. There were few survivors: Ahmed's brother Muhammed was killed, but his wife Shimaa and their three-year-old son Omar survived. Another survivor, eleven-year-old Malak, was rescued but later died in hospital due to a lack of medical supplies. Ahmed and others have struggled with the loss and with communication blackouts following further Israeli military action. He also learned that other relatives and friends have lost entire families, such as Darwish al-Manaama, who lost 44 relatives, and Yara Sharif, who lost 20. Their stories reflect the difficulties faced in Gaza, including limited rescue efforts due to fuel shortages, inability to recover bodies, and challenges in grieving and holding funerals. Ahmed remembers his father as a kind man who worked hard to support and educate his family, and who believed in peaceful coexistence. Now, after so much loss, Ahmed questions what the future will hold for the only nephew who survived. Reporting by the BBC, with additional reporting by Husna Wahid.

Nagu paljudes palestiina peredes, ehitasid ka Ahmedi vennad oma kodud isa maja peale—see traditsioon on toonud kaasa mitme põlvkonna kaotuse üheainsa rünnakuga. Tema õde Aya otsis varju isa majas, kui tema enda korter oli varem rünnakus kahjustatud. Ka tema teised õed Walaa ja Alaa olid seal koos lastega. Pere arvas, et nende kodu, mis asub Deir al-Balah' keskuses, on turvaline. Ahmed, kes elab nüüd Londonis, nägi oma õe- ja vennalapsi viimati videokõne teel, kui kinkis neile päeva rannas. Paljud neist lastest on nüüd hukkunud—sh tema 13-aastane õepoeg Eslam ja mitmed nooremad lähedased. Pärast rünnakut jagas Ahmed laste pilte nende lugude teadvustamiseks. Ellujäänuid oli väga vähe: Ahmedi vend Muhammed hukkus, kuid tema naine Shimaa ja nende kolmeaastane poeg Omar jäid ellu. Üks ellujäänu, üheteistaastane Malak, päästeti, kuid suri hiljem haiglas meditsiinitarvete puuduse tõttu. Ahmed ja teised on pidanud toime tulema suurte kaotustega ning suhtluskatkestustega pärast täiendavaid Iisraeli sõjalisi rünnakuid. Ta sai teada, et ka teised sugulased ja sõbrad kaotasid terveid perekondi, näiteks Darwish al-Manaama (44 hukkunut) ja Yara Sharif (20 hukkunut). Nende lood peegeldavad Gaza mitmekülgseid raskusi: päästetöid takistab kütusepuudus, paljusid hukkunuid ei ole suudetud välja tuua ning matuste ja leinamise korraldamine on väga keeruline. Ahmed meenutab oma isa kui lahket inimest, kes töötas kõvasti pere toetamiseks ja harimiseks ning uskus rahumeelsesse kooselusse. Pärast suurt kaotust mõtleb ta, milline tulevik ootab tema ainsat ellujäänud õepoega. BBC uudiste kajastus, lisatoimetaja Husna Wahid.

article_content: Robin Williams, the beloved comedian and actor, was found dead at his home in Marin County, California, on August 11, 2014, at the age of 63. According to the coroner’s report, there were no illegal drugs or alcohol in his system at the time of his death. Williams had a history of battling depression, anxiety, and paranoia, and had recently been diagnosed with Parkinson's disease. Authorities confirmed his cause of death as suicide by hanging. Toxicology results showed Williams had two antidepressants and two caffeine compounds in his system, all within therapeutic levels. A closed bottle of Seroquel, a medication used to treat mood disorders, was found in the room; it had been prescribed a week prior to his death. Williams, a father of three, was discovered in a bedroom of his Tiburon home. Williams’ wife, Susan Schneider, prayed over his body before it was removed from the home. She told authorities he was not interested in auto-erotic activities, but noted that he had been emotionally affected by his role in the 2009 movie, 'World's Greatest Dad,' in which his character's son dies in a similar way. The coroner's report described this scene as 'very difficult and emotional' for Williams. In the final hours before his death, Williams made a brief phone call to Susan to tell her he was picking up magazines for her. She reported he seemed well, and she viewed his interest in using his iPad as a positive sign, since he had avoided reading or watching television for about six months. Authorities found that his internet browser had tabs open about medications including Lyrica and propranolol. Williams had suffered from Parkinson's symptoms since 2011, including tremors and slowed movement in his left hand, and had recently started treatment with Levodopa. The night before he died, he took extra precautions with personal items and had trouble sleeping, leading the couple to sleep in separate bedrooms. Susan said the last time she saw him, he appeared 'excited.' Fans paid tribute by leaving flowers outside his home. Williams’ final Instagram post showed him celebrating his 63rd birthday with Crystal the monkey, his co-star from the 'Night at the Museum' films. For those struggling with suicidal thoughts, support is available. In the US, contact 1 (800) 273-TALK. In the UK, call 08457 909090 or visit www.samaritans.org.

Williamsil oli olnud depressiooni, ärevuse ja paranoiaga seotud probleeme ning hiljuti oli tal diagnoositud Parkinsoni tõbi. Võimud kinnitasid, et tema surma põhjuseks oli enesetapp poomise teel. Toksikoloogilised testid näitasid, et Williamsi organismis oli kaks antidepressanti ja kaks kofeiiniühendit, kõik terapeutilistes kogustes. Tuba, kus ta leiti, oli suletud Seroqueli pudel—ravim, mida kasutatakse meeleoluhäirete raviks—millele oli retsept välja kirjutatud nädal enne Williamsi surma. Kolme lapse isa Williams leiti surnuna oma Tiburoni kodu magamistoast. Williamsi abikaasa Susan Schneider palvetas tema keha juures enne, kui see välja viidi. Ta ütles võimudele, et abikaasa polnud huvitatud autoerootilistest tegevustest, ent tõi välja, et Williamsit oli emotsionaalselt mõjutanud tema roll 2009. aasta filmis 'Maailma Parim Isa', kus tema tegelaskuju poeg hukkub sarnasel moel. Kohtuarsti raporti kohaselt oli see stseen Williamsi jaoks 'väga raske ja emotsionaalne'. Viimastel tundidel enne surma helistas Williams Susanile, et öelda, et toob talle ajakirju. Susan kinnitas, et mehe käitumine näis tavapärane, ning pidas tema huvi iPadi vastu heaks märgiks, sest ta polnud viimase poole aasta jooksul televiisorit vaadanud ega lugenud. Võimud leidsid, et Williamsi veebibrauseris oli avatud ravimeid Lyrica ja propranolool käsitlevaid lehti. Williamsil olid Parkinsoni tõve sümptomid alates 2011. aastast, sealhulgas värinad ja aeglustunud liigutused vasakus käes, ning hiljuti oli ta alustanud ravi levodopaga. Surma eelõhtul hoolitses ta erakordselt oma isiklike asjade eest ja kannatas unehäirete all, mistõttu abikaasad magasid eraldi tubades. Susan ütles, et viimati Williamsit nähes tundus mees olevat 'elevil'. Fännid tõid tema maja juurde lilli austusavalduseks. Williamsi viimane Instagrami postitus näitas tema 63. sünnipäeva tähistamist koos Crystaliga, ahviga, kes oli tema kaasnäitleja filmis 'Öö muuseumis'. Neile, kes raskustega silmitsi seisavad või vajavad tuge: USAs saab abi numbril 1 (800) 273-TALK. Ühendkuningriigis helista 08457 909090 või külasta www.samaritans.org.

article_content: Google Glass, one of the most anticipated new technologies since the iPhone, is set to go on sale to the public next year. However, privacy concerns are rising, with hundreds of public places such as cinemas, banks, parks, and strip clubs considering bans on the device. Legal experts warn of impending legal challenges related to its use. Early 'explorer' versions of Google Glass are currently sold for £1,000 ($1,500), though the consumer version is expected to be cheaper. Analyst firms estimate that wearable technology and self-driving cars could represent a $500 billion opportunity for Google, and shipments of smart glasses may reach $6.6 million in three years. Some businesses, including strip clubs, cinemas, and casinos, have already banned customers from using Google Glass to prevent unauthorized recordings. In West Virginia, legislators have tried to prohibit the use of Google Glass while driving, and plan to pursue further legal actions before the device becomes widely available. Timothy Toohey, a privacy attorney in Los Angeles, predicts major legal disputes over the technology. The 5 Point Cafe in Seattle was the first to explicitly ban Glass, sparking a trend that many venues have followed. Experts believe that Google Glass could challenge privacy laws globally. Bradley Shear, a social media expert at George Washington University, remarks that Google Glass will test the balance between privacy rights and the First Amendment. Nick Pickles, director of the UK campaign group Big Brother Watch, voiced concerns over potential control by unknown third parties. Thad Starner, a technical adviser to the Glass team, claimed he has not seen a single instance where the technology caused harm. Conversely, Steve Mann, a professor at the University of Toronto, reported being physically confronted at a Paris McDonald’s over his wearable device. Google representatives, including chairman Eric Schmidt and spokesperson Courtney Hohne, have emphasized the company’s careful consideration of privacy implications. Test versions are currently being distributed to developers and selected 'explorers.' Google acknowledges the technology’s unresolved issues, encouraging developers to test and innovate further. Business owners remain skeptical. Peter Feinstein, managing partner of Sapphire Gentlemen's Club in Las Vegas, insists that visitors will be asked to check in the device, while MGM Resorts and Regal Entertainment Group reiterate their bans on recording devices to protect customer's privacy. The Winky app has been released for Google Glass, allowing users to take pictures with a blink rather than by voice command, raising further privacy concerns. At the same time, Google’s voice translation technology censors curse words in voice-written communications, similar to its SafeSearch filter.

Õiguseksperdid hoiatavad eesootavate juriidiliste vaidluste eest. Google Glassi varased 'explorer' versioonid maksavad praegu £1,000 ($1,500), kuid tarbijaversioon peaks tulema odavam. Analüütikufirmad hindavad, et kantav tehnoloogia ja isesõitvad autod võivad Googele tuua 500 miljardi dollari suuruse võimaluse ning nutiprillide saadetised võivad kolmega aastaga ulatuda 6,6 miljonini. Suurbritannia kampaaniagrupi Big Brother Watch juht Nick Pickles väljendas muret, et kolmandad isikud võivad seadme üle kontrolli saada. Ettevõtete omanikud on endiselt skeptilised. Sapphire Gentlemen's Clubi juht Las Vegases Peter Feinstein ütleb, et külastajad peavad seadme ära andma. MGM Resorts ja Regal Entertainment Group kinnitavad samuti, et salvestusvahendid on nende asutustes keelatud, et kaitsta klientide privaatsust. Google Glassi jaoks on ilmunud Winky rakendus, mis võimaldab kasutajatel teha pilte silmapilgutusega, mitte häälkäsklusega, tekitades täiendavaid privaatsusmuresid. Samal ajal tsenseerib Google'i häältõlgete tehnoloogia vandesõnu häälega kirjutatud sõnumites, sarnaselt SafeSearch filtrile.

Pumpkin Key, a 26-acre private island near Miami, Florida, has been listed for sale at $100 million. The exclusive island, part of the Ocean Reef community, offers a variety of luxury amenities: a three-bedroom main residence, two caretaker cottages, a boat captain's apartment, a swimming pool, helipad-ready tennis courts, a marina for up to 20 boats or a mega yacht, and an expansive private beach.

Its location provides both privacy and accessibility, situated within a 50-minute boat trip or a 10-minute helicopter flight from Miami. The property also comes with planning permission to build up to 12 additional homes, providing opportunities for further development overlooking Card Sound Bay.

Buyers would have access to Ocean Reef club’s full suite of amenities on nearby Key Largo, including a spa, golf courses, restaurants, shopping, and a school. Russell Post of Sotheby's International Realty describes Pumpkin Key as a rare chance for privacy and exclusivity within a connected, amenity-rich community, suitable for a luxury family estate or a private club retreat.

article_content: Amy Williams, a 31-year-old British athlete and Olympic gold medalist in skeleton at the 2010 Vancouver Winter Games, has paid a high physical price for her decade-long career. Williams suffers from chronic knee and neck injuries, including a degenerative disc and ongoing sciatica, due to the stresses of her sport. Despite frequent pain and medical treatments, she pushed herself to Olympic success, winning gold after years of relentless focus. Nearly four years after her Olympic triumph, Williams continues to seek new challenges despite her injuries. Rather than preparing for the upcoming Sochi Winter Olympics as a competitor, she is exploring rally racing as a co-driver alongside rally veteran Tony Jardine in the World Rally Championships' final round in Wales. Williams finds rallying satisfies her need for adrenaline and competition without the same physical demands as skeleton. As a co-driver, she is responsible for navigating complex routes and maintaining team coordination at high speeds, a demanding role requiring precise communication and trust. Her partnership with Jardine began after he saw her co-driving on a British TV show and invited her to join his team. Williams recently earned her rally license after completing several minor rallies across the UK. She acknowledges the mental and physical challenges of her new role but is enthusiastic about the task. Williams notes that rallying, while less glamorous than Formula One or MotoGP, demands significant teamwork and skill. She expresses frustration that rallying does not receive the widespread media attention enjoyed by other motorsports, despite champions like Sebastian Loeb dominating the World Rally Championship. Reflecting on her skeleton career, Williams missed selection for the 2006 Winter Olympics but achieved gold in 2010 through perseverance and dedication, despite the cost to her health. She anticipates bittersweet emotions as she attends the Sochi Games as a broadcaster, noting that part of her still wishes to compete, but she chose retirement on medical advice. Currently, rallying fulfills her competitive spirit, but Williams is also preparing for a new adventure: attempting to break the record for circumnavigating the world in a rigid inflatable boat (RIB). She and her team are working to secure funding, hoping to launch the expedition in spring 2015.

Williams kannatab krooniliste põlve- ja kaelavigastuste all, sealhulgas on tal degeneratiivne disk ja pidev ishias – kõik sportlaseeluga kaasnenud pingete tagajärjel. Williams leiab, et rallisport rahuldab tema vajadust adrenaliini ja võistlusmomendi järele, ilma et see sama füüsilist koormust nõuaks kui skeleton. Kaardilugejana on ta vastutav keeruliste radade navigeerimise ja meeskonna koordineerimise eest suurte kiiruste juures – see nõuab täpset suhtlemist ja usaldust. Koostöö Jardine’iga sai alguse pärast seda, kui ta nägi Williamst Briti teleprogrammis kaardilugejana ja kutsus ta oma meeskonda. Praegu rahuldab ralli tema võistlusvaimu, kuid Williams valmistub ka uueks seikluseks: proovida purustada rekordi ümbermaailmareisil jäigaroomulise kummipaadiga (RIB). Tema meeskond kogub selleks raha, et alustada ekspeditsiooni 2015. aasta kevadel.

article_content: Andy Murray secured his place in the quarter-finals of the Erste Bank Open by defeating Canada’s Vasek Pospisil 6-4, 6-4. Murray, seeded second, had a first-round bye and showed resilience by saving five break points in the second set after dropping serve at 3-2. After sealing his 470th career win, Murray stated, 'Hopefully I can improve for my next game.' He has now tied Fabrice Santoro for 50th in all-time Open era wins. This is Murray’s first appearance at the Vienna tournament. He decided to enter as a wild card to boost his chances of qualifying for the ATP World Tour Finals, aiming to rise from 11th to a top-eight ranking after his earlier loss to David Ferrer in Shanghai. Pospisil, who hit 27 aces in his opening round against Daniel Brands, was limited to just three aces by Murray. Murray's upcoming opponent is Germany’s Jan-Lennard Struff, who advanced by winning the last seven points in a third-set tiebreak against Sergiy Stakhovsky. In other matches, top seed David Ferrer reached his 15th quarter-final of the season by defeating Tobias Kamke and next faces Ivo Karlovic. Thomaz Bellucci from Brazil overcame former champion Feliciano Lopez with a strong comeback, including a stretch of 19 consecutive points won. Bellucci will now meet Serbia’s Viktor Troicki, who beat Lukas Rosol. Germany’s Benjamin Becker defeated last year’s finalist Robin Haase and will face fellow German Philipp Kohlschreiber in the quarter-finals.

article_content:
The Israeli-Palestinian conflict is deeply rooted in disputes over land of historical and religious significance for Jews, Muslims, and Christians. Recent violence—including an unprecedented Hamas attack and Israel's retaliatory actions—has further complicated efforts toward peace.

The long-discussed two-state solution, in which Israelis and Palestinians would each have independent states, has been a central goal of international diplomacy—advocated by the United States and others for decades. However, recurring setbacks such as failed negotiations, the expansion of Israeli settlements, cycles of violence, and persistent disagreements over issues like final borders, control of Jerusalem, and the rights of Palestinian refugees have eroded support for this plan among both populations.

In statements following the October 2023 Hamas attack, President Joe Biden reaffirmed the need for a two-state solution, emphasizing that returning to the pre-crisis status quo is not an option. Analysts, including former US negotiator Dennis Ross and security expert Jon Alterman, highlight that while neither Israelis nor Palestinians are likely to leave, coexistence remains elusive due to mistrust and conflicting aspirations.

Historical attempts at peace—such as the 1993 Oslo Accords brokered by US President Bill Clinton, which provided mutual recognition between Israel and the Palestine Liberation Organization—raised hopes but ultimately faltered. Key events, including violent attacks and continued settlement growth, undermined trust and fragmentated potential Palestinian statehood, according to scholars like Atalia Omer.

Current data underscores the challenge. The number of Israeli settlers in the occupied West Bank and East Jerusalem has grown substantially—from about 520,000 in 2012 to more than 700,000 in 2022. Recent surveys show declining optimism: just 24% of Palestinians and 35% of Israelis now support a two-state solution.

Major obstacles remain, notably disagreements on borders, the status of Jerusalem—which both Israelis and Palestinians claim as their capital—and the fate of millions of Palestinian refugees and their descendants. Security concerns persist for both sides. Israel seeks guarantees against attacks from militant groups like Hamas, while Palestinians demand sovereignty and an end to occupation.

Alternatives to the two-state solution—including a single binational state, confederation models, annexation, or perpetuating the status quo—do not command broad support among either population. Activists and experts, such as Atalia Omer and groups like A Land for All, note the complexity of balancing Israel’s identity as both a Jewish and democratic state, and stress the need for new ideas and mutual recognition to break the current deadlock.

Worsening conditions and the apparent collapse of existing paradigms have led some activists to hope for change. Grassroots movements within Israeli and Palestinian communities continue to push for coexistence and equality, even as official political solutions remain out of reach.

Iisraeli-Palestiina konflikt on sügavalt juurdunud vaidlustes maa üle, millel on oluline ajalooline ja religioosne tähendus nii juutidele, moslemitele kui ka kristlastele. Hiljutine vägivald — sealhulgas enneolematu Hamasi rünnak ja sellele järgnenud Iisraeli vastutegevus — on rahupüüdlusi veelgi keerulisemaks muutnud.

Pikka aega arutatud kahe riigi lahendus, mille kohaselt oleks nii iisraellastel kui ka palestiinlastel oma iseseisvad riigid, on olnud rahvusvahelise diplomaatia keskne eesmärk, mida on USA ja teised toetanud aastakümneid. Kuid korduvad tagasilöögid nagu läbikukkunud rahukõnelused, laienevad Iisraeli asundused, vägivalla tsüklid ja kestvad lahkarvamused näiteks lõplike piiride, Jeruusalemma staatuse ning palestiina põgenike õiguste osas on toetusbaasi mõlemas kogukonnas kahandanud.

2023. aasta oktoobrikuu Hamasi rünnaku järel kinnitas president Joe Biden taas, et kahe riigi lahendus on vajalik, rõhutades, et kriisieelse olukorra juurde tagasi pöörduda ei saa. Analüütikud nagu endine USA läbirääkija Dennis Ross ja turvaekspert Jon Alterman rõhutavad, et kuigi kummalgi poolel pole kavatsust piirkonnast lahkuda, on usaldamatus ja vastandlikud eesmärgid takistanud kooseksisteerimist.

Ajaloolised katsetused rahuks — näiteks USA presidendi Bill Clintoni eestvedamisel 1993. aastal sõlmitud Oslo rahulepped, mis tõid kaasa Iisraeli ja Palestiina Vabastusorganisatsiooni vastastikuse tunnustuse — tõid alguses lootust, kuid see hääbus. Märgilised sündmused, sealhulgas vägivallaepisoodid ning jätkuv asunduste laienemine, on usaldust õõnestanud ja potentsiaalse Palestiina riigi killustanud, märgivad teadlased nagu Atalia Omer.

Tänased andmed rõhutavad väljakutse suurust. Iisraeli asunike arv okupeeritud Läänekaldal ja Ida-Jeruusalemmas on kasvanud 520 000-lt 2012. aastal enam kui 700 000-ni 2022. aastaks. Uuringud näitavad kahanevat optimismi: kahe riigi lahendus saab toetust ainult 24% palestiinlastest ja 35% iisraellastest.

Peamised takistused on endiselt alles — piirijoone määratlemine, Jeruusalemma staatus (mida peavad mõlemad pooled oma pealinnaks) ning miljonite palestiina põgenike ja nende järeltulijate tulevik. Turvakaalutlused on võtmetähtsusega mõlemalt poolt: Iisrael otsib tagatisi rünnakute vastu relvastatud rühmitustelt nagu Hamas, palestiinlased aga tahavad suveräänsust ja okupatsiooni lõppu.

Alternatiivid kahe riigi lahendusele — nagu ühe riigi mudel, konföderatsioon, annekteerimine või olukorra jätkumine — ei leia laialdast toetust kummalgi poolel. Aktivistid ja eksperdid nagu Atalia Omer ning liikumine „A Land for All“ rõhutavad, et Iisraeli identiteedi hoidmine nii juudi kui demokraatliku riigina on keerukas ning lahendus eeldab uusi ideid ja vastastikust tunnustust.

Halvenev olukord ja olemasolevate lahenduste ilmne kokkukukkumine panevad mõned aktivistid lootma muutusele. Rohujuuretasandi liikumised Iisraeli ja Palestiina ühiskondades jätkavad pingutusi kooseksisteerimise ja võrdsuse nimel, ehkki ametlikud poliitilised lahendused tunduvad kaugel.

Reece Delashmit, an 11-year-old from Illinois, hasn't let his use of a wheelchair stop him from helping out at home. When his brother Harry was shoveling snow from their driveway, Reece joined in by attaching a shovel to his powered wheelchair to help clear the snow. A video of Reece's inventive snowplowing, uploaded to YouTube by his father Rick Delashmit, has attracted nearly 70,000 views.

Six years ago, Reece suffered a brain injury in a car accident, which initially left him unable to walk, talk, eat, or drink. After months in the hospital and years of therapy, he can now walk with a trainer, communicate using a speech device and hand signals, and eat and drink on his own. His parents provided him with a powered wheelchair several months ago, a decision they had postponed for some time.

Reece and his brother work together to clear the driveway, with their proud father capturing the moment on video. In another popular YouTube clip, Reece gives his sister Sofie a ride around the house in a laundry basket attached to his wheelchair—a video that has garnered over 26,000 views. These heartwarming moments highlight Reece’s determination and the strong bond within his family.

article_content: A video has surfaced showing a New York police officer repeatedly striking a shirtless man in the basement of a Jewish youth center in Brooklyn. The incident took place at the Aliya Institute after volunteer security guard Zlamy Trappler called the police about a man sleeping in the lounge. The individual, identified as Ehud Halevi, was reportedly permitted to stay at the center. Upon arrival, the officers attempted to rouse Halevi, who appeared disoriented but not hostile. When the officers tried to handcuff him, Halevi apparently resisted, leading to a physical altercation. During the altercation, the male officer was seen punching Halevi and the female officer used both a truncheon and pepper spray. The confrontation lasted about two minutes until additional police arrived. Halevi was subsequently arrested on charges including assaulting a police officer, trespassing, resisting arrest, and harassment. Trappler, the security guard who made the call, later expressed regret over involving the police, stating, 'I should have let him sleep. It spiraled out of control.' The NYPD has yet to respond publicly to the incident. Community sources, as well as Sara Feiglin, wife of Rabbi Moshe Feiglin who runs the youth center, confirmed that Halevi was allowed to stay at the center. The event was reportedly in response to calls about two men fighting, but the video footage and multiple sources suggest Halevi was not acting violently.

Ivanka Trump, who previously served as a senior White House adviser during her father’s presidency, is scheduled to testify in person in the New York civil fraud trial examining the Trump family business. Her father, former President Donald Trump, and her brothers, Eric Trump and Donald Trump Jr., have already spent significant time on the witness stand giving testimony. While Ivanka is no longer a defendant in the case—after an appeals court ruled the claims against her were too old—she has been called to testify after unsuccessful attempts to block her appearance.

The lawsuit, brought by New York Attorney General Letitia James, alleges that Donald Trump and other defendants fraudulently inflated asset values for years on financial statements used to obtain loans and insurance. Judge Arthur Engoron has already found that Trump committed fraud, a decision that could potentially remove his control over major properties, though appeals allow him to maintain oversight for now. James, a Democrat, is seeking more than $300 million in penalties and a prohibition against Trump conducting business in New York. Trump and his co-defendants deny any wrongdoing, asserting that the financial statements undervalued his net worth and that any discrepancies were minor and covered by legal disclaimers.

Ivanka Trump held the role of executive vice president at the Trump Organization before her White House tenure. She has said she had limited knowledge regarding her father's annual financial statements and was not responsible for preparing them. Court documents show Ivanka Trump was involved in projects such as securing a loan and lease for a Washington hotel, as well as financing deals for properties in Miami and Chicago.

In January 2017, as her father’s presidency began, Ivanka stepped away from her Trump Organization role and later moved to Florida. Although she was dismissed as a defendant, state prosecutors argue that her testimony remains relevant due to her former leadership role and ongoing financial connections with the Trump business. The Trump Organization continues to manage aspects of her personal finances, provide insurance, and pay some of her legal fees.

In other business news, India’s packaged consumer goods sector grew by 9% in value and 8.6% in volume in the September quarter, primarily driven by rising rural demand, according to NielsenIQ. Meanwhile, Snap Inc., parent of Snapchat, reported doubling its Indian user base to 200 million in a year, largely due to the success of its Spotlight video feature. Additionally, India’s finance ministry may slow the pace of capital expenditure increases in the upcoming budget to address fiscal deficit targets.

article_content: Britain is about to experience a brief spell of warmer, spring-like weather, with temperatures forecast to climb up to 13°C—higher than usual for this time of year, according to the Met Office. However, the warmth will not last long, as cooler conditions and more rain are expected by the weekend. On the Invercauld Estate near Braemar in Aberdeenshire, the annual practice of controlled heather burning is underway. Despite the arrival of warmer weather in much of the UK, one moorland keeper continues to manage the heath in wintry conditions, with snow and ice still present in the highlands. The combination of controlled fire and lingering cold is unusual for this time of year. Heather burning, also known as 'swiping,' is typically done when heather dries but the peat remains damp. This tradition helps rejuvenate moorland, which benefits livestock and wildlife and contributes to the rural economy—supporting activities such as grouse shooting as birds feed in newly burned areas. Elsewhere, temperatures reached close to 13°C in some regions yesterday, and they are expected to remain around this level for much of the week. Still, parts of the UK woke up to sub-zero temperatures and ground frost yesterday morning. The frozen conditions led to cancellations at locations like Newbury Racecourse in Berkshire. Signs of spring are on the horizon, with newborn lambs enjoying shelter in barns in Durham as lambing season continues. Despite the cold mornings, the Met Office says these warmer daytime temperatures are not unusual for early March, though they are a welcome shift after recent colder weeks. The forecast predicts that today will be slightly cooler in the north, with London and southern areas seeing temperatures of around 9°C or 10°C. By Tuesday, readings are expected to rise again to as high as 12°C or 13°C. Most of the country will see dry weather with clouds and occasional sunshine through Tuesday. Starting Wednesday, rain will likely begin in the southwest and then spread more broadly, though the rainfall should remain light and be accompanied by cloudier, breezier conditions. Unsettled and rainy weather is anticipated to continue as the week progresses.

article_content: Pro-Palestinian protests erupted across the Middle East and around the world on Friday after former Hamas leader Khaled Meshaal called on supporters to participate in a "Day of Rage" amid the ongoing Israel-Hamas conflict. Large gatherings were observed in Iraq, where tens of thousands rallied; Iran, where Israeli and American flags were burned; and Yemen, with demonstrators waving Palestinian flags. In Beirut, Lebanon, supporters of Hezbollah held a rally backing Palestinians and criticizing Israel, chanting slogans such as "Death to Israel" and "Death to America," as Hezbollah leaders expressed solidarity with Hamas. In Jordan, riot police used tear gas to disperse hundreds of protesters heading toward the West Bank border, according to Reuters. Elsewhere, pro-Palestinian supporters staged demonstrations in Japan, Malaysia, Bangladesh, and Sri Lanka. These actions followed Meshaal's call for a day of "anger" in support of Palestinians and against Israeli strikes in Gaza, urging neighboring countries to show support. Meshaal encouraged demonstrators to send a message that they stand with Palestine and Gaza, describing the situation as a shared battle. In response to anticipated protests, the Israeli government advised Israelis abroad to be vigilant, warning that the calls for action might result in violence. In France, Interior Minister Gerald Darmanin banned pro-Palestinian demonstrations due to potential threats to public order, as reported by Agence France-Presse. Hungary and Germany have also prohibited such protests. Cities across the United States increased security measures ahead of planned demonstrations. "We are deeply disturbed by the message of hate. It is not acceptable," said New York City Mayor Eric Adams on Thursday, outlining enhanced police presence at schools and places of worship to ensure safety. The "Day of Rage" comes nearly a week after Hamas militants carried out a large, deadly surprise attack on Israel, launching thousands of rockets at southern areas and ambushing communities near the Gaza border. Israel responded by declaring war and vowing to destroy Hamas. According to Israeli authorities, at least 1,300 people have died, and 3,227 others have been injured in Israel since the Hamas attack. In Gaza, at least 1,799 people have been killed and an estimated 7,388 injured in Israeli retaliatory strikes, according to the Palestinian Ministry of Health. With a potential ground operation looming, Israel's military on Friday ordered the evacuation of northern Gaza—home to about 1.1 million people—within 24 hours.

article_content: Many people become sales managers due to their strong performance in sales, but team leadership demands a different skill set. New managers often take on these positions with little management training, defaulting to the short-term, target-focused methods they used as salespeople. However, true leadership is about guiding and supporting others, while recognizing there are various ways to achieve business objectives. Sales managers often believe their job is to motivate through directives and ensure their voices predominate, sometimes sidelining their team's perspectives. Yet, genuine commitment can't be forced. Effective leaders prioritize trust, allowing team members to show initiative and contribute their own ideas. Books like those by Stephen M. R. Covey discuss this trust-based approach. Transitioning from high-performing salesperson to effective sales manager means shifting from doing to teaching. Although it may be tempting for leaders to solve team problems personally for short-term gains, allowing team members to learn fosters greater independence and long-term performance, much like the lesson in the 'give a man a fish' proverb. Coaching within sales shouldn't be solely the manager’s duty. As business polls consistently reveal, most believe coaching is a manager’s responsibility, but this can create bottlenecks and dependency. When coaching comes from across the team, each member can find support from multiple sources, building a stronger, more empowered group. One-on-one meetings between managers and salespeople are typically focused on numbers and immediate targets, but this can impede development. Shifting these conversations to help individuals find impactful actions and overcome their own challenges encourages more meaningful growth and skill-building. Above all, prioritizing customer needs is crucial for any sales leader. Despite new responsibilities and shifting roles, keeping customer goals and challenges at the forefront ensures the team's efforts always serve the broader organizational mission.

A new report from Johns Hopkins University's SNF Agora Institute highlights significant disparities in civic engagement opportunities across the United States. Utilizing big data and computational tools, the institute created the first detailed map of civic opportunity, revealing inequalities tied to race, class, immigration status, and education. Published in Nature Human Behaviour, the study found that faith institutions and social and fraternal organizations—rather than high-profile advocacy groups—are the main engines of civic engagement nationwide.

"If you want to strengthen civic engagement, you first have to map what the civic infrastructure of the United States looks like. You can’t fix what you can’t see," said Hahrie Han, director of the SNF Agora Institute. Han explains that having a comprehensive overview is the first step toward targeted reforms to rebuild modern civic spaces, or "agoras."

The research team started with data from 1.8 million IRS-registered nonprofit organizations, cross-referencing more than 1 million organizational websites and U.S. Census information. They filtered for organizations genuinely fostering civic opportunity, identifying 564,559 such groups. The data shows that civic opportunity per capita decreases as poverty increases; wealthier, whiter, and better-educated communities have more civic opportunities, while communities with fewer opportunities struggle to address collective challenges, such as pandemic response and vaccine advocacy. For example, Connecticut counties generally score high on civic opportunity, whereas most of Mississippi ranks among the lowest.

According to the report, faith-based and social/fraternal organizations (like Rotary clubs, fraternities, and ethnic societies) account for 37% of all civic opportunity organizations, and are the leading providers in 85% of U.S. counties. Han noted, “It’s surprising how central these organizations remain to civic life. Political elites and reformers often overlook grassroots gathering spots, which are key to engaging communities in democracy.”

The SNF Agora Institute team, which includes associate research scholar Milan de Vries and research fellow Jae Yeon Kim, plans to make the civic opportunity data publicly available and searchable by ZIP code, allowing people to identify these organizations in their communities.

article_content: Each year, tens of millions of travelers fly across major oceans, making transatlantic journeys almost commonplace. On prominent routes, such as between New York’s John F. Kennedy Airport and London’s Heathrow Airport, there are more than a dozen nonstop flights in each direction every day. These vast airports are bustling hubs with multiple terminals connected by internal rail systems, moving both people and luggage. Over 76,000 people work at Heathrow alone, ensuring operations begin before dawn and continue until the last flight of the day. The first major transatlantic passenger gateway into Europe was Foynes, Ireland. At the Foynes Flying Boat & Maritime Museum, visitors can experience a life-size replica of a Pan Am flying boat, commemorating the pioneering role of this coastal village. Today, airlines determine new routes at industry events like Routes, a trade show where thousands of airline and airport executives gather to discuss potential services. Since travel and tourism contribute around 10% of global employment, establishing new routes can significantly boost local economies. Governments and tourism boards often support new flights with financial incentives or promotional backing. The story of how the first European passenger air link from the U.S. was established is highlighted at the Foynes museum. Situated on the Shannon Estuary about 50 minutes from Shannon Airport, Foynes played a crucial role when stopovers in western Ireland were mandated for political and economic reasons, steering visitors into rural regions. Unlike policy decisions, the original choice of Foynes was based on strategic suitability. Inside the Pan Am flying boat replica, visitors can learn how, in 1933, iconic aviator Charles Lindbergh selected the site for what would later become Heathrow Airport. After his 1927 solo nonstop flight across the Atlantic, Lindbergh became a consultant to Pan Am founder Juan Trippe. Trippe’s vision helped shape modern commercial aviation, pushing manufacturers like Douglas and Boeing to develop the DC-8, 707, and eventually becoming the first customer for the Boeing 747. He also supported innovations such as supersonic flight and the expansion of business jets. Lindbergh's work surveying potential new flight routes was instrumental in Pan Am’s transoceanic ambitions. In the 1920s and 30s, he piloted propeller planes to remote coasts, identifying water landings safe from rough seas—a necessity before concrete runways became widespread during WWII. The resulting infrastructure helped transform global air travel and ended the reign of flying boats. By the 1930s, after mapping paths to South America and Asia, Pan Am aimed to launch passenger flights between the U.S. and Europe. These pioneering flights faced numerous dangers: unpredictable weather, limited navigational tools, and no nearby emergency landing spots. Navigators used sextants and stars to plot courses, sometimes dropping smoke buoys to measure wind over the open Atlantic. Adverse conditions often forced flights to turn back or take southern routes via Lisbon, Trinidad, Brazil, and West Africa. Multiple flying boat designs were tried before one was reliable enough to safely cross between the U.S. and Europe via Foynes. With the outbreak of WWII shortly after the first successful crossings in 1939, Pan Am suspended commercial service. However, flying boats continued critical wartime operations, benefiting from Ireland’s neutrality as they shuttled key envoys between the Allied nations. Postwar advancements in aviation made flying boats obsolete. Long-range jets and new runways enabled nonstop flights across the Atlantic. During its heyday, Foynes welcomed prominent visitors such as Winston Churchill, Eleanor Roosevelt, Ernest Hemingway, John F. Kennedy, Bob Hope, and Humphrey Bogart. Today, the museum houses a full-scale replica of the double-decker Boeing 314 ‘Yankee Clipper,’ offering a glimpse into the spacious cabins and cockpits, period artifacts, and the history of early transatlantic aviation. One enduring legacy from Foynes is Irish Coffee. On a stormy evening, after a flight returned to Foynes due to bad weather, a local chef created the now-classic drink—freshly brewed coffee, Irish whiskey, sugar, and cream—to warm the chilled passengers, a recipe still served today in the same style of glass.
translated_content: Igal aastal lendavad kümned miljonid reisijad üle ookeanide, muutes Atlandi-üleste reiside tavaliseks nähtuseks. Olulistel marsruutidel, nagu New Yorgi John F. Kennedy lennujaama ja Londoni Heathrow lennujaama vahel, toimub iga päev enam kui tosin otselendu mõlemas suunas. Need hiiglaslikud lennujaamad on saginad täis sõlmpunktid, kus on mitu terminali, mida ühendavad sisemised raudteed ning kus liigutatakse nii inimesi kui ka pagasit. Ainult Heathrow’s töötab üle 76 000 inimese, kes alustavad oma vahetusi enne koitu ja lõpetavad alles pärast viimase lennuki väljumist. Esimene suurem Atlandi-üleste reisijate värav Euroopasse oli Foynes Iirimaal. Foynes’i Lendpaadi ja Meremuuseumis saavad külastajad kogeda Pan Ami lendpaadi tõetruud koopiat, mis tähistab selle rannikuküla teedrajavat rolli. Tänapäeval otsustavad lennufirmad uute marsruutide avamise üle valdkonnaüritustel nagu Routes mess, kus tuhanded lennufirmade ja lennujaamade juhid arutavad võimalikke uusi ühendusi. Kuna turism moodustab umbes 10% ülemaailmsest tööhõivest, võib uute lennuliinide rajamine kohalikke majandusi märkimisväärselt elavdada. Valitsused ja turismiametid toetavad uusi lende sageli rahaliselt või promokampaaniatega. Esimese USA-st Euroopasse viiva reisilennu värava lugu on Foynesi muuseumis põhjalikult kajastatud. Shannon Estuaaril asuv Foynes on umbes 50 minuti autosõidu kaugusel Shannon Airportist ja mängis tähtsat rolli, kui lääne-Iirimaa vahepeatust nõuti poliitilistel ning majanduslikel põhjustel, et suunata reisijaid maapiirkondadesse. Foynesi esialgne valik tehti siiski strateegilise sobivuse, mitte poliitika alusel. Pan Ami lendpaadi koopas saavad külastajad teada, kuidas 1933. aastal valis legendaarne lendur Charles Lindbergh koha tulevasele Heathrow lennujaamale. Pärast 1927. aasta soololendu üle Atlandi sai Lindberghist Pan Ami asutaja Juan Trippe nõunik. Trippe visioon kujundas tänapäevase kaubandusliku lennunduse, suunates lennukitootjaid Douglas’t ja Boeingut arendama DC-8 ja 707 lennukeid ning olles esimene Boeing 747 ostja. Ta toetas ka ülehelikiirusega reisilende ja ärilennunduse kasvu. Lindberghi panus uute marsruutide uurimisel oli Pan Ami transokeaaniliste ideede jaoks kriitilise tähtsusega. 1920.–30. aastatel lendas ta propellerlennukitega kaugematesse rannikupiirkondadesse, otsides paiku, kus lendpaadid said lainevarjus turvaliselt vette maanduda—aeg, mil betoonrajad polnud veel standardiks. Teise maailmasõjaga kaasnenud infrastruktuurimuutused muutsid maailma lennundust ja lõpetasid lendpaatide ajastu. 1930ndateks alustas Pan Am, pärast lõuna-ameerika ja Aasia marsruutide kaardistamist, reisilende USA ja Euroopa vahel. Need esmased lennud olid riskantsed: ilm oli ettearvamatu, navigeerimisvahendid piiratud ning hädamaandumiskohad puudusid. Kursse määrati sekstandi ja tähtede järgi, tihti visati Atlandi kohal tuule mõõtmiseks suitsumarker. Halbade tingimuste korral pöörduti tagasi või võeti lõunapoolne marsruut Lissaboni, Trinidadi, Brasiilia ja Lääne-Aafrika kaudu. Mitmeid lendpaadimudeleid katsetati enne, kui leiti sobiv ja turvaline variant Foynesi kaudu Atlandi ületamiseks. Vahetult pärast 1939. aasta esimesi edukaid ületusi puhkes Teine maailmasõda ning Pan Am peatas kommertsliinid. Lendpaadid jätkasid siiski sõjaaegseid olulisi lennutusi, kasutades Iirimaa neutraalsuse eeliseid alliansi esindajate vaheliste lendude jaoks. Sõjajärgsete lennundusedenduste tõttu muutusid lendpaadid kiirelt iganenuks. Pikamaa reaktiivlennukid ja uued maandumisrajad võimaldasid otselendusid üle Atlandi. Oma hiilgeajal võõrustas Foynes mitmeid kuulsusi nagu Winston Churchill, Eleanor Roosevelt, Ernest Hemingway, John F. Kennedy, Bob Hope ja Humphrey Bogart. Täna asub muuseumis täismõõdus Boeing 314 ‘Yankee Clipper’i’ koopia, pakkudes pilguheidu algusaegade avaratesse kajutitesse, kabiinidesse, esemetele ja lennundusajaloo lugudesse. Foynesist pärineb ka kuulus Irish Coffee. Tormisel ööl, kui lendpaadiga reisijad naasid halva ilma tõttu, valmistas kohalik kokk neile kosutava joogi—värske kohv, iiri viski, suhkur ja vahustatud koor—retsept, mida serveeritakse veel tänagi samasuguses klaasis.

article_content: The UK's doctors' regulator emphasizes that attracting skilled overseas-trained doctors will remain vital, even as the country works to train more healthcare professionals locally. The General Medical Council (GMC) reports that nearly two-thirds (63%) of new doctors in 2022 qualified abroad. Despite the government's ambitious plan, launched in June, to train and recruit more healthcare workers in England, the GMC notes that effects will take several years to be realized. NHS England reports 10,855 full-time doctor vacancies, representing a rate of 7.2%. Under the Long Term Workforce Plan, NHS England aims to recruit and retain 'hundreds of thousands' more healthcare staff over the next 15 years. The plan includes a £2.4 billion investment in additional training places, with the number of annual medical school spots for future doctors set to double to 15,000. Prospective doctors require five years of medical school followed by further on-the-job training before fully qualifying. Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland also have their own recruitment and retention programs. Doctors must be registered with the GMC to practice anywhere in the UK. Charlie Massey, chief executive of the GMC, described the initiative to grow the workforce as 'brilliant', but warned, 'it takes a long time to make a doctor.' He stated, 'We’re unlikely to see significant impact for at least a decade. As a result, we will need to rely on greater numbers of overseas-trained doctors coming to the UK to maintain the workforce necessary to meet public needs.' The GMC's latest report predicts that in 14 years, the proportion of overseas-trained doctors working in the UK will likely be similar to the current level (39%). The regulator is also concerned about retaining NHS doctors, citing 'worrying signs' that more are planning to leave the profession due to high dissatisfaction and burnout. In 2022, approximately 2,000 UK-trained doctors left to practice abroad, accounting for 15% of those exiting the profession. NHS England's workforce plan includes efforts to improve retention, such as flexible working options and career development opportunities. Mr Massey stressed the importance of fully supporting incoming overseas-trained doctors. The GMC provides workshops to help these doctors adapt to the UK's medical culture, with new arrivals encouraged to participate. 'The more we and our health services support doctors arriving in the UK, the better the chance of retaining their services longer,' said Massey. Oyku Tural, a doctor who trained in Cyprus, recently attended a GMC 'Welcome to the UK' event. She said she values support in adapting to a new system and believes overseas-trained doctors can be a valuable asset to the NHS. Dr. Sarah Clarke, president of the Royal College of Physicians, commented, 'Doctors trained overseas play a vital role in the workforce and without them, the NHS would be under even greater pressure than it is now.' An NHS England spokesperson reiterated that the long-term plan aims to increase recruitment, retain existing staff, and reform education and training for a future-ready workforce, recognizing the continuing need for doctors from overseas.
translated_content: Suurbritannia arstide regulaator rõhutab, et kvalifitseeritud välismaal koolitatud arstide kaasamine jääb väga oluliseks, isegi kui riik püüab koolitada rohkem kohalikke meditsiinispetsialiste. General Medical Council (GMC) andmetel omandas peaaegu kaks kolmandikku (63%) uutest arstidest 2022. aastal kraadi välismaal. Kuigi valitsus käivitas juunis ambitsioonika plaani, et koolitada ja värvata rohkem tervishoiutöötajaid Inglismaal, märgib GMC, et selle mõju avaldub alles mitme aasta pärast. NHS England teatab, et praegu on 10 855 täiskohaga arsti ametikohta täitmata, mis moodustab 7,2%. Pikaajalise tööjõu plaani kohaselt soovib NHS England järgmise 15 aasta jooksul värvata ja säilitada 'sadu tuhandeid' rohkem tervishoiutöötajaid. Plaan sisaldab 2,4 miljardi naela suurust investeeringut täiendavatesse koolituskohtadesse ning meditsiiniõpilaste aastaste kohtade arvu kahekordistamist 15 000-ni. Tulevased arstid peavad enne täiekspädevaks saamist õppima viis aastat arstiteadust ning läbima täiendava väljaõppe töö käigus. Šotimaal, Walesis ja Põhja-Iirimaal on samuti oma värbamis- ja säilitamisprogrammid. Arstid peavad kogu Ühendkuningriigis töötamiseks olema registreeritud GMC-s. GMC tegevjuht Charlie Massey nimetas algatust tööjõu suurendamiseks 'suurepäraseks', kuid hoiatas, et 'arsti koolitamine võtab kaua aega'. Ta märkis: 'Tõenäoliselt ei näe me olulist mõju enne vähemalt kümnendit. Seetõttu peame tuginema veelgi rohkem välismaal koolitatud arstide tulekule, et hoida vajalikku tööjõudu, mis rahuldab avalikkuse vajadusi.' GMC värskeim raport prognoosib, et 14 aasta pärast moodustavad välismaal koolitatud arstid Ühendkuningriigis tõenäoliselt umbes sama suure osa (39%) kui praegu. Regulaator väljendab samuti muret NHS-i arstide säilitamise üle, viidates 'murettekitavatele märkidele', et üha enam arste plaanib ametist lahkuda rahulolematuse ja läbipõlemise tõttu. 2022. aastal lahkus välismaal töötamiseks umbes 2 000 Suurbritannias koolitatud arsti, mis moodustab 15% kõigist ametist lahkujatest. NHS Englandi tööjõuplaani hulka kuuluvad meetmed arstkonna säilitamiseks, näiteks paindlikud töövõimalused ja karjääriarengu võimalused. Massey rõhutas välismaal koolitatud arstide täieliku toetamise olulisust. GMC pakub töötubasid, mis aitavad neil arstidel kohaneda Ühendkuningriigi meditsiinikultuuriga, ning uutele saabujatele soovitatakse kindlasti osaleda. 'Mida rohkem meie ja tervishoiuasutused toetame Ühendkuningriiki saabunud arste, seda suurem on võimalus nende teenuseid kauem kasutada,' ütles Massey. Oyku Tural, Küprosel koolitatud arst, osales hiljuti GMC 'Tere tulemast Ühendkuningriiki' üritusel. Ta ütles, et hindab abi uue süsteemiga kohanemisel ning usub, et välismaal koolitatud arstid võivad NHS-ile olulist lisandväärtust pakkuda. Royal College of Physiciansi president dr Sarah Clarke kommenteeris: 'Välismaal koolitatud arstid mängivad tööjõus olulist rolli ja ilma nendeta oleks NHS veelgi suurema surve all kui praegu.' NHS Englandi pressiesindaja kinnitas, et pikaajaline plaan näeb ette arstide arvu suurendamise, olemasoleva personali hoidmise ning hariduse ja koolituse reformimise, et töötajaskond oleks tulevikuks valmis, ning rõhutab jätkuvat vajadust välismaalt tulnud arstide järele.

article_content: An independent investigation has found that senior police officers in Northern Ireland did not act on substantial intelligence suggesting a Catholic priest was linked to the 1972 Claudy bombings, a major terrorist attack in the region. On July 31, 1972, three bombs were detonated in Claudy, County Londonderry—near a pub, a post office, and a hotel—resulting in nine deaths and 30 injuries. Al Hutchinson, the Police Ombudsman for Northern Ireland, reported that the Royal Ulster Constabulary (RUC) had significant evidence implicating Father James Chesney as an operative for the Irish Republican Army (IRA), yet the police chose not to arrest or interrogate him. Instead, they consulted with the government, which then involved senior Catholic Church officials. This led to Chesney being quietly transferred to a different parish in the Republic of Ireland. Although accused, Chesney, who died in 1980, denied any involvement when questioned by the Church. The ombudsman’s report found no criminal intent by police, government, or Church leadership, and it did not find evidence that police could have proactively prevented the bombings. However, it strongly criticized the police for undermining the investigation, failing victims and detectives. Church leaders, such as Cardinal Sean Brady and Bishop Seamus Hegarty, expressed deep shock over the priest’s suspected involvement, accepted the findings, and appealed to anyone with further information to come forward. They emphasized the Catholic Church’s continued condemnation of violence and stated that all relevant evidence had been handed over to investigators. The report noted that the extreme violence and instability of 1972 were factors in police decisions, although the lack of follow-up now appears collusive. The senior officials responsible for these decisions are now deceased and cannot provide additional details. The ombudsman investigation began in 2002 after the Police Service of Northern Ireland (which succeeded the RUC in 2001) revealed that it possessed historic intelligence involving a priest in the Claudy bombing case.
translated_content: Sõltumatu uurimine leidis, et Põhja-Iirimaa kõrged politseiametnikud ei reageerinud olulisele luureandmetele, mis viitasid katoliku preestri võimalikule seotusele 1972. aasta Claudy pommirünnakutega – ühe rängima terroriaktiga piirkonna ajaloos. 31. juulil 1972 lõhkes Claudy linnas, Londonderry krahvkonnas, kolm pommi – kõrtsi, postkontori ja hotelli juures –, mille tagajärjel hukkus üheksa ja vigastada sai 30 inimest. Põhja-Iirimaa politsei ombudsman Al Hutchinson ütles oma raportis, et Royal Ulster Constabularyl (RUC) oli märkimisväärseid tõendeid, mis seostasid isa James Chesney't Iiri Vabariikliku Armee (IRA) tegevusega, kuid politsei otsustas teda mitte vahistada ega küsitleda. Selle asemel pöörduti valitsuse poole, kes kaasas arutelusse katoliku kiriku juhid. Chesney viidi seejärel vaikselt uude kogudusse Iirimaa Vabariigis. Kuigi süüdistati, eitas Chesney – kes suri 1980. aastal – igasugust seotust, kui kiriku ülemad temalt aru pärisid. Ombudsmani raport pärast uurimist ei leidnud tõendeid, et politsei, valitsuse või kiriku juhid oleksid tegutsenud kuritegeliku kavatsusega või et neil oleks olnud infot, millega oleks saanud rünnakuid ära hoida. Samas kritiseeriti politseid juurdluse takistamise ja ohvrite ning uurijate ebaõiglase kohtlemise eest. Kiriku juhid, sealhulgas kardinal Sean Brady ja piiskop Seamus Hegarty, väljendasid sügavat šokki preestri võimaliku seotuse üle, aktsepteerisid raporti tulemused ja kutsusid kõiki, kellel on lisateavet, ühendust võtma. Nad rõhutasid kiriku järjepidevat vägivalla hukkamõistu ning kinnitasid, et kogu teadaolev info on jõudnud uurijateni. Raportis toodi välja, et 1972. aasta keeruline ja vägivaldne olukord mõjutas politsei otsuseid, kuid praeguse pilguga võib tehtud valikuid näha koostöö või katmisena. Otsused teinud isikud on tänaseks surnud ja täiendavat infot nende motivatsioonide kohta pole võimalik saada. Ombudsmani uurimine käivitati 2002. aastal pärast seda, kui Põhja-Iirimaa Politseiteenistus (PSNI, endise RUC järglane) avaldas, et nende valduses on ajalooline info preestri võimalikust osalusest Claudy pommirünnakus.

article_content: Bishop Bell Church of England School in Eastbourne, East Sussex, has implemented stricter uniform rules for students. The updated guidelines prohibit figure-hugging clothing, short skirts, and visible underwear. Girls below year 10 (ages 14 to 15) are also not allowed to wear make-up. Skirts must be no more than 2 inches (5 cm) above the knee, and tight or skinny-fitting styles are not permitted. According to the uniform guide, trousers should be straight-cut, loose around the ankles, and free of Lycra or similar stretch fabrics. Nail varnish, body piercings, and most jewellery are banned. The school stresses the importance of maintaining high standards of appearance. Students are expected to wear the full school uniform not only on campus, but also during their journey to and from school. A letter to parents explained that these rules are intended to encourage students to take pride in themselves and in their school. Although the updated uniform policy was announced after former teacher Jeremy Forrest’s conviction for child abduction and sexual activity with a student, there is no indication that the rules are a direct response to that case. Forrest received a five-and-a-half-year prison sentence after being found guilty at Lewes Crown Court. The school’s administration did not provide further comment on the new guidelines due to the summer break. A representative from East Sussex County Council stated that they could not comment on individual school uniform policies.

Seelikud tohivad olla maksimaalselt 5 cm (2 tolli) üle põlve ning liibuvad või kitsad stiilid on keelatud. Vormijuhised nõuavad, et püksid oleksid sirge lõikega, pahkluu ümbruses avarad ja ilma lükrata või sarnase veniva materjalita. Keelatud on ka küünelakk, kehakaunistused ja enamik ehteid. Lapsevanematele saadetud kirjas selgitab kool, et need reeglid peaksid aitama õpilastel tunda uhkust enda ja kooli üle. Kuigi uuendatud vorminõuded avalikustati pärast endise õpetaja Jeremy Forresti süüdimõistmist lapse röövimise ja seksuaalse teo eest, ei ole viiteid, et need oleksid otsene vastus sellele juhtumile. Forrest sai Lewesi kohtus viie ja poole aasta pikkuse vangistuse. Kooli juhtkond ei andnud suvevaheaja tõttu täiendavaid kommentaare. Ida-Sussexi maakonnanõukogu esindaja ütles, et nad ei saa üksikute koolide vorminõuetega seoses kommentaare anda.

article_content: Manchester United manager Louis van Gaal is urging his players to mentally prepare for their upcoming clash against Stoke City, encouraging them to replay the match in their minds—even while resting. United will visit the Britannia Stadium on New Year's Day, hoping to claim their eighth win out of ten matches—a challenge, especially after possible New Year's Eve festivities. Van Gaal, who has used Wayne Rooney in several roles this season, is determined to help United catch up with Manchester City and Chelsea, both of which have games later that day. The Dutch manager emphasizes that the team’s fate lies in their own hands, stating, 'You need to focus on your own preparation and visualize playing the game; each player should already have the match in their head before kickoff.' Though United are unbeaten in nine matches and currently third in the Premier League, Van Gaal remains unsatisfied with their performances. He says their win over Newcastle reminded him of Sir Alex Ferguson-era victories but still wasn’t up to his standards. Van Gaal reflects that, in almost three decades of coaching, he’s only witnessed a 'perfect' match once—when Ajax beat Real Madrid in the 1995 Champions League. Reflecting on recent draws with Tottenham and Aston Villa, Van Gaal expresses regret over lost points, noting United could be much closer to league leaders if those results had been wins. Regardless, he praises United fans for their persistent support, highlighting their encouragement after setbacks—something he didn’t experience at Barcelona, Bayern Munich, or Ajax. Ahead of the Stoke match, United may see the return of Adnan Januzaj and Ander Herrera from injury and illness, and Angel di Maria’s minor pelvic issue is not expected to sideline him. Van Gaal also has faith in referee Michael Oliver to manage the game fairly.
translated_content: Manchester Unitedi peatreener Louis van Gaal julgustab oma mängijaid vaimselt valmistuma eesootavaks kohtumiseks Stoke Cityga, soovitades neil mängule mõttes keskenduda – isegi voodis puhates. United sõidab uusaasta päeval Britannia staadionile lootusega võtta kümnest mängust kaheksas võit – eriti raske ülesanne, arvestades võimalikku aastavahetuse tähistamist. Van Gaal, kes on sel hooajal kasutanud Wayne Rooneyt erinevatel positsioonidel, soovib, et United jõuaks järele Manchester Cityle ja Chelseale, kellel mõlemal on samal päeval veel mäng ees. Hollandi juhendaja rõhutab, et edu sõltub mängijate oma pingutusest: 'Peate keskenduma enda ettevalmistusele ja visualiseerima mängu; iga mängija peaks juba enne avavilet vaimusilmas mängu läbi mängima.' Kuigi United on üheksa mängu järjest kaotuseta püsinud ja hoiab Premier League’is kolmandat kohta, ei ole Van Gaal veel meeskonna esitustes täielikult rahul. Ta ütleb, et võit Newcastle’i vastu meenutas talle Fergusoni-aegseid mänge, kuid see ei vastanud siiski nõutud tasemele. Van Gaali sõnul on ta pea 30-aastase treenerikarjääri jooksul näinud ideaalset esitust vaid korra – kui Ajax 1995. aasta Meistrite liigas võitis Real Madridi. Viimasteks viikideks Tottenhamiga ja Aston Villaga tagasi vaadates avaldab Van Gaal kahetsust kaotatud punktide pärast, märkides, et nendes mängudes võidud oleks Unitedi tippu lähemale toonud. Siiski kiidab ta Unitedi fänne vankumatu toetuse eest ka ebaõnnestumiste korral – midagi, mida ta Barcelonas, Münchenis või Ajaxis ei kogenud. Stoke’i kohtumiseks võivad Adnan Januzaj ja Ander Herrera naasta pärast vigastust ja haigust, samal ajal kui Angel di Maria kerge vaagna vigastus tõenäoliselt teda kõrvale ei jäta. Samuti usub Van Gaal, et kohtunik Michael Oliver juhib kohtumist ausalt.

article_content: Ben Mezrich’s new book, "Breaking Twitter," describes an incident where James Musk, Elon Musk’s cousin, was discovered close to tears at Twitter’s San Francisco office. Mezrich, also known for his book on Facebook that inspired "The Social Network" film, told Business Insider that a former Twitter executive found James Musk visibly upset in a soundproof booth, afraid he could be fired as easily as any other employee. The stress came from trying to meet Elon Musk’s expectations, leaving James feeling overwhelmed and anxious. Both James and his brother Andrew Musk came to Twitter—now X—shortly after Elon Musk’s $44 billion takeover. They are sons of Elon’s uncle on his father’s side. Andrew focused on software engineering tasks, while James took on a flexible role supporting Elon personally. Company representatives did not reply to requests for comment. Mezrich’s account is built from interviews with Twitter staff and Musk’s associates, but not Elon himself; he notes some dialogue and scenes are reconstructed, particularly those imagining Elon Musk’s thought process. Mezrich added that conditions under Musk’s leadership became so fraught that staff once contemplated a wellness check after Elon secluded himself in his office.
