Mezrich, kes on ka Facebooki teemalise raamatu autor (sellest valmis film „Sotsiaalvõrgustik”), ütles Business Insiderile, et endine Twitteri juht nägi James Muski helikindlas kabiinis silmanähtavalt ärevil ja mures selle pärast, et ta võiks töö kaotada sama lihtsalt kui iga teine töötaja. Pinge tuli sellest, et James püüdis täita Eloni ootusi, mis tegi ta ülekoormatuks ja ärevaks. James ja tema vend Andrew Musk liitusid Twitteriga – nüüd tuntud kui X – vahetult pärast Elon Muski 44 miljardi dollari suurust ostu. Nad on Eloni isa venna pojad. Andrew töötas tarkvarainsenerina, James aga toetas Eloni otse erinevate ülesannetega. Ettevõte ei vastanud kommentaaripalvetele. Mezrichi raamat põhineb intervjuudel Twitteri töötajate ja Muski lähikondsetega, kuid ei sisalda Eloni enda intervjuud; autor rõhutab, et osa stseene ja dialoogi on taasloodud, eriti need, mis kirjeldavad Eloni mõtteid. Mezrich lisas, et olukord Muski juhtimise ajal oli niivõrd pingeline, et töötajad kaalusid lausa Muskile heaolukontrolli kutsumist, kui ta eraldus oma kontorisse.

article_content: During her Rio de Janeiro concert on Sunday night, Taylor Swift performed 'Bigger Than the Whole Sky,' a song about grief, just two days after the tragic death of fan Ana Clara Benevides Machado. The 23-year-old passed away on Friday after falling ill during Swift’s concert at Nilton Santos Stadium. Extremely high temperatures were believed to have contributed to her death. Swift postponed her Saturday night show in Rio to Sunday due to the weekend's heat. She stated on Instagram, 'The safety and well-being of my fans, fellow performers, and crew has to and always will come first.' Although Swift did not mention Benevides Machado by name during the concert ('I’m not going to be able to speak about this from stage because I feel overwhelmed by grief when I even try to talk about it,' she wrote on social media), her song choice prompted an emotional response from the audience. A video recorded by an audience member shows the crowd singing along to the lyrics, 'goodbye, goodbye, goodbye.' The song includes the verses: 'No words appear before me in the aftermath/Salt streams out my eyes and into my ears/Every single thing I touch becomes sick with sadness/’Cause it’s all over now, all out to sea/ Goodbye, goodbye, goodbye/You were bigger than the whole sky/You were more than just a short time.' During Friday's concert, Swift repeatedly asked security to provide water for fans standing near the stage. Temperatures in Rio exceeded 100 degrees Fahrenheit, and many fans, eager to keep their spots at the front, had been waiting in line for hours and were hesitant to leave for water. Ana Clara Benevides Machado was identified as the casualty by event organizers Time for Fun. According to People magazine, her father Weiny Machado told Folha de S.Paulo newspaper he wants clarification on whether fans were prohibited from bringing water to Friday’s show. 'I want to know if it’s true that they are prohibited from bringing water and neglected to provide assistance,' he reportedly said. 'I lost my only daughter, a happy and intelligent girl.'
translated_content: Oma Rio de Janeiro kontserdil pühapäeva õhtul esitas Taylor Swift loo 'Bigger Than the Whole Sky', mis käsitleb leina, vaid kaks päeva pärast fänni Ana Clara Benevides Machado traagilist surma. 23-aastane Benevides Machado suri reedel, pärast seda kui tal hakkas Nilton Santose staadionil toimunud Swift’i kontserdil halb. Tema surma põhjustajaks peetakse äärmuslikku kuumust. Swift lükkas laupäevase kontserdi Rio de Janeiros edasi pühapäevaks nädalavahetuse kuumuse tõttu. Ta kirjutas Instagramis: 'Minu fännide, teiste esinejate ja meeskonna turvalisus ja heaolu peavad olema ja jäävad alati esikohale.' Kuigi Swift ei maininud Benevides Machado nimepidi kontserdi ajal ('Ma ei suuda sellest laval rääkida, sest tunnen end isegi proovides ülekoormatuna leinast,' kirjutas ta sotsiaalmeedias), kutsus see laul publikus esile tugeva emotsionaalse reaktsiooni. Ühe pealtvaataja videost on kuulda, kuidas rahvas laulab kaasa sõnadele: 'hüvasti, hüvasti, hüvasti.' Laulus kõlab rida: 'No words appear before me in the aftermath/Salt streams out my eyes and into my ears/Every single thing I touch becomes sick with sadness/’Cause it’s all over now, all out to sea/ Goodbye, goodbye, goodbye/You were bigger than the whole sky/You were more than just a short time.' Reede kontserdi ajal palus Swift mitu korda turvalisust tuua vett fännidele, kes seisid lava ees. Rio temperatuurid ületasid 100°F (umbes 38°C) ja paljud fännid, kes olid kohti hoidnud eesliinil juba tunde, ei soovinud vett saamiseks eemalduda. Ana Clara Benevides Machado tuvastati ohvrina ürituse korraldajate Time for Fun poolt. Ajakirja People andmetel ütles tema isa Weiny Machado ajalehele Folha de S.Paulo, et soovib selgust, kas fännidel oli keelatud reedesele kontserdile vett kaasa võtta. 'Ma tahan teada, kas see vastab tõele, et neil oli keelatud vett kaasa võtta ja neile ei osutatud abi,' ütles ta väidetavalt. 'Ma kaotasin oma ainukese tütre, rõõmsa ja intelligentse neiu.'

article_content: A Raja, a DMK Member of Parliament and former Union Minister, is facing a legal challenge in the Madras High Court, where a writ of quo warranto has been filed against him for his remarks on Sanatana Dharma. In his counter affidavit, Raja explains that his statements are his personal views, protected by constitutional rights, and are not unconstitutional. He argues that as a public servant, he has a duty to criticize and condemn practices he considers illegal, especially those involving caste and gender inequality, which, he claims, are practiced in the name of Sanatana Dharma. Raja disputes the allegations against him as vague, false, and taken out of context, maintaining that the petition is not maintainable under the Constitution and should be dismissed. Raja refers to the Constituent Assembly debates and the enactment of various Hindu Code Bills, stating that these legal reforms were also motivated by a concern for social justice. He insists his comments are in line with the constitutional guarantees of social and gender equality. His previous public statements have involved comparing Sanatana Dharma to diseases like HIV, and he has supported similar remarks by Minister Udhayanidhi Stalin. These comparisons have sparked political controversy, particularly with the BJP. Raja clarifies that his intent was to draw attention to ongoing social inequalities, not to offend religious beliefs. Additionally, Raja accuses the petitioner of distorting his speech through selective video editing to present a misleading narrative. He maintains that none of his statements qualify as grounds for disqualification from Parliament and that the issue is beyond judicial review. He has asked the Madras High Court to dismiss the writ petition and award costs.
translated_content: A Raja, DMK parlamendiliige ja endine liidu minister, seisab silmitsi kohtuvaidlusega Madras High Courtis, kus tema vastu on esitatud quo warranto määrus seoses tema avaldustega Sanatana Dharma kohta. Oma vastuses kohtule rõhutab Raja, et tema väljaütlemised on tema isiklikud arvamused, mis on põhiseadusega kaitstud ega ole vastuolus seadusega. Ta väidab, et avaliku teenistujana on tema kohustus kritiseerida ja hukka mõista tavasid, mida ta peab ebaseaduslikeks, eriti neid, mis on seotud kastide ja soolise ebavõrdsusega ning mida tema sõnul tehakse Sanatana Dharma nimel. Raja lükkab süüdistused tagasi kui ebamäärased, valed ja kontekstist välja rebitud, väites, et kaebus pole põhiseaduse kohaselt pädev ning tuleks tagasi lükata. Raja viitab Asutava Kogu aruteludele ja erinevate hindu seaduste vastuvõtmisele, öeldes, et ka need õigusreformid lähtusid sotsiaalse õigluse vajadusest. Ta kinnitab, et tema kommentaarid on kooskõlas põhiseaduse sotsiaalse ja soolise võrdsuse põhimõtetega. Tema varasemad avalikud väljaütlemised on sisaldanud Sanatana Dharma võrdlemist näiteks HIV-ga, samuti on ta toetanud sarnaseid märkusi minister Udhayanidhi Stalini poolt. Need avaldused on tekitanud poliitilist vaidlust, eriti BJP-ga. Raja rõhutab, et tema eesmärk oli juhtida tähelepanu jätkuvale sotsiaalsele ebavõrdsusele, mitte solvata usulisi veendumusi. Samuti süüdistab Raja kaebajat tema kõne moonutamises ja valikulises videoredigeerimises eksitava narratiivi loomiseks. Ta väidab, et ükski tema avaldus ei anna alust parlamendiliikmest lahkumiseks ning et see küsimus ei kuulu kohtu pädevusse. Raja palub Madras High Courtil kaebus koos kuludega tagasi lükata.

article_content: Bill Clinton gave an emotional tribute to Elif Yavuz, a Dutch-born, 33-year-old Harvard graduate who was eight-and-a-half months pregnant and working for the Clinton Foundation when she was killed in the Nairobi mall attack. Speaking at the Clinton Global Initiative, the former president remembered Yavuz, who was killed along with her partner, Australian-British architect Ross Langdon, in a popular mall frequented by Westerners. Yavuz, a malaria specialist, had moved to Nairobi, believing it would be a safe place to give birth. Clinton, who met her six weeks before her death, described her as a 'brilliant young mother-to-be' who sought to make the most out of life, while calling Langdon 'incredibly gifted and good'. Clinton became emotional as he recalled speaking to Yavuz's grieving mother, who had planned to name the unborn child after a Swahili word for 'life' or 'love'. He expressed his gratitude for Yavuz's dedication to the foundation and shared his sorrow at her loss. The Clinton family paid tribute to Yavuz on their foundation’s website, describing her as devoted to helping others, especially those suffering from malaria and HIV/AIDS in developing countries. They noted she had recently rejoined the foundation as a senior vaccines researcher in Tanzania, after working with the Health Access Initiative during her doctoral studies. Ross Langdon, recognized for his prize-winning architecture and humanitarian projects across several African countries, was also killed. Langdon had worked in Uganda, Rwanda, Tanzania, and had designed an HIV-AIDS hospital in Kenya. He co-founded Regional Associates Ltd in 2008 and was known for his commitment to disadvantaged communities and conservation. Friends and family of both Yavuz and Langdon, along with former colleagues, expressed profound grief and shared tributes. Ross's mother described the loss of her son, Elif, and their unborn child as 'immeasurable, absurd and excruciating'. The Westgate mall attack, claimed by Somali group Al Shabaab in retaliation for Kenyan military intervention in Somalia, resulted in at least 62 deaths. Colleagues from Langdon’s architectural firm and organizers of TEDxKrakow, where he previously spoke about his work in Africa, also shared condolences, remembering both Langdon and Yavuz for their remarkable contributions and hopeful outlook.
translated_content: Bill Clinton avaldas emotsionaalse austusavalduse Elif Yavuzile – Hollandist pärit, 33-aastasele Harvardi lõpetanud naisele, kes oli kaheksa ja poole kuu rase ning töötas Clintonite fondis, kui ta Nairobi kaubanduskeskuse rünnakus tapeti. Clinton Global Initiative’i kõnes meenutas endine president Yavuzi, kes hukkus koos oma Austraalia-Briti arhitektist elukaaslase Ross Langdoniga populaarses, lääne inimeste seas armastatud kaubanduskeskuses. Yavuz oli malaariaspetsialist, kes kolis Nairobisse, arvates, et see on turvaline koht sünnitamiseks. Clinton, kes kohtus temaga kuus nädalat enne tema surma, kirjeldas teda kui 'briljantset noort tulevast ema', kes püüdis elust maksimumi võtta, ning nimetas Langdoni 'uskumatult andekaks ja heaks'. Clinton muutus emotsionaalseks, kui meenutas vestlust Yavuzi leinava emaga, kes kavatses sündimata lapsele panna nimeks svahhiili keelest sõna, mis tähendab 'elu' või 'armastus'. Ta avaldas tänu Yavuzile tema pühendumise eest fondile ning jagas kurbust tema kaotuse pärast. Clintonite perekond avaldas Yavuzile austust ka fondi veebilehel, kirjeldades teda kui inimest, kes pühendas oma elu abivajajate aitamisele, eriti arengumaade malaariat ja HIV/AIDS-i põdevatele inimestele. Nad märkisid, et Yavuz liitus hiljuti taas fondiga Tansaanias vanemvaktsiinide teadlasena, olles varem töötanud Health Access Initiative’is doktorantuuri ajal. Ross Langdon, tunnustatud auhinnatud arhitekt ja humanitaarprojektide eestvedaja mitmes Aafrika riigis, sai samuti surma. Langdon töötas Ugandas, Rwandas, Tansaanias ning projekteeris tasuta HIV/AIDSi haigla Keenias. 2008. aastal asutas ta piirkondliku arhitektuurifirma Regional Associates Ltd ning oli tuntud oma pühendumise poolest vähekindlustatud kogukondadele ja looduskaitsele. Yavuzi ja Langdoni sõbrad, perekonnad ja endised kolleegid väljendasid sügavat kurbust ja jagasid mälestusi. Rossi ema kirjeldas poja, Elifi ja nende sündimata lapse kaotust kui 'mõõtmatut, absurdset ja piinavat'. Westgate’i kaubanduskeskuse rünnaku eest võttis vastutuse Somaalia relvarühm Al Shabaab, viidates põhjuseks Keenia sõjalise sekkumise Somaaliasse. Rünnakus hukkus vähemalt 62 inimest. Langdoni arhitektuuribüroo kolleegid ja TEDxKrakowi korraldajad, kus ta kõneles oma tööst Aafrikas, avaldasid samamoodi kaastunnet, meenutades Langdoni ja Yavuzit kui märkimisväärselt panustanud ning lootust andvaid inimesi.

article_content: While searching for loose change, three roommates in New York unexpectedly uncovered $41,000 stashed in their $20 secondhand couch from the Salvation Army. Lara Russo and Reese Werkhoven were relaxing and watching TV when Reese opened a lumpy cushion and discovered a bubble-wrapped package filled with stacks of $100 bills. Initially worried the package could contain drugs, they soon realized it was cash. Excited and startled, they showed their find to their other roommate, Cally Guasti. Cally’s first reaction was to secure the apartment, fearing the cash might be linked to crime. Searching further, they found more envelopes tucked into the sofa, one of which had a name. Seeking advice, Reese consulted his mother, who found a phone number for the owner. After two phone calls, Reese reached an elderly woman who revealed the cash was her life savings, inadvertently donated when her family gave away the couch. She expressed deep gratitude, describing the roommates’ actions as meaningful and serendipitous. Though briefly tempted to keep the windfall, the roommates unanimously agreed it belonged to the rightful owner. The woman, who wished to remain anonymous, rewarded them with $1,000 for their honesty. Despite the couch’s odd smell, the roommates decided to keep it, considering it their lucky charm.
translated_content: Uut vahetusraha otsides avastasid kolm New Yorgi toakaaslast ootamatult oma 20-dollarilises kasutatud diivanis Salvation Army poest 41 000 dollarit. Lara Russo ja Reese Werkhoven puhkasid ja vaatasid telekat, kui Reese avas ühe tükilise padja ning leidis seest mulliümbrikusse pakitud paki, mis oli täis 100-dollariseid rahatähti. Alguses kahtlustasid nad, et pakis võivad olla hoopis narkootikumid, ent peagi selgus, et tegemist on sularahaga. Üllatusest erutatud ja veidi ehmunud, jagasid nad oma leidust kolmanda toakaaslase Cally Guastiga. Cally esimene mõte oli korter lukku panna, kartes, et raha võib millegagi kriminaalsega seotud olla. Edasisel otsimisel leidsid nad diivanist veel ümbrikke, millest ühel oli nimi peal. Reese küsis nõu oma emalt, kes aitas leida omanikule telefoninumbri. Pärast kahte telefonikõnet jõudis Reese vanema naiseni, kes ütles, et raha oli tema elu säästud, mis annetati diivani perelt kogemata koos diivaniga. Naine oli väga tänulik, kirjeldades tudengite käitumist kui tähenduslikku ja saatuslikku. Kuigi neil tekkis hetkeks kiusatus leitud raha endale jätta, otsustasid kõik üksmeelselt, et see kuulub õigele omanikule. Anonüümseks jääda soovinud naine tänas neid aususe eest 1000-dollarilise tasuga. Diivani veidra lõhna kiuste otsustasid toakaaslased selle alles jätta, nimetades seda nüüd oma õnnetoovaks esemeks.
post_content: Imagine finding $41,000 hidden in your thrift-store couch! That’s what happened to 3 NY roommates, who tracked down the owner & returned her lost savings – and got a $1,000 reward. Honesty wins! #FeelGood #FoundMoney #NYC

article_content: Governor Peter Mbah of Enugu State announced that his administration will allocate nearly 30 percent of the 2024 state budget to the education sector. Speaking at the 19th convocation ceremony of the Enugu State University of Science and Technology (ESUT) in Agbani, Mbah emphasized that education is the state’s most effective tool against poverty. He stated that his administration is committed to ensuring that even the poorest children in the most remote areas of the state have access to world-class education using modern technology. Governor Mbah highlighted that the most significant changes in education would occur at the basic education level. "Education is probably our greatest weapon in our fight against poverty in the medium to long term. That’s why it is central to our strategy, which aims to boost the state’s GDP from about $4.4 billion to at least $30 billion by the end of 2031," Mbah said. The Governor explained that the government has designed and is implementing a comprehensive strategy to overhaul the educational system, affecting basic, secondary, and tertiary levels, including ESUT. Planned reforms will involve updates to curricula and teaching methods, with the most substantial changes happening in basic schools, where children spend their first nine years. Mbah revealed that, in 2024, the state will spend close to 30 percent of its budget on education, surpassing international benchmarks. His administration has already finished building one smart school and has begun construction on another nine. An additional 250 smart schools will be constructed within 14 months, aiming to cover all 260 wards in the state. Training for teachers in these model schools is being conducted by global experts. Each smart school will feature internet access, solar power, robotics and artificial intelligence centers, modern ICT facilities, two laboratories for primary and junior secondary school students, a creative production studio, 25 inclusive classrooms with interactive whiteboards, Android tablets for students, and other modern amenities. Mbah praised ESUT’s management for aligning with the government’s vision for tertiary education. Vice-Chancellor Prof. Alloysius-Michaels Okolie thanked the governor for his commitment to education and continued support of ESUT. Okolie noted that ESUT is being repositioned in line with the governor's educational policies. At the convocation ceremony, honorary doctorate degrees were awarded to several distinguished Nigerians, including Osagie Okunbor (Managing Director of Shell Petroleum Development Company of Nigeria Limited), Ike Chioke (Group Managing Director of Afrivest West Africa Ltd), Surv Ugochukwu Chime (estate developer), as well as recognitions and cash awards to outstanding students led by the best-graduating student, Miss Barbara Ijeoma Ikeonyia.
translated_content: Enugu osariigi kuberner Peter Mbah teatas, et tema administratsioon eraldab 2024. aasta osariigi eelarvest ligi 30 protsenti haridussektorile. Esinedes Enugu Riikliku Teaduse ja Tehnoloogia Ülikooli (ESUT) 19. lõpuaktusel Agbanis, rõhutas Mbah, et haridus on osariigi kõige tõhusam vahend vaesuse vastu. Ta kinnitas, et administratsioon on pühendunud sellele, et isegi kõige vaesemad lapsed kaugemates osariigi piirkondades saaksid maailmatasemel hariduse kaasaegsete tehnoloogiate abil. Kuberner Mbah tõi esile, et suurimad hariduslikud muudatused leiavad aset põhihariduses. "Haridus on tõenäoliselt meie suurim relv vaesuse vastu võitlemisel keskpikas kuni pikas perspektiivis. Seetõttu on haridus meie strateegia keskmes, mille eesmärk on tõsta osariigi SKT-d umbes 4,4 miljardilt dollarilt vähemalt 30 miljardi dollarini 2031. aastaks," ütles Mbah. Kuberner selgitas, et valitsus on välja töötanud ja rakendab ulatuslikku strateegiat haridussüsteemi ümberkujundamiseks, mis hõlmab põhi-, kesk- ja kõrgharidust, kaasa arvatud ESUT. Planeeritavad reformid hõlmavad nii õppekavade kui ka õppetöö metoodika ajakohastamist, kusjuures kõige suuremad muutused toimuvad just põhikoolides, kus lapsed veedavad esimesed üheksa õppeaastat. Mbah avalikustas, et 2024. aastal kulutatakse haridusele peaaegu 30 protsenti osariigi eelarvest, edestades rahvusvahelisi soovituslikke standardeid. Tema administratsioon on juba ühe nutika kooli valmis saanud ja alustanud veel üheksa ehitust. Veel 250 nutika kooli ehitatakse järgmise 14 kuu jooksul, hõlmates kõiki 260 valimisringkonda. Pilootkoolide õpetajaid koolitavad rahvusvahelised eksperdid. Iga nutikas kool saab olema varustatud internetiga, päikeseenergiaga, robootika ja tehisintellekti keskusega, modernse IKT-ruumiga, kahe laboriga alg- ja põhikooli teise astme õpilastele, loovstuudio, 25 kaasava klassiruumi interaktiivsete tahvlitega, Androidi tahvelarvutid õpilastele ning muu kaasaegne varustus. Mbah tunnustas ESUT juhtkonda, et nad on liikunud valitsuse kõrghariduse visiooniga samas suunas. Rektor prof. Alloysius-Michaels Okolie tänas kubernerit märkimisväärse panuse ja pideva toe eest ESUT-le ning kinnitas, et ülikool kohandub nüüd kuberneri hariduspoliitikaga. Lõpuaktusel anti aumärgid mitmele silmapaistvale nigeerlasele: Osagie Okunborile (Shell Petroleum Development Company of Nigeria Limited tegevdirektor), Ike Chiokele (Afrivest West Africa Ltd grupijuht), Surv Ugochukwu Chime’ile (kinnisvaraarendaja), ning tunnustati ja anti rahalisi auhindu väljapaistvatele tudengitele, sealhulgas parimale lõpetajale, miss Barbara Ijeoma Ikeonyia’le.

article_content: Foot Locker, a prominent global sportswear and footwear retailer, is making its debut in India through a long-term partnership with Metro Brands Limited and Nykaa Fashion. Metro Brands will oversee the launch and management of Foot Locker’s brick-and-mortar stores nationwide, providing authorized products directly to Indian consumers. Nykaa Fashion takes on the role of e-commerce partner, operating the Foot Locker India website and selling company products through its online channels. According to Foot Locker CEO Mary Dillon, the Indian market’s enthusiasm for sneakers is significant, and this collaboration is ideally positioned to engage with the country’s growing interest in trendy footwear. Industry reports project that India’s sneaker market could reach 66 million pairs by 2028, with consumers increasingly seeking footwear that fuses traditional and modern styles. Metro Brands CEO Nissan Joseph noted that this new alliance is set to elevate India’s sneaker market and customer shopping experience. article_content: Sidney Powell, a Republican lawyer who briefly represented Donald Trump, has accepted a plea deal with Georgia prosecutors ahead of her trial on multiple criminal charges. According to court documents, Powell pleaded guilty to six counts of conspiracy to interfere with election duties. She is one of more than a dozen co-defendants—including Trump himself—in the Fulton County District Attorney's RICO case, which alleges violations of Georgia's racketeering laws during efforts to overturn the state's 2020 presidential election results. As part of the plea agreement, Powell, who previously promoted conspiracy theories about the 2020 election and promised evidence of fraud that never materialized, will testify at upcoming trials and write a letter of apology to Georgia's citizens. Powell joined Trump’s legal team after the 2020 election and promoted discredited theories alleging voting systems were manipulated to benefit Joe Biden. Her unsupported claims included suggestions that the Venezuelan government and financier George Soros helped rig the election, that Trump won by a 'landslide,' and that the Mueller investigation was a 'deep state' plot. Powell has also previously expressed support for QAnon, which spreads false conspiracy theories. In her plea deal, Powell admitted conspiring with local election officials to breach voting machines in Coffee County, Georgia, where prosecutors say she sought voter information to support her claims of fraud. Trump's attorney, Steve Sadow, responded to Powell's guilty plea, stating that, 'assuming truthful testimony in the Fulton County case, it will be favorable to my defense strategy.' Powell's plea deal was announced in court on Thursday. Under the agreement, she must pay $2,700 in restitution to replace election equipment, pay a $6,000 fine, and will serve up to six years of probation. Powell was scheduled to be tried on Monday alongside former Trump campaign lawyer Kenneth Chesebro, who had also requested a speedy trial. It is not yet clear whether Chesebro will change his plea. The judge in Trump’s case has not yet set a date for the former president's trial.

article_content: Flight operations at Imphal’s Bir Tikendrajit International Airport in Manipur were disrupted for several hours on Sunday, November 20, after an unidentified flying object (UFO) was seen above the airport, officials said. Two flights were diverted and three departing flights were delayed before services resumed, according to airport director Chipemmi Keishing. Sky objects have long fascinated people, fueling speculation about their origins. However, not all UFOs suggest the existence of life beyond Earth, and in some cultures, there are unique reasons for the popularity of such ideas. According to the US Air Force Declassification Office, UFOs are any apparent aerial phenomena whose cause cannot be readily identified. The US Air Force coined the term in 1952, originally defining UFOs as objects that remained unidentified after expert investigation. While the term once referred only to investigated cases, it now broadly describes any unknown aerial object. The US is not the only country where such sightings occur, but both its government and public have shown exceptional interest. In a 2021 CBS interview, former US President Barack Obama said, 'There’s footage and records of objects in the skies that we don’t know exactly what they are, and we can’t explain how they moved. They did not have an easily explainable pattern, so people are still seriously investigating.' One example of official US investigations is Project Blue Book. Time Magazine reported that from 1952 to 1969, more than 12,000 reports were analyzed, with just 6% classified as 'unidentified.' Due to the low percentage and a drop in sightings, the program was discontinued. In 2021, a recent US government report found that most available data on such sightings is inconclusive, though patterns suggest they often appear around US training and testing sites. These objects are simply unidentified—they could be birds, balloons, drones, natural atmospheric phenomena, or foreign technology. Interest in UFOs increased notably after World War II, during the Cold War, when unidentified objects became a security concern amid tensions between the US and the USSR. Improvements in rocketry and imaging technology also spurred analysis of these sightings. UFOs have not been as central to Indian culture, but the spread of TV and cameras has increased reports. Even before the television era, aliens featured in Indian media. Renowned writer-director Satyajit Ray wrote a 1967 script, 'The Alien,' about an extraterrestrial visiting Earth, a project he hoped to turn into a Hollywood film. Later, Steven Spielberg was accused of plagiarizing Ray’s story for his film E.T. (1982), though Spielberg has denied this. Ray also wrote 'Bonkubabur Bondhu' ('Bonkubabu’s Friend'), published in 1962 in the Bengali magazine Sandesh. The 1963 Tamil film 'Kalai Arasi,' starring MG Ramachandran and Bhanumathi, is another early Indian film featuring aliens. To reduce confusion and speculation surrounding the term 'UFO,' officials increasingly use 'UAP' (Unidentified Aerial Phenomenon). The Pentagon and NASA now use this terminology. In June 2022, NASA announced it would study UAPs from a scientific perspective, focusing on available data and future research. A preliminary report summarized by the journal Scientific American in June noted that clarifying unidentified anomalous phenomena will require time, better data, and rigorous scientific analysis. US National Security Council spokesman John Kirby said in a July 2023 press briefing that some unexplained aerial phenomena have affected training ranges and pilot operations, making it a national security matter. He acknowledged, 'We don’t have the answers about what these phenomena are.' This is an edited version of an explainer first published in July 2023.

USA õhujõudude deklassifitseerimisameti järgi on UFO-d mis tahes nähtavad õhunähtused, mille põhjust ei saa kiiresti tuvastada. UFO-d pole olnud India kultuuris nii keskse tähtsusega, kuid teleri ja kaamerate levik on raportite arvu kasvatanud. Juba enne teleri-ajastut esinesid tulnukad India meedias: tuntud režissöör Satyajit Ray kirjutas 1967. aastal stsenaariumi 'Tulnukas', mis rääkis Maale saabunud maavälisest olendist ja mida ta lootis filmiks teha. Hiljem süüdistati Steven Spielbergi Ray loomingu plagieerimises tema filmi E.T. (1982) puhul, kuid Spielberg on seda eitanud. Ray kirjutas ka loo 'Bonkubabur Bondhu' ('Bonkubabu sõber'), mis ilmus 1962. aastal bengali ajakirjas Sandesh. 1963. aasta tamili film 'Kalai Arasi', mille peaosades olid MG Ramachandran ja Bhanumathi, on samuti varajane India film tulnukatest. article_content: After serving nearly a year off the coast of Syria, U.S. Navy Seaman Apprentice Dylan Ruffer married his longtime partner, Madison Meinhardt, in a one-of-a-kind ceremony at Reno-Tahoe International Airport. Both 19 years old and graduates of Chester High School in Northern California, the couple exchanged vows just after midnight under a tulle-draped archway, surrounded by more than 200 guests and bystanders. The pair had initially planned to wed in October, but when Dylan's deployment was extended, Madison reached out about arranging an airport ceremony so they could marry as soon as he returned home. Their story inspired generosity from the local community and businesses—Peppermill casino gave Madison a spa package, and Eldorado casino donated a honeymoon suite and limousine. The airport's catering team set up a decorated reception area in the baggage claim, featuring a DJ and refreshments. Many travelers were surprised and delighted to witness the unique wedding, said airport spokesperson Brian Kulpin. Dylan's grandfather, James Ruffer, shared that the family was deeply touched by the community's kindness. Next month, Madison plans to join Dylan in Virginia, where they’ll start their new life together.

article_content: John McAfee, best known for founding the antivirus software company bearing his name, has voiced his intention to return to the United States to lead a quiet, ordinary life. Speaking through an online broadcast from a detention facility in Guatemala, McAfee expressed his wish to spend his later years enjoying simple pleasures like fishing and swimming. McAfee is currently facing legal proceedings after Belizean authorities announced they wished to question him about the shooting death of his neighbor, Gregory Viant Faull, who lived close to McAfee on Ambergris Caye in Belize. McAfee has categorically denied involvement, stating that he is being targeted as a result of his refusal to pay bribes to police officials. He described a series of police raids at his properties in Belize, including an incident involving 42 armed officers in April and subsequent searches in which he reports he lost nearly half a million dollars’ worth of property. Supported by his fiancée, 20-year-old Samantha Vanegas, and her uncle, attorney Telesforo Guerra, McAfee is contesting extradition from Guatemala back to Belize. Guerra has filed several legal appeals, seeking to safeguard McAfee’s rights, reverse the asylum denial, and allow him to stay in Guatemala. According to Guatemalan Immigration Department spokesman Fredy Viana, immigration cannot review McAfee’s case until other appeals are resolved. Throughout his detention, McAfee has documented his predicament and maintains that officials in Belize are corrupt and determined to frame him. He criticized the international press for sensationalized coverage of his saga. While he admits to having had disputes with his neighbor over his dogs, he firmly denies any role in Faull’s killing. McAfee moved to Belize after selling his stake in his company and claims to have lost most of his fortune during the U.S. financial crisis, although this has been questioned in media reports. He is known for his unconventional lifestyle, including interests in yoga, aviation, and herbal medicine.

article_content: For a split second, Nick Kyrgios, son of a tradesman and the rising star of Australian tennis, seemed to be eliminated from Wimbledon following a double fault. However, a Hawkeye review overturned the call, offering a second chance to the wildcard teenager, who went on to save nine match points and achieve one of the tournament’s biggest upsets.  Across the net, Richard Gasquet—the 13th seed—was left stunned, having taken a two-set lead before ultimately losing 3-6, 6-7, 6-4, 7-5, 10-8. Gasquet is no stranger to heavy expectations from a young age, but his career has often been seen as not fully living up to that early promise.  Kyrgios’ win immediately drew attention. Endorsements have already accumulated, with Andy Murray recently calling the 19-year-old 'the next big Aussie star', and Gasquet himself commenting, 'He can be a top-five player and win a Grand Slam.' Despite being ranked outside the top 100 at 144, Kyrgios has shown rapid progress since abandoning a possible basketball career for tennis, a sport he initially disliked.  Recalling his start, Kyrgios explained, 'My mum took me to the local tennis centre in Canberra when I was seven, but I wasn't interested. Looking back, it wasn’t a bad choice.' Since then, he has captured the Australian Open junior title, won junior doubles at Wimbledon, and now claimed his first high-profile victory over an elite player.  The win was fueled by a small but spirited group of Australian fans, whose enthusiastic support Kyrgios acknowledged with fist pumps and cheers. He dramatically saved the first of nine match points in the fourth set and notably survived a crucial call—confirmed in his favor by Hawkeye—during the fifth set. Each moment was met with amplified support from his fans, including celebratory renditions of the Rocky theme.  'We all know his potential,' Gasquet remarked after congratulating Kyrgios. Kyrgios, determined and ambitious, stated, 'My goal is to become the best. It’s a long journey. This is my biggest career win.'  He followed his success by preparing for his upcoming match against 20-year-old Jiri Vesely—another wildcard who recently defeated Gael Monfils, the 24th seed. The victor of that encounter may face Rafael Nadal in the fourth round, presenting a possible dream match.  Elsewhere, Jo-Wilfried Tsonga survived a fourth consecutive day of play, eking out a hard-fought win over Sam Querrey after their match was extended over two days. Tsonga prevailed 4-6, 7-6, 6-7, 6-3, 14-12.  Milos Raonic also advanced, defeating Jack Sock in straight sets (6-3, 6-4, 6-4). So far, Raonic has conceded only one break point across two matches.

Teisel pool võrku jäi Richard Gasquet – 13. asetusega mängija – hämmeldunult seisma, olles juba kahe setiga juhtimas, kuid kaotades lõpuks 3-6, 6-7, 6-4, 7-5, 10-8. Nüüd vaadates ei olnudki halb valik.” Alates sellest on ta võitnud Austraalia lahtiste noortetiitli, Wimbledoni noorte paarismängu ning nüüd esimese tõsise võidu eliitmängija üle. Ta päästis dramaatiliselt esimese üheksast matšpallist neljandas setis ning eriti olulise Hawkeye’i ülekutse viiendas setis. Iga hetk kaasnes valjude ovatsioonide ja Rocky filmi teemalooga tema fännide esituses.  „Me kõik teame tema potentsiaali,” märkis Gasquet, õnnitledes Kyrgiost. Otsusekindel ja ambitsioonikas Kyrgios ütles: „Mu eesmärk on saada parimaks. See on pikk teekond. See oli mu karjääri suurim võit.”  Edu järel keskendus ta järgmisele kohtumisele 20-aastase Jiri Veselyga – samuti wild card’i saanud mängijaga, kes alistas hiljuti Gael Monfilsi, 24. asetusega mängija. Selle matši võitja võib neljandas ringis kohtuda Rafael Nadaliga, mis oleks tõeline tennisemuinasjutt.  Samal ajal suutis Jo-Wilfried Tsonga neljandal järjestikusel mängupäeval üle elada raske viiesetilise matši Sam Querrey vastu, mida mängiti kahe päeva jooksul. Tsonga võitis 4-6, 7-6, 6-7, 6-3, 14-12.  Milos Raonic pääses samuti edasi, alistades Jack Socki sirgetes settides (6-3, 6-4, 6-4). Raonic on kahe matši jooksul loovutanud vaid ühe murdepalli.

article_content: A 40-year-old earning Rs 60,000 per month seeks advice for post-retirement income of Rs 30,000 per month. Current investments include Rs 1.32 lakh annually in PPF, ULIP, and LIC policies, plus Rs 11,000 monthly in SIPs targeting small- and large-cap mutual funds, with no liabilities. Adhil Shetty, CEO of BankBazaar, advises that with 20 years to retirement, a minimum corpus of Rs 80 lakh is required to yield Rs 3.6 lakh annually, rising 6% yearly with inflation. However, targeting Rs 2 crore is more robust, since in 20 years Rs 30,000 today may equate to Rs 96,000 monthly. Investing Rs 20,000 per month in mutual funds (12% expected CAGR) can grow to Rs 2 crore, supporting withdrawals for 27 years after retirement. Shetty recommends recalibrating expense projections for inflation and investing in blue-chip and passive funds. For investing Rs 1 lakh each for his 20-year-old and 13-year-old children in small- and micro-cap stocks over 15 years, Vidya Bala, Co-founder of PrimeInvestor.in, cautions that few small/micro caps become wealth builders; many underperform or get delisted. She suggests starting with large or emerging large-caps, reviewing periodically, and gradually adding small-caps. Currently, SIPs in mutual funds are advised over lump sum stock purchases. A reader with Rs 30 lakh in each of five funds seeks to withdraw Rs 18,000 monthly from each after a year, increasing withdrawals by 5% annually, for 10–15 years. Prableen Bajpai, Founder of FinFix Research and Analytics, confirms SWP is a prudent option for steady cash flow in retirement and has tax benefits. With a portfolio of Rs 1.5 crore across diversified funds, an initial withdrawal of Rs 90,000 monthly (with 5% annual increase) should last 15 years at a 10% return, leaving a residual corpus. Bajpai advises keeping one year’s expenses as a contingency fund in a liquid or ultra-short debt fund. India's FMCG sector grew by 9% in value and 8.6% in volume in the September quarter, driven by increased rural spending (NielsenIQ). Snap Inc doubled its Indian user base to 200 million in a year after launching new video features. The finance ministry is considering slower capital spending growth in the FY25 interim budget to support fiscal consolidation.

Outrage erupted in the Jewish community after Asher and Rosa Wiesenthal, the long-deceased parents of Holocaust survivor Simon Wiesenthal, were posthumously baptized by a Mormon individual—a ritual considered insensitive by many Jews. Rosa died in 1942 at the Belzec death camp in Nazi-occupied Poland, while Asher was killed as an Austrian soldier in 1915. The Simon Wiesenthal Center condemned the act, calling it a mockery of longstanding dialogue between Mormon and Jewish leaders. Rabbi Abraham Cooper of the Center expressed frustration, emphasizing that discussions to end posthumous baptisms of Holocaust victims have been ongoing since 1995.

Mormon Church officials responded with an apology, clarifying that the action was taken by a single member against Church policy. Consequently, both the individual and their spouse have had their access to genealogical records suspended. Jewish genealogist Gary Mokotoff, who has campaigned against these practices, confirmed these suspensions. The Church has since reinforced its rules, stating that names of Holocaust victims may only be submitted for baptism if they are direct ancestors. Church spokespeople reiterated this policy to the Salt Lake Tribune.

Media interest in Mormon practices has grown due to the popularity of The Book of Mormon musical and high-profile figures like Mitt Romney. The recent baptism incident was uncovered by activist and ex-Mormon Helen Radkey. Simon Wiesenthal, who survived multiple concentration camps and spent his life tracking Nazi war criminals including Adolf Eichmann, passed away in 2005 at age 96.

Juudi kogukonnas puhkes pahameel, kui selgus, et holokausti üle elanud Simon Wiesenthali ammu surnud vanemad Asher ja Rosa Wiesenthal ristis mormoonist isik pärast nende surma – tegu, mida paljud juudid peavad tundetuks. Rosa hukkus 1942. aastal Poolas natside Belzeci koonduslaagris, Asher langes Austria sõdurina 1915. aastal. Simon Wiesenthali Keskus mõistis teo hukka, nimetades seda mormoonide ja juutide vaheliste pikaajaliste vestluste naeruvääristamiseks. Keskuse asedekaan rabi Abraham Cooper väljendas pettumust, rõhutades, et arutelud holokaustiohvrite surnujärgsete ristimiste lõpetamiseks on kestnud alates 1995. aastast.

Mormoonide kiriku ametnikud vabandasid ja selgitasid, et tegu oli üksikliikme omavolitsemine, mis läks vastuollu kiriku poliitikaga. Selle tulemusena peatati nii selle liikme kui ka tema abikaasa ligipääs genealoogilistele andmetele. Juudi genealoog Gary Mokotoff, kes on nende praktikate vastu aastaid võidelnud, kinnitas peatamised. Kirik on sellele reageerinud, tugevdades poliitikat: holokaustiohvrite nimesid tohib ristimiseks esitada vaid juhul, kui tegemist on otseste esivanematega. Kiriku esindaja kinnitas seda Salt Lake Tribune'ile.

Huvi mormoonide praktikate vastu on kasvanud, eriti tänu menukale muusikalile "The Book of Mormon" ja avaliku elu tegelastele nagu Mitt Romney. Hiljutise ristimisjuhtumi paljastas aktivist ja endine mormoon Helen Radkey. Simon Wiesenthal, kes elas üle mitu koonduslaagrit ja pühendas elu natsikurjategijate, sealhulgas Adolf Eichmanni, tabamisele, suri 2005. aastal 96-aastasena.

Alex Song's smooth control and dynamic passing on the pitch may seem effortless, but it is rooted in intense dedication and training. The West Ham midfielder, currently on loan from Barcelona, has played a significant role in West Ham’s impressive form this season, showcasing his skill and exceptional range of passing.

Song recently shared a glimpse into the secret of his success by posting a video of his training routine on Instagram. In the video, Song works closely with West Ham's rehab fitness coach, Eduardo Parra, fielding passes and controlling the ball from different angles. Inside the Hammers' gym, Song rapidly alternates passes between three targets, using both feet and maintaining precise control as he rebounds the ball off a barrier and returns it to Parra.

Song boasts a passing accuracy of 79 percent in the Premier League, a statistic made understandable by his evident commitment in training. However, manager Sam Allardyce expressed concern about the upcoming Africa Cup of Nations, when West Ham may have to cope without key players like Song, top scorer Diafra Sakho, and Cheikhou Kouyate.

'We might have a little worrying spell during the Africa Cup of Nations in January,' Allardyce said. 'That's why I'm not prepared to do any more predictions until they come back. We don't want to get carried away. We just want to keep on playing the football we're playing at the moment. Everyone is enjoying themselves, there's a good buzz around the training ground, which is always a good sign.'

Throughout the season, Song has been outstanding in midfield for the high-flying Hammers in the Premier League.

West Hami poolkaitsja, kes on hetkel laenul Barcelonast, on olnud tänavusel hooajal West Hami eduka seeria üks võtmemängijaid, näidates oma oskusi ja muljetavaldavat söötude valikut.

Hiljuti jagas Song Instagramis videoklippi oma treeningrutiinist, paljastades oma edu saladused. Videos teeb Song tihedat koostööd West Hami taastustreeneri Eduardo Parraga, võttes vastu sööte ning kontrollides palli erinevate nurkade alt. Hammersi jõusaalis vahetab Song kiiresti sööte kolme märgi vahel, kasutades mõlemat jalga, hoides täpset kontrolli, põrgatades palli vastu takistust ja andes selle Parrale tagasi.

Songi söödutäpsus Premier League'is on 79 protsenti, mis peegeldab tema pühendumust treeningule. Samas väljendas peatreener Sam Allardyce muret läheneva Aafrika Rahvuste Karika pärast, mil West Ham peab hakkama saama ilma võtmemängijateta nagu Song, suurim väravakütt Diafra Sakho ja Cheikhou Kouyaté.

'Jaanuaris võib Aafrika Rahvuste Karika ajal olla veidi ärevam aeg,' ütles Allardyce. 'Sellepärast ma ei soovi rohkem prognoose teha enne, kui mängijad tagasi on. Me ei kavatse end liigselt ära vedada. Praegu soovime lihtsalt jätkata samas vaimus. Kõigil on hea meel, treeningväljakul on positiivne õhkkond - see on alati hea märk.'

Kogu hooaja vältel on Song olnud Hammersi poolkaitses Premier League’is väga hea.

article_content: President Obama recently outlined a fresh vision for the U.S. space program at the Kennedy Space Center. This new direction allocates an extra $6 billion to NASA over the next five years and targets sending humans to Mars in the 2030s. The updated approach rules out further missions to the moon; Obama reasoned it’s time to explore new frontiers. Moon-landing astronaut Buzz Aldrin endorsed the plan, while Neil Armstrong and others voiced concerns, especially about job losses. In response to the fatal Upper Big Branch Mine explosion in West Virginia, President Obama has called for increased checks on unsafe mines, criticizing the mine’s operator for its safety record. The company contested his remarks, while Governor Joe Manchin encouraged miners to spend the day focusing on safety reviews as a tribute to the victims. The Tea Party movement is ramping up its efforts ahead of the midterm elections, spotlighting candidates they support and those they oppose. A large rally wrapped up in Washington, D.C. on Tax Day, ending a cross-country tour and emphasizing resistance to perceived government overspending. Three years after the tragedy at Virginia Tech University, communities across the U.S. are gathering for memorials, including remembrance runs and vigils, to honor the 32 lives lost in the shooting. A volcanic eruption in Iceland, which had been dormant for nearly 200 years, is now disrupting European air travel. Ash clouds have forced major airports like Heathrow to ground flights, with experts warning the eruption could continue for months, echoing past events from the 1820s. Kyrgyzstan has seen a significant power shift with President Kurmanbek Bakiev stepping down and fleeing to Kazakhstan. Backed by global partners including the U.S. and Russia, the interim government has pledged to hold elections in six months. The U.S. is watching closely, citing the country’s importance due to its military base that aids NATO operations in Afghanistan. Mackenzie Bearup, recognized as a CNN Hero, has donated over 38,000 books to children in shelters, inspired by how reading helped her manage chronic pain. Her outreach spans 27 shelters in six states, aiming to change children’s lives through books. The episode also featured trivia about the Library of Congress—the largest library in the world—and concluded with a segment on the growing trend of 'fingerboarding,' a tabletop take on skateboarding.

article_content: An 85-year-old woman narrowly escaped injury after accidentally driving her car for about 50 yards along a busy railway line in Brockenhurst, Hampshire. The woman, who was driving her 20-year-old grandson to the station, became confused at a level crossing on the A337 and mistakenly turned onto the tracks instead of crossing over them. She drove along the commuter railway line toward Brockenhurst station before stopping. Police and railway workers responded quickly to the incident, which occurred at approximately 9:35 am. Officers climbed onto the tracks and helped the woman and her grandson to safety. Both were uninjured but treated for shock. The rail route—an important main line between Bournemouth and London Waterloo—was closed for nearly two hours while the car, a silver Renault Clio, was removed with a crane. Eyewitness Alex Capozza remarked that the pair were lucky to avoid injury, given the frequency of trains during the morning. He noted the closeness of the signal box likely helped in raising a quick alarm. After the rescue, the elderly woman appeared shaken and was taken away by taxi. British Transport Police stated the car had driven onto the railway line from the level crossing, and that both occupants were treated for shock but suffered no other injuries. Train services resumed at 11:18 am after the car was removed.
translated_content: 85-aastane naine pääses napilt vigastusteta pärast seda, kui ta kogemata sõitis umbes 45 meetrit mööda tiheda liiklusega raudteed Brockenhurstis, Hampshire’is. Naine, kes viis oma 20-aastast pojapoega rongijaama, sattus A337 tasandilülesõidul segadusse ja keeras ekslikult rööbastele selle asemel, et ülesõidust üle sõita. Ta sõitis mööda pendelrongiliini Brockenhursti jaama suunas, enne kui peatus. Politsei ja raudteetöötajad reageerisid juhtunule kiiresti; see juhtus umbes kell 9:35 hommikul. Politseinikud ronisid rööbastele ning aitasid naise ja tema pojapoja ohutult ära. Mõlemad olid vigastusteta, kuid vajasid šokiravi. Raudteeliin—oluline põhiliin Bournemouth’i ja London Waterloo vahel—oli suletud ligi kaheks tunniks, kuni hõbedane Renault Clio kraanaga rööbastelt eemaldati. Pealtnägija Alex Capozza märkis, et neil oli õnne, et nad pääsesid vigastusteta, arvestades rongide tihedust hommikuti. Tema sõnul aitas signaalimaja lähedus kiirele häire andmisele kaasa. Pääste järel oli eakas naine silmnähtavalt ehmunud ning viidi taksoga minema. Briti transpordipolitsei sõnul sõitis auto tasandilülesõidult raudteeliinile. Mõlemat inimest raviti šoki pärast, muid vigastusi ei olnud. Rongiliiklus taastati kell 11:18 pärast auto eemaldamist.

Mantecore, the famed white tiger known for his role in Siegfried & Roy's dazzling Las Vegas act, has died at the age of 17. Siegfried Fischbacher announced Mantecore's passing on March 19 via the duo's official Facebook page. The tiger had resided at the Siegfried & Roy Secret Garden and Dolphin Habitat at the Mirage hotel.

Mantecore became internationally known after he attacked Roy Horn during a sold-out performance in October 2003. Midway through the show, the tiger lunged at Roy's neck, leaving audience members shocked. "He looked like a rag doll in his mouth," recalled a witness to CNN. Trainers swiftly intervened. The attack, which occurred on Horn's 59th birthday, resulted in massive blood loss and critical injuries for Horn, who also suffered a stroke and underwent two surgeries. Roy survived but was left partially paralyzed and never returned to the stage, with the show closing permanently thereafter.

In the aftermath, Siegfried Fischbacher defended Mantecore, telling CNN's 'Larry King Live' that he believed the attack was accidental, and emphasizing that had Mantecore intended to kill, "it would have happened in no time." He likened the tiger's actions to a mother cat carrying her cubs.

Mantecore had been hand-raised after his mother neglected him as a cub. Fischbacher once administered mouth-to-mouth resuscitation to save the young tiger, and Fischbacher's mother bottle-fed him every three hours. In his farewell message, Fischbacher expressed a deep and lasting affection for the animal, writing, "Farewell my dear friend. Know that your image is forever burned into my heart."
translated_content:
Mantecore, kuulus valge tiiger, kes oli tuntud oma rolli poolest Siegfried & Roy säravas Las Vegase etteastes, suri 17-aastaselt. Siegfried Fischbacher teatas Mantecore'i lahkumisest 19. märtsil duo ametlikul Facebooki lehel. Tiiger elas Siegfried & Roy saladuseaias ja delfiini elupaigas Mirage hotelli juures.

Mantecore sai rahvusvaheliselt tuntuks pärast seda, kui ta ründas Roy Horni 2003. aasta oktoobris täismajale müüdud etenduse ajal. Etenduse keskel hüppas tiiger Roy kaela, mis šokeeris publikut. "Ta nägi tema suus välja nagu kaltsunukk," meenutas üks pealtnägija CNN-ile. Treenerid sekkusid kiiresti. See rünnak leidis aset Roy Horni 59. sünnipäeval ning põhjustas talle suure verekaotuse ja tõsised vigastused. Ta sai ka insuldi ning teda opereeriti kaks korda. Roy jäi ellu, kuid jäi osaliselt halvatuks ega naasnud enam lavale, ning etendus lõpetati lõplikult.

Hiljem kaitses Siegfried Fischbacher Mantecore'i, öeldes CNN-i saates 'Larry King Live', et tema arvates oli see õnnetus ning rõhutas, et kui Mantecore oleks tahtnud tappa, "oleks see juhtunud hetkega." Ta võrdles tiigri käitumist ema-kassiga, kes kannab oma poegi.

Mantecore kasvatati käsitsi, sest tema ema ei hoolitsenud tema eest noorena. Fischbacher elustas kunagi poega suhu-suhu kaudu ning Fischbacheri ema toitis teda iga kolme tunni järel lutipudeliga. article_content: WASHINGTON (AP) — President Joe Biden welcomed Indonesian President Joko Widodo to the White House on Monday, declaring the beginning of a 'new era' in the relationship between the United States and Indonesia. The two leaders formalized a strategic partnership, reflecting closer ties with the world’s third-largest democracy and a significant player in Southeast Asia. The announcement underscores U.S. commitment to the region, coming just before Biden departs for San Francisco to attend a summit of Asian leaders. At the summit, he is expected to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping, amid ongoing competition between Washington and Beijing for influence in Southeast Asia—a vital hub for global trade and potential geopolitical tensions. Sitting beside Widodo in the Oval Office, Biden remarked, 'This will mark a new era in relations between the United States and Indonesia across the board.' Biden also joked about Widodo feeling cold on arrival, commenting, ‘I told him I could take care of that immediately,’ referencing the burning fire in the Oval Office fireplace. The two presidents shared afternoon tea and met with top advisors as they launched their new strategic partnership. A key topic was the potential expansion of trade in critical minerals, particularly nickel—an essential resource for producing electric vehicle batteries. Indonesia leads the world in nickel production. Widodo described the U.S. as one of Indonesia's most important partners, urging both sides to give 'real meaning' to their strengthened relationship. However, differences emerged regarding the conflict in Gaza. As the world’s most populous Muslim-majority country, Indonesia is particularly sensitive to the violence. Widodo arrived in Washington after attending a summit in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, where leaders criticized Israel’s military actions in Gaza. He urged the U.S. to 'do more to stop the atrocities in Gaza and have a ceasefire for the sake of humanity.' While Biden has resisted calls for an immediate ceasefire, he has pressed Israel to show restraint in its military operations and has called for humanitarian pauses to allow aid deliveries and the release of hostages held by Hamas. The Biden administration has been investing in ties with Indonesia in recent years. Biden attended the Group of 20 summit in Bali last year, and Vice President Kamala Harris participated in a regional summit in Jakarta in September. Widodo also visited Georgetown University prior to his White House meeting, as the university plans to launch a new program in Indonesia. Improving educational opportunities remains a priority for Indonesia’s development. Widodo remarked that deepening U.S.-Indonesia ties could bring significant benefits, saying, 'The United States is a big country, and its influence on other countries is also very significant.' At the same time, Widodo emphasized Indonesia’s neutrality amid rising U.S.-China tensions. 'Indonesia is always open to cooperate with any country, and not to take the side of any power, except to take the side of peace and humanity,' he said. He also drew attention to the civilian toll in Gaza, mentioning estimates that a child is killed every 10 minutes. 'Human life seems meaningless, but for me, every life is precious,' he said, calling for global solidarity and leadership focused on prioritizing humanity.

Mõlemad riigipead formaliseerisid strateegilise partnerluse, mis märgib tihedamaid sidemeid maailma kolmanda suurima demokraatia ja olulise Kagu-Aasia tegijaga. See samm rõhutab USA pühendumust piirkonnale ning toimub vahetult enne Bideni sõitu San Franciscosse, kus ta osaleb Aasia liidrite tippkohtumisel. Seal on plaanis ka kohtumine Hiina presidendi Xi Jinpingiga, ajal, mil Washington ja Peking konkureerivad mõjule Kagu-Aasias—see on oluline rahvusvaheline kaubanduskeskus ning võimalik geopoliitiline pingekolle. Bideni ja Widodo kohtumisel Ovaalkabinetis märkis USA president: 'See tähistab uut ajastut Ameerika Ühendriikide ja Indoneesia suhetes.' Biden viskas nalja Widodo külmatunde üle saabudes, öeldes: 'Ma ütlesin talle, et saan selle kohe lahendada,' viidates Ovaalkabineti kaminas põlevale tulele. Presidendid jõid pärastlõunateed ja kohtusid oma nõunikega, et käivitada uus strateegiline partnerlus. Oluliseks teemaks oli kaubanduse laiendamine kriitilistes mineraalides, eriti niklis, mida vajatakse elektrisõidukite akude tootmiseks. Indoneesia on maailma suurim nikli tootja. Widodo nimetas USA-d Indoneesia jaoks oluliseks partneriks ning rõhutas vajadust anda tugevdatud suhtele 'tõeline tähendus.' Samas tõi Gaza konflikt kaasa pinged: maailma suurima moslemi-enamusega riigina on Indoneesias toimuvale vägivallale palju tähelepanu. Widodo saabus Washingtoni pärast tippkohtumist Riyadhis, kus islamiriikide juhid mõistsid hukka Iisraeli sõjalise tegevuse Gazas. Ta kutsus USA-d üles 'tegema rohkem, et lõpetada Gaza julmused ja saavutada inimkonna nimel relvarahu.' Kuigi Biden ei toeta kohest relvarahu, on ta kutsunud Iisraeli üles vaoshoitusele ning lubanud humanitaarkpause, mis võimaldaks abi andmist ja Hamas'i poolt kinnipeetavate pantvangide vabastamist. Viimastel aastatel on Bideni administratsioon tugevdanud suhteid Indoneesiaga: Biden osales mullu G20 tippkohtumisel Balil ja asepresident Kamala Harris regionaalsel tippkohtumisel Jakartas. Enne Valge Maja visiiti käis Widodo Georgetowni ülikoolis, mis plaanib avada uue programmi Indoneesias. Haridusvõimaluste parandamine on Indoneesia arengus prioriteet. Widodo sõnul võib tihedam koostöö USA-ga tuua olulisi eeliseid: 'Ameerika Ühendriigid on suur riik ja selle mõju teistele riikidele on väga suur.' Samal ajal rõhutas Widodo Indoneesia neutraalsust USA-Hiina pingete kontekstis. 'Indoneesia on alati valmis koostööks igas riigiga ning ei vali pooli, välja arvatud rahu ja inimlikkuse poolel,' ütles ta. Ta tõi välja ka Gaza tsiviilelanike kannatused, viidates hinnangule, et iga 10 minuti jooksul hukkub üks laps. 'Inimelul näib olevat vähe väärtust, kuid minu jaoks on iga elu hindamatu,' rõhutas ta, kutsudes üles globaalsele solidaarsusele ning juhtimisele, mis seab esikohale inimlikkuse.

A leading Chinese government forensic scientist has raised doubts about the official cause of death of British businessman Neil Heywood. Wang Xuemei, an official at the Supreme People’s Procuratorate, stated that the conclusion made by Chinese authorities—that Heywood, 41, died from cyanide poisoning—lacks sufficient scientific evidence. This statement questions the official account of a high-profile scandal that involved top levels of the Communist Party.

Heywood’s murder in Chongqing last year was central to the case, which led to the ousting of Chinese politician Bo Xilai. His wife, Gu Kailai, received a suspended death sentence after confessing to killing Heywood by pouring cyanide into his mouth during a business dispute. Recently, former Chongqing police chief Wang Lijun, who helped expose the case by visiting the U.S. consulate in Chengdu, was sentenced to 15 years in prison for defection, abuse of power, and other crimes. Wang Lijun had revealed that Heywood had been murdered and implicated Gu Kailai.

Bo Xilai, formerly the Communist Party chief of Chongqing, was removed from his post in February after once being considered for a top leadership position. Initially, Heywood’s death in a hotel room was ruled an accident attributed to alcohol abuse, despite friends asserting that he was not a heavy drinker.

Wang Xuemei is the first female forensic scientist at China’s highest prosecution office. Her blog post, made despite strict censorship and scant domestic media coverage outside of state news, questioned why typical symptoms of cyanide poisoning were not cited in reports from Gu’s trial or Wang Lijun’s trial. Reports suggest Gu’s defense team raised doubts over the toxicological evidence, noting that two blood samples collected by Wang Lijun showed no poison, while a third, tested after four months, revealed only low levels of a toxin insufficient to be fatal.

Wang Lijun’s trial also reportedly included a recording he made of Gu confessing after Heywood’s death, but details were not disclosed. Wang Xuemei also suggested that Wang Lijun might have manipulated Gu Kailai, raising the question of who truly benefited from Heywood’s death. She wrote of feeling humiliated and concerned for the reputation of Chinese forensic doctors, stating it was her duty to speak out.

Hiina valitsuse juhtiv kohtuekspertiisi teadlane on seadnud kahtluse alla Briti ärimehe Neil Heywoodi ametliku surma põhjuse. See avaldus seab küsimärgi alla kõrgetasemelise poliitskandaali ametliku versiooni, mis puudutas Kommunistliku Partei ladvikut.

Heywoodi mõrv Chongqingis eelmisel aastal oli juhtumi keskmes, mis viis Hiina poliitiku Bo Xilai tagandamiseni. Tema abikaasa Gu Kailai mõisteti mõrva eest tingimisi surma, olles tunnistanud, et tappis Heywoodi äritüli käigus, valades talle tsüaniidi suhu. Hiljuti mõisteti endine Chongqingi politseiülem Wang Lijun, kes juhtumi avalikustas pärast USA konsulaadi külastamist Chengdus, 15 aastaks vangi riigireetmise, võimu kuritarvitamise ja muude kuritegude eest. Wang Lijun avaldas, et Heywood mõrvati ning süüdistas Gu Kailaid.

Bo Xilai, endine Chongqingi Kommunistliku Partei juht, tagandati veebruaris, kuigi teda peeti varem kõrge kohaga kandidaadiks. Algselt nimetati Heywoodi surm hotellitoas õnnetuseks, mis tulenes alkoholitarbimisest, kuigi sõprade sõnul ta palju ei joonud.

Wang Xuemei on esimene naine kohtuekspertiisi teadlasena Hiina kõrgeimas prokuratuuris. Tema blogipostitus, mis tehti rangest tsensuurist ja tagasihoidlikust meediakajastusest hoolimata, seadis küsimuse alla, miks tsüaniidimürgistuse tüüpilised sümptomid kohtuprotsesside kirjeldustest puudusid. Teated viitavad, et Gu kaitsja kahtles toksikoloogiliste tõendite usaldusväärsuses – kaks Wang Lijuni võetud vereproovi ei näidanud mürki ning kolmas, mida testiti neli kuud hiljem, tuvastas vaid madala taseme jääkaineid, mis polnud surmavad.

Wang Lijuni protsessil mängiti väidetavalt ette salvestis, kus Gu tunnistab juhtunu järgmisel päeval pärast Heywoodi surma, kuid üksikasju ei avalikustatud. Wang Xuemei viitas ka, et Wang Lijun võis Gu Kailaid mõjutada ning esitas küsimuse, kellele oli Heywoodi surm kasulik. Ta kirjutas, et tunneb end alandatuna ning mures Hiina kohtuekspertiiside maine pärast, märkides, et pidas õigeks tõe avalikustamist.

article_content: MB&F has revealed its latest creation, the Horological Machine No. 11 'Architect', at a special event in Dubai. This innovative watch draws inspiration from 1960s architecture and is structured like a miniature house, featuring four 'rooms' that each serve a unique function. The case is made from titanium and topped with a double-domed sapphire roof, and rotates on its foundation to wind the movement inside. At the heart of the watch is MB&F's 21st caliber mechanism with a central flying tourbillon comprising 394 individual components. Each of the four protruding cones acts as a room: one shows the hours and minutes using colored orbs with red pointers, one displays the power reserve, another indicates temperature in Celsius or Fahrenheit, and the fourth room holds an engraved MB&F battle-axe badge, which also functions as the crown. The manual movement is wound by rotating the entire case, offering a 96-hour power reserve. Wearers can turn the watch to bring any of the rooms to the front. The complex construction is water resistant to 20 meters, protected by 19 gaskets and anti-reflective sapphire crystals on all sides. Two versions are available in limited runs: one with a blue dial and one with an 18-karat 5N rose gold dial, each limited to 25 pieces. Each Horological Machine No. 11 is priced at $230,000, showcasing MB&F's commitment to exceptional design, exclusivity, and technical artistry.

See innovaatiline ajanäitaja on inspireeritud 1960ndate arhitektuurist ning meenutab miniatuurset maja, millel on neli ‘tuba’, millest igaühel on oma funktsioon. Korpus on valmistatud titaanist ning kaetud topeltkupliga safiirkaanega, keereldes alusel, et kerida sees olevat mehhanismi. Kella südames töötab MB&F-i 21. kaliibri mehhanism, mille keskmes asub lendav tourbillon, mis koosneb 394 detailist. Kõik neli väljaulatuvat koonust on justkui tuba: üks kuvab aega värviliste kuulide ja punaste näidikutega, teine näitab jõuvaru, kolmas tubadest indikeerib temperatuuri (Celsiuse või Fahrenheiti järgi) ning viimane sisaldab graveeritud MB&F battle-axe embleemi, mis ühtlasi toimib krooni rollis. Mehhanismi keritakse, keerates kogu kellakorpust, võimaldades kuni 96-tunnist jõuvaru. Kandja saab pöörata kella nii, et soovitud tuba on otse ees. Keerukas konstruktsioon on veekindel kuni 20 meetrit, 19 tihendiga ja peegeldusvastaste safiirklaasidega kõigil külgedel. Saadaval on kaks piiratud väljaannet: sinise sihverplaadiga ja 18-karaadise 5N roosakullast sihverplaadiga mudelid, igat vaid 25 tükki. Iga Horological Machine No. 11 hind on 230 000 dollarit, kinnitades MB&F-i soovi pakkuda ainulaadset disaini, eksklusiivsust ja tipptasemel inseneritööd.

article_content: Anthony Lawson, age 79, an Australian expat and son of well-known soprano Queenie Ashton, faced a traumatic ordeal at Vachira Hospital in Phuket, Thailand. According to his son Ashton, Lawson was tied to his bed with bedsheets after being repeatedly ignored in his requests for water, a new IV, and sleeping medication. Having settled in Thailand after previous residences in Sydney, England, and Hong Kong, Lawson was transferred to Vachira Hospital in November 2014 for a suspected pulmonary embolism following hernia surgery. Once there, his appeals for assistance reportedly went unanswered, leading him to leave his bed looking for help. Ashton claims hospital staff—specifically a male nurse and security guards—restrained his father with green sheets and still did not address his immediate needs. It was only after two more hours that Lawson finally received water, but he was forced to drink while still restrained. After hearing of the incident, Ashton reported the mistreatment to local police. Authorities, however, declined to investigate, citing lack of evidence and the belief that Lawson may have endangered himself. While hospital officials acknowledged restraining Lawson, they denied other accusations. They stated attempts were made to contact Ashton, although he refutes receiving any communication that night. Anthony Lawson passed away in January 2015 from advanced colon cancer, with his family stating that distress from the hospital incident lingered until his death. Lawson’s extensive career in film and voice acting was overshadowed in his final days by this unsettling experience, leaving his family deeply saddened and dissatisfied with the hospital’s handling of the situation.
translated_content: 79-aastane Austraalia väliseestlane Anthony Lawson, kuulsa sopran Queenie Ashtoni poeg, sattus Phuketis, Tai Vachira haiglas traumaatilisse olukorda. Tema poja Ashtoni sõnul seoti Lawson voodilinaadega voodi külge pärast seda, kui tema korduvad palved vee, uue tilguti ja unerohtude saamiseks jäid tähelepanuta. Lawson, kes oli elanud Sydneys, Inglismaal ja Hongkongis enne jõudmist Taisse, viidi Vachira haiglasse 2014. aasta novembris pärast songaoperatsiooni ja kahtlustatavat kopsuarteri trombembooliat. Haiglas jäid tema abipalved kuulmata, mistõttu ta üritas voodist lahkuda, et abi otsida. Ashtoni sõnul sidusid haigla töötajad – meesõde ja turvatöötajad – tema isa rohelistest linaadest voodi külge, kuid ei andnud talle endiselt vajalikku abi. Alles kahe tunni pärast anti Lawsonile lõpuks vett, kuid ta oli selleks ajaks endiselt kinni seotud. Pärast juhtunust teada saamist pöördus Ashton kohaliku politsei poole. Võimud otsustasid siiski uurimist mitte alustada, viidates tõendite puudumisele ning võimalusele, et Lawson võis olla iseendale ohtlik. Kuigi haigla esindajad tunnistasid, et Lawson seoti voodisse, eitasid nad muid süüdistusi. Nad väitsid, et proovisid Ashtoniga ühendust võtta, kuid Ashton ütleb, et talle ei helistatud tol ööl. Anthony Lawson suri 2015. aasta jaanuaris terminaalse käärsoolevähi tagajärjel, perekonna sõnul mõjutas haiglas juhtunu teda tema viimastel elunädalatel. Lawsoni pika ja eduka filmi- ning häälnäitleja karjääri varjutas see ebameeldiv kogemus haiglas, mis jättis tema lähedased kurvaks ja rahulolematuks haigla tegevusega.

Violence following Kenya’s disputed election has led to hundreds of deaths and forced tens of thousands from their homes. Beyond the tragic human toll, the unrest has sparked fears for the stability of East Africa’s previously thriving economy. Numerous businesses have been destroyed or looted, and key supply routes remain disrupted after opposition leaders accused incumbent President Mwai Kibaki of election fraud following his declared victory on Sunday. Investors are closely watching these developments, worried about disrupting one of Africa’s rare economic success stories. Early signs are troubling: The Nairobi Stock Exchange lost 40 billion Kenyan Shillings ($591 million USD) in value on its first day of New Year trading, according to Business Daily Africa. Business leaders say the government is losing about 2 billion Shillings ($29.5 million USD) daily in revenue due to ongoing violence. 

"We do seem to be in a new place — there’s a lot of uncertainty about where we go from here. Much depends on how long this situation lasts," said Razia Kahn, an Africa analyst at Standard Chartered Bank. Kenya’s economy has attracted many multinational companies and features one of the world’s fastest-growing stock exchanges. The nation's relative economic success is due in part to its flourishing tourism industry, drawing visitors to its wildlife and beaches. Provisional 2006 figures from Kenya’s tourist board report 1.5 million visitors, an increase of 5.2%. 

However, concerns for tourism are mounting, as the British Federation of Tour Operators announced it would suspend all holidays to Kenya until at least Saturday. The UK Foreign Office has advised British tourists already in the country to remain indoors and avoid major cities. 

The regional impact is also significant: Around 40% of Kenya’s exports are sent to other African nations, according to Kahn. Agriculture — including tea, coffee, vegetables, and flowers — represents about one-fifth of the economy and is under threat from transport disruptions and halted auctions due to violence. 

Arun Shah, a London-based coffee importer, told CNN that his business relies on a stable Kenya: "We have always had a reliable supply, quality, and the quantities needed for our trade."

CNN’s Jim Boulden in London contributed to this report.

Pärast Kenya vaidlusaluseid valimisi puhkenud vägivald on põhjustanud sadu surmajuhtumeid ja sundinud kümneid tuhandeid kodudest lahkuma. Lisaks inimtragöödiale on rahutused tekitanud tõsiseid muresid Ida-Aafrika varem edukaks peetud majanduse stabiilsuse pärast. Paljud ettevõtted on hävinenud või rüüstatud ning olulised tarneahelad on häiritud, kuna opositsioon süüdistab ametisolevat presidenti Mwai Kibakit valimispettuses pärast tema väljakuulutatud võitu pühapäeval. Investorid jälgivad olukorda tähelepanelikult, kartes, et see võib ohustada üht vähestest Aafrika edukatest majandustest. Esimesed märgid on murettekitavad: Nairobi börs kaotas aasta esimesel kauplemispäeval 40 miljardit Kenya šillingit (591 miljonit USA dollarit) turuväärtusest, teatas Business Daily Africa. Ärijuhid kinnitavad, et valitseva vägivalla tõttu kaotab valitsus päevas umbes 2 miljardit šillingit (29,5 miljonit USA dollarit) tuludest.

"Me oleme nähtavasti uues olukorras – tulevik on väga ebakindel ning palju sõltub sellest, kui kaua see kestab," ütles Razia Kahn Standard Chartered Pangast. Kenya majandus on ligi meelitanud mitmeid rahvusvahelisi ettevõtteid ning seal tegutseb üks maailma kiiremini kasvavaid börse. Edu saavutamisele aitab kaasa ka tugev turismisektor, mis meelitab külastajaid looduse ja randadega. Kenya turismiameti esialgsed 2006. aasta andmed näitavad, et riiki külastas 1,5 miljonit inimest, kasv 5,2%.

Turismisektori pärast kasvab mure, sest Briti Reisikorraldajate Liit teatas, et peatab kõik puhkusereisid Kenyasse vähemalt laupäevani. Briti välisministeerium soovitas juba riigis olevatel turistidel siseruumides püsida ja vältida suuremaid linnu.

Ka piirkondlik mõju on oluline: umbes 40% Kenya ekspordist suundub teistesse Aafrika riikidesse, märkis Kahn. Põllumajandus – sealhulgas tee, kohv, köögiviljad ja lilled – moodustab umbes viiendiku kogu majandusest, kuid sellel on oht, sest transpordiahelad on katkenud ja oksjonid peatunud vägivalla tõttu.

Londonis tegutsev kohviimportija Arun Shah ütles CNN-ile, et tema ettevõte sõltub stabiilsest Kenyast: "Oleme alati saanud usaldusväärset tarnet, kvaliteeti ja meile vajalikud kogused."

Raporti koostamisele aitas kaasa CNNi Jim Boulden Londonist.

Dylan Hartley might soon close the chapter on his England rugby career, as speculation grows that he’ll transfer to Montpellier in France after the upcoming World Cup. Currently 28, Hartley is the national side’s most experienced player, earning 58 caps since debuting against the Pacific Islanders six years ago, and he’s captained Northampton Saints since 2009—a period that’s seen the club win significant trophies and make major finals.

Hartley’s playing track record is notable for both strong leadership and high-profile disciplinary issues. His 2013 11-week suspension for swearing at an official excluded him from the British and Irish Lions tour, but his club has always backed him, making him a rallying point for teammates and fans. Now, with his contract set to expire at season’s end, French media claim he has already checked out Montpellier’s facilities, laying the groundwork for a three-year deal. However, neither Hartley nor Montpellier has officially commented. The Rugby Football Union’s rule—barring overseas-based players from national selection—would mean any such move signals the end of Hartley’s England tenure.

This possible transfer comes at a tough time for Northampton, who could also lose starter Samu Manoa, reportedly joining Toulon, and George Pisi, linked to Castres. Such changes would challenge the club as they try to defend domestic and European ambitions.

England, meanwhile, would lose a seasoned hooker at a time when depth in that position is limited. Injuries have hampered Tom Youngs and Rob Webber, with David Paice and Joe Gray currently next in line. Looking ahead, Exeter’s young Luke Cowan-Dickie is tipped as a future international. England coach Stuart Lancaster recently repeated his stance that only home-based players will be selected, aiming to curb the flow of talent to French teams. For Hartley, born in New Zealand, playing in the 2015 World Cup could now serve as his final outing for the national side.
