article_content: Seasoned travelers often face the dilemma of how much to tip and who deserves it while abroad. While tipping customs are well-entrenched in much of the West, confusion and mistakes abound when visitors encounter unfamiliar expectations, sometimes leading to awkward moments. Failing to tip or giving too little can unintentionally let down staff who count on tips to supplement their wages. Tipping traditions differ widely. For instance, offering a gratuity in Japan is considered an insult, while in China it's generally not expected—though this is changing in areas popular with Western visitors. In many parts of Europe and the Americas, tipping is more routine, but local guidelines and expectations vary according to location and service type. William Hanson, an expert on etiquette, reminds travelers that tipping is not required for poor service, as it can reinforce substandard standards. Paul Fidgeon from the University of West London recommends the '10% rule' where in doubt, but stresses the value of researching the local tipping culture beforehand. Even a modest tip, if unsure, is usually appreciated. Oonagh Shiel of Cheapflights.co.uk notes that tipping practices around the world are inconsistent and can perplex even seasoned travelers, given the differences in currencies and cultural norms. Despite differing opinions, there's evidence that generosity in tipping can enhance the quality of service—a point illustrated by stories of exceptional treatment following a generous tip, like complimentary items or special attention from staff. To navigate tipping, travel experts and organizations offer guidance. The American Hotel & Lodging Association advises guests to tip hotel housekeepers $1–$5 per night, concierges $5–$10 depending on services provided, bell staff $1–$5 per bag, door staff $1–$2 for summoning a cab, and shuttle or valet drivers according to the help they've given. In restaurants, unless a service charge is included, a gratuity of 10–15% is standard, or up to 20% for exceptional service. Bartenders and room service attendants also usually receive 15–20% if service fees aren't already imposed. Housekeepers are sometimes forgotten since their work is outside guest view. Chain hotels like Marriott sometimes place envelopes in rooms to prompt guests to leave appropriate gratuities, and Hanson suggests leaving £5–£10 for housekeepers at the end of a week-long stay in high-end hotels. Concierge tips depend on the complexity of assistance needed—a simple reservation may warrant a small tip, while securing rare tickets could merit at least $10. Some travelers offer a lump sum tip at departure. The usual tip for porters and door staff ranges from £1–£5 per bag (higher for heavy baggage or extra service), and £1–£2 for hailing taxis. When it comes to transportation, it's common to tip taxi drivers about 10% or to round up, while shuttle and valet drivers receive £1–£2. On safari trips in Africa, group guides may expect $10 per day, with higher rates for private tours. Tour guides are generally tipped 10–20% for exemplary service, or about £5 per day for group multi-day outings. Checking local customs before departure—or discreetly watching how locals tip—can reduce social missteps. According to Saskia Welman, it's wiser to observe than to ask directly, as discussing tips with staff can be uncomfortable for everyone. Country-to-country, tipping customs diverge greatly. Japan discourages tipping, viewing it as improper. In Africa, 10–15% is common in restaurants; safari guides have established expectations. Australia and New Zealand have little tipping culture, though outstanding service might merit a small token. Most Caribbean resorts build tips into the package—guests should check rules before adding more. Tipping in China is rare, but Western-focused venues increasingly expect it. Guidance from experts: in France, 'service compris' means service charges are included but extra gratitude is optional; in Germany, give tips directly to waitstaff rather than leaving cash on the table; in Spain, a 7–13% tip is common but not obligatory; and in Thailand, tipping is uncommon but small amounts are welcome.
translated_content: Kogenud reisijad seisavad tihti küsimuse ees, kui palju jootraha anda ja kellele seda välismaal maksta. Kui läänemaailmas on jootrahakultuur tugev, siis tundmatud tavad võivad segadusse ajada ning põhjustada piinlikke olukordi. Kui jootraha jääb andmata või on liiga väike, võib see teenindajat alt vedada, sest paljud arvestavad sellega oma sissetuleku osana. Jootrahatraditsioonid on väga erinevad. Näiteks Jaapanis loetakse jootraha pakkumine solvavaks, samas kui Hiinas seda üldjuhul ei eeldata – välja arvatud turistide seas populaarsetes kohtades. Paljudes Euroopa ja Ameerika paikades on jootraha andmine pigem norm, ent summad ja ootused sõltuvad kohalikest kommetest ja teenustest. Etiketiekspert William Hanson ütleb, et halva teeninduse korral pole jootraha vajalik, sest see võib kinnistada lohakust. Londoni Ülikooli turismiõppejõud Paul Fidgeon soovitab juhtnöörina 10% reeglit, kuid toonitab, et enne reisi võiks uurida konkreetse sihtkoha tavasid. Kui pole kindel, on väike jootraha siiski tavaliselt sobiv. Oonagh Shiel portaalist Cheapflights.co.uk märgib, et jootraha teemad on maailmas väga erinevad ning võivad tekitada segadust nii summade, protsentide kui rahvusvaluutade osas. Erinevate arvamuste kiuste näitavad lood, et helde jootraha võib tuua kaasa eriti hea teeninduse – näiteks tähelepanu või väikseid kingitusi pärast suuremat summat. Reisieksperdid ja organisatsioonid annavad nõu: Ameerika Hotelli- ja Majutusühing soovitab jätta toateenindajale 1–5 dollarit öö kohta, konsjeržile 5–10 dollarit olenevalt teenusest, uksehoidjale takso kutsumise eest 1–2 dollarit ning pagasikandjale 1–5 dollarit koti eest. Restoranis, kui teenustasu pole arvel, antakse tüüpiliselt 10–15% jootraha, suurepärase teeninduse korral kuni 20%. Baarmeni ja toateenindaja puhul kehtib sama, kui teenustasu pole sees. Toateenindajaid unustatakse tihti, sest nad tegutsevad külalistest eemal. Suuremad hotelliketid, näiteks Marriott, jätavad tubadesse ümbrikud, et teavitada jootraha vajadusest, ning Hanson soovitab kallimas hotellis jätta nädalase viibimise lõpus 5–10 naela. Konsjerži jootraha suurus sõltub teenuse keerukusest – lihtne laudade broneering väärib väiksemat, raskemini saadud piletid vähemalt 10 dollari suurust tunnustust. Mõni külaline annab lahkumisel suurema summa. Portjee ja uksehoidja saavad üldiselt 1–5 naela koti kohta (raskema pagasi või erilise abi puhul rohkem) ning 1–2 naela takso kutsumise eest. Transpordis on tavaks anda taksojuhile umbes 10% arvest või ümardada summa, transfeeri- või parkimisteenuse puhul 1–2 naela. Aafrika safaridel eeldatakse grup giidile vähemalt 10 dollarit päeva kohta, privaatretkedel rohkem. Giide tasustatakse tavaliselt 10–20% ulatuses suurepärase teenuse korral või umbes 5 naela päev grupireisi puhul. Enne reisi tasub tutvuda kohalike jootrahakombestikega või jälgida diskreetselt teiste käitumist. Saskia Welmani sõnul tuleks jootraha kohta pigem vaikselt jälgida kui otse küsida, kuna teema võib teenindajatele olla ebamugav. Erinevates riikides on jootrahakombed väga isikupärased. Jaapanis peetakse jootraha kohatuks, Aafrikas lisandub restoranis tavaliselt 10–15% ning safarigiididel on kindlad ootused. Austraalias ja Uus-Meremaal pole jootrahakultuur levinud, kuid suurepärase teeninduse korral võib siiski väikse tunnustuse jätta. Kariibi mere kuurortides sisaldavad hinnad enamasti juba jootraha – enne tasumist tasub uurida reegleid. Hiinas on jootraha endiselt pigem erand, kuid turismipiirkondades oodatud. Prantsusmaal tähendab «service compris», et teenustasu sisaldub arves, kuid lisaraha andmine on soovi korral lubatud. Saksamaal antakse tipp otse teenindajale, mitte ei jäeta lauale. Hispaanias on tavapärane jätta 7–13% jootraha, kuid see pole kohustus. Tais pole jootraha eeldus, ent väikest summat hinnatakse.

article_content:
Christopher Nolan is set to receive the Public Service Award from the Federation of American Scientists (FAS) this November in Washington D.C., honoring his work on the film 'Oppenheimer'. The award recognizes exceptional contributions to science policy and culture. This ceremony revives a decades-long tradition dating back to 1971, celebrating individuals who advance science and technology.

'Oppenheimer' chronicles J. Robert Oppenheimer and the founding of what began as the 'Federation of Atomic Scientists' in 1945, aiming to inform the public about the dangers of nuclear weapons. Reflecting on this, FAS CEO Daniel Correa noted the ongoing relevance of these issues in today's world.

Nolan expressed his gratitude, emphasizing the significance of being acknowledged by an organization rooted in the era his film portrays.

At the same event, Senators Chuck Schumer (D-NY) and Todd Young (R-IN) will be recognized for their pivotal roles in passing the CHIPS & Science Act, a major investment in American science and innovation. FAS CEO Correa highlighted the importance of their legislative achievement in strengthening the nation's future.

Additional honorees include Alondra Nelson, former acting director of the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy, for her leadership on AI regulation and equity in STEM, and Alexa White, recipient of FAS's first 'Policy Entrepreneurship' award, celebrating emerging leaders in science policy.

Past FAS awardees include prominent figures such as Senators Ted Kennedy, Sam Nunn, Richard Lugar, Secretaries Henry Kissinger, George Shultz, William Perry, author Carl Sagan, editor Ruth Adams, and activist Sally Lillenthal.

'Oppenheimer' has achieved remarkable commercial success, becoming the third highest-grossing film of 2023 with $939.1 million in global revenue, despite debuting the same weekend as the year's top-earner, 'Barbie.'

See auhind tunnustab erakordset panust teaduspoliitikasse ja kultuuri. Tseremoonia elustab 1971. aastast kestnud pikaajalise traditsiooni, millega austatakse teaduse ja tehnoloogia edendajaid.

„Oppenheimer“ jutustab J. Robert Oppenheimerist ning sellest, kuidas 1945. aastal loodi algselt „Aatomiteadlaste Föderatsioon“, et teavitada avalikkust tuumarelvade ohtudest. FAS-i tegevjuht Daniel Correa rõhutas, et need teemad on ka tänapäeval väga asjakohased.

Nolan avaldas tänulikkust ning rõhutas, kui palju tähendab talle tunnustus organisatsioonilt, mille juured ulatuvad tema filmi käsitletavasse ajajärku.

Samas sündmusel tunnustavad senaatoreid Chuck Schumerit (D-NY) ja Todd Youngi (R-IN) nende olulise töö eest CHIPS & Science Acti läbiviimisel, mis panustab märkimisväärselt Ameerika teaduse ja innovatsiooni tulevikku. FAS-i juht Correa tõstis esile nende panust riigi tuleviku kindlustamisel.

Au osaliseks saavad ka Alondra Nelson, Valge Maja teadus- ja tehnoloogiapoliitika büroo endine juht, tema eestvedamise eest tehisintellekti reguleerimisel ja võrdsete võimaluste edendamisel STEM-valdkonnas, ning Alexa White, kes saab FAS-i esimese „Poliitikaettevõtluse“ preemia, tunnustamaks uusi juhte teaduspoliitika vallas.

Varasemate FAS-i auhinnasaajate seas on olnud tuntud isikuid, nagu senaatorid Ted Kennedy, Sam Nunn, Richard Lugar, sekretärid Henry Kissinger, George Shultz, William Perry, kirjanik Carl Sagan, toimetaja Ruth Adams ja aktivist Sally Lillenthal.

article_content: Grimes and Elon Musk's three children are currently not allowed to leave California after Grimes filed for physical custody last month, according to court records obtained by Insider. In a parental rights lawsuit submitted to San Francisco Superior Court on September 29, Grimes (whose real name is Claire Boucher) requested sole physical custody of their three children and joint legal custody with Musk. This petition comes about three weeks after Musk initiated a separate legal action in Texas, aiming to 'establish a parent-child relationship' with the children—X, age 3, and Exa and Tau, both age 1. Grimes also requested that the judge dismiss Musk's Texas suit. Grimes' California petition includes a standard restraining order preventing the children from being taken out of California or applying for passports without a court order or written consent from all parties involved. Similarly, Musk's Texas lawsuit contains a standard order prohibiting either parent from hiding the children, moving them to another residence, or disrupting their schooling or daycare. These restraining orders are typical in custody and family law disputes, but procedures can vary from state to state, according to Los Angeles attorney Neama Rahmani. Attorneys for both Musk and Grimes declined to comment, and Musk did not respond to requests for comment. As the legal dispute continues, Musk and Grimes have disagreed about the children's proper residence and where the children have actually been living. In his filing, Musk accused Grimes of moving to California in an 'apparent attempt to circumvent the jurisdiction' of Texas courts. According to Texas family law attorney Holly Davis, the Texas legal system often favors high earners in custody and divorce proceedings due to state caps on child support, whereas California allows for a more flexible post-divorce lifestyle. Forbes currently estimates Musk's net worth at $259.6 billion, making him the world's richest person and CEO of Tesla. Musk's September suit asserts that the primary residence for the children was in Austin, Texas, and that he, Grimes, and their son X moved there in early 2021. Musk claims to have shared primary care of the children since their births and lived with them and Grimes from May to July. Grimes, in her filing, disputes these claims, stating the children have primarily lived with her in California since early 2023. Courts generally determine residential custody based on where the children have resided for the previous six months, aiming to minimize disruption to their lives, Davis said. However, if parents disagree on the state of residence, the courts from both states may confer to decide jurisdiction based on the children's best interests. Currently, the children's exact whereabouts are unclear. On September 7, Grimes made and then deleted a post on X (formerly Twitter), asking Musk to let her see her son or respond to her lawyer. A week later, Musk brought his eldest son, X, to a meeting with the president of Turkey in New York, telling the leader that he 'mostly' took care of X.
translated_content: Grimes ja Elon Muski kolm last ei tohi hetkel Californiast lahkuda pärast seda, kui Grimes esitas eelmisel kuul avalduse laste füüsilise hooldusõiguse saamiseks, selgub Insideri saadud kohtudokumentidest. 29. septembril San Francisco ülemkohtule esitatud vanemlike õiguste kohtuasjas taotles Grimes (kodanikunimega Claire Boucher) nende kolme lapse ainuhooleõigust ning jagatud seaduslikku hooldusõigust koos Muskiga. See avaldus esitati umbes kolm nädalat pärast seda, kui Musk algatas Texases eraldi kohtuasja, mille eesmärk oli 'luua vanema-lapse suhe' nende lastega – X (3-aastane) ning Exa ja Tau (mõlemad 1-aastased). Grimes palus samuti, et kohtunik lükkaks tagasi Muski Texase hagi. Grimesi California kohtuasjas on ka standardne lähenemiskeeld, mis takistab lapsi Californiast välja viia või neile passi taotlemist ilma kohtu korralduse või kõigi osapoolte kirjaliku loata. Samamoodi sisaldab Muski Texase kohtuasja standardkäsklust, mis keelab kummalgi vanemal lapsi varjata, neid teise elukohta viia või nende kooli- või päevahoiukorraldust segada. Neid piiranguid kasutatakse tavaliselt hooldus- ja perekonnaõiguslikes vaidlustes, kuid protseduurid võivad riigiti erineda, ütles Los Angelese advokaat Neama Rahmani. Nii Muski kui Grimesi advokaadid keeldusid kommentaarist ning Musk ei vastanud kommentaaripalvetele. Kohtuvaidluse jätkudes on Musk ja Grimes eriarvamusel laste elukoha suhtes ning selles, kus nad tegelikult elanud on. Oma avalduses süüdistas Musk Grimesi Californiasse kolimises 'ilmselt selleks, et vältida Texase kohtute pädevust'. Texase pereõiguse advokaadi Holly Davise sõnul on Texase õigussüsteem sageli kõrge sissetulekuga vanematele soodsam, kuna osariigis on lapsetoetuse suurusele piirangud, samal ajal kui Californias on lahutusejärgne elukorraldus paindlikum. Forbes hindab Muski netoväärtuseks praegu 259,6 miljardit dollarit, tehes temast maailma rikkaima inimese ja Tesla tegevjuhi. Muski septembrikuine hagi väidab, et laste põhielukoht oli Austin, Texas, ning et tema, Grimes ja nende poeg X kolisid sinna 2021. aasta alguses. Musk väidab, et on igast lapsest sünnist saati hoolitsenud ning elanud koos nende ja Grimesiga maist juulini. Grimes vaidlustab oma avalduses need väited, öeldes, et lapsed on 2023. aasta algusest saadik peamiselt temaga Californias elanud. Kohtud lähtuvad hooldusõigust määrates tavaliselt sellest, kus lapsed on viimased kuus kuud elanud, et nende elu võimalikult vähe segada, ütles Davis. Kui vanemad vaidlevad elukoha osas, võivad mõlema osariigi kohtud pidada nõu, et laste huvides otsustada, milline osariik peaks juhtumi lahendama. Hetkel pole laste täpne asukoht teada. 7. septembril tegi Grimes X-is (endise nimega Twitter) postituse, mille ta kiiresti kustutas, paludes Muskil lasta tal oma poega näha või vastata tema advokaadile. Nädal hiljem viis Musk oma vanima poja X-i New Yorki, et kohtuda Türgi presidendiga, öeldes riigipeale, et ta 'enamasti' hoolitseb X-i eest.

article_content: The mother of Milly Main, a girl whose death is part of a corporate homicide investigation at Glasgow's Queen Elizabeth University Hospital (QEUH), believes she will find justice. Ten-year-old Milly died while undergoing cancer treatment after contracting an infection from the hospital's water supply. NHS Greater Glasgow and Clyde (NHSGGC), Scotland's largest health board, was recently named as a suspect. Milly's mother, Kimberly Darroch, expressed 'profound sadness' over her daughter's death but maintains hope for justice. Police Scotland began a criminal investigation in 2021 into several deaths at QEUH, including Milly, two other children, and 73-year-old Gail Armstrong. The investigation may lead to criminal charges or a fatal accident inquiry, while a separate public inquiry into the construction of several Scottish hospitals is ongoing. Ms Darroch previously described her child's death as 'murder' to the inquiry. An earlier review concluded that an infection contributing to Milly's death was likely caused by conditions at QEUH. At a press conference organized by Scottish Labour leader Anas Sarwar following the corporate homicide probe announcement, Ms Darroch said, 'We should be watching [Milly] grow up, enjoying life with her, but unfortunately we're here today. This is a big step toward justice for Milly. I know there is more to do, but I believe we're on the right path. I truly believe we will get justice one day.' Milly was diagnosed with leukaemia in 2012 and died in 2017 after contracting stenotrophomonas at QEUH. Ms Darroch praised hospital staff for their care, but said, 'I have never been able to celebrate Milly's life as I should. Every time I think of Milly, I recall the pain of that day and its lasting impact. I hope this process ends soon so I can remember her and celebrate the happy times.' Anas Sarwar, who has advocated for bereaved families, said that Milly's parents are seeking justice when they should be able to grieve privately. He described the identification of the hospital as a suspect as 'unprecedented.' Sarwar thanked whistle-blowers and said the investigation brings answers and justice closer. The QEUH, including adult and children's hospitals, opened in 2015 following an £842 million project funded by the Scottish government. NHSGGC initiated legal proceedings in 2020 against three construction companies over technical issues. Sarwar noted that former health minister Jeane Freeman supported an investigation, placed the health board under special measures, and instigated a public inquiry. He criticized leadership before and after Freeman, including current First Minister Humza Yousaf, for insufficient accountability. Sarwar called for new leadership at NHSGGC, specifically the removal of John Brown and Jane Grant, to support full compliance with the investigations. He said staff deserve better leadership. Sandie Armstrong, daughter of Gail Armstrong, also welcomed the police investigation and hopes it will prompt improvement. She criticized the health board for focusing on denying connections between patient deaths and issues at QEUH instead of finding the root problems. She called for responsibility to restore public and patient trust. NHSGGC confirmed it received an update from the Crown Office but said prosecutors have not reached a final decision. Board chair John Brown said the board continues to cooperate fully with authorities, is focused on healthcare improvement, and takes infection prevention 'very seriously.' He referenced recent positive reviews but acknowledged the need for diligence. Brown is set to step down at the completion of his contract. The Corporate Manslaughter and Corporate Homicide Act (2007), introduced after disasters like Piper Alpha, allows Scottish organizations to be prosecuted for gross breaches of duty of care resulting from management failures. However, the act has not yet been used in Scotland, even after the Stonehaven rail crash. The QEUH case involves two years of collecting evidence and expert input. Prosecutors may drop the case or charge NHSGGC, which could face an unlimited fine if found guilty. Civil action is also possible. A separate public inquiry continues to review failings at QEUH to identify lessons for the future, but this process does not determine civil or criminal liability.
translated_content: Milly Maini ema, kelle tütre surm on Glasgow Queen Elizabethi Ülikoolihaiglas toimuva korporatiivse tapmise uurimise keskmes, usub, et õiglus võidab. Kümneaastane Milly suri vähiravi ajal, olles haiglas saanud vee kaudu nakkuse. Šotimaa suurimat terviseametit, NHS Greater Glasgow and Clyde (NHSGGC), nimetati hiljuti kahtlusaluseks. Milly ema Kimberly Darroch väljendas 'sügavat kurbust' tütre surma pärast, kuid usub ikka, et saab õigust. Šotimaa politsei alustas 2021. aastal kriminaaluurimist mitme surma osas QEUH haiglas, sealhulgas Milly, kahe teise lapse ja 73-aastase Gail Armstrongi juhtumites. Uurimine võib viia kriminaalsüüdistusteni või surma põhjuse uurimiseni. Samal ajal on käimas ka avalik uurimine mitme haigla ehituse kohta Šotimaal. Darroch ütles uurimisel varem, et tema lapse surm oli 'mõrv'. Varasem raport leidis, et Milly surmale kaasa aidanud nakkus oli tõenäoliselt seotud QEUH-i tingimustega. Šoti Tööpartei juhi Anas Sarwari korraldatud pressikonverentsil pärast uurimise avalikuks tulekut ütles Darroch: 'Me peaksime nägema [Millyt] kasvamas ja temaga elu nautimas, kuid kahjuks oleme täna siin. See on oluline samm õigluse poole. Ma tean, et ees ootab veel tööd, kuid usun, et liigume õiges suunas. Ma tõesti usun, et ühel päeval saavutame õiguse.' Millyl diagnoositi leukeemia 2012. aastal ja ta suri 2017. aastal pärast stenotrophomonase nakkuse saamist QEUH-s. Darroch tänas haigla töötajaid hoolitsuse eest, kuid märkis: 'Ma ei ole kunagi saanud Milly elu päriselt tähistada. Iga kord, kui Millyt meenutan, meenub selle päeva valu. Loodan, et see protsess lõpeb peagi, et saaksin tema elu ja häid aegu mälestada.' Anas Sarwar, kes on seisnud kannatanud perede eest, ütles, et Milly vanemad otsivad õiglust, kui tegelikult peaks neil olema võimalus rahus leinata. Tema sõnul oli haigla kahtlusaluseks nimetamine 'pretsedenditu'. Sarwar tänas vilepuhujaid ning ütles, et uurimine viib lähemale vastustele ja õigusele. QEUH, kuhu kuuluvad täiskasvanute ja lastehaigla, avati 2015. aastal Šotimaa valitsuse rahastatud 842 miljoni naelase ehitusprojekti tulemusena. NHSGGC alustas 2020. aastal kohtuvaidlusi kolme ehitusfirmaga tehniliste probleemide tõttu. Sarwar tõi välja, et endine terviseminister Jeane Freeman toetas uurimist, viis juhatuse erijärelevalve alla ja algatas avaliku uurimise. Ta kritiseeris Freemanile eelnenud ja järgnenud juhte, sealhulgas praegust esimeministrit Humza Yousafit, ebapiisava vastutuse eest. Sarwar kutsus üles vahetama NHSGGC juhtkonda, eriti John Browni ja Jane Granti, et tagada täielik koostöö uurimistega. Ta lisas, et töötajad väärivad paremat juhtimist. Gail Armstrongi tütar Sandie Armstrong tervitas samuti uurimist ja lootis, et see toob muutuse. Ta kritiseeris juhatust keskendumise eest seose vältimisele patsientide surmade ja QEUH probleemide vahel, mitte põhjuste otsimisele. Armstrong rõhutas, et vastutuse võtmine on vajalik avaliku ja patsientide usalduse taastamiseks. NHSGGC kinnitas, et on saanud prokuratuurilt infot, kuid otsust pole veel tehtud. Juhatuse esimees John Brown sõnas, et juhatus teeb koostööd võimudega, keskendub tervishoiu parandamisele ning võtab nakkustõrjet väga tõsiselt. Ta viitas positiivsetele raportitele, kuid tõdes, et tähelepanu tuleb pidevalt hoida. Brown lahkub ametist lepingu lõppedes. Korporatiivse tapmise seadus (Corporate Manslaughter and Corporate Homicide Act, 2007), mis võeti vastu pärast Piper Alpha katastroofi, võimaldab Šotimaal organisatsiooni juhtimisvigade eest vastutusele võtta, kui see põhjustab tõsise kohustuse rikkumise. Kuid seadust pole veel Šotimaal rakendatud, isegi mitte pärast Stonehaveni rongiõnnetust. QEUH juhtumis on kogutud tõendeid ja ekspertarvamusi üle kahe aasta. Prokurörid võivad juhtumi lõpetada või NHSGGC-le esitada süüdistuse; süüdimõistmise korral võib määrata piiramatu trahvi. Ka tsiviilnõuded on võimalikud. Eraldi avalik uurimine analüüsib jätkuvalt QEUH puudujääke, et õppida vigadest, kuid see ei otsusta tsiviil- ega kriminaalvastutuse üle.

article_content: Kobane, located on the Syria-Turkey border, is reportedly the target of a suspected ISIS chemical weapon attack targeting Kurdish forces. Witnesses and officials have described victims suffering from blindness, blisters, and respiratory complications. Although severe fighting has prevented laboratory confirmation, local doctors believe there's a high likelihood that a chemical agent, possibly chlorine, was used. In Iraq, authorities are alarmed over ISIS's control of the Muthanna State Establishment, a major chemical weapons site from the Saddam era. This facility, partially destroyed by the United States in 1991, still houses thousands of aging sarin-filled rockets and other toxic substances. Iraq’s UN Ambassador, Mohamed Ali Alhakim, has raised concerns about the risks these munitions pose now that they may be accessible to militants. Despite these warnings, US defense officials argue that the chemical weapons are so old that they are unlikely to function properly and may even pose greater dangers to those trying to use them. After the US-led invasion of Iraq in 2003, coalition forces found and managed approximately 5,000 chemical weapons created prior to 1991. However, revelations about these discoveries were kept out of public discourse, in part because they contradicted the prevailing justification for the war and due to the fact that some had American origins. From 2004 to 2011, at least 17 US service members and seven Iraqi police officers sustained injuries from exposure to these munitions, suffering burns, nausea, temporary blindness, and other effects. In some cases, explosives disposal teams were unaware of chemical risks, leading to additional exposure during handling and disposal. Many injuries related to chemical weapons were downplayed by medical officers and not fully acknowledged, leading to frustration among affected service members over the lack of recognition and transparency. The rise of ISIS has refocused international attention on Iraq, with the United States supporting local forces once again as ISIS gains access to historic chemical weapons sites. These developments highlight persistent concerns about the legacy of chemical weapons in the region, intelligence errors before and during the Iraq War, and the continued impact of past conflicts and government policies.
translated_content: Kobane, mis asub Süüria ja Türgi piiril, on väidetavalt langenud ISIS-e keemiarelvarünnaku alla, mille sihtmärgiks olid kurdi väed. Tunnistajad ja ametnikud kirjeldavad ohvreid, kellel on täheldatud pimedust, ville ning hingamisraskusi. Laborikinnitust pole saadud intensiivse lahingutegevuse tõttu, kuid kohalikud arstid leiavad väga tõenäoliseks, et kasutati keemiarelva, võimalik, et kloori. Iraagis on põhjustanud muret ISIS-e kontroll Muthanna keemiarelvatehase üle – tegemist oli ühe Saddam Husseini ajastu suurima keemiarelvalao ja -tehasega. Rajatis hävitati USA poolt osaliselt 1991. aastal, kuid sinna jäi alles tuhandeid vanu sariini täidetud rakette ja muid mürgiseid aineid. Iraagi ÜRO suursaadik Mohamed Ali Alhakim on osutanud ohule, et need laod võivad nüüd olla mässuliste käes. USA kaitseametnikud peavad neid keemiarelvi siiski nii vanadeks ja lagunenudeks, et nende kasutamine oleks pigem ohtlik püüdele endale kui sihitud ohvritele. Pärast USA juhitud sissetungi Iraagisse 2003. aastal leidis ja haldas koalitsioon ligikaudu 5000 keemiarelva, mis olid valmistatud enne 1991. aastat. Need leidud jäeti avalikkuse eest varjatuks, kuna see oli vastuolus sõja õigustamiseks toodud väidetega ja osad mürsud olid USA päritolu. Aastail 2004–2011 said vähemalt 17 USA sõdurit ja seitse Iraagi politseinikku kokkupuute tõttu keemiarelvadega põletusi, iiveldust, ajutist pimedust ning muid tervisekahjustusi. Mõnikord ei teadnud lõhkekehade kahjutustajad, et käsitletavad mürsud sisaldasid ohtlikke kemikaale ning said ise mürgiste ainete poolt kahjustada. Sõjalise meditsiinipersonali poolt alahinnati neid vigastusi sageli ning kannatanud sõdurid tundsid, et nende tervisekahjustusi ei tunnustatud ega avalikustatud. ISIS-e tõus on viinud rahvusvahelise tähelepanu tagasi Iraaki, sest terrorirühmitus on saanud ligipääsu endistele keemiarelvade ladudele ning USA aitab taas kohalikke julgeolekujõude. Kõik see rõhutab endiselt lahtisi teemasid seoses keemiarelvade jääkidega piirkonnas, varasemate ja praeguste luurevigade ning Iraagi sõja poliitiliste otsustega.

article_content: Ann Duffy, a resident of Plymouth, Devon, cancelled her brother David’s wedding just twenty days before the event, acting out of disapproval for his fiancée, Sandra Greatrex. On November 5, Duffy impersonated Sandra during a call to the Plymouth Register Office and requested to cancel the ceremony—without David’s knowledge. She then called her brother and told him she had called off his wedding, claiming she was ‘saving’ him from a future divorce. The strained relationship between Duffy and her future sister-in-law reportedly stemmed from disagreements about the care of Duffy’s mother, who was living with David and Sandra. After discovering the cancellation, David and Sandra rebooked their wedding the next day and have since married. In Plymouth Magistrates’ Court, Duffy pleaded guilty to harassment without violence, explaining that her actions were intended to distress her sister-in-law, not her brother. Her lawyer, Roger Page, argued that Duffy believed she was protecting her brother from marrying someone unsuitable. The court postponed sentencing to February 11, pending a detailed report.

article_content:
Liberian President George Weah has conceded defeat following this week’s tightly contested presidential election. With nearly all votes counted, opposition leader Joseph Boakai holds a narrow lead at 50.89%, while Weah has secured 49.11% of the ballots. Boakai’s slim victory margin is just over 28,000 votes. Addressing the nation on Friday evening, Weah acknowledged the result, stating, "Tonight the CDC has lost the election, but Liberia has won. This is a moment to demonstrate grace in defeat and prioritize the nation above personal interests."

Weah revealed that he had personally congratulated Boakai, highlighting the importance of a peaceful handover. In his remarks, Weah also recognized that the close result points to ongoing divisions in the country.

Nearly 2.4 million citizens were eligible to participate in Tuesday’s vote, although official turnout data is yet to be published. Jubilant supporters of Boakai gathered and celebrated outside his party’s office in Monrovia as the results became clear.

This was the first presidential election since the United Nations ended its peacekeeping mission in Liberia in 2018—a mission launched in the aftermath of Liberia’s brutal civil wars between 1989 and 2003, which claimed more than 250,000 lives.

Observers, including Nigerian political leaders and former President Goodluck Jonathan, have commended Weah for accepting the outcome and setting a democratic example for the region.

Ligi kõigi häälte loendamisel juhib opositsiooniliider Joseph Boakai napi eduga – 50,89%, samas kui Weah sai 49,11% häältest. Boakai võiduvahe oli veidi üle 28 000 hääle. Reedel õhtul rahvale esinedes tunnistas Weah tulemusi: "Täna kaotas CDC valimised, kuid võitis Libeeria. See on aeg kaotust väärikalt tunnistada ja seada isiklikest huvidest ettepoole rahva huvid."

Weah ütles, et õnnitles Boakait isiklikult ning rõhutas rahumeelse võimu üleandmise tähtsust. Samuti tõdes Weah, et tulemuste nappus viitab jätkuvatele lõhedele riigis.

Ligi 2,4 miljonit kodanikku said osaleda teisipäeval toimunud hääletusel, kuid ametlikke valimisaktiivsuse andmeid pole veel avaldatud. Boakai toetajad kogunesid rõõmustama tema partei kontori juurde Monrovias, kui tulemused teatavaks said.

See oli esimene presidendivalimine pärast ÜRO rahuvalvemissiooni lõppu Libeerias 2018. aastal – missioon käivitati pärast 1989–2003 toimunud kodusõdasid, milles hukkus üle 250 000 inimese.

Vaatlejad, sealhulgas Nigeeria poliitikud ja endine president Goodluck Jonathan, kiitsid Weahi valimistulemuste tunnistamise ning demokraatia eeskuju eest piirkonnas.

article_content: Oregon Governor John Kitzhaber is under growing scrutiny due to allegations that his fiancée, Cylvia Hayes, used her relationship with him to attract business for her environmental consulting firm. These claims have initiated both an ethics investigation and the involvement of Oregon’s attorney general. Kitzhaber’s precise role in Hayes’ business activities remains unclear, but the controversy puts his long-standing political career at risk. Recently, The Oregonian—Oregon’s leading newspaper—called for his resignation, arguing the situation has distracted from his responsibilities as governor. Hayes has been working as an unpaid adviser in the governor’s office while simultaneously maintaining her consulting business, and reports claim she leveraged her influence for personal benefit. She admitted to marrying an immigrant in the 1990s for $5,000 to help him secure legal status, and acknowledged buying land in Washington state in 1997 with the aim of starting a marijuana farm. Attorney General Ellen Rosenblum is exploring possible legal measures, although the options for criminal prosecution are limited, her office could be involved in complex investigations. In response, some advisers to Kitzhaber’s former Republican opponent, Dennis Richardson, have begun preparing for a potential recall—a process that demands over 220,000 signatures in 90 days. Despite calls for his resignation and mounting pressure, Kitzhaber has remained in office, asserting that his recent electoral win demonstrates public support for his leadership. Some members of Kitzhaber’s own party have spoken out against him or withheld support, while others express understanding for the personal strain he faces. The Oregon Government Ethics Commission is currently assessing whether Hayes’ overlapping roles created a conflict of interest. Media scrutiny also focused on Hayes’ financial disclosures. She received $118,000 over two years from a green energy organization—a figure inconsistent with her tax returns. Kitzhaber says he and Hayes file taxes separately, and Hayes has not addressed media inquiries about this discrepancy. Kitzhaber emphasizes that it is up to the ethics commission to decide if any wrongdoing occurred, saying he and Hayes tried to avoid conflicts. The commission is set to make a decision by March regarding a formal investigation. According to Secretary of State Kate Brown, the recall campaign cannot officially start until Kitzhaber has completed six months of his current term.
translated_content: Oregoni kuberner John Kitzhaber on sattunud suureneva tähelepanu alla seoses süüdistustega, et tema kihlatu Cylvia Hayes kasutas nendevahelist suhet, et hankida kliente oma keskkonnanõustaja firmale. Need väited on kaasa toonud nii eetikauurimise kui ka osariigi peaprokuröri sekkumise. Kitzhaberi täpne roll Hayesi ärilistes tegevustes pole selge, kuid skandaal seab ohtu tema pikaajalise poliitilise karjääri. Hiljuti nõudis osariigi juhtiv ajaleht The Oregonian tema tagasiastumist, väites, et olukord segab tema võimalust kubernerina tõhusalt tegutseda. Hayes on töötanud palgata nõunikuna kuberneri kantseleis ning samal ajal jätkanud oma konsultatsioonitegevust; väidetavalt kasutas ta mõjuvõimu isiklikuks kasuks. Ta on tunnistanud, et abiellus 1990. aastatel immigrandiga 5000 dollari eest, et too saaks seaduslikku staatust, ning samuti, et ostis 1997. aastal Washingtoni osariigis maad marihuaanafarmi rajamise eesmärgil. Peaprokurör Ellen Rosenblum kaalub võimalikke õiguslikke samme, ehkki võimalused kriminaalsüüdistuste esitamiseks on piiratud; tema amet võib siiski osaleda keerukate juhtumite uurimisel. Vastuseks alustasid Kitzhaberi endise vabariiklasest vastaskandidaadi Dennis Richardsoni nõunikud võimaliku tagandamiskampaania ettevalmistamist – selleks on vaja koguda üle 220 000 allkirja 90 päeva jooksul. Vaatamata kasvavale survele ja üleskutsetele tagasi astuda on Kitzhaber ametis, rõhutades, et tema värske valimisvõit tõestab avalikkuse toetust tema juhtimisele. Mõned parteikaaslased on teda kritiseerinud või hoidnud madalat profiili, teised aga on väljendanud kaastunnet tema isiklike raskuste suhtes. Oregoni eetikanõukogu hindab praegu, kas Hayesi tegevustes esines huvide konflikti. Meedia uurib samuti Hayesi rahalisi avaldusi – ta sai kahe aasta jooksul roheenergia organisatsioonilt 118 000 dollarit, mis ei ühti tema tuludeklaratsioonidega. Kitzhaberi sõnul esitavad nad Haysiga maksud eraldi ning Hayes pole küsimusele vastanud. Kitzhaber toonitab, et eetikakomisjonil lasub otsus võimaliku väärkäitumise kohta, lisades, et nemad Haysiga püüdsid vältida huvide konflikti. Komisjon peaks otsustama märtsis, kas algatada ametlik uurimine. Riigisekretär Kate Brown täpsustas, et tagandamisprotsess saab ametlikult alata alles siis, kui Kitzhaber on ametis olnud vähemalt kuus kuud.

article_content: Wound healing usually occurs gradually, as new tissue slowly covers and closes a skin lesion until it disappears. Scrapes, cuts, or burns typically heal fully over time. However, chronic wounds—injuries that fail to heal after four weeks—pose a much higher risk for complications. Such wounds can escalate into ongoing health issues or even blood poisoning. Treating chronic wounds presents particular challenges because some bacteria can settle in the wound and shield themselves by forming tenacious structures called biofilms. These biofilms, composed of various bacteria that can cause pus, secrete a protective mucus barrier, making it tough for antibiotics and disinfectants to reach and eliminate the embedded germs. A research team from Empa (Switzerland) and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) is developing a wound dressing that deploys beneficial probiotic bacteria to fight these biofilms. A proof of concept was recently published in the journal Microbes and Infection. Empa researcher Qun Ren is leading efforts to discover more effective treatments for stubborn biofilms. At Empa’s Biointerfaces laboratory in St. Gallen, the team incorporated living probiotic bacteria—particularly lactobacilli found in healthy intestinal flora and foods like yogurt and cheese—into the new dressing. According to visiting scientist Dr. Zhihao Li, these probiotics are biocompatible and lower the wound’s pH by producing lactic acid, shifting the typically alkaline environment of chronic wounds toward acidity. In laboratory tests, the probiotics generated a strongly acidic medium (pH 4), which also encouraged the migration of human fibroblasts, cells that are vital to the healing process. The researchers then integrated these beneficial bacteria into a cellulose-based dressing designed to protect chronic wounds from further infection. This setup allowed the lactobacilli to safely and continuously produce lactic acid inside the dressing, which was then steadily released into the wound environment. Laboratory experiments showed the probiotic-infused dressing could completely eradicate a typical biofilm of skin pathogens in a petri dish. To further evaluate its effectiveness, the team simulated wounds on human tissue samples and cultivated a biofilm of the pathogen Pseudomonas aeruginosa. Applying the probiotic dressing reduced the pathogen count by 99.999%. The research also confirmed that probiotics do not harm human skin cells but can trigger an inflammatory response. According to Qun Ren, this proof of concept highlights the potential of using beneficial bacteria in wound treatment, and further research is underway to better understand the mechanism and maximize the benefits of living probiotic dressings.
translated_content: Haavade paranemine toimub tavaliselt järk-järgult, kui uus kude katab aegamööda nahavigastuse, kuni see kaob. Marrastused, lõiked või põletused paranevad tavaliselt täielikult. Kroonilised haavad – vigastused, mis ei parane nelja nädala jooksul – kujutavad endast aga palju suuremat tüsistuste ohtu. Sellised haavad võivad põhjustada pikaajalisi terviseprobleeme või isegi veremürgitust. Krooniliste haavade ravi on eriti keeruline, kuna mõned bakterid suudavad haavas püsima jääda ja end kaitsta, moodustades tugevaid biofilme. Need biofilmid koosnevad erinevatest mäda tekitavatest bakteritest, mis eritavad kaitsvat limakihti ja takistavad antibiootikumidel ning desinfitseerijatel sinna tungimast. Empa (Šveits) ja Massachusettsi Tehnoloogiainstituudi (MIT, USA) uurimisrühm töötab välja haavaplaastri, mis kasutab nende biofilmide vastu võitlemiseks kasulikke probiootilisi baktereid. Hiljuti avaldasid nad ajakirjas Microbes and Infection selle kohta tõendusmaterjali. Empa teadlane Qun Ren juhib visalt uusi lahendusi otsivat uurimisrühma. Empa Biointerfaces laboratooriumis St. Gallenis töötas meeskond uusi elus-probiootikume – eriti laktobatsille, mida leidub tervislikus soolestiku mikroflooras ning toitudes nagu jogurt ja juust – haavasidemele. Külalisuurija dr Zhihao Li sõnul on need probiootikumid biokompatibilised ja langetavad haava pH-d piimhapet moodustades, suunates tavaliselt aluselist kroonilist haava keskkonda happelisemaks. Laboratooriumkatsetes lõid probiootikumid tugevalt happelise keskkonna (pH 4), mis soodustas ka inimese fibroblastide liikumist – rakud, mis on paranemise jaoks olulised. Teadlased integreerisid need kasulikud bakterid tselluloosil põhinevasse sidemesse, mis kaitseb kroonilisi haavu lisainfektsioonide eest. Sellises seadistuses said laktobatsillid turvaliselt ja järjepidevalt piimhapet toota ning sidemes eraldus hape haavale aeglaselt. Laboratooriumkatsetes suutis probiootikumidega rikastatud side täielikult hävitada nahapatogeenide tüüpilise biofilmi Petri tassil. Tõhususe hindamiseks simuleerisid teadlased inimese koekohtades haavu ning kasvatasid haavapatogeeni Pseudomonas aeruginosa biofilmi. Probiootilist plaastrit kasutades vähenes selle patogeeni hulk 99,999%. Uuringus kinnitati ka, et probiootikumid ei kahjusta inimese naharakke, kuid võivad esile kutsuda põletikureaktsiooni. Qun Ren sõnul näitab see tõestust leidnud kontseptsioon kasulike bakterite võimalikku rolli haavade ravis ning edasised uuringud keskenduvad mehhanismi mõistmisele ja probiootiliste sidemete võimaluste maksimaalsele ärakasutamisele.

article_content: Akbar Ali, a shopkeeper in Fauldhouse, West Lothian, faced an attempted robbery in his corner shop on Sunday evening. Around 5:45pm, a masked man entered brandishing an eight-inch knife, demanding money while several customers were in the store. Instead of yielding, the 54-year-old used a plastic folding stool to defend himself, striking at the assailant until the robber retreated and fled. The suspect is described as white, tall, and of stocky build, wearing a dark hoodie, blue jeans, brown Timberland boots, gloves, and a grey Tammy hat, with his face covered. Despite the frightening event, Mr Ali reopened his store as usual the next day, urging local residents to assist police in identifying the perpetrator. His wife, Sheida Ali, who has worked in the shop for 25 years, shared her increased concerns for safety following the incident. Police commended Mr Ali for his bravery and requested anyone with relevant information about suspicious activity in the area at that time to come forward. The incident is one among multiple recent armed robberies in surrounding areas, such as Musselburgh and Armadale.

Kahtlusalune on valgenahaline, pikk ja tugeva kehaehitusega, kandis tumedat kapuutsi, teksaseid, pruune Timberlandi saapaid, kindaid ja halli mütsi, nägu oli kaetud. Vaatamata ehmatavale sündmusele avas hr Ali poe järgmisel päeval tavapäraselt ning kutsus kohalikke elanikke üles politseid abistama mehe tuvastamisel. Tema abikaasa Sheida Ali, kes on töötanud kaupluses 25 aastat, väljendas muret turvalisuse pärast pärast juhtunut. article_content: If you can't take the heat, getting out of the kitchen might not help in Vic Clinco's house. This Phoenix, Arizona resident is believed to own the world's largest hot sauce collection, boasting approximately 6,000 bottles and counting. His condiments line shelves from floor to ceiling throughout his dining room and even spill into cupboards and the fridge. Clinco has been growing his collection for 17 years and is widely considered a world record holder for the biggest private hot sauce assembly. He works as a staff cook at the Four Seasons hotel, and his most expensive bottle, a unique item, is valued at about $900 (£580). The highest price he has paid for a single bottle is $400 (£260). His obsession began in 1996, when his wife, Wendy, gave him 12 bottles as a Christmas present during their first holiday together. 'It was simple enough,' he recounts. 'Wendy bought them for me, and when friends and family visited, we laughed at the funny and quirky labels. That's how the obsession started.' After a 23-year career in retail, Clinco dedicated himself fully to collecting hot sauces. He believes there are hundreds of thousands of bottles left to find, as the industry is always evolving. Clinco says his collection is 'priceless' and includes sauces made specifically for him, discontinued company products, many signed bottles, and special promotional items. Some of his rarest possessions are a pair of Adam and Eve sauces from CaJohn's Fiery Foods, and two bottles of Blair's Calderas, which are particularly hard to locate. Blair's also manufactures Caldera 16 Mil, the Guinness World Record hottest sauce at 16 million Scoville units—the scale used to measure the heat of chili peppers. There are only 499 bottles in existence, each valued at close to £3,000 on specialist sites, and Clinco owns one. Clinco offers context: 'To appreciate how hot that is, most police pepper sprays in the U.S. range between 2 and 9 million Scoville units—11 million is hotter than most sprays.' He clarifies that Caldera 16 Mil is in crystallized form rather than a traditional sauce. Clinco also contributes to Chile Pepper magazine and is a regular at hot sauce exhibitions, where he hosts his own heat tolerance challenge, the 'CaJohn's Execution Station.' The contest involves sampling seven sauces, each spicier than the last. 'The goal is to make it from level one to level seven without passing out or getting sick—it happens!' he laughs. 'Most people quit around levels four or five. Only the strongest make it and walk away with bragging rights.' Though not a sauce producer, Clinco sees himself as an ambassador for the industry, aiming to educate and spread enthusiasm for hot sauce. 'If the industry prospers, it grows not just in the U.S., but globally. That means more sauces are made for everyone—and for me to collect, too.'
translated_content: Kui sulle ei meeldi kuumus, pole isegi köögist lahkumine Vic Clinco kodus lahendus. Phoenixis, Arizonas elav mees omab tõenäoliselt maailma suurimat tulise kastme kollektsiooni – ligi 6 000 pudelit ning arv kasvab pidevalt. Tema maitseained paiknevad riiulitel põrandast laeni kogu söögitoas ja mahuvad vaevu kappidesse ning külmikusse. Clinco on oma kollektsiooni täiendanud 17 aastat ning teda peetakse erakollektsioonide maailmarekordi omanikuks. Ta töötab Four Seasonsi hotellis kokana ning tema kalleim pudel on ainulaadne, väärt umbes 900 dollarit (580 naela). Kõige rohkem on ta ühe pudeli eest maksnud 400 dollarit (260 naela). Clinco kirg sai alguse 1996. aastal, kui tema abikaasa Wendy kinkis talle nende esimeseks jõuluks 12 pudelit. „See oli lihtne,“ meenutab ta. „Wendy ostis need mulle ja kui sõbrad ning pere külastasid, naersime naljakate ja omapäraste siltide üle. Sealt see kõik algas.“ Pärast 23-aastast müügitööd pühendus Clinco täielikult tuliste kastmete kogumisele. Tema sõnul on maailmas veel sadu tuhandeid pudeleid, mida avastada, sest tööstus areneb pidevalt. Clinco ütleb, et tema kollektsioon on „hindamatu“ ning sisaldab spetsiaalselt talle loodud kastmeid, kadunud tootjate tooteid, paljusid signeeritud pudeleid ja erilisi promotooteid. Mõned tema haruldasemad esemed on CaJohn’s Fiery Foodsi Adam and Eve kastmed ning kaks Blair’s Calderat, mida on väga raske leida. Blair’s toodab ka Caldera 16 Mil vürtsikastet – Guinnessi maailmarekordi järgi maailma kõige vürtsikamat, 16 miljonit Scoville’i ühikut. Neid pudeleid on ainult 499 ning ühe hind spetsiaalsetel veebilehtedel on ligi 3 000 naela – Clincol on üks neist. Clinco selgitab: „Et mõista, kui tuline see on, enamik politsei pipraspreisid USA-s jäävad vahemikku 2 kuni 9 miljonit Scoville’i ühikut – 11 miljonit on enamiku spreide kuumusest kõrgem.“ Ta märgib, et Caldera 16 Mil ei ole tavaline kaste, vaid hoopis kristalliseeritud kujul. Clinco kirjutab Chile Pepper ajakirjale ja osaleb regulaarselt vürtsikastmete üritustel, kus ta korraldab omaenda tulisuse taluvuse võistlust „CaJohn’s Execution Station”. Võistlus hõlmab järjest tugevamaid seitset kastet. „Eesmärk on jõuda tasemest üks tasemeni seitse ilma minestamata või oksendamata – seda juhtub!“ naerab ta. „Enamik katkestab neljanda või viienda taseme juures. Ainult kõige tugevamad jõuavad lõpuni ja saavad uhkuse õiguse.” Kastmetootjaks Clinco end ei pea, vaid pigem peab end tööstuse saadikuks, kelle eesmärk on harida ja tuua rohkem entusiasmi tuliste kastmete vastu. „Kui tööstusel hästi läheb, kasvab see mitte ainult USAs, vaid üle maailma. See tähendab rohkem uusi kastmeid kõigile – ja mulle kogumiseks.“

article_content: Geologists have known for some time that about 155 million years ago, a 5,000-kilometre-long fragment of continent broke off from western Australia and drifted away. Its departure left a ‘void’ now known as the Argo Abyssal Plain, a basin deep beneath the ocean. This feature lends its name to the lost continent—Argoland. Evidence from the seafloor suggests Argoland drifted northwest and should now be beneath the islands of Southeast Asia. Surprisingly, scientists have found no large, hidden continent under these islands—only scattered fragments of continental crust surrounded by older oceanic basins. This mystery prompted geologists at Utrecht University to reconstruct Argoland’s history. They discovered Argoland survives today, but only as fragments. Their study, published in the journal Gondwana Research, suggests that if these fragments had vanished without leaving a trace, it would present a significant scientific problem. Geologists classify the Earth’s crust as either heavier oceanic or lighter continental crust. Unlike other lost continents, such as Greater Adria—which formed mountain ranges in Southern Europe when it partially subducted into the mantle—Argoland left no such folded rocks at the surface. Utrecht University geologist Douwe van Hinsbergen explains that understanding these ancient reconstructions is crucial for studying the evolution of biodiversity, climate, raw material discovery, mountain formation, and tectonic processes. Van Hinsbergen and his colleague Eldert Advokaat wanted to uncover Argoland’s fate, but initially faced ‘islands of information.’ Their research, spanning seven years, pieced together the scattered evidence. Unlike Africa and South America, where continental break-up produced two clear landmasses, Argoland splintered into many smaller pieces. These fragments arrived in their current locations at roughly the same time, showing how they once connected. The pieces now lie hidden beneath large swathes of Indonesia and Myanmar, forming a ‘collage’ of Argoland. This pattern is typical of Argoland, which was never a single defined landmass but rather an ‘Argopelago’—a collection of microcontinental fragments separated by ancient ocean basins. Similar processes shaped Greater Adria and Zealandia, the largely submerged continent east of Australia. Researchers estimate Argoland’s splintering began around 300 million years ago. Their reconstruction fits between the geological systems of the Himalayas and the Philippines. The final break-up of Argoland accelerated about 215 million years ago, shattering the continent further. To test their models and date key rock layers, the geologists conducted fieldwork on islands including Sumatra, the Andaman Islands, Borneo, Sulawesi, and Timor.
translated_content: Geoloogid on juba mõnda aega teadnud, et umbes 155 miljonit aastat tagasi murdus lääne-Austraaliast ära 5 000 kilomeetri pikkune mandrilõik ja triivis minema. Selle lahkumine jättis maha „tühimiku“, mis on nüüd tuntud kui Argo abüssaallava ehk sügav ookeanibassein. See tunnus andis nime kadunud mandrile – Argolandile. Merepõhja ehitus viitab sellele, et Argoland triivis loodesuunas ja peaks asuma praegu Kagu-Aasia saarte all. Üllatuslikult ei ole teadlased nende saarte alt leidnud suurt peidetud mandrit – ainult laiali paisatud mandrikoorikutükke, mida ümbritsevad vanemad ookeanibasseinid. See mõistatus ajendas Utrechti Ülikooli geolooge Argolandi ajaloo taaslooma. Nad avastasid, et Argoland eksisteerib ka tänapäeval, kuid ainult fragmentidena. Nende uurimus, mis avaldati ajakirjas Gondwana Research, väidab, et kui need killud oleksid jäljetult kadunud, oleks see suur teaduslik probleem. Geoloogid liigitavad Maa kooriku raskemaks ookeaaniliseks ja kergemaks mandriliseks koorikuks. Erinevalt teistest kadunud mandritest, näiteks Greater Adriast, mis lõi osa maapinda Lõuna-Euroopa mäestikeks, kui ta osaliselt sukeldus vahevöösse, pole Argoland jätnud pinnale voltunud kivimikihte. Utrechti Ülikooli geoloog Douwe van Hinsbergen selgitab, et selliste iidsete rekonstruktsioonide mõistmine on oluline nii elurikkuse, kliima ja toorainete leidmise kui ka mägede tekkimise ja laamtektooniliste protsesside uurimiseks. Van Hinsbergen ja tema kolleeg Eldert Advokaat soovisid välja selgitada Argolandi saatuse, kuid seisid algul silmitsi „infosaarega“. Nende seitse aastat kestnud uurimistöö võimaldas laiali paisatud tõendid omavahel kokku viia. Erinevalt Aafrikast ja Lõuna-Ameerikast, kus mandri laiali murdumine tekitas kaks selget tükki, jagunes Argoland palju väiksemateks osadeks. Need fragmendid jõudsid oma praegustesse paikadesse enam-vähem samal ajal, mis näitab nende varasemat ühendust. Killud lebavad nüüd peidus suurel osal Indoneesiast ja Myanmarist, moodustades Argolandi „kollaži“. Selline muster on Argolandile tüüpiline – see polnud kunagi ühtne maismaa, vaid pigem „Argopelaago“: mikromandritükkide kogu, mida eraldasid iidsed ookeanibasseinid. Sarnased protsessid mõjutasid ka Greater Adriat ja Zelandiat, enamjaolt veealust mandrit Austraaliast ida pool. Teadlased arvavad, et Argolandi killustumine algas juba umbes 300 miljonit aastat tagasi. Nende rekonstruktsioon sobitub suurepäraselt Himaalaja ja Filipiinide vahele jääva piirkonna geoloogilisse süsteemi. Argolandi lõplik katkemine kiirenes umbes 215 miljonit aastat tagasi, kui mandritükid jagunesid veelgi enam. Oma mudelite kontrollimiseks ja peamiste kivimikihtide vanuse määramiseks tegid geoloogid välitöid sellistel saartel nagu Sumatra, Andamanid, Borneo, Sulawesi ja Timor.

article_content: At the 32nd convocation ceremony of the Federal University of Technology Akure (FUTA) in Ondo State, Vice Chancellor Professor Adenike Oladiji has called on individuals and organisations to provide further support to help the university achieve its vision. Speaking during the event, Professor Oladiji acknowledged the significant advancements the institution has made through donations and stakeholder grants but emphasized that continued assistance is vital for ongoing development. Professor Oladiji appealed for support in several key areas, including the endowment of professorial chairs in various disciplines, donations of laboratory equipment and learning materials, as well as the provision of doctoral and post-doctoral scholarships and fellowships for staff. She also cited the need for constructing modern lecture halls and laboratories, establishing prizes and awards for outstanding students and staff, building student hostels under Build-Operate-Transfer agreements, and providing buses for student field trips. She reported that, following an accreditation review by the National Universities Commission, 26 out of 27 academic programmes at FUTA have received full accreditation, with one program receiving interim accreditation. Notably, no programme has been denied accreditation. During the ceremony, a total of 5,297 students were awarded degrees and diplomas. Of these, 3,491 received first degrees, while 1,806 were conferred with postgraduate diplomas, master’s, and doctoral degrees.

Üritusel rääkides tunnustas professor Oladiji ülikooli olulist edasiminekut annetuste ja sidusrühmade toetuste kaudu, kuid rõhutas, et pidev abi on jätkuva arengu jaoks hädavajalik. Professor Oladiji palus toetust mitmes olulises valdkonnas, sealhulgas professuuride asutamine erinevates teadusvaldkondades, laboriseadmete ja õppematerjalide annetus, samuti doktorantide ja järeldoktorantide stipendiumide ning töötajate stipendiumite andmine. Samuti tõi ta esile vajaduse kaasaegsete loengusaalide ja laboratooriumide rajamiseks, väljapaistvate üliõpilaste ja töötajate preemiate ning tunnustuste sisseviimiseks, üliõpilaste ühiselamute ehitamiseks Build-Operate-Transfer lepingute alusel ning busside hankimiseks õppekäikudeks. Tema sõnul on pärast riikliku ülikoolide komisjoni (National Universities Commission) akrediteerimisülevaatust 26-st 27-st FUTA õppekavast saanud täieliku akrediteeringu ning üks programm ajutise akrediteeringu. Oluline on märkida, et ühtegi programmi pole akrediteeringust ilma jäetud. Lõpuaktusel omistati kokku 5 297 üliõpilasele kraadid ja diplomid. Nendest said 3 491 esimese astme kraadi ning 1 806 magistri- ja doktorikraadi või kraadiõppe diplomi.

article_content: Hamas was reportedly surprised by the success of its surprise attacks over the weekend and by the perceived weakness of Israeli forces, a senior figure in the group told the Associated Press. "We were surprised by this great collapse," said Ali Barakeh, a member of Hamas' exiled leadership, according to the news agency. Barakeh added that Hamas militants intended to make gains and take prisoners for potential exchanges, but found the Israeli army to be a 'paper tiger.' On Saturday, Hamas fighters launched coordinated sea, air, and ground attacks that appeared to catch Israeli intelligence off guard, according to military experts. David Khalfa, of the North Africa and Middle East Observatory at the Fondation Jean-Jaurès, told France 24 that the attack represented a 'historic failure' for Israeli intelligence. Bruce Hoffman, a senior fellow for counterterrorism and homeland security at the Council on Foreign Relations, told NPR: 'No national intelligence agency is omniscient or flawless, but this is a colossal failure.' Israel is regarded as having one of the most advanced intelligence networks in the Middle East, with key agencies and informants embedded in military groups, reported BBC security correspondent Frank Gardner. Israeli government sources informed Gardner that a major investigation into the intelligence failures is underway, with one official stating the probe could last years. Barakeh also told the AP that Hamas had so far used only a small portion of its forces, saying nearly 2,000 out of an estimated 40,000 fighters in Gaza had participated; these figures could not be independently verified. Shortly after the attack, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu declared a 'state of war,' stating the goal of eliminating Hamas. On Monday, Israel announced a 'complete siege' of Gaza, vowing to cut off electricity, food, water, and fuel.

"Olime üllatunud sellest suurest kokkuvarisemisest," ütles Ali Barakeh, Hamasi pagendatud juhtkonna liige, uudisteagentuuri andmetel. Barakeh lisas, et Hamasi võitlejad kavatsesid saavutada mõningaid territoriaalseid edusamme ja võtta vange võimalike vahetuste jaoks, kuid pidasid Iisraeli armeed 'paberist tiigriks'. Laupäeval algatasid Hamasi võitlejad koordineeritud rünnakud mere-, õhu- ja maateed mööda, mis näisid eksperdi sõnul tabavat Iisraeli luuret ootamatult. David Khalfa, Fondation Jean-Jaurès' Põhja-Aafrika ja Lähis-Ida vaatluskeskusest, ütles France 24-le, et rünnak oli Iisraeli luure jaoks 'ajalooline läbikukkumine'. Bruce Hoffman, terrorismiennetuse ja sisejulgeoleku vanemteadur Välissuhete Nõukogus, ütles NPR-ile: 'Ükski riiklik luureasutus ei ole kõiketeadev ega eksimatu, kuid see on tohutu läbikukkumine.' Iisraelit peetakse üheks arenenuma luurevõrgustikuga riigiks Lähis-Idas, kus võtmeagentuurid ja allikad on seotud sõjaväeliste rühmitustega, teatas BBC julgeolekukorrespondent Frank Gardner. Iisraeli valitsuse allikad teatasid Gardnerile, et ulatuslik uurimine luure ebaõnnestumiste põhjuste selgitamiseks on käimas, ning üks ametnik nentis, et uurimine võib kesta aastaid. Barakeh ütles AP-le ka, et Hamas on seni kasutanud vaid väikest osa oma jõududest – tema sõnul osales lahingutes ligi 2000 võitlejat umbes 40 000-st Gaza sektoris; neid numbreid ei olnud võimalik iseseisvalt kinnitada. Vahetult pärast rünnakut kuulutas Iisraeli peaminister Benjamin Netanyahu välja 'sõjaseisukorra', märkides eesmärgiks Hamasi likvideerimise. Esmaspäeval kuulutas Iisrael Gaza suhtes välja 'täieliku blokaadi', lubades katkestada regiooni elektri, toidu, vee ja kütuse varustamise.

article_content: Earlier this year, Expensify introduced a luxurious perk at its San Francisco office — a lounge serving fresh cappuccinos, crafted cocktails, and nightly champagne toasts. The space was designed to resemble a blend of upscale airport lounge and co-working environment, and access was offered with Expensify memberships starting at $9 a month. However, the experiment is coming to an end. CEO David Barrett announced in a lengthy blog post that the Expensify Lounge will close on November 1, only six months after opening. Barrett explained that the lounge was an experiment to see if exceptional amenities could entice people back to the office voluntarily. Ultimately, he concluded that even the most attractive office perks couldn’t lure employees away from their favorite coffee shops or the flexibility of remote work. He reflected that forcing employees back was ineffective, writing that the era of 'work from anywhere' has become the new normal and cannot be easily undone. This news comes amid ongoing debate over remote versus in-office work. While Barrett tried to attract workers with incentives, other business leaders take a firmer approach. For example, JPMorgan’s CEO Jamie Dimon once told The Economist he understood long commutes were unpopular but said that didn't mean employees could keep their jobs if they refused to come in. Expensify, based in Portland, Oregon, has embraced remote and hybrid working options for years, even before the pandemic. The company did not respond immediately to requests for comment from reporters.
translated_content: Selle aasta alguses tutvustas Expensify oma San Francisco kontoris luksuslikku lisateenust — salongi, kus pakuti värskelt valmistatud cappuccinosid, käsitöökokteile ja igal õhtul šampanjat. See ruum oli loodud meenutama kõrgetasemelist lennujaama lounge'i ning ühiskontorit; sissepääs oli tagatud Expensify liikmetele alates 9 dollarist kuus. Kuid katse jõuab nüüd lõpule. Tegevjuht David Barrett teatas pikemas blogipostituses, et Expensify Lounge suletakse 1. novembril, vaid kuus kuud pärast avamist. Barrett selgitas, et salong avati katsetusena, et näha, kas erakordsed mugavused suudavad inimesed vabatahtlikult kontorisse tagasi meelitada. Lõpuks jõudis ta järeldusele, et isegi kõige ahvatlevamad kontorihüved ei motiveeri töötajaid loobuma oma lemmikkohvikust ega kaugtöö paindlikkusest. Ta tõdes, et kontorisse tagasi sundimine pole tulemuslik ja 'töö kõikjalt' on nüüd uus normaalsus, mida pole enam lihtne tagasi pöörata. See uudis tuleb ajal, mil kaugtöö ja kontoritöö teemalised arutelud jätkuvad. Kui Barrett proovis töötajaid meelitada hüvedega, siis teised ärijuhid eelistavad rangemat lähenemist. Näiteks JPMorgani juht Jamie Dimon ütles The Economisti intervjuus, et saab aru, miks inimesed ei soovi igapäevaselt poolteist tundi tööle sõita, kuid see ei tähenda, et nad võiksid siiski ettevõttesse tööle jääda, kui kontorisse ei ilmu. Expensify peakorter asub Portlandis, Oregonis ning ettevõte on juba enne pandeemiat toetanud kaugtööd ja hübriidtööviise. Ettevõte ei vastanud reporterite kommentaarisoovile kohe.

article_content: Andrew Ng, a prominent AI expert and cofounder of Google Brain, claims that major technology companies are exaggerating the risks of AI to discourage competition. Google Brain, a deep-learning research team, merged with DeepMind earlier this year. Ng, who is also an adjunct professor at Stanford University and previously taught OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, told The Australian Financial Review that some leading tech firms aim to prompt strict regulations by promoting the 'bad idea that AI could make us go extinct.' "Some major tech companies would prefer not to compete with open source alternatives, so they're fueling fears that AI could lead to human extinction," Ng said. "It's a lobbying tool for legislation that could severely harm the open-source community." In May, AI experts and CEOs—including Sam Altman (OpenAI), Demis Hassabis (DeepMind), and Dario Amodei (Anthropic)—signed a statement from the Center for AI Safety equating AI risks with those from nuclear war and pandemics. Other AI leaders have issued similar warnings, urging rapid regulatory action. Governments around the world are working on AI regulation, citing concerns about safety, potential job losses, and even the threat of human extinction. The European Union is expected to be among the first regions to implement rules around generative AI. Ng warns that framing AI as an existential threat could lead to proposals for licensing AI systems, which risks stifling innovation. He advocates for thoughtful and deliberate AI regulation. Ng did not immediately respond to Insider's request for comment, which was made outside of normal business hours.

Google Brain, süvaõppe uurimisrühm, liitus DeepMindiga varem tänavu. Ng, kes töötab Stanfordi ülikooli dotsendina ning on varem õpetanud OpenAI tegevjuhti Sam Altmani, ütles ajalehele The Australian Financial Review, et mõned juhtivad tehnoloogiafirmad soovivad kehtestada rangeid regulatsioone, levitades „halba ideed, et tehisintellekt võib meid hävitada“. "Mõned suured tehnoloogiaettevõtted eelistavad mitte võistelda avatud lähtekoodiga alternatiividega, nii et nad külvavad hirmu, et tehisintellekt võib viia inimkonna väljasuremiseni," ütles Ng. "See on lobitööriist seadusandluse jaoks, mis võib tõsiselt kahjustada avatud lähtekoodi kogukonda." Mais allkirjastasid tehisintellekti eksperdid ja tegevjuhid - sealhulgas Sam Altman (OpenAI), Demis Hassabis (DeepMind) ja Dario Amodei (Anthropic) - Center for AI Safety avalduse, mis võrdsustas tehisintellekti riskid tuumasõja ja pandeemiatega. Teised tehisintellekti juhid on teinud sarnaseid hoiatusi ning kutsuvad üles kiire küllastada regulatsiooni. Valitsused kogu maailmas töötavad välja tehisintellekti reegleid, tuues välja ohutuse, võimalike töökohtade kadumise ja isegi inimkonna väljasuremise ohud. Eeldatavasti on Euroopa Liit üks esimesi piirkondi, kus rakendatakse regulatsioone generatiivse tehisintellekti kohta. Ng hoiatab, et tehisintellekti kujutamine eksistentsiaalse ohuna võib viia litsentsinõuete ettepanekuteni tehisintellekti süsteemidele, mis võib innovatsiooni pärssida. Ta pooldab läbimõeldud ja kaalutletud regulatsioone. Ng ei vastanud kohe Insideri kommentaaripalvele, mis saadeti väljaspool tööaega.

article_content: New Delhi: The National Investigation Agency (NIA) has charged Gurpatwant Singh Pannun, a designated 'individual terrorist' and US-based member of the banned group Sikhs for Justice (SFJ), under India's anti-terror laws following recent video threats directed at Air India and its passengers. In his video message shared on social media, Pannun threatened a global blockade of the airline and called for the suspension of its operations from November 19. He urged Sikhs to avoid flying Air India, alleging safety risks, and threatened that Air India, now owned by the Tata Group, would not be allowed to operate internationally. Additionally, Pannun warned the Indian government that Indira Gandhi International Airport in Delhi would be closed on November 19 and renamed after Beant Singh and Satwant Singh, the assassins of former Prime Minister Indira Gandhi, if his separatist demands were met. In response to these threats, the NIA announced on Monday that Pannun has been charged under provisions of the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA) of 1967 and the Indian Penal Code for attempting to disrupt India's transportation sector and incite enmity. Security agencies in India, Canada, and other countries have increased vigilance at airports serving Air India, with heightened security and restrictions on visitor entry in Delhi and Punjab. The Ministry of Home Affairs had declared SFJ an ‘unlawful association’ in 2019. Pannun has been under NIA investigation since that year, and in September, authorities confiscated his property in Amritsar and Chandigarh. Officials assert that Pannun has been creating and spreading false narratives about issues in Punjab, particularly regarding the Sikh community, as part of efforts to foment unrest and revive terrorism. An NIA official stated that booking Pannun under UAPA demonstrates India's zero-tolerance policy toward terrorism.

Nende ähvarduste peale teatas NIA esmaspäeval, et Pannunile on esitatud süüdistus India ebaseadusliku tegevuse ennetamise seaduse (UAPA) ja kriminaalkoodeksi alusel, eesmärgiga takistada transpordisektori tööd ja õhutada vaenu. India, Kanada ja teiste riikide julgeolekuasutused on suurendanud valvsust Air India lennujaamades, kehtestades tugevdatud turvameetmed ning piirates külastajate pääsu Delhi ja Punjabi lennujaamades. article_content: Humans have set foot on the moon, but reaching Mars remains a goal for the future. Among the many challenges of sending a crew to Mars, providing food is a crucial issue. Constraints on weight, volume, and shelf life limit the amount and types of food that can be taken on the journey. Emmanuel Mendoza, an undergraduate aerospace engineering student at Texas A&M University, is addressing this challenge by researching how to grow food in simulated Martian soil. His question: What can be done to modify Martian soil to make it more suitable for plant growth? Mendoza is conducting a study where he mixes simulated Martian soil with waste (frass) from black soldier fly larvae, looking for the best combination to support plant growth on Mars. This research idea was inspired by the 2015 film The Martian, where the protagonist survives by growing potatoes on Mars. Budget constraints and data collection needs led Mendoza to choose English peas instead of potatoes. Peas are self-pollinating, grow quickly, and allow for continuous observation as they grow above ground. Simulated Martian soil, known as regolith, is manufactured on Earth based on data from Martian landers. It lacks the organic matter and some essential nutrients—like nitrogen, phosphorus, and sulfur—found in Earth's soil. However, it does include some important minerals. To provide missing nutrients and organic matter, Mendoza adds black soldier fly larvae frass to the simulated soil. This byproduct is a promising organic fertilizer that can enhance plant growth. Mendoza's experiment involves testing different ratios of Martian soil and larvae frass to observe pea plant growth. So far, he has observed growth in all setups, even in 100% simulated Martian soil. He presented his preliminary findings at the Entomological Society of America’s 2023 conference. His pea plants are nearly mature; soon, he will harvest and analyze their pods, compiling his data into a research paper. Mendoza hopes his work will encourage further study in the field. Although his experiment does not address water supply issues on Mars, he notes that this is an important direction for future research. As for traveling to Mars himself, Mendoza says he would love the chance—ideally, not as a stranded astronaut like Mark Watney, but as a contributor to advancing space exploration.
translated_content: Inimesed on astunud Kuu pinnale, kuid Marsini jõudmine on endiselt tuleviku eesmärk. Üks suurimaid väljakutseid Marsile meeskonna saatmisel on toidu varustamine. Kaalu, mahu ja säilivusaja piirangud mõjutavad seda, kui palju ja millist toitu saab kaasa võtta. Emmanuel Mendoza, Texase A&M ülikooli lennundustehnika bakalaureusetudeng, tegeleb selle probleemiga, uurides, kuidas kasvatada toitu simuleeritud Marsi pinnases. Tema küsimus: mida saaks teha Marsi pinnasega, et muuta see taimede kasvuks sobivamaks? Mendoza viib läbi uuringut, kus ta segab simuleeritud Marsi pinnast musta sõdurikärbse vastsete väljaheidetega (frass), et leida parim kooslus taimede kasvatamiseks Marsil. Selle uurimisidee inspireeris 2015. aasta film „Marslane“, mille peategelane kasvatab ellujäämiseks Marsil kartuleid. Eelarvepiirangute ja andmekogumisvajaduste tõttu valis Mendoza kartulite asemel inglise herned. Herned on isetolmlevad, kasvavad kiiresti ning nende kasvamist on lihtne jälgida, kuna need kasvavad maa peal. Simuleeritud Marsi pinnas ehk regoliit valmistatakse Maal Marsilt saadud andmete põhjal. See ei sisalda orgaanilist ainet ega teatud olulisi toitaineid – näiteks lämmastikku, fosforit ja väävlit –, mida leidub Maa pinnases. Küll aga on seal mõned tähtsad mineraalid. Puuduvate toitainete ja orgaanilise aine lisamiseks segab Mendoza pinnasesse musta sõdurikärbse vastsete frassi. See kõrvalprodukt on paljutõotav orgaaniline väetis, mis võib taimede kasvu parandada. Mendoza katsetab erinevaid Marsi pinnase ja frassi suhtarve, et jälgida hernetaimede kasvu. Siiani on ta täheldanud taimede kasvu kõigis variantides, isegi 100% simuleeritud Marsi pinnases. Ta esitles esialgseid tulemusi 2023. aasta Entomoloogia Seltsi konverentsil. Tema hernetaimed on peaaegu küpsed – varsti koristab ta hernekaunad ning kaalub, mõõdab ja analüüsib need, kogudes tulemused uurimistöösse. Mendoza loodab, et tema töö innustab edasisi uuringuid selles valdkonnas. Kuigi tema eksperiment ei käsitle Marsi veevarude küsimust, märgib ta, et see oleks tulevikus oluline uurimissuund. Marsile reisimisest rääkides ütleb Mendoza, et läheks sinna hea meelega – mitte küll mahajäetud astronaudina nagu Mark Watney, vaid panustajana kosmoseuuringute arengusse.

article_content: Ian Kiernan, the 73-year-old founder of Clean Up Australia and a prominent environmentalist, pleaded guilty to a mid-range drink driving charge in Sydney. On July 21, police pulled Kiernan over on Hickson Road in Millers Point and found his blood alcohol level to be 0.09. He admitted the charge at Downing Centre Local Court and is scheduled for sentencing in October. Kiernan first came to prominence in 1989 by organizing Clean Up Sydney Harbour, an event that inspired the creation of Clean Up Australia—a nationwide volunteer initiative held every March. Kiernan’s lifetime achievements include being named Australian of the Year in 1994, being appointed an officer of the Order of Australia, and winning the United Nations Environment Programme Sasakawa Environment Prize in 1998 for mobilizing tens of millions globally.
translated_content: 73-aastane Clean Up Australia asutaja ja tuntud keskkonnakaitsja Ian Kiernan tunnistas Sydney kohtus end süüdi keskmises joobes juhtimises. 21. juulil peatas politsei ta Millers Pointi Hickson Roadil ning tuvastati alkoholitasemeks 0,09. Ta tunnistas süüd Downing Centre'i kohalikus kohtus ning kohtuotsus langetatakse oktoobris. Kiernan sai laiema tuntuse 1989. aastal, kui ta korraldas Clean Up Sydney Harbour'i, millest kasvas välja iga-aastane Austraalia üleriigiline koristuskampaania, mis toimub märtsis ja kaasab sadu tuhandeid vabatahtlikke. Tema panus keskkonnakaitsesse on pälvinud mitmeid tunnustusi: ta nimetati 1994. aastal aasta austraallaseks, sai Austraalia Teenetemärgi ohvitseriks ning 1998. aastal anti talle ÜRO Keskkonnaprogrammi Sasakawa keskkonnapreemia miljonite inimeste mobiliseerimise eest üle maailma.
