article_content: Dominique Strauss-Kahn, the managing director of the International Monetary Fund, is being investigated by New York authorities after a hotel housekeeper accused him of sexual assault. Police say Strauss-Kahn was apprehended from an Air France flight at JFK Airport just before departure, shortly after the incident at the Hotel Sofitel in Times Square. According to reports, a 32-year-old hotel employee entered Strauss-Kahn’s room to clean around 1 p.m. Saturday, where she alleges he tried to force himself on her while unclothed. She managed to escape and informed hotel staff, who immediately notified the police. Strauss-Kahn had already left the hotel when officers arrived, leaving his mobile phone behind. The alleged victim was treated for minor injuries at Roosevelt Hospital. Police, learning of Strauss-Kahn's travel plans, coordinated with Port Authority officials; two detectives intercepted him in first class and removed him from the aircraft without resistance. Currently, Strauss-Kahn is in custody and has not made any statement or responded to police inquiries. No formal charges have been filed as of this report. Hotel Sofitel’s management says they are cooperating fully with the investigation. Strauss-Kahn is a former French finance minister and a major figure in international economics. He was considered a potential leading candidate for France’s 2012 presidential race. In 2008, he admitted to an inappropriate but consensual relationship with an IMF staff member. An independent inquiry found no misconduct, though the IMF board noted a significant error in judgment. Since leading the IMF from 2007, Strauss-Kahn has played a key role in addressing global economic crises and supporting international financial stability. Reporting assistance by Miguel Susana and Ross Levitt.
translated_content: Rahvusvahelise Valuutafondi (IMF) peadirektor Dominique Strauss-Kahn on New Yorgi võimude uurimise all pärast seda, kui hotellitöötaja süüdistas teda seksuaalses rünnakus. Politsei sõnul võeti Strauss-Kahn Air France’i lennukilt maha JFK lennujaamas vahetult enne väljalendu, kohe pärast intsidenti Times Square’il asuvas Sofiteli hotellis. Allikate kohaselt läks 32-aastane hotellitöötaja laupäeval kell 13 Strauss-Kahni tuba koristama, kuid mees üritas väidetavalt teda alasti olles seksuaalselt rünnata. Naine suutis põgeneda ja andis juhtunust teada hotelli personalile, kes kutsus politsei. Politsei kohale jõudes oli Strauss-Kahn hotellist juba lahkunud, jättes maha oma mobiiltelefoni. Väidetav ohver viidi kergete vigastustega Roosevelti haiglasse. Kui politsei sai teada Strauss-Kahni reisiplaanidest, tegid nad koostööd sadamavägede ametnikega; kaks detektiivi pidasid ta esimeses klassis kinni ja eemaldasid lennukist ilma vastupanuta. Hetkel viibib Strauss-Kahn vahistuses ning pole politseile selgitusi andnud ega küsimustele vastanud. Käesoleva raporti kirjutamise hetkeks pole formaalseid süüdistusi esitatud. Sofiteli hotelli juhtkond kinnitab, et teeb uurimisega täielikku koostööd. Strauss-Kahn on endine Prantsusmaa rahandusminister ja rahvusvahelise majanduse võtmeisik. Teda peeti üheks tugevamaks kandidaadiks Prantsusmaa 2012. aasta presidendiks. 2008. aastal tunnistas ta sobimatut, kuid vastastikusel nõusolekul toimunud suhet IMF-i töötajaga. Sõltumatu uurimine ei tuvastanud väärkäitumist, kuigi IMF-i juhatus pidas tegu tõsiseks eetiliseks veaks. IMF-i juhina alates 2007. aastast on Strauss-Kahn olnud olulisel kohal ülemaailmsete majanduskriiside lahendamisel ja rahvusvahelise finantsstabiilsuse tagamisel. Kaasa aitasid Miguel Susana ja Ross Levitt.

Jack Ma, the co-founder of Alibaba and a leading figure in China's tech industry, is now turning his attention to the food business. On Wednesday, Ma registered a company named 'Hangzhou Ma's Kitchen Food' in Hangzhou, the city that serves as Alibaba's headquarters and also Ma's hometown, according to media reports. The company's registered capital is 10 million Chinese yuan (approximately $1.4 million), as reported by the Alibaba-owned South China Morning Post, referencing the official National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System.

Hangzhou Ma’s Kitchen Food is fully owned by Ma’s investment arm, Hangzhou Dajingtou No 22 Arts and Culture. The new enterprise will be involved in the sales of pre-packaged foods, as well as the processing and retail of agricultural products, according to the South China Morning Post.

Ma’s growing interest in agriculture began after the Chinese government’s crackdown on his businesses in 2020, which started following a speech Ma made criticizing China’s financial regulatory system. Since then, Ma—well known for his outspoken and flamboyant style—has maintained a low profile for two years and has made only rare public appearances. During this period, he has traveled globally to study agricultural technology, visiting Spain, the Netherlands, Japan, and Thailand to learn about agrotech and sustainable practices.

In October 2021, Ma was in Spain to study agriculture and environmental technology. In May, Tokyo College announced Ma would join as a teacher and researcher focusing on sustainable agriculture and food production. In January, Ma visited Thailand, where he had dinner with Supakit Chearavanont, the chairman of Charoen Pokphand Group, a major animal feed producer.

Ma retired from Alibaba in 2019. The Jack Ma Foundation did not immediately respond to a request for comment from Business Insider.

Correction: November 27, 2023 – An earlier version of this story stated that the registered capital of Hangzhou Ma's Kitchen Food was $1.4 billion. The correct amount is $1.4 million.

article_content: NASA recently apologized for a post on X (formerly Twitter) that questioned whether people could ever visit Jupiter. In the post, NASA wrote: “Is visiting Jupiter on your bucket list? Let’s face facts, it’s not going to happen.” The agency then encouraged space enthusiasts to submit their names to be carried aboard the upcoming Europa Clipper mission, set to launch in October 2024 and destined to study Jupiter’s icy moon, Europa. While NASA intended to promote engagement, some reactions to the post were negative. Nathan Commissariat, an engineering intern at SpaceX, commented on X, “NASA really out here telling kids to stop dreaming and instead engrave their name on a tiny plate,” and others accused NASA of discouraging big dreams and explorers. Two days later, NASA issued an apology on X: “Hey, folks—we goofed up. We want to be clear: we’re always reaching for the stars (and planets and moons), and we want what we do to inspire you to do the same. Never stop dreaming.” The agency included a face-palming astronaut gif to underscore its regret. In reality, traveling to Jupiter is not possible with current or near-future technology. Human spaceflight ambitions are substantial, but they must be grounded in scientific understanding and technological reality. SpaceX affiliates were among those to criticize NASA’s statement, which aligns with Elon Musk’s well-known passion for colonizing other worlds. To date, humans have not landed on any other planet. NASA plans to send astronauts to Mars in the 2030s, a much closer and more Earth-like destination than Jupiter. Jupiter is about 385 million miles (611 million kilometers) from Earth, has no solid surface, and emits high levels of radiation, making it an impossible destination for human landing. Europa, one of Jupiter’s moons, is considered a more plausible target for future exploration due to its potential to support microbial life. However, such missions would require significant technological advances and are many years away. For now, the Europa Clipper is scheduled to reach Jupiter’s orbit in 2030, where it will conduct about 50 close flybys of Europa to study its astrobiological potential. For more spaceflight news, follow us on X and bookmark Gizmodo’s dedicated Spaceflight page.

Olgem ausad, see ei juhtu.” Seejärel kutsus agentuur kosmosehuvilisi üles saatma oma nimesid eelolevale Europa Clipperi missioonile, mis stardib oktoobris 2024 ja uurib Jupiteri jäist kuud Europat. Kuigi NASA soovis inimesi kaasata, olid mõned reaktsioonid postitusele eitavad. Suured inimkonna kosmoseunistused peavad siiski põhinema teaduslikul arusaamal ja tehnika võimalustel. SpaceX-i töötajad olid nende seas, kes NASA avaldust kritiseerisid, mis langeb kokku Elon Muski tuntud sooviga teisi planeete asustada. Tänaseni pole inimesed ühelgi teisel planeedil maandunud. NASA plaanib saata astronaute Marsile 2030. aastatel, mis on Jupiterist palju lähemal ning sarnasem Maale. Jupiter asub Maast umbes 385 miljoni miili (611 miljoni kilomeetri) kaugusel, seal puudub tahke pind ja radiatsioonitase on väga kõrge, mistõttu on inimmaandumine seal võimatu. Kuid sellised missioonid nõuavad suuri tehnoloogilisi edusamme ja jäävad veel kaugesse tulevikku. Praegu jõuab Europa Clipper Jupiteri orbiidile 2030. aastal ja sooritab umbes 50 lähedast ülelendu Europast, et uurida selle ookeanimaailma astrobioloogilist potentsiaali. Rohkem infi kosmoselennu kohta leiad meie lehelt X-is ja kingi Gizmodo spetsiaalsele Spaceflight-lehele järjehoidja.

article_content: During the 2012 U.S. presidential election, voters across several states experienced lengthy wait times at the polls, especially in Florida and areas severely affected by Superstorm Sandy such as New York and New Jersey. In Florida, while polling was scheduled to end at 7pm, large crowds prompted many locations to remain open as state law allowed anyone in line at closing time to vote. The delays were mainly due to a record turnout and a lengthy ballot. Reports indicated about 70% of Florida precincts stayed open late to accommodate all waiting voters. Virginia faced similar issues; state election officials noted that results would be delayed in localities with extended lines. Social media buzzed with the hashtag #stayinline, motivating voters not to give up. Many Americans waited hours to participate, with younger voters often sharing their experiences and ballot photos online—acts that were prohibited in several states. In some storm-impacted districts, voters made do without electricity, sometimes using their phones as flashlights in dark polling stations. To assist those affected, free shuttles were provided in areas like Coney Island. Despite these challenges, turnout was high nationwide. Early polling suggested significant Latino voter participation compared to previous years, with President Obama being especially favored by that group. However, not everyone managed to vote. Some, particularly in places like Hoboken, New Jersey, were prevented by storm-related circumstances. Across the nation, more than 32 million individuals voted early, with early voting numbers rising compared to earlier elections. Social media played a key role, with millions sharing their voting experiences online. Facebook tracked over 6 million users discussing the election, and Instagram hosted hundreds of thousands of ballot images, despite legal prohibitions in certain locations. In some cases, voters faced consequences for posting their ballots. The election atmosphere was a mix of determination and frustration, as citizens lined up for hours to cast their votes against the backdrop of a closely fought national race and, for many, ongoing recovery from a natural disaster.

Floridas lubati valimiskohtadesse jääda kõigil, kes olid kell 19.00 järjekorras ning rahvamasside tõttu jäid mitmed jaoskonnad avatuks ka pärast ametlikku sulgemist. Viivitused tulenesid peamiselt rekordilisest osalusest ja pikast valimissedelihulgast. Ligikaudu 70% Florida jaoskondadest olid avatud ka pärast ametlikku sulgemist, et kõik ootajad saaksid hääletada. Virginias esines samuti sarnaseid probleeme – valimisametnikud hoiatasid tulemuste hilinemise eest piirkondades, kus järjekorrad kestsid tunde. Sotsiaalmeedias levis märksõna #stayinline, mis julgustas valijaid ootama lõpuni. Paljud ameeriklased ootasid hääletamiseks mitmeid tunde, nooremad jagasid sageli kogemusi ja valimissedeli fotosid internetis – kuigi see oli mitmes osariigis keelatud. Tormi kahjustatud piirkondades tuli valimistel hakkama saada elektrita ning valijad kasutasid hääletamiseks taskulampide või telefonide valgust. Coney Islandil võimaldati elanikele tasuta hääletusbussid. Vaatamata raskustele oli valimisaktiivsus kõrge üle kogu riigi. Eelhääletustel osales märkimisväärselt rohkem latiinotaustaga valijaid kui varem ning president Obama oli nende seas väga populaarne. Kõigil siiski hääletada ei õnnestunud. Rängalt kannatanud kohtades, nagu Hoboken, takistasid ilmaolud või tormikahjustused paljusid hääletamast. Üle riigi oli üle 32 miljoni inimese, kes kasutasid varajast hääletust – see arv kasvas võrreldes varasemate valimistega. Sotsiaalmeedial oli valimistel suur roll, miljonid jagasid seal oma kogemusi. Facebookis avaldati valimistest üle 6 miljoni postituse, Instagrami laaditi üles sadu tuhandeid valimissedelite fotosid, ehkki see oli paljudes kohtades seadusega keelatud. Mõned valijad said selle eest ka karistada. Valimispäeva õhkkonnas põimusid sihikindlus ja frustratsioon: inimesed seisid tunde järjekorras, tihti külmas või pimedas, et oma hääl anda – seda kõike tiheda presidendivalimisvõistluse ja jätkuva orkaanijärgse taastumise taustal.

article_content: CNN.com recently hosted an informal poll, pitting Portland, Oregon, against Seattle, Washington, in a friendly city rivalry. While Seattle is the larger city, Portland emerged the winner by a narrow margin, capturing 52% of the votes. Despite the close results, Portland’s supporters participated with remarkable enthusiasm. They highlighted many advantages, including more park space, an effective mass transit system, a vibrant bicycling culture, and close proximity to both renowned skiing areas and wine regions. Many Portlanders also praised the city’s favorable weather, its diverse food cart scene, and lively events such as the Portland Saturday Market and Last Thursday street fair. Notable brunch spots and coffee houses like Sanborn’s, Genies Cafe, Zell’s Cafe, Stumptown Coffee Roasters, and Sisters Coffee Company were also celebrated. On the other hand, Seattle’s fans pointed to the city’s stunning natural beauty, the iconic ferry system, and landmark attractions like the Space Needle and Pike Place Market. Suggestions for visitors included enjoying a meal at SkyCity, taking an Argosy Cruises tour, and exploring neighborhoods such as Bainbridge Island and Bremerton. Seattle’s Green Lake Park, EMP Museum, and Pacific Science Center were also recommended. The article features comments from individuals with connections to both cities, reflecting a mix of perspectives and fond memories. While each city’s supporters highlighted distinctive strengths, the comparison ultimately remains subjective. CNN.com’s poll reflects engaged reader opinions rather than objective metrics. Readers are encouraged to share their own recommendations and stories about both cities in the comments section.

article_content: Two people were killed and 17 others injured, including children, after a rally car crashed into a crowd of spectators in southern France on Saturday afternoon. The incident occurred during the Var Rally in Plan-de-la-Tour, near Toulon on the Mediterranean coast. According to reports, the driver failed to turn right at an intersection as required, instead going straight and ploughing into bystanders. One of those killed was reportedly a rally marshall. A witness said the car struck the first row of spectators before veering off and hitting others. Around 50 rescue workers were deployed to the scene, and some victims were rushed to local hospitals. The Var Rally is not one of France’s major road races, but like others in the country, drivers face the challenge of navigating high-speed, narrow rural roads with many spectators nearby. Plan-de-la-Tour gained international attention some years ago when American actor Johnny Depp and singer Vanessa Paradis purchased a house there.

Õnnetus juhtus Var Rally ajal Plan-de-la-Tour'is, mis asub Vahemere rannikul Touloni lähedal. Teatete kohaselt ei pööranud juht ristmikul paremale, nagu ette nähtud, vaid sõitis otse edasi ja sõitis pealtvaatajatesse. Üks hukkunutest oli väidetavalt rallimarssal. Tunnistaja sõnul tabas auto esmalt esimest rida pealtvaatajaid ning seejärel paiskus edasi ja vigastas teisi. Umbes 50 päästjat saadeti sündmuskohale ning osa kannatanutest toimetati kohalikesse haiglatesse. Var Rally ei kuulu Prantsusmaa suurimate autovõistluste hulka, kuid nagu teistelgi, peavad juhid kitsastel ja kiiretel maateedel sõitma, pealtvaatajad sageli lähedal tee ääres. article_content: Nigeria has faced huge financial losses from natural gas flaring, estimated at around $16 trillion between 2012 and 2022, based on the Energy Institute’s 2023 World Energy report. During this time, oil and gas companies in Nigeria burned a total of approximately 86.5 billion cubic metres of gas, starting at a high of 12.9 billion in 2012 and falling to 5.3 billion by 2022. Each billion cubic metres of flared gas could have generated about $183 million, underlining both the economic drain and lost opportunities. Throughout the decade, agencies such as the Nigerian Upstream Petroleum Regulatory Commission and NOSDRA have levied fines to cut down on flaring—oil companies were penalized $25.3 million in July alone. To tackle the issue, the Nigerian government has pledged to hit zero gas emissions by 2060, although this extends beyond the UN’s 2050 target. The state has also granted licenses to 42 companies for commercialising flared gas under a 2022 initiative, distributing flare sites to convert wasted gas into revenue. The goal is to attract investment and develop a more transparent market for gas use. Engr Gbenga Komolafe, the head of Nigeria’s upstream petroleum regulatory body, condemned gas flaring for wasting resources and causing environmental and health risks. The government continues to prioritize strict enforcement, commercialisation projects, and oversight to address both economic loss and ecological harm from gas flaring.
translated_content: Nigeeria on maagaasi põletamise tõttu viimase kümne aasta jooksul kaotanud tohutult – hinnanguliselt umbes 16 triljonit dollarit, tuginedes Energy Institute’i 2023. aasta Maailma Energia aruandele. Aastatel 2012–2022 põletati Nigeeria nafta- ja gaasisektoris kokku ligikaudu 86,5 miljardit kuupmeetrit maagaasi, tase kahanes 2012. aasta 12,9 miljardilt 2022. aastaks 5,3 miljardi kuupmeetrini. Iga miljardi kuupmeetri eest oleks riik võinud teenida ligi 183 miljonit dollarit, mis viitab selgele majanduslikule kahjule ja kasutamata võimalustele. Selle kümnendi jooksul on järelevalveasutused, näiteks Nigeeria Ülemvoodluse Naftareguleerimiskomisjon ja NOSDRA, määranud trahve põletamise piiramise eesmärgil – ainuüksi juulis trahviti naftafirmasid 25,3 miljoni dollariga. Nii soovitakse tuua investeeringuid ja luua läbipaistvam gaasiturg. Nigeeria naftatööstuse järelevalve juht Engr Gbenga Komolafe taunis maagaasi põletamist, nimetades seda ressursi raiskamiseks ning tõsiseks keskkonna- ja terviseriskiks. Valitsus hoiab fookust rangetel meetmetel, kommertsialiseerimisel ja järelevalvel, et kahandada majanduslikku ja ökoloogilist kahju, mida maagaasi põletamine põhjustab.

article_content: Yiaga Africa, a prominent international human rights organization, announced on Saturday that it will deploy a high-level election study mission to observe Liberia's 2023 general elections. This initiative follows Yiaga Africa’s official accreditation by the National Elections Commission of Liberia. According to a statement from Monrovia by Yiaga Africa’s Executive Director, Samson Itodo, the mission is part of its 'Transforming Electoral Governance in Africa' initiative. The project seeks to advance electoral governance across the continent through evidence-based research, documentation, and advocacy. Under this initiative, Yiaga Africa will conduct policy discussions, study missions, and participatory action research focusing on elections and electoral reforms. The Liberia mission will be led by Dr. Aisha Abdullahi, a former Commissioner for Political Affairs at the African Union Commission and former Nigerian Ambassador to Guinea, who also serves on the Yiaga Africa board. The study team includes: Senator Sharafadeen Alli, Chair of Nigeria’s Senate Committee on Independent National Electoral Commission; Prince Bayo Balogun, Chairman of the House of Representatives Committee on Electoral Matters; Dr. Asmau Maikudi, former INEC Resident Electoral Commissioner; Toyin Akinniyi, Vice President, Africa at Luminate; Ezenwa Nwagwu, Chair of Partners for Electoral Reform and Yiaga Africa board member; and Francis Madugu, Deputy Country Director of National Democratic Institute Nigeria. Other members are Maupe Ogun-Yusuf, broadcast journalist at Channels Television; Esrom Ajanya, Project Coordinator at The Kukah Centre; Olusegun Ogundare, Africa Head of Operations and Research at Yiaga Africa; Ibrahim Faruk, Africa Programme Coordinator; and Samson Itodo, Executive Director of Yiaga Africa. The delegation will engage key electoral stakeholders focusing on areas such as election management, the use of electoral technology, election results management, and citizen participation. At the conclusion of the election, the mission will release a report presenting its findings and recommendations to stakeholders in Liberia and Nigeria, aimed at furthering reforms and transforming electoral governance in Africa.

article_content:
World Rugby has announced that there is insufficient evidence to support England flanker Tom Curry’s accusation that South Africa hooker Bongi Mbonambi racially abused him during the Rugby World Cup semifinal. As a result, Mbonambi has been cleared to play in the final against New Zealand in Paris this Saturday. The incident was investigated after Curry made the allegation in the first half of last weekend’s semifinal, which South Africa won 16-15.

World Rugby also reviewed a similar incident from a match between the two teams in London last year. In a statement issued Thursday, the governing body emphasized that all discrimination allegations are taken extremely seriously, but concluded that, after reviewing match footage, audio, and testimony from both teams, there is not enough evidence to proceed with charges at this time. The matter will remain closed unless new evidence arises.

World Rugby stressed that Curry made his allegation in good faith and clarified there is no indication it was deliberately false or malicious. 

England’s Rugby Football Union (RFU) said in a statement that it was "deeply disappointed" with the decision not to hold a formal hearing. The RFU argued that not presenting the evidence to an Independent Disciplinary Panel prevented Curry from sharing his full account and the disciplinary process from independently analyzing the case. The RFU also claimed Curry, 25, experienced the same abuse from Mbonambi during the Springboks’ 27-13 win over England at Twickenham last November.

Since making the allegation, Curry has faced significant online abuse. World Rugby expressed concern about the social media hostility directed at both players, stressing that there is no place in rugby—or society—for discrimination, abuse, or hate speech. It encouraged fans to uphold the sport’s core values of respect, integrity, and solidarity.

Springbok captain Siya Kolisi shared that he has reached out to Curry about the situation. Kolisi noted that while players can often manage personal criticism, it is much more challenging when abuse is directed at their families, expressing his support and hoping the abuse stops.

article_content: A new cash-for-questions scandal erupted when Conservative MP Patrick Mercer was caught in a sting operation. Mercer resigned the Conservative whip after it was revealed he had accepted £4,000 to ask Parliamentary questions and lobby on behalf of Fiji. Photos allegedly show him signing a contract with a fake lobbying company created by journalists. The BBC’s Panorama program filmed Mercer meeting undercover reporters posing as lobbyists. Mercer was recorded signing the contract, stating: 'Let's sign this, with pleasure.' He announced he would refer himself to the Parliamentary Commissioner for Standards and would not stand for re-election. Several other politicians may also be involved. Mercer is accused of failing to declare the £4,000 payment in the register of interests, as required by Commons rules. The BBC Panorama team and a national newspaper approached him as representatives of a fake company, Alistair Andrews Communications, lobbying for Fiji. Fiji was suspended from the Commonwealth in 2006 after a military coup. Mercer has previously spoken on behalf of Fijians in the British Army. David Cameron faces calls to introduce a right of recall to let voters remove MPs between elections and to set up a register of lobbyists. Other MPs and campaigners, including Matthew Sinclair of the TaxPayers’ Alliance and Douglas Carswell, urged swift action. Mercer signed a contract for £2,000 a month and submitted five Parliamentary questions about Fiji, all of which were answered, but did not declare his interest. He also proposed an Early Day Motion supporting Fiji's readmission to the Commonwealth. The scandal has been compared to the 1990s cash-for-questions affair, which hurt the Conservative Party's reputation. Jon Trickett of Labour called for immediate steps to create a statutory register of lobbyists. Mercer said he resigned the whip to spare his party further embarrassment. The BBC has contacted other MPs and peers with similar allegations. Mercer, a former Army officer, has been an outspoken critic of Prime Minister David Cameron since being removed as homeland security spokesman in 2007. If Mercer resigns as MP, a by-election could take place, potentially benefiting the UK Independence Party. Critics questioned Mercer's decision to resign from his party but not from Parliament. Mercer's friends say he did not submit Parliamentary questions exactly as directed and refused to alter reports dishonestly. Mercer stated he is taking legal advice about the allegations. David Cameron was made aware of the situation while on holiday; his spokesman said Mercer did the right thing by referring himself to the Parliamentary Commissioner and resigning the whip.

Fotodel on väidetavalt näha, kuidas ta kirjutab alla ajakirjanike loodud võltsitud lobifirma lepingule. BBC Panorama saade filmis Mercerit kohtumas varjatult ajakirjanikega, kes esinesid lobistidena. Võimalik, et skandaali on kaasatud ka teisi poliitikuid. Mercerit süüdistatakse selles, et ta ei deklareerinud 4000-naelast makset, mis on parlamendi reeglite kohaselt kohustuslik. BBC Panorama meeskond ja riiklik ajaleht lähenesid talle, esitades end kui võltsfirma – Alistair Andrews Communications – esindajad, kes lobistasid Fidži nimel. Fidži eemaldati Rahvaste Ühendusest 2006. aastal pärast sõjalist riigipööret. Mercer on varem rääkinud Briti armees teenivate fidžilaste kaitseks. David Cameronile avaldatakse survet kehtestada seadus, mis võimaldaks valijatel saadikuid ametist tagasi kutsuda, ning luua lobistide register. Teised parlamendiliikmed ja aktivistid nagu Matthew Sinclair (TaxPayers’ Alliance) ja Douglas Carswell nõuavad kiireid tegusid. Mercer allkirjastas 2000-naelase kuupalgaga lepingu ning esitas viis Fidžiga seotud parlamendiküsimust, kuid ei deklareerinud huvi. Ta algatas ka varajase päeva ettepaneku Fidži taasliitmiseks Rahvaste Ühendusega. Skandaali võrreldakse 1990ndate 'küsimuste eest raha' afääriga, mis kahjustas konservatiivide mainet. Leiborist Jon Trickett nõuab viivitamatut lobistide seadusliku registri loomist. Mercer ütles, et astus tagasi, et säästa erakonda edasisest piinlikkusest. BBC on pöördunud ka teiste parlamendiliikmete ja lordide poole sarnaste süüdistustega. Mercer, endine armeeohvitser, on olnud peaminister David Cameroni kõvahäälne kriitik pärast seda, kui ta 2007. aastal sisejulgeoleku esindaja kohalt tagandati. Kui Mercer taandub parlamendist, võib toimuda erakorraline valimine, mis võib kasu tuua Suurbritannia Iseseisvusparteile. Kriitikud küsivad, miks Mercer lahkus erakonnast, kuid mitte parlamendist. Merceri tuttavad ütlevad, et ta ei esitanud küsimusi täpselt nii, nagu talt paluti, ja keeldus raportite võltsimisest. Mercer ütles, et konsulteerib nende süüdistuste osas juristidega. David Cameroni informeeriti olukorrast tema puhkusel olles; pressiesindaja sõnul tegi Mercer õige, suunates end uurimisele ja astudes tagasi.

article_content: NEW DELHI: Despite suffering from severe cramps, star all-rounder Glenn Maxwell delivered an extraordinary unbeaten double century, scoring 201 runs from 128 balls, to lead Australia to a thrilling three-wicket victory over Afghanistan at Mumbai's Wankhede Stadium on Tuesday. Maxwell's remarkable performance propelled the five-time champions, Australia, into the ICC World Cup 2023 semi-finals. Maxwell's innings featured 21 fours and 10 sixes. After the match, he posted a heartfelt message on X (formerly Twitter): 'Pretty overwhelmed with all the love. Thank you so much to everyone that has sent messages. Pat Cummins was amazing out there! Sorry I knocked back a couple. Time to get back to dad duties.' In September, Maxwell and his wife, Vini Raman, welcomed their son, Logan Maverick Maxwell. Maxwell became Australia's first double-century scorer in ODI matches and the first player ever to reach 200 runs in an ODI chase. He is also only the third player to score 200 in a World Cup, following Chris Gayle's 219 against Zimbabwe in 2015, and Martin Guptill's 237 not out against West Indies the same year. Australia is now the third team, after India and South Africa, to qualify for the semi-finals. The team will next face Bangladesh on November 11 in Pune.

Maxwelli erakordne esitus viis viiekordsed meistrid Austraalia ICC maailmakarika 2023 poolfinaali. Maxwelli löögis oli 21 neljast ja 10 kuuest. Pärast mängu postitas ta X-i (endine Twitter) südantsoojendava sõnumi: 'Olen tõesti liigutatud kogu selle armastuse üle. Aitäh kõigile, kes on sõnumeid saatnud. Pat Cummins oli väljakul suurepärane! Vabandan, et paar pakkumist tagasi lükkasin. Aeg naasta isakohustuste juurde.' Septembris tervitasid Maxwell ja tema abikaasa Vini Raman poega, kelle nimeks pandi Logan Maverick Maxwell. Austraalia on nüüd kolmas meeskond, kes pärast Indiat ja Lõuna-Aafrikat poolfinaali pääsenud. Järgmine mäng toimub Bangladeshiga 11. novembril Punes.

article_content: United Airlines is reportedly considering using its extensive passenger data to help advertisers target customers more effectively, according to The Wall Street Journal. Sources familiar with the matter told the Journal that personalized ads could be displayed on seatback screens aboard United aircraft or through its mobile app, allowing the airline to capitalize on its customer information. As seen in a presentation reviewed by the WSJ, an entertainment company could use United’s data to recommend one of its movies to travelers. For example, a passenger might receive an ad based on their frequent vacation spots near that brand’s theme parks, or a recent purchase of branded merchandise with United miles. Though United has not yet committed to this targeted advertising initiative, sources said the company is aware of potential customer backlash over the use of personal information and is planning a careful rollout if the project moves forward. Thanks to privacy regulations, United customers would also have the option to opt out of data sharing for advertising purposes. United is not alone in exploring such models. In May 2022, Marriott launched a “retail media” network, using data from its 164 million Marriott Bonvoy loyalty members to suggest relevant products and services throughout their travels. Ads may appear on hotel TVs, within Marriott’s app, or via email campaigns. According to software firm Clearcode, 'retail media' involves brands using data from their core business—such as travel—and promoting products on their own digital platforms. The sector is experiencing rapid growth. Insider Intelligence estimates that U.S. companies will spend $55 billion on such ads in 2024, with spending projected to reach $85 billion by 2026.
translated_content: Väidetavalt kaalub United Airlines oma ulatusliku reisijate andmete kasutamist, et aidata reklaamijatel kliente tõhusamalt sihtida, kirjutas The Wall Street Journal. Olukorraga kursis olevate allikate sõnul võivad isikupärastatud reklaamid ilmuda Unitedi lennukite seljatoe ekraanidele või mobiilirakendusse, võimaldades lennufirmal klientide infot paremini ära kasutada. WSJ poolt vaadatud esitluse kohaselt võiks meelelahutusettevõte kasutada Unitedi andmeid, et soovitada reisijale mõnd oma filmi. Näiteks võib reisija näha reklaami vastavalt sellele, kui sageli ta puhkab selle ettevõtte lõbustusparkide lähedal või kui ta on hiljuti Unitedi miile kasutades kaubamärgi kaupa ostnud. Kuigi United ei ole sihitud reklaamide projektis veel lõplikku otsust langetanud, kinnitavad allikad, et ettevõte on teadlik andmekasutusest tingitud võimalikust klientide pahameelest ning plaanib projekti käivitamisel olla ettevaatlik. Tänu andmekaitse regulatsioonidele saavad Unitedi kliendid soovi korral keelduda andmete jagamisest reklaamimiseks. United ei ole ainus, kes sellist mudelit uurib. 2022. aasta mais käivitas Marriott „jaemedia“ võrgu, kasutades oma 164 miljoni Marriott Bonvoy lojaalsusliikme andmeid, et pakkuda reisi jooksul personaalseid toote- ja teenusesoovitusi. Reklaamid kuvatakse nii hotelli telerites, Marriotti rakenduses kui ka e-kirjades. Tarkvarafirma Clearcode hinnangul tähendab „jaemedia“, et ettevõtted kasutavad põhitegevusest kogutud andmeid ning reklaamivad oma tooteid omaenda digitaalsetes kanalites. Tööstus kasvab kiirelt. Insider Intelligence prognoosib, et USA firmad kulutavad sellistele reklaamidele 2024. aastal 55 miljardit dollarit ning 2026. aastaks võib summa ulatuda 85 miljardi dollarini.

article_content: Facebook has rolled out a new 'Privacy Checkup' feature, which will soon appear for users when they log in. This handy tool guides users through the process of managing who can view their posts and what information they share on the platform. With guidance from a friendly blue dinosaur character, users are led through three essential privacy settings: selecting who can see future posts, checking apps connected to Facebook, and updating visible profile information. Facebook representative Paddy Underwood stated in a blog post that the company aims to give users clear control over their personal data. This move addresses persistent concerns about how Facebook handles user data, especially amid lawsuits and ongoing scrutiny from regulators over data protection and marketing practices. Facebook has committed to external audits as part of its efforts to improve trust. The company has also come under fire for forcing users to adopt its Messenger app, which asks for extensive device permissions such as access to contacts, phone calls, messages, and files—prompting privacy worries. Moreover, Facebook’s autoplay video feature has contributed to unexpectedly high mobile data expenses for some users, as videos in the news feed play automatically unless settings are changed. The consumer website MoneySavingExpert.com reported that numerous users noticed a spike in data usage, with many confirming that turning off autoplay helped them avoid exceeding their data limits.
translated_content: Facebook on kasutusele võtnud uue funktsiooni nimega 'Privaatsuse Kontroll', mis ilmub lähiajal kasutajatele sisse logides. See lihtne tööriist aitab kasutajatel hõlpsasti hallata, kes nende postitusi näevad ja millist infot nad platvormil jagavad. Sõbralik sinine dinosauruse tegelane juhendab läbi kolme olulise privaatsusseadistuse: tulevaste postituste nähtavuse valimine, Facebookiga seotud rakenduste kontrollimine ning profiilil kuvatava teabe uuendamine. Facebooki esindaja Paddy Underwood märkis blogipostituses, et ettevõte soovib anda kasutajatele parema kontrolli oma isikuandmete üle. article_content: The U.S. government has warned about a new security flaw in iPhones and iPads that could allow hackers to steal sensitive data. Cybersecurity firm FireEye identified this vulnerability, called 'Masque Attack,' which lets hackers trick users into installing malicious apps via deceptive texts, emails, or website links. Exploitation depends on users installing an untrusted app. FireEye notes that through this attack, criminals can steal banking credentials and email passwords. To avoid this risk, they recommend three steps: install apps only from Apple's official App Store or your organization; never approve app installations from pop-ups on third-party websites; and remove any app immediately if you see an 'Untrusted App Developer' warning. The National Cybersecurity and Communications Integration Center and U.S. Computer Emergency Readiness Teams issued additional guidance, echoing FireEye’s warnings. The vulnerability has already been used in the 'WireLurker' campaign, and more attacks may follow. Through Masque Attack, hackers can replace genuine apps with harmful versions, potentially accessing your data or spying on your device. Sticking to trusted app sources and avoiding pop-up installations helps avoid these threats. According to FireEye, Masque Attack takes over legitimate apps, including those for banking or email, by exploiting this vulnerability. Tao Wei, a senior FireEye researcher, called the flaw both serious and easy to exploit. FireEye informed Apple about the bug in July, and Apple is working on a fix. Apple responded by saying that iOS and OS X include security measures to warn users before installing potentially dangerous apps. The company reports no known incidents of customer data being compromised by this attack so far. Apple continues to advise downloading only from trusted sources and paying attention to security alerts. Enterprise users should install custom apps via secure company websites. More details are available on Apple’s support site. The vulnerability was publicized on security forums in October, according to FireEye. WireLurker—a new malware—infects Macs first, then transfers itself to iOS devices connected to infected computers, automatically installing malicious apps. Experts warn that WireLurker uses various methods to make all iOS devices at risk and urge users to get apps only from the official App Store and maintain up-to-date software. FireEye aired its findings after Palo Alto Networks traced the first exploitation of the flaw via WireLurker. So far, no other attacks have been documented, but researchers expect more cases. The vulnerability was confirmed on multiple iOS versions, both with and without jailbreaking. In a test, FireEye replaced the Gmail app with a fake game app to demonstrate how the flaw can let hackers substitute trusted apps if users don’t follow security guidelines.

Küberjulgeolekufirma FireEye tuvastas selle haavatavuse, nimega 'Masque Attack', mis võimaldab häkkeritel veenda kasutajaid pahatahtlikke rakendusi alla laadima petlike sõnumite, e-kirjade või veebilingi kaudu. Need rünnakud õnnestuvad ainult siis, kui kasutaja installeerib usaldamatu rakenduse. FireEye sõnul võivad selliste rünnakutega häkkerid varastada näiteks pangakontode või e-posti paroole. Nende vältimiseks soovitatakse kolme kriitilist sammu: laadi rakendusi ainult Apple'i ametlikust App Store’ist või oma organisatsiooni kaudu; ära kunagi kiida heaks äpi paigaldust kolmanda osapoole veebisaidi hüpikaknast; ja kui seadmes kuvatakse hoiatus 'Untrusted App Developer', siis kustuta rakendus kohe. Rahvuslik Küberjulgeoleku ja Kommunikatsiooni Integratsiooni Keskus ning USA arvutite hädaolukordade meeskond avaldasid täiendavaid juhiseid, korrates FireEye hoiatusi. Seda haavatavust on juba kasutatud rünnakutes nimega WireLurker ning tulevikus võib olla rohkem sarnaseid juhtumeid. Masque Attacki kaudu võivad häkkerid asendada tõelised rakendused pahavaraga, saades seeläbi juurdepääsu teie andmetele või jälgides seadme tegevust. Selliste rünnakute vältimiseks tasub rakendusi laadida vaid usaldusväärsetest allikatest ja vältida veebipõhistest hüpikutest appide paigaldust. FireEye hinnangul võimaldab Masque Attack häkkeritel üle võtta ka olulised äpid (nt panga- või e-posti rakendused), kasutades ära seda haavatavust. FireEye vanemteadur Tao Wei nimetas probleemi tõsiseks ja lihtsasti ärakasutatavaks. FireEye andis Apple’ile haavatavusest teada juba juulis ja Apple töötab paranduse kallal. Apple'i ametlikus vastuses öeldakse, et iOS ja OS X sisaldavad mitmeid turvameetmeid, mis hoiavad kasutajaid ohtlike äppide eest. Praegu pole teadaolevaid juhtumeid, kus kasutajaid oleks sel viisil rünnatud. Apple rõhutab jätkuvalt, et äppe tuleks laadida vaid App Store’ist ning oluline on tähele panna turvahoiatusi. Ettevõtted peaksid ettevõttesiseseid rakendusi installima vaid turvaliste kanalite kaudu. Lisainfot leiab Apple'i tugilehelt. FireEye sõnul avalikustati see haavatavus esimest korda oktoobris turvalisusfoorumites. WireLurker on uus pahavara, mis nakatab esmalt Mac’i, seejärel kandub USB kaudu ühendatud iOS seadmetesse ja installeerib sinna pahatahtlikud rakendused. Eksperdid hoiatavad, et WireLurker kasutab mitmeid meetodeid ja seab ohtu kõik iOS seadmed; ohutuks tuleb rakendusi laadida vaid ametlikust App Store’ist ja hoida tarkvara uuena. FireEye avalikustas oma leiud pärast seda, kui Palo Alto Networks uuris esimest WireLurkeri juhtumit. Praegu pole muid teadaolevaid rünnakuid, kuid teadlased arvavad, et neid võib juurde tulla. Haavatavust kinnitati mitmetel iOS versioonidel, nii jailbreak'itud kui ka tavalistel seadmetel. Katsetes asendas FireEye Gmaili rakenduse võltsitud mänguga, et näidata, kui kiiresti võivad häkkerid vahetada välja usaldatud rakenduse, kui turvanõuandeid eirata.

article_content: Marcus Simpson, who previously ran as a Conservative candidate in Corby, has been sentenced to 16 years in prison after being found guilty of smuggling firearms from Serbia and supplying them to gangs in London. Simpson, aged 42, posed as a respectable community member but was actually the leading figure in a group responsible for bringing dangerous weapons into the UK. The court heard that Simpson arranged at least two trips to Serbia to buy submachine guns, assault rifles fitted with laser sights, pistols such as the Walther PPK, as well as silencers and ammunition. He then sold these weapons to criminal gangs locked in violent disputes over drugs. Simpson was described as having a fascination with guns and personally handled manufacturing and modification of the firearms at his home. Simpson’s associates, Ryan Groves (39) from Tottenham and Jerome Minott (27) from Acton, played significant roles in the operation. Acting as intermediaries, they sold the weapons and ammunition to gang members and drug dealers, fully aware that the weapons could be used to commit violence. Both men were each sentenced to 12 years in prison. Minott's involvement was characterized as less substantial than Groves’, who was considered an eager middleman. The police arrested Simpson and Groves after observing a weapons deal at Groves' restaurant, Jah Mek Ya, in Tottenham on May 29. Evidence included messages advertising a selection of guns at various prices, as well as the recovery of cash, firearms, and ammunition. Several others were also convicted for using the smuggled guns in violent gang activity. Anthony Bennett (28), Marcus Paul (20), and Dylan Addo (20) received sentences ranging from 12 to 14 years for their involvement in armed attacks. Jeffrey Larbi (20) was given a 10-year sentence after being convicted of multiple firearms offenses. Jadine Mills (21) was previously sentenced to five years for her part in the conspiracy after police recovered an assault rifle and handguns from her home. The judge, Witold Pawlak, criticized Simpson for living a double life, acting as a model citizen while secretly leading a dangerous gun-running operation. He also imposed four-year license extension periods on Simpson, Groves, Paul, and Bennett due to the significant risk they posed to public safety. Detective Inspector Steve Meechan praised the thorough investigation and emphasized that gang violence causes misery for residents and damages communities. The operation resulted in a total of 88 years in prison sentences for those involved. Police assured the public that tackling gun crime and gang activity remains a top priority. Prosecutors noted that the investigation successfully linked the suppliers to both the sale and use of the weapons during a spate of violent inter-gang disputes, mainly connected to drug trafficking in North London.

Prokurörid märkisid, et uurimine suutis edukalt seostada relvade müüjad nii nende müümise kui ka kasutamisega vägivallaaktidesse, mis olid seotud peamiselt narkokaubandusega Põhja-Londonis.

article_content: The elusive British street artist Banksy has kicked off a monthlong art project in New York, known as 'Better Out Than In.' According to an announcement on his website, he plans to create public installations across the city throughout October. Yet, both of Banksy’s inaugural works were promptly defaced. The initial piece, which appeared in Manhattan’s Lower East Side, portrayed two boys—one stretching toward a spray can beside a 'Graffiti Is A Crime' sign. Curious viewers could call a provided number for an audio commentary, which humorously warned the piece might have already been covered up and explained, 'the children represent youth, and the sign represents, well, signs.' Not long after its debut, the artwork was first whitewashed, then obscured by other graffiti, notably a message saying, 'Sweaty palms made me lose the love of my life!' Banksy's second creation surfaced under the High Line in Chelsea. It featured the phrase, 'This is my New York accent' written in graffiti script, with the follow-up, '...normally I write like this' rendered in a standard font. This piece was also quickly tagged over by another graffiti artist. Having built a global reputation for his provocative, stencil-based street art, Banksy continues to conceal his identity since starting out in Bristol, England. His works often deliver sharp social commentary and are coveted in the art market. His 2010 documentary, 'Exit Through the Gift Shop,' was Oscar-nominated, further amplifying his influence on popular culture. Some of his murals, like 'Slave Labour,' have prompted legal and ethical debates regarding ownership after being removed from their original sites and sold at auction. 'Slave Labour' was recently sold in London for $1.1 million after being pulled from a Miami auction, and his 'Flower Girl' mural, painted on a Los Angeles gas station in 2008, is expected to fetch up to $300,000 at an upcoming Beverly Hills auction. Although Banksy's art garners admiration and high prices, it remains vulnerable to vandalism—highlighting the very transience and defiance embedded in his creations.
translated_content: Salapärane Briti tänavakunstnik Banksy alustas New Yorgis kuuajast kunstiprojekti „Better Out Than In“. Oma veebilehel teatas ta, et loob erinevate paikadele üle linna teoseid kogu oktoobri jooksul. Kuid mõlemad Banksy esimesed teosed rüüstati peagi pärast ilmumist. Esimene töö, mis ilmus Manhattani Lower East Side’il, kujutas kahte poissi – üks ulatub spreipurgi poole, nende kõrval on silt „Graffiti on kuritegu“. Huvilised said helistada lisatud telefoninumbril, kust kuulsid humoorikat kommentaari, et teos võib juba üle värvitud olla, ning selgitust: „lapsed sümboliseerivad noorust ja silt lihtsalt silte.“ Varsti pärast selle avalikkuse ette jõudmist kaeti kunstiteos esmalt valge värviga ning seejärel muu graffitiga, teiste seas sõnumiga: „Higised peopesad võtsid mult mu elu armastuse!“ Banksy teine teos ilmus Chelsea linnaosas High Line’i all. Sellel tekst: „See on minu New Yorgi aktsent“ grafitikirjas ning selle all tavatähestikus: „...tavaliselt kirjutan nii“. Ka see töö märgiti kiiresti üle mõne teise tänavakunstniku poolt. Tuntud tugeva sõnumiga šabloonkunstist, hoiab Banksy endiselt oma identiteeti saladuses, olles alustanud Bristolis, Inglismaal. Tema tööd sisaldavad sageli sotsiaalset kriitikat ning nende vastu on kunstimaailmas suur huvi. Tema 2010. aasta dokumentaalfilm „Exit Through the Gift Shop“ kandideeris Oscarile, mis võimendas tema mõju popkultuuris veelgi. Mitmed Banksy teosed, nagu „Slave Labour“, on endaga kaasa toonud juriidilisi ja eetilisi arutelusid, sest need eemaldati algsest paigast ja müüdi oksjonil. „Slave Labour“ müüdi hiljuti Londonis 1,1 miljoni dollari eest pärast seda, kui teos eemaldati Miami oksjonilt, ja „Flower Girl“ seinamaaling, mis valmis Los Angeleses 2008. aastal, võib Beverly Hillsi oksjonil maksta kuni 300 000 dollarit. Kuigi Banksy tööd pälvivad tunnustust ning saavutavad kõrgeid hindu, seisavad nad silmitsi pideva vandalismi ohuga – see rõhutab kunstniku loomingus leiduvat kaduvuse ja mässu teemat.

article_content: Last month, a 120-page executive order from the Biden administration outlined plans for regulating companies developing artificial intelligence technologies, as well as strategies for expanding the federal government's own adoption of AI. Central to the document are concerns about security—both identifying and addressing vulnerabilities in AI products and preparing defenses against AI-driven cyberattacks. As with many executive orders, the challenge lies in translating broad directives into concrete actions. Today, the US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), a division of the Department of Homeland Security, will unveil its 'Roadmap for Artificial Intelligence,' a comprehensive plan for carrying out the order's goals. CISA’s roadmap divides its approach into five key areas. Two focus on enhancing communication, collaboration, and workforce expertise across public and private sectors, while the other three address specific steps outlined in the executive order. According to CISA director Jen Easterly, it's crucial to put these plans into practice and hold the agency accountable, both for its overall mission and for the specific actions called for by the executive order. 'AI as software will have a significant impact on society,' Easterly told WIRED, 'and while it can improve our lives, it may also benefit adversaries. Our focus is on ensuring the safe and secure development and deployment of these systems.' The agency emphasizes responsible yet proactive use of AI to strengthen US digital defenses. Easterly noted that although the agency prioritizes 'security over speed' in developing AI-powered defense tools, there is urgency since threat actors are already leveraging these capabilities. CISA’s recommendations stress that AI should be 'secure by design,' meaning security is built in from the start, not added as an afterthought. The agency also promotes the use of 'software bills of materials' and other practices to ensure openness and supply chain transparency. Easterly explained, 'AI manufacturers should be responsible for security outcomes. It’s about enforcing transparency and shifting accountability to those who build and design these systems, ensuring we know what’s in the software so we can protect it effectively.'
translated_content: Eelmisel kuul esitas Bideni administratsioon 120-leheküljelise täitekorralduse, mis tutvustas plaane tehisintellekti tehnoloogiaid arendavate ettevõtete reguleerimiseks ning föderaalvalitsuse AI kasutuse laiendamiseks. Dokument keskendus peamiselt turvalisusele—nii AI toodetes esinevate haavatavuste tuvastamisele ja lahendamisele kui ka AI-toega küberrünnakute vastaste kaitsemeetmete ettevalmistamisele. Nagu paljude täitekorralduste puhul, seisneb väljakutse ulatuslike juhiste konkreetseteks tegudeks muutmises. Täna avalikustab Ameerika Ühendriikide Küberjulgeoleku ja Infrastruktuuri Turvalisuse Agentuur (CISA), mis kuulub Siseministeeriumi alla, oma „Tehisintellekti tegevusplaani“, mis on põhjalik strateegia korralduse eesmärkide elluviimiseks. CISA tegevusplaan jagab oma lähenemise viieks oluliseks valdkonnaks. Kaks neist keskenduvad suhtluse, koostöö ja tööjõu asjatundlikkuse suurendamisele avaliku ja erasektori vahel, kolm tegelevad täitekorralduse konkreetsete sammudega. CISA direktor Jen Easterly sõnul on oluline need plaanid ellu viia ning agentuuri nii üldise missiooni kui ka konkreetsete täitekorralduse tegevuste eest vastutavaks pidada. 'Tehisintellekt tarkvarana avaldab ühiskonnale märkimisväärset mõju,' ütles Easterly ajakirjale WIRED, 'ja kuigi see võib meie elu paremaks muuta, võib see kasulik olla ka vastastele. Meie fookus on tagada nende süsteemide ohutu ja turvaline arendamine ning kasutuselevõtt.' Agentuur rõhutab vastutustundlikku, kuid otsustavat AI kasutamist USA digitaalkaitse tugevdamiseks. Easterly märkis, et kuigi agentuur seab AI-põhiste kaitsevõimekuste arendamisel turvalisuse kiirusest ettepoole, on olukord siiski kiireloomuline, sest ohustajad juba kasutavad neid võimalusi. CISA soovitused rõhutavad, et tehisintellekt peab olema 'turvaline disainist alates' ehk turvalisus peab olema süsteemi sisse ehitatud, mitte lisatud hiljem. Samuti propageerib agentuur 'tarkvarakomponentide loetelu' ja muid meetmeid läbipaistvuse ja tarneahela kontrolli tagamiseks. Easterly selgitas: 'AI tootjad peavad vastutama turvalisuse eest. Oluline on tagada läbipaistvus ning nihutada vastutus nendele, kes neid süsteeme arendavad ja disainivad, et teaksime täpselt, mis tarkvaras on, ning saaksime seda tõhusalt kaitsta.'

article_content:
As part of their pre-season tour in the United States, Liverpool FC made a poignant stop at New York City's 9/11 memorial and museum. Club manager Brendan Rodgers, with prominent former players Kenny Dalglish, Ian Rush, Robbie Fowler, and executive Billy Hogan, participated in the tribute. They laid a wreath adorned with a Liverpool scarf reading 'You'll Never Walk Alone,' showing their respect for those lost in the September 11, 2001 attacks.

Joe Daniels, president of the memorial, along with retired New York firefighter Tim Brown, guided the Liverpool group through the museum. The stories shared, particularly by Brown, had a profound impact on the visitors.

Rodgers stated it was an honor to bring representatives of Liverpool to a place of such global significance. He thanked Daniels and Brown for sharing emotional accounts of the events, emphasizing that this visit would remain memorable for him and the team.

The team had been staying in Manhattan since Tuesday, prior to their penalty shootout victory against Manchester City, and was scheduled to continue their tour in Charlotte, North Carolina. The 9/11 attacks, which claimed the lives of 2,977 people from 93 countries, served as a powerful reminder of the day's global impact.

Klubi peatreener Brendan Rodgers koos legendide Kenny Dalglishi, Ian Rushi, Robbie Fowleri ja juhatuse liikme Billy Hoganiga osalesid mälestusüritusel. Nad asetasid pärja, mida ehtis Liverpooli sall sõnumiga 'You'll Never Walk Alone', austamaks 11. septembri 2001. aasta ohvreid.

Memoriaali president Joe Daniels ja endine New Yorgi tuletõrjuja Tim Brown juhendasid Liverpooli esindust muuseumituuril. Eriti Browni jagatud lood avaldasid külalistele sügavat mõju.

Rodgers ütles, et tal oli au tuua Liverpooli delegatsioon kohta, millel on globaalne tähtsus. Ta tänas Danielsit ja Browni emotsionaalsete lugude eest ning rõhutas, et see külastus jääb talle ja meeskonnale pikaks ajaks meelde.

Meeskond viibis Manhattanil alates teisipäevast enne penaltiseerias võidetud mängu Manchester City vastu ja suundus järgmisena Charlotte'i, Põhja-Carolinas. 9/11 rünnakud, mis nõudsid 2 977 inimese elu 93 riigist, tuletasid võimsalt meelde selle päeva ülemaailmset mõju.

article_content: Cindy Okafor, known for her roles in acting and as a past Big Brother Naija housemate, says she has no regrets about anyone leaving her life. article_content: A battered Nikon F camera from the late 1960s, recently bought on eBay by freelance photographer Paul Turner from Fishguard, Wales, is sparking intrigue. Turner suspects this camera, marked with worn 'SF' initials, might have belonged to Sean Flynn—the renowned photojournalist and son of actor Errol Flynn. In April 1970, at age 28, Sean Flynn vanished in Cambodia while reporting as the Vietnam War spread into the region. Along with fellow photographer Dana Stone, Flynn disappeared after reportedly being captured by communist guerrillas at a roadblock during an assignment. Despite years of searches and speculation, their fate remains unknown; Flynn was declared legally dead in 1984. Turner noticed the 'SF' initials when he was cleaning the camera. After researching its serial number, he confirmed the camera was manufactured between November 1967 and January 1968—matching Flynn’s period as a Vietnam War correspondent. He observed that among missing journalists from that era, only Sean Flynn had those initials, and noted that engraving personal marks was common among photographers for easy identification. The camera’s origin traces to a French flea market, with claims that it may have migrated from Vietnam, Cambodia, or surrounding areas. Its poor condition allowed Turner to purchase it for just £51. He believes Nikon could possibly trace its first owner using the serial number, which might settle the mystery of its past. Sean Flynn, born to Errol Flynn and Lili Damita in 1941, began his career in acting before pursuing adventure as a safari guide and ultimately, as a war photojournalist. He gained fame for his fearless reporting style, often working alongside military units in conflict zones. After brief stints in acting and covering the 1967 Arab-Israeli war, he returned to Vietnam and then Cambodia. On April 6, 1970, he and Dana Stone, both on assignment for Time magazine, were captured while traveling by motorcycle from Phnom Penh to a conflict area. Despite efforts by family and search teams—including a 2010 investigation funded by Flynn’s half-sister Rory—remains found in Cambodia did not match the Flynn family’s DNA, leaving the case unresolved. The prevailing theory is that Flynn and Stone were held prisoner for over a year and then killed by Khmer Rouge rebels in 1971, but some believe Flynn may have survived past that date. Flynn’s mother, Lili Damita, invested heavily in search efforts and declared him dead in absentia in 1984. She passed away in 1994. Sean Flynn’s legacy continues to captivate the public, inspiring the Clash’s song 'Sean Flynn' and films such as 'The Road to Freedom.' His daring spirit and mysterious end remain part of journalism lore.
translated_content: Räsitud Nikon F kaamera, mis pärineb 1960ndate lõpust ja mille ostis hiljuti eBayst Fishguardis, Walesis elav vabakutseline fotograaf Paul Turner, on tekitanud palju huvi. Turner kahtlustab, et see initsiaalidega 'SF' märgistatud kaamera võis olla kunagi kuulunud Sean Flynnile – tuntud sõjafotograafile ja Errol Flynni pojale. Sean Flynn kadus 1970. aasta aprillis Kambodžas, olles 28-aastane, kui Vietnamisõda laienes piirkonda. Koos kaaskolleegi Dana Stone’iga kadus Flynn pärast seda, kui väidetavalt kommunistlikud võitlejad nad kontrollpunktis kinni pidasid. Hoolimata aastatepikkustest otsingutest pole nende saatus siiani selgunud; Flynn kuulutati seaduslikult surnuks 1984. aastal. Turner märkas 'SF' initsiaale, kui ta kaamerat puhastas. Kui ta uuris seerianumbrit, selgus, et kaamera toodeti novembris 1967 kuni jaanuaris 1968 – just perioodil, mil Flynn tegutses sõjafotograafina Vietnamis. Turner lisas, et kadunud ajakirjanikest oli ainult Sean Flynnil need initsiaalid ning märkis, et fotograafid tähistasid oma tehnikat sageli initsiaalidega segaduste vältimiseks. Kaamera pärineb väidetavalt Prantsusmaa kirbuturult ning see võis algselt olla pärit Vietnamist, Kambodžast või lähiriikidest. Halvas seisukorras aparaat läks Turnerile maksma vaid 51 naela. Ta usub, et Nikon saaks ehk seerianumbri põhjal tuvastada kaamera esialgse omaniku ning see aitaks lahendada selle päritolu müsteeriumi. Sean Flynn, kes sündis 1941. aastal Errol Flynni ja Lili Damita perre, alustas oma teed näitlejana, kuid suundus peagi safarijuhina Aafrikasse ning lõpuks sõjaajakirjanikuks. Teda tunti julguse poolest minna sinna, kuhu teised ei julgenud, sageli sõjaväeüksustega rindel olles. Pärast lühikest naasmist näitlemise juurde ning Lähis-Ida konfliktide kajastamist suundus ta taas Vietnamisse ja hiljem Kambodžasse. 6. aprillil 1970 kadusid Flynn ja Dana Stone Time’i väljaande jaoks töötades, kui nad mootorratastel Phnom Penh’ist sõjaalale liikusid ja kommunistlikud võitlejad nad kinni pidasid. Kuigi Flynni pere ja otsingumeeskonnad – kaasa arvatud 2010. aasta uurimine, mida toetas poolõde Rory – on püüdnud teda leida, pole Kambodžast leitud jäänustest Flynni perekonna DNA-ga vastet leitud. Levinud arvamus on, et Flynn ja Stone viibisid vangistuses üle aasta ja tapeti 1971. aastal punaste khmeeride poolt, kuid mõned usuvad, et Flynn jäi kauemaks ellu. Flynni ema, Lili Damita, kulutas poja otsingutele märkimisväärseid vahendeid ning kuulutas ta 1984. aastal surnuks. Lili suri kümme aastat hiljem. Sean Flynni legend elab edasi – tema vaprat elu ja seletamatut kadumist peetakse ajakirjanduse ajaloos tähelepanuväärseks ning see on inspireerinud The Clash’i laulu 'Sean Flynn' ja mängufilme 'The Road to Freedom.'

A pony was found drowned in the Brinklow to Newbold canal near Rugby, Warwickshire, over the weekend. RSPCA inspectors, alerted by dog walkers, examined the animal’s body and reported that it was still warm when found, suggesting it may have been alive when pushed into the freezing water. Investigators discovered drag marks on the towpath and clumps of mane and tail hair, indicating the pony struggled before entering the canal.

The RSPCA considers the animal’s death suspicious and is appealing for information from the public. A dark Range Rover was seen near a lay-by opposite this stretch of water at around 7am on Saturday. Inspector Louise Labram said, ‘At the moment, I am treating this as suspicious. The disturbed soil, pony hair, and drag marks suggest the animal may have been alive and struggling.’

The RSPCA has contacted local authorities about the removal of the pony, as the charity does not have the statutory responsibility or resources to dispose of animal bodies. Anyone with information is urged to contact the RSPCA at 0300 1234 999.

Uurijad avastasid teerajal lohistamisjälgi ning lakast ja sabast rebitud karvu, mis viitab, et loom võitles enne kanalisse sattumist.

RSPCA peab looma surma kahtlaseks ning kutsub avalikkust üles jagama vihjeid. Umbes kell 7 laupäeva hommikul nähti kanali vastas asuva peatuskoha juures tumedat Range Roverit. Inspektor Louise Labram ütles: "Hetkel käsitlen seda juhtunut kahtlusalusena. Pinnas on mõnes kohas rikutud, leidub karvatutte ja lohistamisjälgi, mis viitab, et eläin võis veel elada ja võidelda."

RSPCA on võtnud ühendust kohalike ametiasutustega, sest loomade korjuste teisaldamine pole nende vastutusalas ega võimalustes. Kõigil, kel on juhtunu kohta infot, palutakse ühendust võtta RSPCA-ga numbril 0300 1234 999.

article_content: The fixtures for the 2014-15 Barclays Premier League season have been unveiled, revealing a series of pivotal clashes that could determine the fate of the title. Sportsmail highlights ten major matches that are set to capture the attention of football fans across the country come August. Manchester City v Liverpool (Saturday, August 23): Last season's top two clubs meet early in the campaign. Manchester City, having dropped only five home points in 2013-14, managed a comeback victory against Liverpool on Boxing Day, while Liverpool secured revenge with a 3-2 win at Anfield later in the season. Arsenal v Tottenham (Saturday, September 27): Arsenal completed the double over Tottenham last season with two 1-0 wins, finishing ten points ahead of their North London rivals. This season's first derby could be crucial for both teams’ hopes of a top-four finish, and marks new Spurs boss Mauricio Pochettino's introduction to the fixture. Manchester United v Chelsea (Saturday, October 25): Early fixtures appear relatively favorable for new Manchester United manager Louis van Gaal, though the visit from Chelsea, managed by Jose Mourinho, promises to be a major test. This match could help gauge United's progress under their new leadership. Liverpool v Chelsea (Saturday, November 8): Last season, Steven Gerrard’s notorious slip in this fixture played a defining role in Liverpool’s failed title challenge, with Chelsea completing a double over the Reds. Liverpool manager Brendan Rodgers knows there is little margin for error this time. Manchester United v Liverpool (Saturday, December 13): Liverpool dominated United in this match last year, which further threatened David Moyes’s tenure as manager. With Van Gaal at the helm, Manchester United will aim for a stronger showing at Old Trafford. Manchester City v Arsenal (Saturday, January 17): Arsenal struggled in this fixture last season, losing 6-3 at the Etihad Stadium despite leading the league at the time. Heavy defeats to City, Liverpool, and Chelsea undermined their title credentials, making this match a key test of their progress. Everton v Liverpool (Saturday, February 7): Roberto Martinez recently signed a long-term contract with Everton, who last defeated Liverpool over three years ago. Despite a strong campaign in 2013-14, Everton finished 12 points behind their Merseyside rivals. Burnley v Manchester City (Saturday, March 14): Newly-promoted Burnley’s home form could be crucial as they aim to secure Premier League survival. During their last top-flight spell, Burnley managed several upsets at Turf Moor, though Manchester City won 6-1 on their previous visit. Arsenal v Chelsea (Saturday, April 25): Chelsea have held the upper hand over Arsenal recently, notably winning 6-0 at Stamford Bridge last season. If both clubs are in title contention at this late stage, the match could be a memorable one. Everton v Tottenham (Sunday, May 24): The final day features a compelling clash between two teams that challenged for a Champions League place last season but settled for the Europa League. A top-four finish could be on the line, raising the stakes at Goodison Park.

Joan Rivers is currently on life support following complications during a minor throat surgery in New York City. Despite some reports suggesting improvement, her daughter Melissa Rivers issued a statement confirming her mother's critical condition. Melissa expressed deep gratitude for the public's outpouring of support and asked for continued prayers as Joan remains under intensive care.

Before her surgery, Joan was reportedly in good spirits, joking about the procedure with friends. Close friend Jay Redack recounted their recent dinner and conversation, describing Rivers as lively and cheerful. On Thursday, Joan stopped breathing during the procedure and was placed in a medically induced coma at Mount Sinai Hospital. Doctors are now gradually working to wake her, though concerns remain about possible long-term effects from the brief lack of oxygen to her brain.

Family, friends, and colleagues have rallied around Melissa, who traveled from Los Angeles to New York immediately after hearing the news. Support has come from many in the entertainment industry, including Kelly Osbourne, Giuliana Rancic, Donald Trump, Charlie Sheen, and Sarah Silverman, among others, many of whom posted encouraging messages on social media.

Some sources suggest the Rivers family may pursue legal action related to the incident, citing shock and frustration over the outcome of the outpatient procedure. Currently, the New York Police Department has not announced any investigation into the clinic involved.

Just hours before her surgery, Joan Rivers performed on stage, promoted her book, and energetically interacted with fans. Those close to Rivers have emphasized her resilience and strong spirit during this difficult time.
translated_content:
Joan Rivers on praegu elutoel pärast tüsistusi väikese kurguoperatsiooni käigus New Yorgis. Vaatamata mõningatele teadetele tema seisundi paranemisest kinnitas tütar Melissa Rivers avalduses, et ema seisund on jätkuvalt kriitiline. Melissa avaldas suurt tänu avaliku toetuse eest ja palus jätkuvalt palveid, kuna Joan viibib intensiivravis.

Enne operatsiooni oli Joan heas tujus ning naljatas protseduuri üle sõpradega. Lähedane sõber Jay Redack meenutas nende äsjast õhtusööki ja vestlust, kirjeldades Riversit elava ja rõõmsana. Neljapäeval lakkas Joan operatsiooni ajal hingamast ning ta viidi kunstlikku koomasse Mount Sinai haiglas. Arstid äratavad teda nüüd aeglaselt, kuid on mures võimalike pikaajaliste ajukahjustuste pärast, mis võivad olla põhjustatud hapnikupuudusest.

Perekond, sõbrad ja kolleegid on Melissa ümber koondunud, kes lendas Los Angelesest New Yorki kohe pärast uudise saamist. Paljud meelelahutustegelased, sealhulgas Kelly Osbourne, Giuliana Rancic, Donald Trump, Charlie Sheen ja Sarah Silverman, on avaldanud toetust ja julgustavaid sõnumeid sotsiaalmeedias.

Mõned allikad viitavad, et Riversi perekond võib kaaluda kohtuteed seoses juhtunuga, väljendades šokki ja pettumust ambulatoorse protseduuri üle. Praegu ei ole New Yorgi politsei teatanud kliiniku suhtes uurimise alustamisest.

Vaid mõned tunnid enne operatsiooni esines Joan Rivers laval, reklaamis oma raamatut ja suhtles energiliselt fännidega. Lähedased on toonitanud tema vastupidavust ja tugevat vaimu sellel raskel ajal.

Justice Secretary Chris Grayling has accused Labour and the Liberal Democrats of aiming to penalise the country’s wealth creators through higher taxes. Grayling criticized Labour’s approach as promoting the 'politics of envy', warning that protecting job creators is a priority for the Conservative party.

Speaking as Labour leader Ed Miliband announced plans to revive socialist policies—such as increasing wages for the lowest paid and requiring schools to stay open longer—Grayling claimed Labour wants to increase taxes on the rich to fund an expanded welfare state.

Business groups, including the Confederation of British Industry (CBI) and the Institute of Directors, expressed concern over Labour's proposals, arguing that economic growth should be the focus.

Labour shadow Treasury minister Rachel Reeves stated that people earning £60,000 a year should not be targeted by tax rises, emphasizing that Labour’s plans are aimed at the wealthiest individuals. Similarly, Liberal Democrat aides stressed that their party is focused on taxing wealth, not income, introducing a proposed tax on properties worth more than £2 million—though party briefings mentioned possible tax changes for those earning £50,000, which was later denied.

Grayling’s remarks further underscore the policy divides between the Conservatives and their coalition partners, as the parties prepare for party conferences and the upcoming General Election. He reiterated that supporting wealth and job creators is a 'red line' for the Conservative party.
translated_content:
Justiitsminister Chris Grayling süüdistas Tööparteid ja Liberaaldemokraate riigi jõukuse loojate kõrgema maksustamise soovimises. Grayling nimetas Tööpartei lähenemist „kadeda poliitikaks“ ning rõhutas, et töökohtade loojaid kaitsta on konservatiivide prioriteet.

Samas kui Tööpartei juht Ed Miliband teatas soovist taastada sotsialistlik poliitika — näiteks tõsta madalapalgaliste palku ja hoida koole kauem avatuna — väitis Grayling, et Tööpartei soovib rikastelt rohkem makse koguda, mis läheks laieneva sotsiaalhoolekande rahastamiseks.

Ettevõtlusorganisatsioonid, nagu Briti Tööstuskonföderatsioon (CBI) ja Direktorite Instituut, väljendasid Tööpartei ettepanekute suhtes muret ja leidsid, et majanduskasvu peaks eelistama.

Tööpartei vari-rahandusminister Rachel Reeves kinnitas, et 60 000 naelast teenijaid ei tuleks kõrgemalt maksustada, rõhutades, et fookuses on ühiskonna kõige jõukamad. Ka Liberaaldemokraatide esindajad laususid, et erakond keskendub jõukuse, mitte sissetuleku maksustamisele, ning pakkusid välja maksustamist üle 2 miljoni naela väärtusega kinnistutele — kuigi erakonnasiseselt räägiti võimalikest maksutõusudest ka 50 000 naela teenivatele, kuid see võimalus lükati hiljem ümber.

Graylingi sõnul toovad need kommentaarid esile konservatiivide ja nende koalitsioonipartnerite poliitilised erimeelsused enne parteikonverentse ja lähenevaid üldvalimisi. Ta kordas, et konservatiivide jaoks on rikkuse ja töökohtade loomise toetamine „punane joon“.

article_content: At the 2012 MTV Movie Awards, Jennifer Aniston received the inaugural Best On-Screen Dirtbag award for playing Dr. Julia Harris in 'Horrible Bosses'. Wearing a black leather dress, Aniston appeared stronger and more muscular than in her recent public appearances, possibly reflecting a new approach to fitness she may share with boyfriend Justin Theroux. This new award celebrates the most memorable, outrageous film characters. Aniston’s noteworthy performance as an inappropriate dentist, including a standout banana-eating scene, helped her win over fellow nominees: Colin Farrell, Bryce Dallas Howard, Kristen Wiig, Jon Hamm, and Oliver Cooper. In her acceptance speech, Aniston thanked 'Friends' for giving her the opportunity to be an 'inner sweetheart', and expressed gratitude to director Seth Gordon for allowing her to explore a very different kind of role. She joked about finally getting to embrace her on-screen 'dirtbag'. Earlier, the ceremony was briefly interrupted when Mila Kunis was heckled by a member of the audience while preparing to present an award. Her co-presenter, Mark Wahlberg, intervened effectively to keep the atmosphere positive, and the event continued without further issues. Later, Aniston was seen celebrating backstage with Russell Brand.

article_content: A final attempt to secure peace in eastern Ukraine is being presented to national leaders today, amid warnings that failure may lead to all-out war. Since the conflict began in April, over 5,300 people have died and around one million have been displaced. On the eve of negotiations, pro-Russian separatists intensified shelling of Ukrainian government positions along various front lines, reportedly preparing for renewed offensives against the railway hub of Debaltseve and the coastal city of Mariupol, according to Ukrainian military sources. Recent fighting claimed the lives of seven civilians and five Ukrainian soldiers, leaving widespread destruction. In the last 24 hours, five Ukrainian soldiers were killed and 26 wounded, as artillery fire echoed in Donetsk. Officials described the situation as tense, with no immediate information on additional casualties or damage. Ukrainian President Petro Poroshenko appealed passionately for political, economic, and military aid from international allies, expressing that the crisis will remain unresolved without such support. The escalation in violence has prompted the United States to consider providing lethal aid to the Ukrainian government, though German Chancellor Angela Merkel has cautioned that this could worsen the situation. Meanwhile, France and Germany have devised a new peace proposal after four hours of talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow. While most details remain confidential, French President Francois Hollande revealed that the plan includes creating a wider demilitarized zone and granting greater autonomy to eastern regions. The United States and United Kingdom continue to accuse Russia of supplying weapons and troops to separatists, allegations that Moscow denies, suggesting instead that Western actions are fueling the conflict. Britain's Foreign Secretary Philip Hammond reiterated the UK's active role in peace efforts, dismissing claims about diminished British influence. As both military and civilian casualties mount, international leaders are intensifying diplomatic efforts to broker a lasting peace and avert further escalation.

article_content: I used many phones this year, including all the flagship, mid-range, and budget models. While flagships were as impressive as expected, the mid-range category is now stronger than ever. If you're shopping for a phone this Black Friday, there are plenty of excellent options under $500. The Galaxy A54, now discounted to $324, is a popular choice—Samsung has done a good job with this device, making it solid for everyday use. However, there's an even better choice: the Pixel 7a. Google's mid-range phone outperforms the Galaxy A54 in most key areas, and the best part is that it's now available for just $374—just $50 more than the A54. The Pixel 7a (128GB) usually costs $499, but you can get it for $374 on Amazon. In my experience with phones, this is the best Black Friday deal right now. The Pixel 7a offers the best cameras in its class, clean software, powerful hardware, and, overall, it's a better choice than the Galaxy A54. Why you should consider the Pixel 7a instead of the A54: Samsung hasn’t changed much with the Galaxy A54, but it still features a vibrant 120Hz AMOLED screen, respectable cameras, and a large battery. The Pixel 7a has received significant upgrades compared to its predecessor. It has a 90Hz OLED panel, a great 64MP main camera with the best wide-angle lens in its class, more powerful hardware than the A54, and cleaner, enjoyable software. I’ve used both extensively, and the Pixel 7a is the logical pick. It’s smaller and easier to use with one hand thanks to its 6.1-inch screen (compared to 6.4 inches for the A54), and while it’s limited to 90Hz, it feels smooth in daily use. The biggest advantage for the Pixel 7a is its cameras. It clearly outperforms the Galaxy A54 in this respect—the Pixel 7a offers the best camera package you’ll find for under $600. Software is another strong point. The Pixel 7a already runs Android 14 and comes without any bloatware. Google's interface is clean, colorful, packed with useful features, and generally a lot of fun to use—even after using Samsung’s One UI for months. While Samsung’s One UI has many features, it’s not as well-optimized on the A54, and there’s too much bloatware included. Though not crucial to the buying decision, I also prefer the Pixel 7a’s design over the Galaxy A54. The distinctive camera bar on the back adds character. The one area where the A54 excels is battery life. Its larger 5000mAh battery easily lasts more than a day. The Pixel 7a’s 4385mAh battery consistently gets through a day, but it's not as long-lasting as the A54. Where the Pixel 7a shines is in performance. The custom Tensor G2 is noticeably faster than the Exynos 1380 used in the A54—you can tell in daily tasks. The Pixel 7a also matches the A54 with IP67 water and dust resistance. I've recommended Samsung phones in the past, but this year, Google has taken the lead. The Pixel 7a stands out in all the important areas, and with its current $374 price tag, it's one of the best bargains this year. If you’re planning to upgrade this Black Friday, the Pixel 7a should be your pick.
