Spain may have discovered the leader of their next generation on Saturday night in Huelva, comfortably defeating Belarus 3-0. Real Madrid midfielder Isco opened the scoring with a stunning long-range effort, orchestrating play for the European champions and earning a standing ovation when he was substituted after 80 minutes. Pre-match tensions about Sergio Ramos' remarks regarding his teammates' commitment were swept aside as Isco delivered an impressive performance. Ramos’ comments were perceived as criticism directed at Cesc Fabregas and especially Diego Costa, who missed the qualifier despite having played for Chelsea the previous weekend. Although Ramos clarified he hadn’t targeted specific players, Costa’s absence reportedly troubled several senior Spanish players.

Despite missing key Premier League players, Spain eased to victory. Arsenal’s Santi Cazorla created an early chance for Pedro, who missed narrowly. In the 18th minute, Isco’s spectacular shot gave Spain the lead. He has been compared to Zinedine Zidane at Real Madrid, with fans hopeful he will succeed—even ahead of stars like Gareth Bale. Isco’s goal found the top corner from outside the area, leaving Belarus goalkeeper Yuri Zhevnov helpless. Three minutes later, Sergio Busquets doubled the lead after perfectly striking a defensive clearance. Spain’s captain Iker Casillas returned to the starting lineup for the injured David de Gea and had a quiet night, with Spain largely controlling the game.

After the break, Paco Alcacer headed just wide from a Pedro cross, but the third goal soon arrived as Pedro converted Juanfran’s delivery. Isco was well-supported by Atletico Madrid’s Koke and the energetic Cazorla, who departed to applause in the 69th minute for Jose Callejon. Isco also received a warm ovation upon his substitution. Alvaro Morata made his Spain debut, highlighting coach Vicente del Bosque’s efforts to rejuvenate the squad following a disappointing World Cup. Pedro struck the post late on, while Belarus failed to respond.

Spain faces World Champions Germany next in Vigo and resumes their qualification campaign against Ukraine in March. With this result, Spain is well-positioned to top Group C, even without Fabregas and Costa.

article_content: If you've ever imagined living in your own historic Scottish tower, now might be your opportunity. Abbots Tower in New Abbey, Dumfries, built around 1580, is up for sale for under £600,000. This four-story property blends old-world charm with modern comforts, featuring hand-crafted ironwork, original wooden floors, and period fireplaces. Constructed in the style of the Scottish Renaissance—with pepperpot turrets and unique rooflines—the tower also boasts stone staircases and gunloop windows. The accommodation is spread across four floors, accessed by winding stone stairs, and includes four bedrooms. The master suite offers an en-suite bathroom, exposed beams, a window seat, and a fireplace. The kitchen mixes classic and contemporary design, with a handmade island, antique dresser, range cooker, and Belfast sink. On the third floor, a formal room provides stunning views—including, on a clear day, Skiddaw in the Peak District. A 'secret' staircase leads to a garret, currently serving as an attic bedroom. The tower has historic ties to the religious upheavals of the 16th century. Gilbert Broun, the last abbot of the neighboring Sweetheart Abbey and a prominent opponent of the Scottish Reformation, reportedly used Abbots Tower as a base for his efforts. The abbey itself was founded in the 13th century by Lady Devorgilla to honor her late husband, John Balliol, former King of Scotland. After being built by John Broun and passing through various owners, Abbots Tower was neglected for centuries before a comprehensive restoration began in 1990, lasting twenty years. During restoration, traditional details like a painted ceiling—fashionable in Scotland during the reign of James VI—were recreated. Now fully refurbished, Abbots Tower offers a rare chance to own a piece of Scottish history in the picturesque village of New Abbey, renowned for its medieval roots and the legacy of Sweetheart Abbey.

See neljakorruseline hoone ühendab ajastutruu võlu ja kaasaegse mugavuse — tunnusjoonteks käsitsi sepistatud rauatööd, algupärased puupõrandad ja kaminad. Majutus jaguneb neljale korrusele, mida ühendavad kivist keerdtrepid. Tornis on neli magamistuba; peamagamistoas on oma vannituba, paljad talad, aknaalune istumisnurk ja kamin. article_content: Kevin Spacey thought he might be having a heart attack during a recent visit to Uzbekistan for a film festival. While delivering a speech at the Tashkent International Film Festival, his left arm went numb for about eight seconds. "I was looking at these extraordinary murals on the walls, and I suddenly felt my entire left arm go numb for about eight seconds," the 64-year-old told Entertainment Weekly. "Now, everything turned out to be completely normal, and I am of course grateful that it was not anything more serious." According to the Los Angeles Times, citing an unnamed source, Spacey was taken to a medical center due to health concerns. He was treated by doctors and medical staff, and no problems with his heart were found. The actor returned to the festival later that same night and told the audience that his health was normal. Spacey is working to rebuild his career following a series of legal battles in the United States and the United Kingdom. Most recently, he was found not guilty in July of nine charges of sexual assault in a U.K. trial.

"Ma vaatasin neid erakordseid maalinguid seintel ja äkki tundsin, et kogu mu vasak käsi läks umbes kaheksaks sekundiks tuimaks," rääkis 64-aastane Spacey ajakirjale Entertainment Weekly. "Kõik osutus täiesti tavaliseks ja olen loomulikult tänulik, et see polnud midagi tõsisemat." article_content: Queens Park Rangers (QPR) have opened discussions with Tim Sherwood regarding the club's vacant managerial position after Harry Redknapp resigned on Tuesday due to the need for two knee operations. Sherwood, previously the manager of Tottenham Hotspur, is considered the top choice of Les Ferdinand, who has recently been promoted to director of football by chairman Tony Fernandes. Ferdinand was previously head of football operations and joined QPR in October. Currently, Chris Ramsey and Kevin Bond are in temporary charge of the first team, after Joe Jordan and Glenn Hoddle—both former members of Redknapp’s staff—departed. Bond has expressed a desire to remain with the club and has held talks with Ferdinand about his future role. QPR have yet to earn a single point in eleven away Premier League matches this season. Should talks progress successfully, Sherwood could be appointed in time for the weekend fixture. The departure of Glenn Hoddle, who reportedly had a longstanding disagreement with Sherwood from their time at Tottenham, has cleared the way for Sherwood’s potential appointment. Chairman Tony Fernandes stated the board intends to hire a manager committed to long-term planning, youth development, and giving academy players opportunities. Fernandes remarked, 'We are considering names suggested by fans, and we will conduct at least three interviews. Fan feedback has been incorporated.' Sherwood has been without a club since leaving Tottenham last summer, though he was considered for positions at Crystal Palace and West Bromwich Albion. He is working towards completion of his UEFA Pro Licence with the Football Association of Wales. Ferdinand will now oversee all football operations at QPR and will play a major role in selecting the new manager. The club is focused on developing young talent, as shown by the recent acquisition of Ryan Manning for the Elite Development Squad. This signals a shift away from quick-fix recruitment toward a culture of nurturing ambitious, young players for the club’s future. Ferdinand, a former QPR striker, has expressed enthusiasm for his expanded responsibilities, stressing his commitment to building a long-term positive legacy for the club.

article_content: For Ryan Ferguson and his father Bill, going to the Super Bowl in Glendale, Arizona, is more than just catching a big game—it's a celebration of their fight for justice. Ryan, who comes from Missouri, spent a decade behind bars for a murder he didn’t commit. His father Bill worked tirelessly for years, studying the case, organizing evidence, and reaching out to witnesses to clear his son's name. This journey to the Super Bowl was made possible after Ram Silverman, co-founder of Golden Tickets, learned of their story and generously offered them a free trip. Silverman was inspired by Ryan’s resilience and persistence. Ryan was convicted in 2004 of the 2001 murder of Kent Heitholt, a local sports editor, due to misleading witness statements. Two primary witnesses eventually confessed to lying, leading to Ryan’s exoneration in 2013 after serving ten years in prison. Life after prison brought new challenges for Ryan. He moved to Florida, became a certified personal trainer, and published a book on fitness. Despite being free, he feels uneasy about returning to Columbia, Missouri, because of the stigma and painful memories attached to his case. Football has always brought Ryan and Bill together. Now, the Super Bowl trip offers them a fresh start, helping to make up for the precious years lost. For Bill, the best part is the chance to spend uninterrupted time with his son. While the excitement of the game matters, it's their time together that means the most. Ryan views this experience as something he'll always treasure—a symbol of hope, determination, and the enduring bond between father and son.
translated_content: Ryan Fergusonile ja tema isale Billile tähendab Super Bowlile Glendales, Arizonas minek palju enamat kui lihtsalt suurele mängule kaasaelamist—see tähistab nende õiguse eest võitlemise võitu. Missourist pärit Ryan veetis kümme aastat vanglas mõrva eest, mida ta polnud toime pannud. Tema isa Bill töötas väsimatult aastaid, uurides juhtumit, kogudes tõendeid ja küsitledes tunnistajaid, et poja nimi puhtaks pesta. See Super Bowli reis sai võimalikuks tänu Ram Silvermanile, Golden Ticketsi kaasasutajale, kes kuulis nende lugu ja pakkus lahkelt tasuta reisi. Silvermani inspireeris Ryani vastupidavus ja pühendumus. Ryan mõisteti süüdi 2004. aastal, seoses sporditoimetaja Kent Heitholti 2001. aasta mõrvaga, eksitavate ütluste tõttu. Kaks peamist tunnistajat tunnistasid lõpuks, et nad valetasid, ja Ryan õigeks mõisteti 2013. aastal pärast kümneaastast vangistust. Vanglast vabanedes tuli Ryanil silmitsi seista uute väljakutsetega. Ta kolis Floridasse, sai personaaltreeneriks ja avaldas raamatu füüsilisest vormist. Vabadusest hoolimata tunneb ta end Columbia linnas ebakindlalt, sest juhtumiga seotud taust ja mälestused on endiselt valusad. Jalgpall on alati Ryani ja Billi sidunud. Nüüd annab Super Bowli reis neile võimaluse uuteks algusteks ning aitab tasa teha kaotatud aastaid. Billi jaoks on tähtsaim veeta pojaga kvaliteetaega. Kuigi mäng on põnev, on nende koosveedetud aeg kõige olulisem. Ryan peab seda kogemust väga väärtuslikuks—see sümboliseerib lootust, sihikindlust ja isa ja poja vahelist tugevat sidet, mida ta kunagi ei unusta.

article_content: YouTube and YouTube TV subscribers, particularly NFL fans, are facing major streaming disruptions today. The services are currently experiencing significant lag, and YouTube TV has posted a message on its support page acknowledging widespread buffering issues and stating the technical team is working on a solution. Users are reporting problems like excessive loading times, diminished video quality, and lowered frame rates, and some say the service isn't accessible on devices such as the Nest Hub Max. This outage is especially troublesome for YouTube TV, now the largest live-streaming television service in the U.S., which has grown to over 5 million users—with increasing numbers due to the addition of NFL Sunday Ticket. Unfortunately, there's little that subscribers can do right now but wait for a resolution. In the meantime, options include using an over-the-air antenna if available, exploring alternative streaming providers with trial periods, watching at a sports bar or at a friend's place, or simply spending time outside.

article_content: In response to the Global Fund’s 2014-2015 audit findings that revealed fraudulent practices in Nigeria’s health sector, the administration of President Muhammadu Buhari took firm action to address these issues and restore confidence among international partners. These malpractices, which occurred before Buhari’s tenure, were resolved to the satisfaction of both the administration and the Global Fund, leading to the reinstatement of critical support for Nigeria’s health programmes. Buhari’s government developed and fully implemented a comprehensive 12-point action plan. Key measures included the refund of $5.8 million in recoverable funds identified by the Office of the Inspector General (OIG), alongside the prosecution of staff involved in fraudulent activities and the recovery of misappropriated assets. A Memorandum of Understanding was signed between the Global Fund, the EFCC, and the Federal Ministry of Health to facilitate these efforts. Further steps focused on institutional and financial reforms. New programme management units were established in government principal recipient offices, fiscal agents were engaged to safeguard procurement and financial management, and partnerships with international organizations such as Family Health International (FHI360) and CRS were expanded to strengthen HIV and malaria treatment efforts. Improvements in grant governance and coordination mechanisms were introduced, making management more inclusive by involving key populations, gender, and state representatives. Financial management systems for NACA and NMEP were enhanced, and grant implementation resumed in July 2017 with a renewed focus on policy and oversight. On a broader scale, increased domestic resource mobilization was achieved through the allocation of 1% of the national budget to the health sector, the creation of the HIV Trust Fund, and reforms to the National Health Insurance Authority. Nigeria also fulfilled its commitment to provide antiretroviral therapy (ART) to 50,000 people living with HIV. The administration undertook significant procurement reforms by using international competitive processes for the purchase of HIV, TB, and malaria health products, ensuring value for money and efficiency. In infrastructure and economic development, the Buhari administration completed key projects in Edo State, including reviving the Itakpe-Ajaokuta-Warri railway project (commissioned in 2020 after decades of neglect), commissioning housing and business facilities, and supporting the growth of MSMEs. Major energy projects such as the Azura Power Plant and modular refineries were also completed and launched, boosting local economies. This article rebuts criticism by columnist Sonala Olumhense, asserting that President Buhari’s leadership brought tangible improvements to Nigeria’s health sector and infrastructure, particularly in Edo State. The writer contends that attacks on Buhari’s record overlook his administration’s achievements. Garba Shehu is the spokesperson for Former President Muhammadu Buhari.

Need väärteod toimusid enne Buhari ametiaega ning lahendati nii administratsiooni kui Global Fundi rahuloluks, mis viis olulise toe taastamiseni Nigeeria tervishoiuprogrammidele. Buhari valitsus töötas välja ja viis täielikult ellu põhjaliku 12-punktilise tegevuskava. Oluliste meetmetena maksti tagasi 5,8 miljonit dollarit tuvastatud tagasinõutavat raha, kuritegudes osalenud töötajad said karistada ning nende varad võeti tagasi. Global Fondi, EFCC ja Tervishoiuministeeriumi vahel sõlmiti vastav vastastikuse mõistmise memorandum. Edasised sammud keskendusid institutsionaalsetele ja finantsreformidele. Valitsusasutuste juhtkontoritesse loodi uued projektijuhtimise üksused, hankemenetluste ja finantsjuhtimise turvalisuse suurendamiseks kaasati fiskaalagendid ning HIVi ja malaariatõrje tõhustamiseks laiendati koostööd rahvusvaheliste organisatsioonidega nagu Family Health International (FHI360) ja CRS. Tervishoiutoetuste koordineerimist ja juhtimist parandati, kaasates juhtimisse võtmeisikuid, sugude ja osariikide esindajaid. NACA ja NMEP finantsjuhtimissüsteemid muudeti paremaks ning alates juulist 2017 jätkus toetuste rakendamine, keskendudes poliitikale ja järelevalvele. Laiemas plaanis suurendati sisemaisi tervishoiuinvesteeringuid, suunates 1% riigieelarvest tervishoidu, luues HIVi usaldusfondi ning reformides riikliku tervisekindlustuse ameti tööd. Nigeeria täitis oma kohustuse tagada 50 000 HIVi põdevale inimesele antiretroviirusravi (ART). Valitsus viis ellu olulised hankereformid, kasutades HIVi, tuberkuloosi ja malaariaga seotud toodete ostmisel rahvusvahelisi konkurentsimehhanisme, tagades efektiivsuse ja hea hinna-kvaliteedi suhte. Taristu ja majandusarengu valdkonnas viidi Edo osariigis lõpule olulised projektid – muu hulgas taaskäivitati Itakpe-Ajaokuta-Warri raudtee (avati taas 2020. aastal pärast aastakümneid seismist), avati elamu- ja ärirajatised ning toetati väikeettevõtlust. Tõuke majandusele andsid ka Azura elektrijaama ja modulaarsete rafineerimistehaste käivitumine. Artikkel lükkab tagasi kolumnist Sonala Olumhense kriitika, väites, et president Buhari juhtimisel toimusid märkimisväärsed edusammud tervishoius ja taristuehituses, eriti Edo osariigis. Autor leiab, et rünnakud Buhari tegevuse vastu jätavad tema saavutused tähelepanuta. Garba Shehu on endise presidendi Muhammadu Buhari pressiesindaja.

article_content: Barcelona FC faces a long period without making major signings after FIFA upheld a ban preventing the club from registering new players until January 2016. This penalty was imposed because Barcelona violated rules about signing under-18 international players. The club announced plans to appeal the decision to the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS), arguing the ban undermines their values and the reputation of their famed youth academy, La Masia. In a public statement, Barcelona emphasized their intention to defend their position through the highest sporting authority, labeling FIFA’s sanction as contrary to their developmental philosophy. With the current transfer window still open until September 1, Barcelona has moved to reinforce its squad before the restriction takes effect. The most notable transfer is Uruguayan striker Luis Suarez, acquired from Liverpool for around $128.5 million. Suarez is currently serving a suspension for biting Italy’s Giorgio Chiellini at the World Cup. Barcelona has also added Belgian defender Thomas Vermaelen from Arsenal for €25 million, French defender Jeremy Mathieu from Valencia, Chilean goalkeeper Claudio Bravo from Real Sociedad, Croatian midfielder Ivan Rakitic from Sevilla for $23.9 million, and Alen Halilovic from Dinamo Zagreb for $3 million.

See karistus määrati, kuna Barcelona rikkus rahvusvaheliste alla 18-aastaste mängijate üleminekureegleid. Klubi teatas, et kavatseb otsuse edasi kaevata Spordiarbitraažikohtusse (CAS), väites, et keeld kahjustab nende väärtusi ja kuulsa noorteakadeemia La Masia mainet. Avalikus avalduses rõhutas Barcelona oma kavatsust oma seisukohta kõrgeimas spordiorganis kaitsta, nimetades FIFA sanktsiooni nende arendusfilosoofiaga vastuolus olevaks. Kuna praegune üleminekuaken on avatud kuni 1. septembrini, kasutas Barcelona võimalust meeskonda enne piirangu jõustumist tugevdada. Kõige silmapaistvam täiendus on Uruguay ründaja Luis Suarez, kes osteti Liverpoolist umbes 128,5 miljoni dollari eest. article_content: A dog shelter was required to return a lurcher abandoned at the Glastonbury Festival to her owners after rescue workers said there was 'no other option.' The female lurcher, nicknamed Dolly after country singer Dolly Parton offered to adopt her, was discovered cowering among 5,000 abandoned tents on the festival site at Worthy Farm, Somerset. Shelter staff expressed disbelief and anger at the dog's neglect, but after seeking legal advice, had to return Dolly when her foreign owners came forward. The RSPCA confirmed legal advice had been sought before the handover, stating they were left with no alternative once the owners claimed her. Dolly, cared for in the meantime by Happy Landings animal shelter in Pylle, Somerset, has now been reunited with her owners, although the shelter remains unsure how she ended up at the festival, which has a no-pets policy. A Happy Landings spokesperson stated: 'Although we had concerns and unanswered questions, we were legally obliged to return her.' 'The RSPCA pursued all possible legal avenues. Dolly was happy to see her owners, and there were tears all around.' 'We passed on her medication, and the owner will continue a care programme started here, which will be monitored.' The shelter thanked supporters for their donations, which allowed treatment for Dolly without taking resources from other rescues. Shelter staff acknowledged public disappointment but maintained they sought legal advice and had no choice. According to Rolling Stone magazine, Dolly Parton confirmed the dog had been reunited with owners who had reported her missing but struggled due to a language barrier. For five days, the Glastonbury site hosted 175,000 people; after it ended, tractors with magnetic strips were used to collect tent pegs. Staff do not know how Dolly entered the festival, as pets are not allowed. Dolly Parton offered to adopt Dolly if her real owners could not be found, but Rolling Stone confirms she has now been returned. Ms. Parton said: 'We got a call that the true owners came forward. They had reported the dog missing but there was a language barrier. I think they were from another country. They got the dog back, and everyone feels good about it. The Happy Landings shelter has a happy ending now.'
translated_content: Koeravarjupaik pidi Glastonbury festivali juures hüljatud hurt Dolly seaduslikult omanikele tagastama, kuna päästetöötajatel polnud muud valikut. Emane hurt, kellele anti nimeks Dolly pärast seda, kui kantrimuusik Dolly Parton pakkus teda adopteerida, leiti 5 000 mahajäetud telgi hulgast Somersetis, Worthy Farmi festivalialalt. Varjupaiga töötajad väljendasid nördimust ja pahameelt looma hooletusse jätmise üle, kuid pärast juriidilise nõu küsimist tuli Dolly tagastada, kui tema välismaised omanikud välja ilmusid. RSPCA kinnitas, et enne loovutamist küsiti juriidilist nõu ning nad jäid seaduslikult hätta, kui omanikud koera nõudsid. Senikaua hoolitses Dolly eest Happy Landings loomade varjupaik Pylle'is, Somersetis, kuid varjupaiga töötajad pole endiselt kindlad, kuidas koer festivalile sattus, kuna seal kehtib lemmikloomade keeld. Happy Landings'i pressiesindaja ütles: 'Kuigi meil olid mured ja vastuseta küsimused, olime seaduslikult kohustatud ta tagastama.' 'RSPCA tegi kõik võimaliku seadusandluse raames. Dolly oli omanikke nähes õnnelik ning kõik olid väga liigutatud.' 'Andsime käest ka Dolly ravimite kuuri ning omanik jätkab varjupaigas alustatud hooldusprogrammi, mille üle peetakse järelevalvet.' Varjupaik tänas toetajaid ja annetajaid, kelle abil sai Dolly ravi rahastatud ning see ei võtnud ressursse teiste loomade hoolduselt. Töötajad mõistavad avalikkuse pettumust, kuid rõhutavad, et nad otsisid juriidilist nõu ega saanud muud teha. Ajalehe Rolling Stone andmetel kinnitas Dolly Parton, et koer anti päris omanikele tagasi—need olid küll koera kadumisest teada andnud, kuid tekkisid keelebarjäärid. Viis päeva elas Glastonbury festivalil kokku 175 000 inimest; festivali lõpus kasutasid korraldajad magnetribaga traktoreid telgivaiade korjamiseks. Töötajad ei tea siiani, kuidas Dolly festivalile sattus, kuna loomad pole seal lubatud. Dolly Parton pakkus, et adopteerib Dolly, kui päris omanike leidmine ebaõnnestub, kuid Rolling Stone'i andmetel on koer nüüdseks tagastatud. Dolly Parton ütles: 'Meile helistati ja öeldi, et päris omanikud astusid välja. Nad olid koera kadumisest teada andnud, kuid nende jaoks oli keelebarjäär. Usun, et nad olid teisest riigist. Koer sai tagasi koju ja kõik tunnevad end nüüd hästi. Happy Landingsi varjupaigal on nüüd õnnelik lõpp.'

article_content: On Wednesday, Governor Nathan Deal signed Georgia's Safe Carry Protection Act (House Bill 60) into law. While many gun rights advocates support the legislation, it may create unintended challenges for law enforcement, local governments, and the citizens they serve. The changes in Georgia's gun laws were intended to balance the rights of gun owners with the government's responsibility to ensure public safety. However, some provisions may have consequences that do not enhance safety. For example, imagine enjoying a pleasant day at a local park when you notice someone wearing a heavy winter coat with a handgun visible at their waist. Feeling concerned, you might consider calling the police. Yet, starting July 1, Georgia law enforcement officers may be limited in their ability to respond. Under the revised Safe Carry Protection Act, police cannot detain someone just to ask about a weapons carry license, and they might face lawsuits if they do. Regarding convicted felons, while they are still prohibited from possessing firearms in Georgia, exceptions may exist for cases of self-defense. This creates ambiguity, as using a firearm in self-defense requires possessing it in the first place. The law may also increase costs for local governments and taxpayers. Previously, cities could prohibit weapons in government buildings simply by posting signs; now, they must employ security personnel to screen building entrances. This added security is funded by taxpayers. Furthermore, if a police officer is sued for requesting a carry permit, the municipality may be responsible for covering the legal defense, again at taxpayer expense. Additionally, these changes may discourage some citizens from visiting government offices due to increased screening. While the revised law increases gun owners' rights, it also creates practical concerns for law enforcement and local government. As a police chief, my primary concern remains the safety of our residents. Police officers are sworn to protect and serve, and this new law makes our jobs more challenging.
translated_content: Kolmapäeval allkirjastas kuberner Nathan Deal Georgia relvakandmise seaduse ehk Safe Carry Protection Act’i (House Bill 60). Kuigi paljud relvaõiguste pooldajad toetavad seda seadust, võib see tekitada ootamatuid raskusi õiguskaitseorganitele, kohalikele omavalitsustele ja elanikele. Georgia relvaseaduse muudatuste eesmärk oli tasakaalustada relvaomanike õigusi ja valitsuse kohustust tagada avalik turvalisus. Siiski võivad mõned sätted kaasa tuua tagajärgi, mis ei paranda turvalisust. Näiteks kujuta ette, et naudid mõnusat päeva kohalikus pargis ja märkad kedagi, kellel on seljas paks talvemantel ja vööl nähtav käsirelv. Kui tunned muret, võid kaaluda politsei kutsumist. article_content: Authorities in Seminole County apprehended Victor Tate, a 30-year-old man from Lake Mary, after an unusual police chase. Deputies reportedly tried to pull Tate over for speeding on State Road 434 in Longwood, but he accelerated, reaching approximately 90 mph and driving recklessly through traffic. The pursuit ended when Tate crashed into another vehicle at an intersection on Lake Way Road and Greenwood Boulevard. After the collision, Tate exited his car and attempted to escape on foot by running into a nearby apartment complex. However, a police helicopter tracking the scene noted a vivid detail — Tate’s bright red underwear was highly visible. This distinctive flash of color allowed officers in the helicopter to keep an eye on him easily as he fled. Shortly after fleeing, Tate was apprehended by deputies behind an apartment building and was taken into custody without further incident. He faces several charges, including fleeing and eluding, reckless driving, possession of cocaine, possession of marijuana with intent to sell, and driving without a valid license. The Seminole County Sheriff’s Office shared details and a helicopter video of the incident on their Facebook page, highlighting how the suspect’s red underwear assisted law enforcement in tracking him during the chase.

Politsei helikopter märkas silmatorkavat üksikasja — Tate’i erksavärvilised punased aluspüksid olid hästi nähtavad. See eripärane värvilaik aitas helikopteri ametnikel põgenevat meest lihtsalt jälgida. Varsti pärast põgenemist pidasid korrakaitsjad Tate’i kortermajade taga kinni ning ta võeti vahejuhtumiteta vahi alla. Talle esitati mitmeid süüdistusi, sealhulgas põgenemine ja politsei eiramine, hooletu juhtimine, kokaiini omamine, marihuaana müügiks hoidmine ning ilma kehtiva juhiloata sõitmine. Seminole’i maakonna šerifi büroo jagas juhtunust üksikasju ja helikopteri videot oma Facebooki lehel, rõhutades, kuidas Tate’i punased aluspüksid aitasid politseinikel teda jälituse ajal silma peal hoida.

article_content: Hamas released two elderly Israeli women, Yocheved Lifshitz (85) and Nurit Cooper (79), from captivity in Gaza on Monday. The International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) confirmed their release, citing humanitarian and health reasons. The negotiations involved mediators from Qatar and Egypt. Earlier, two American citizens, Judith and Natalie Raanan, were freed following Qatar’s diplomatic efforts. The October 7 Hamas attack on southern Israel resulted in over 200 hostages being taken and more than 1,400 people killed, mostly civilians. This spurred widespread appeals—including from Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and international organizations—for the immediate and unconditional release of all captives. Negotiation claims remain contested: Hamas says Israel turned down previous offers for additional releases, a claim Israel denies and attributes to propaganda purposes. With Israel preparing a possible ground operation in Gaza, relatives of the hostages are torn—some advocate for negotiations or prisoner exchanges to save lives, while others prioritize military action against Hamas. Meanwhile, the US is urging Israel to delay any land assault to increase the chances of freeing more hostages. At the same time, global criticism mounts over Israel’s intensive airstrikes and limits on basic necessities in Gaza, which have devastated neighborhoods and put 2.3 million Palestinians in a severe humanitarian crisis. Local authorities report the death toll from Israeli strikes now exceeds 5,000.

article_content:
Although dogs are often called humanity's best friends, Australia's wild dingoes have long suffered a negative reputation. However, researchers from The Australian National University and The University of Western Australia have uncovered evidence that this was not always the case. Their new study suggests that before European colonization, First Nations people both domesticated dingoes and gave them burial rites.

At the Curracurrang archaeological site, south of Sydney, scientists used radiocarbon dating on dingo remains and found that dingoes were buried alongside humans as far back as 2,000 years ago. According to lead researcher Dr. Loukas Koungoulos, the specific care taken with these burials indicates a much closer relationship between people and dingoes than previously understood. He explains, "Not all camp dingoes were given burial rites, but where such burials are found, their methods are nearly identical to human ones in the same areas. This reflects the close bond between people and dingoes, and their almost-human status."

Further evidence of domestication comes from severely worn dingo teeth at the site, indicating they consumed large bones—likely left over from human meals. Remains were found of dingoes varying in age, from pups to animals up to six or eight years old. Researchers argue this shows First Nations people had deeper, long-term relationships with dingoes, rather than only caring for them as young animals before they returned to the wild.

"These findings are an important step in understanding the relationship between Australia's First Peoples and dingoes," said co-author Professor Susan O'Connor. "By the time Europeans arrived, the bond between Indigenous people and dingoes was well established, as recognized by Indigenous communities and historical observers. Our research shows these ties pre-date colonization and were more enduring than the short-lived relationships noted during colonial times."

The study appears in the journal PLOS One.
translated_content:
Kuigi koeri peetakse sageli inimese parimateks sõpradeks, on Austraalia metsikud dingod pikka aega kandnud halba mainet. Nüüd on Austraalia Riikliku Ülikooli ja Lääne-Austraalia Ülikooli teadlased leidnud tõendeid selle kohta, et alati pole see nii olnud. Uus uuring näitab, et enne Euroopa koloniseerimist kodustasid põlisrahvad dingosid ja pidasid neile matuserituaale.

Curracurrangi arheoloogilises leiukohas Sydney lõunaosas kasutasid teadlased radiosüsiniku meetodit dingo säilmete uurimiseks ning leidsid, et dingosid maeti inimeste kõrvale juba 2000 aastat tagasi. Juhtivteadlane dr Loukas Koungoulos selgitab, et nende matuste puhul üles näidatud hool viitab palju lähedasemale suhtele inimeste ja dingode vahel, kui varem usuti. Ta ütles: "Kõiki laagridingosid ei maetud, kuid kui selliseid matuseid esineb, on nende läbiviimise viisid peaaegu identsed kohalikele inimeste matustele. See peegeldab inimeste ja dingode tihedat sidet ning nende peaaegu inimlikku staatust."

Lisatõendeid kodustamise kohta pakuvad leiukohalt leitud tugevalt kulunud dingo hambad, mis viitavad sellele, et nad sõid suuri luid – tõenäoliselt inimeste toidujäätmeid. Leiukohast leiti erinevas vanuses dingode luid, kutsikatest kuni kuue-kaheksa aastaste loomadeni. Teadlased väidavad, et see näitab põlisrahvaste ja dingode vahel sügavamaid ja pikaajalisemaid suhteid, mitte ainult hoolitsemist noorte loomade eest enne nende naasmist loodusesse.

"Need leiud on oluline samm Austraalia põlisrahvaste ja dingode vahelise suhte mõistmisel," ütles kaasautor professor Susan O'Connor. "Eurooplaste saabumise ajaks oli nende vaheline side juba hästi välja kujunenud, nii nagu põlisrahvad ise ja ajaloolised vaatlejad on täheldanud. Meie uuring näitab, et sellised suhted olid olemas juba enne koloniseerimist ning olid palju kauakestvamad kui kolonialajal täheldatud lühiajalised sidemed."

Uuring on avaldatud ajakirjas PLOS One.

A recent survey has highlighted some of the most unusual names owners have given their cats and dogs. Names like Chicken-Fish and Pickywickywoowoo featured among the top 20 most bizarre pet names. For cats, unique names such as Princess Maisie Dolores, Strawberry Surprise, and Mister Fuzzy Mittens stood out, while dogs sported distinctive monikers like Toe-Jam, Chicken-Fish, and Towpath Tidy. 

The Battersea Dogs and Cats Home compiled this list after asking its 225,000 Facebook and Twitter followers to share the strangest pet names they knew. While 'Charlie' was the UK's most popular name for dogs and cats last year, many owners are now embracing originality when naming their pets. 

Rob Young, operations manager at Battersea, commented, 'Just remember you may need to shout it out in the garden or at the park.' Since Battersea cares for about 9,000 dogs and cats each year—roughly half of which are strays—staff often have to create new names themselves, sometimes drawing inspiration from their top 20 list. Some current residents include an Anatolian shepherd cross named Senor Snuggles and a cat called Cuddle Bear. 'We have to be quite imaginative,' added Rob.

Kasside seas torkasid silma sellised nimed nagu Princess Maisie Dolores, Strawberry Surprise ja Mister Fuzzy Mittens, samas kui koertel olid eripärased nimed nagu Toe-Jam, Chicken-Fish ja Towpath Tidy.

Praeguste elanike seas on näiteks Anatoolia lambakoera segu Senor Snuggles ja kass nimega Cuddle Bear. "Me peame olema päris leidlikud," lisas Rob.

article_content: Donald Sheldon, who is about to turn 90, is suing a Washington state dementia-care facility after his wife, Norma Sheldon, died from hypothermia. Because of his age, he has asked the court to speed up his testimony, saying he may not live to see the trial’s conclusion. The couple was married for 69 years. Norma Sheldon, 88, died in an enclosed courtyard at Canterbury Gardens Alzheimer's Care Center in Longview, Washington, on December 28, when temperatures were 28 degrees Fahrenheit. Donald Sheldon says the lawsuit is not for financial reasons, but to prevent similar incidents from happening to others. He mentioned in court documents that several of his friends died soon after losing their spouses. Records from the facility indicate that the required midnight bed check did not occur, and Norma was not missed until after 1 a.m. Donald Sheldon shared memories of his wife, recalling how they never fought and how he treasures their many years together. He said he remembers the first time he saw her and keeps her memory alive in his mind. According to The Daily News, state investigators found violations at the care home, including doors lacking alarms. Canterbury Gardens officials have expressed sorrow about the tragedy and are working with the Department of Social and Health Services to resolve the issues. The care center is located in Longview, about 35 miles from Portland, Oregon.

Oma vanuse tõttu on ta palunud kohtul kiirendada oma ütluste andmist, kuna ta võib kohtuprotsessi lõppu mitte ära oodata. article_content: FIFA is on the verge of selecting the host countries for the 2018 and 2022 World Cup finals—an honor with significant economic, political, and cultural effects. As one of the world's largest sporting events, the World Cup rivals only the Olympics in scope, generating billions for host nations and boosting national morale. Given these high stakes, the bidding process has involved extensive, often costly campaigns by nations keen to secure the tournaments. These campaigns have been overshadowed by persistent allegations of vote-rigging and corruption, making this the most scrutinized and controversial World Cup bidding in history. Countries invest substantial political and economic resources in their bids. Since the first modest tournament in Uruguay in 1930, the World Cup has grown into a global phenomenon, attracting immense television audiences. For example, in 2010, viewership from South Africa may have surpassed even the Beijing Olympic opening ceremony. National pride is also at stake—during the 2010 semi-final, 40% of Germany watched their team play, while up to 90% of the Netherlands viewed their team in the final. Hosting the World Cup can have lasting effects. The 1998 and 2010 tournaments in France and South Africa were praised for uniting diverse populations, while the 2006 event helped transform Germany’s global image. Governments now see economic opportunity as the main incentive: Germany reportedly gained €150 million from 2006, and hosting in England could bring in $4.7 billion. For bid teams like Qatar, hosting would provide global recognition rather than direct financial reward. The competition for 2018 is intense, with all bids coming from Europe. England has the highest technical rating and a globally popular soccer league, but its bid has suffered due to internal and external allegations of corruption. Russia, though scoring lower in technical assessments, has pledged significant investment and opens new markets for FIFA. Joint bids—such as Spain-Portugal and Holland-Belgium—face logistical and economic hurdles, but rumors of vote-swapping have kept their chances alive. For 2022, the USA is considered the favorite, aiming to build on the popularity jump since hosting in 1994. Australia’s strong Olympic track record demonstrates its organizational ability, but soccer’s relatively low domestic popularity and disputes with other sports organizations present challenges. Qatar, despite its small size and harsh climate, has proposed innovative technology to cool stadiums and promised a lasting legacy in the Middle East. Japan and South Korea both submit solo bids, but face skepticism within FIFA. Recent tensions between North and South Korea have dampened hopes that the tournament could help reunite the peninsula. Campaigns have featured major figures from politics and entertainment: England presented Prime Minister David Cameron, Prince William, and David Beckham. The USA’s bid features Bill Clinton and Morgan Freeman, Russia’s may include Prime Minister Vladimir Putin, and Qatar’s supporters include Pep Guardiola and Zinedine Zidane. Australia’s media campaigns have involved Nicole Kidman and potentially Kylie Minogue and Elle Macpherson. The bidding process has become known for controversy. By choosing to decide both World Cup hosts simultaneously, FIFA has been accused of encouraging deals between bidding nations. Media investigations by the Sunday Times and BBC have revealed evidence of vote-selling and bribery involving several FIFA officials. Amos Adamu and Reynald Temarii were suspended over corruption allegations, and others have been implicated. These scandals could harm bids, particularly England’s, by creating divisions within FIFA. With so much in flux, the winner is difficult to predict and an upset may be in store.

Üks maailma suurimaid spordiüritusi konkureerib mastaabis vaid olümpiaga, tuues korraldajamaadele miljardeid ja tõstes rahvuslikku moraali. Katar, hoolimata oma väiksusest ja kuumast kliimast, pakub tehnoloogilisi uuendusi, et jahutada staadione, lubades MM-ile jäävat pärandit kogu Lähis-Idas. article_content: A couple of years ago, we shared a four-minute video featuring artist, actor, dancer, and choreographer Smac McCreanor, who creates interpretive dance inspired by hydraulic presses crushing objects. Smac—also known as 'Hydraulic Press Girl'—continues to produce these captivating and clever videos. You can view her content on TikTok, Facebook, or YouTube. Included here is a 15-minute video she posted last year to celebrate her 100th press. Her performances stand out because her costumes and dance moves perfectly match the items being crushed. While all her enactments are impressive, a personal favorite is her 'avocado' press routine. Sarah 'Smac' McCreanor is an Australian artist, actress, dancer, choreographer, content creator, and set designer based in Los Angeles. Her work is recognized for its slapstick physicality, offbeat performance art, and signature Australian charm. Her popular series, 'Hydraulic Press Girl,' currently boasts 135 episodes and has earned over 1 billion views. In 2022, Smac was honored as an inaugural member of META's 'Creators of Tomorrow' for Creative Excellence, included in Adweek's Creative Top 100, and featured as a video artist at TED Talk 2022. She looks forward to the debut of her first major art exhibition, 'Hydraulic Press Girl,' at the National Gallery of Victoria's 2023 Triennial Contemporary Art Exhibit.

Japanese star pitcher Yoshinobu Yamamoto has been posted by the Orix Buffaloes and is now available for Major League Baseball teams to sign. Starting Tuesday, MLB clubs have until 5 p.m. EST on Jan. 4 to negotiate with the 25-year-old right-hander, following official notifications from Nippon Professional Baseball and MLB to all 30 teams.

The Yankees are considered front-runners to sign Yamamoto, but they face strong competition from other teams, including the Mets, whose owner Steve Cohen is known for substantial player investments, as well as the Angels, Dodgers, and potentially the Cubs. Unlike their previous high-profile signing of Masahiro Tanaka, this year’s bidding is expected to be even more competitive and expensive.

Yamamoto boasts an exceptional record after completing his age-25 season with a 17-6 record and a 1.16 ERA in 24 starts, totaling 70 wins in seven years in Japan. Yankees general manager Brian Cashman demonstrated his interest by attending Yamamoto’s no-hitter in Japan this September.

If the Yankees secure Yamamoto, he could fill the number two starter position behind Gerrit Cole, and possibly share ace duties as a two-time Pacific League MVP. This would move Carlos Rodon and Nestor Cortes down the rotation, potentially relieving pressure—especially after Rodon’s challenging first season in New York.

Negotiations may be intricate since Yamamoto’s agent, Joel Wolfe, also represents Yankees slugger Giancarlo Stanton. While Cashman’s recent remarks about Stanton’s injury history created some friction with Wolfe, Cashman has said that their relationship is now in a good place.

The Yankees' history with Japanese pitchers has been mixed. Masahiro Tanaka made a significant impact, particularly in the 2017 playoffs, and Hiroki Kuroda provided stability during his tenure. Conversely, Kei Igawa and Hideki Irabu were less successful after highly anticipated signings.

Despite past challenges, the Yankees remain a strong contender for Yamamoto and are expected to face more competition in this pursuit than in previous years.

article_content: Igor Girkin, a prominent pro-war blogger and former FSB officer who led pro-Russian separatists in eastern Ukraine in 2014, has announced he plans to challenge Vladimir Putin in Russia’s presidential election scheduled for next March. Girkin is currently incarcerated on extremism charges, which he denies, but says his intention is to challenge what he considers a prearranged election. In a message shared on Telegram, Girkin (also known as Strelkov) likened participating in the presidential race to 'playing cards with cheaters.' He wants to unify patriotic groups in opposition to the Kremlin’s plans and urged his supporters to set up a campaign office and gather signatures, despite being aware that he is unlikely to be approved for the ballot. His supporters told Reuters that while his court proceedings have been prolonged until December 18, he could, in theory, still run for office as long as he remains unconvicted. Girkin could face up to five years in jail if found guilty. He was also convicted in absentia by a Dutch court for his role in the 2014 downing of Malaysia Airlines flight MH17, which killed 298 people. Since Russia’s intensified offensive in Ukraine began in February 2022, Girkin has been highly vocal, severely criticizing the Russian military's tactics and warning of possible revolution or civil war without significant improvement. His arrest in July followed a broader crackdown on nationalist critics, a campaign that escalated after Wagner group leader Yevgeny Prigozhin’s failed revolt in June. Prigozhin died in August in an unexplained plane accident. President Putin has yet to officially declare his intentions for the election, but Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov recently expressed hope that he will run. Putin was president from 2000–2008, returned to office in 2012, and recent constitutional changes could allow him to stay in power until 2036 if re-elected.

Putin oli president aastatel 2000–2008, naasis ametisse 2012. aastal ning põhiseaduse muudatused võimaldavad tal valituks osutudes võimul olla vähemalt aastani 2036.

article_content: Grimes, the singer whose legal name is Claire Boucher, made extensive efforts to serve Elon Musk, the father of her three children, with custody papers, according to court records obtained by Insider. She is seeking physical custody of their children after disputes over care, reporting in Texas court filings in October that Musk had custody of their three-year-old son, X Æ A-Xii, ‘over [her] objection.’ Grimes’ petition followed Musk quietly filing a lawsuit to ‘establish the parent-child relationship’ with their children. Court papers show that Grimes’ legal team filed a supplemental proof of service last Friday, detailing repeated and unsuccessful attempts to serve Musk personally. As a result, the documents were delivered by substituted service—handed to staff at Musk’s companies and a property associated with him. As of Thursday, Musk had not officially responded to the custody lawsuit. Grimes hired four process servers, who tried to locate Musk between October 13 and October 20 at over a dozen locations, including X’s headquarters in San Francisco, SpaceX’s launch site in Boca Chica, Tesla’s Gigafactory in Austin, and several addresses linked to Musk near Austin. One process server went to a horse farm connected to Musk but was told by a woman there, ‘Nope, not here.’ Efforts even included tracking Musk’s private jets to determine his location. Two servers also tried to serve Musk at the home of Shivon Zilis, a Neuralink director and mother of two of Musk’s children, but someone at the house denied knowing him. Despite their efforts, process servers could not serve Musk personally and were turned away by security staff at Tesla and X, as well as by a police officer in Boca Chica. The papers were ultimately left with staff at X, Tesla, and SpaceX. In her filings, Grimes stated that handing her complaint to Musk’s security at X constitutes adequate service. Family lawyer Christopher Melcher told Insider that Grimes’ attempts surpassed the standard required under California law, and substitute service is generally acceptable for high-profile individuals if direct service is not possible. Melcher added that, after substitute service was completed on October 20, Musk would typically have until November 29 to respond. He noted that effective service is important because certain legal restrictions, like prohibiting children from being moved out of California, start only once service is made. Melcher predicted that Musk’s likely next step is to request the custody case be heard in Texas rather than California. This dispute over jurisdiction could leave both parties in legal uncertainty for months. Neither Musk’s nor Grimes’ legal representatives responded to Insider’s requests for comment. Musk and Grimes started their relationship in 2018 and ended it in 2021 but continued to co-parent. They had a daughter in 2021 and a son via surrogate in 2022. After their breakup, Grimes lived with Musk in Austin for a period. Tensions surfaced publicly in September 2023 when Grimes posted and quickly deleted a message on X, asking to see her son and for Musk to respond to her lawyer, following a photo of Musk with Shivon Zilis. Musk has ten known living children with three women, including his youngest, Techno Mechanicus (Tau), born via surrogate with Grimes in 2022.
translated_content: Laulja Grimes, kodanikunimega Claire Boucher, tegi märkimisväärseid pingutusi, et toimetada oma kolme lapse isale Elon Muskile hooldusõiguse dokumendid kätte, selgub Insideri poolt hangitud kohtudokumentidest. Grimes taotleb laste füüsilist hooldusõigust pärast vaidlusi ning märkis oktoobris Texase kohtusse esitatud dokumentides, et Musk hoidis nende kolmeaastast poega X Æ A-Xii’d ‘tema tahte vastaselt’. Grimesi nõue järgnes Muski vaiksele hagi esitamisele, et ‘kehtestada vanema ja lapse suhe’ nende lastega. Kohtupaberite järgi esitas Grimesi õigusmeeskond möödunud reedel täiendava tõendi, milles kirjeldati arvukaid, kuid edutuid isiklikke kättetoimetamiskatseid. Lõpuks anti dokumendid asenduslikult üle Muski ettevõtete töötajatele ja talle seotud kinnistu personalile. Neljapäevaks polnud Musk ametlikult hooldusõiguse hagile vastanud. Grimes palkas neli kohtutäiturit, kes püüdsid Muski leida 13.–20. oktoobril enam kui tosinast kohast, sealhulgas X-i peakontorist San Franciscos, SpaceXi Boca Chica stardipaigast Texases, Tesla Austin Gigafactryst ning mitmelt Austiniga seotud aadressilt. Üks kohtutäituritest käis isegi Muskiga seotud hobusetalus, kuid seal öeldi neile: ‘Siin teda pole.’ Katsete hulka kuulusid ka Muski eralennukite jälgimine tema võimaliku asukoha selgitamiseks. Kaks täiturit püüdsid dokumente edastada ka Shivon Zilise kodus – Neuralinki direktorile ja kahe Muski lapse emale –, kuid keegi ust avanust ütles, et ei tunne Muski. Vaatamata korduvatele katsetele ei õnnestunud täituritel Muskile dokumente isiklikult anda ja neid tõrjuti turvatöötajate ning Boca Chica politsei poolt. Lõpuks jäeti dokumendid töötajatele X-is, Teslas ja SpaceXis. Oma avalduses nimetas Grimes Muski turvatöötajale X-is kaebuse üleandmist piisavaks kättetoimetustõendiks. Perekonnaõiguse advokaat Christopher Melcher ütles Insiderile, et Grimesi jõupingutused ületasid California seadusega tavapäraselt nõutava ning kõrgetasemeliste inimeste puhul on asenduskättetoimetamine aktsepteeritav, kui otsene kättetoimetamine on võimatu. Melcher lisas, et pärast 20. oktoobri asenduskättetoimetamist on Muskil tavaliselt aega vastata kuni 29. novembrini. Ta rõhutas, et kättetoimetamise hetk on oluline, kuna mõned kohtu keelud, näiteks laste viimine Californiast välja, hakkavad kehtima alles pärast seda. Melcher prognoosis, et Muski järgmine juriidiline samm on taotleda hooldusõiguse kaasuse pidamist Texases, mitte Californias. See jurisdiktsioonivaidlus võib osapooled jätta kuudeks juriidilisse ebakindlusse. Insideri kommentaaripalvetele ei vastanud ei Muski ega Grimesi esindajad. Musk ja Grimes alustasid suhet 2018. aastal, lõpetasid selle 2021. aastal, kuid jätkasid ühiste laste kasvatamist. Neile sündis tütar 2021. ning poeg asendusema abil 2022. aastal. Pärast lahkuminekut elas Grimes veel mõnda aega Muskiga Austinis. Pinged tulid avalikkuse ette 2023. aasta septembris, kui Grimes postitas ja kustutas kiiresti sõnumi X-is, milles palus luba poega näha ja Muskilt advokaadile vastust, pärast fotot Muskist koos Shivon Zilisega. Muskil on teadaolevalt kümme elavat last kolme naisega, sealhulgas tema noorim, Techno Mechanicus (Tau), kes sündis 2022. aastal Grimesiga asendusema abil.

article_content: A recent report indicates that requests from U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) to detain undocumented immigrants ahead of deportation have dropped sharply over the past two years. According to the Syracuse University study, monthly ICE detainer requests have fallen by about 9,000 since 2012, driven largely by substantial reductions in states like California (55% decrease) and Texas (28% decrease). Nationwide, these changes translate to over 100,000 fewer requests annually. The report comes as President Barack Obama prepares to unveil immigration policy changes that could allow up to five million undocumented immigrants to remain in the United States. Fox News reports that Obama’s plan, potentially rolling out as soon as next Friday, would broaden eligibility for deferred action programs, providing relief from deportation for many who came to the U.S. as children and their families. The proposed rule would also allow some parents of U.S. citizens and lawful permanent residents to stay in the country. At the same time, some Congressional leaders, including House Speaker John Boehner, have not ruled out a government shutdown as a means to oppose the President’s executive actions. Boehner stated that all options were under consideration, emphasizing the Republican priority of challenging Obama’s approach but asserting that a shutdown is not their goal. Despite Senate Republican leader Mitch McConnell’s promise to avoid another shutdown, other party members, like Senator Jeff Sessions, have indicated intentions to use the budget process to block any unilateral immigration reforms. The White House has not yet finalized its decision, with Press Secretary Josh Earnest saying that Obama would announce his plans after returning from his trip to Asia. Among those potentially affected are families like that of Moises Herrera, who could benefit under the new proposals.

Üle riigi tähendab see üle 100 000 võrra vähem taotlust aastas. Raport avaldati ajal, mil president Barack Obama valmistub tutvustama sisserändepoliitika muudatusi, mis võiksid lubada kuni viiel miljonil dokumentideta sisserändajal USA-sse jääda. Fox News teatab, et Obama plaan — mis võib jõustuda juba järgmisel reedel — laiendaks edasi lükatud tegevuse programmidest osavõtjate ringi ning võimaldaks paljudel, kes saabusid riiki lastena koos peredega, saada kaitset väljasaatmise eest. Pakutud muudatus võimaldaks riiki jääda ka USA kodanike ja seaduslike alaliste elanike mõningatel vanematel. Samal ajal pole mitmed Kongressi liidrid, sealhulgas esindajatekoja spiiker John Boehner, välistanud valitsuse sulgemist presidendi täidesaatlike otsuste vastu astumiseks. Boehner sõnas, et kõik variandid on laual, rõhutades vabariiklaste prioriteeti Obama poliitika vaidlustamisel, ent lisades, et valitsuse sulgemine ei ole eesmärk. Vaatamata vabariiklasest senati juhi Mitch McConnelli lubadusele uut sulgemist vältida, on teised parteikaaslased — näiteks senaator Jeff Sessions — avaldanud soovi kasutada eelarveprotsessi, et takistada ühepoolseid sisserändereforme. Valge Maja pole veel oma otsust lõplikult teinud; pressiesindaja Josh Earnesti sõnul avalikustab Obama oma plaanid pärast Aasiast naasmist. Nendest muudatustest võiksid kasu saada ka sellised pered nagu Moises Herrera oma.

article_content: Keith Duell, a 68-year-old retiree from Burley, Hampshire, has spent nearly a week braving the chilly winds at Avon Beach in Christchurch, Dorset, all for a chance to secure a highly coveted beach hut. Keen to treat his wife Christine, who has been experiencing health issues, Keith set up camp early to guarantee he’s first in line when the hut’s lease becomes available on Monday morning. Bundled in multiple layers to keep out the cold, Keith occupies his days reading and chatting with people walking by, enjoying the stunning seaside scenery from his deckchair. At night, he seeks shelter in a small tent – unfazed by the freezing temperatures. Christine, his wife of 43 years, visits daily to boost his spirits and bring him homemade soup. Keith’s family also stops by in the evenings with dinner, making his vigil more comfortable. The beach hut lease, priced at £850 for the April to September season, allows the couple priority renewal in future years. The 6ft by 4ft hut represents not just a practical shelter but a heartfelt gift for Christine – Keith hopes she can enjoy relaxing by the sea regardless of the weather and that their grandchildren will create happy memories there in the summer. Keith describes the local community as welcoming and has enjoyed unexpected moments, like watching foxes at night and spotting a seal in the surf. Despite some onlookers questioning his determination, he’s grateful for the unique experience and sights. To manage daily life during his campout, Keith uses a nearby public restroom for washing and keeps himself busy with books and friendly conversation. In total, 17 other long-term beach hut rentals will be available this year, but those huts require annual renewal.

Mitmekordsetesse riietesse mähitult veedab Keith päevi lugedes ja möödujatega vesteldes, nautides mererannast avanevat vaadet tekilt. Öösiti tõmbub ta tagasi väiksesse telki ega lase külmakraadidel end häirida. Juba 43 aastat abielus olnud Christine külastab meest iga päev, tuues omatehtud suppi ja häid sõnu. Õhtul tuleb ka pere toiduga appi, aidates valvelaagrit mugavamaks muuta. Rannamaja üür maksab aprillist septembrini 850 naela ning annab paarile eelisõiguse järgmistel aastatel kasutust pikendada. 6x4 jala suurune rannamaja pole Keithile lihtsalt praktiline pelgupaik – see on sügav kingitus Christine’ile, kellele ta soovib pakkuda võimalust mere äärde tulla iga ilmaga ning kokku veeta suved koos lapselastega. Keith peab kohalikku kogukonda lahkeks ning naudib ootamatuid hetki: öösiti on ta näinud randadel rebaseid ja hommikul märganud hülgeid vees. Mõned möödujad imestavad tema visaduse üle, kuid Keith hindab seda eriskummalist kogemust. Iga päev kasutab Keith lähedal asuvat avalikku WC-d ning hoiab end tegevuses raamatute lugemise ja möödujatega vestlemisega. Tänavu on veel 17 pikaajalist rannamaja saadaval, kuid nende leping tuleb igal aastal uuendada.

article_content: Severe storms battered south-central Michigan on Sunday, leaving more than 100,000 utility customers without power and causing widespread destruction throughout Battle Creek, officials reported. "Our business corridor and residential areas took the brunt of the storms," stated Mike McKenzie, Battle Creek's emergency services director. "Numerous trees are down on houses and cars, there are extensive power outages, and many local businesses have been damaged." The storms struck Battle Creek late Sunday afternoon, producing wind gusts over 80 mph, McKenzie noted. Despite the significant damage, no major injuries were reported. In Calhoun County, home to Battle Creek, about 29,000 Consumers Power customers lost electricity Sunday evening, said company spokesman Jay Jacobs. Overall, 104,000 utility customers in the state were affected by outages. The severe weather also swept into the Chicago area, prompting the cancellation of 450 flights at O'Hare International Airport, according to a media official. Reporting by CNN's Rick Martin and Greg Morrison.

"Meie ärikoridor ja elamupiirkonnad said tormidest kõige rohkem kannatada," ütles Battle Creeki hädaolukordade teenistuse direktor Mike McKenzie. "Arvukalt puid on langenud majadele ja autodele, ulatuslikud elektrikatkestused ning paljud kohalikud ettevõtted on saanud kahjustada." Torm tabas Battle Creeki hilisel pühapäeva pärastlõunal, tuuleiilid küündisid üle 130 km/h, märkis McKenzie. Vaatamata ulatuslikele kahjudele olulisi vigastusi ei teatatud. Calhouni maakonnas, kus asub Battle Creek, jäi pühapäeva õhtuks elektrita umbes 29 000 Consumers Poweri klienti, ütles ettevõtte esindaja Jay Jacobs. Raporteerisid CNN-i Rick Martin ja Greg Morrison.

article_content: The Michelin Guide has published its newest Bib Gourmand selections just before its upcoming ceremony on November 7. Bib Gourmand honors are reserved for restaurants that serve excellent food at reasonable prices, though they don't receive stars. Michelin's International Director, Gwendal Poullennec, shared enthusiasm for the recognition, noting how these awards highlight the vibrant food scenes in various cities. According to Poullennec, these spots offer delicious dishes at a great price point, making them worthwhile for diners and well-enjoyed by inspectors. This year, 11 restaurants in New York City earned their spot on the Bib Gourmand list, increasing NYC’s total to 102 such listings. The newly recognized venues span an impressive array of styles—including casual vegetarian fare, modern Thai, inventive fusion concepts, and more. Some standout restaurants from the latest list include: - 8282 (Lower East Side): Known for playful Korean flavor pairings, like honey-vanilla cream with Parmesan or creamy burrata joining rice cakes and gochujang chicken. - Agi’s Counter (Brooklyn, Crown Heights): Chef Jeremy Salamon channels his Hungarian roots into a welcoming diner that tempts guests to keep tasting. - Alta Calidad (Brooklyn, Park Slope): Chef showcases crispy tempura shrimp on tortillas and caramelized carne asada topped with cheese for unique Mexican-inspired plates. - C As In Charlie (Greenwich Village): Chef Eric JaeHo Choi combines Southern and Korean influences on a compact menu of creative tapas. - Café Mars (Brooklyn, Gowanus): Co-chefs Paul D’Avino and Jorge Olarte deliver a quirky, nostalgic-modern dining experience. - Flora (Brooklyn, Park Slope): Chefs Emiliano Cammardella and Rossella Episcopo create Italian dishes in a light-filled, rustic-meets-industrial space. - Kru (Brooklyn, Williamsburg): Chefs Ohm Suansilphong and Kiki Supap present contemporary takes on Thai traditional dishes. - Peppercorn Station (Midtown West): The menu features Chinese classics for sharing, such as fish fillet with pickled cabbage and spicy mapo tofu. - Potluck Club (Lower East Side): This lively spot delivers fresh spins on Cantonese classics, including Berkshire pork potstickers and mayonnaise-coated fried shrimp. - Pranakhon (Greenwich Village): Run by Intira and Norapol Youngphitak, Pranakhon evokes Bangkok street-food culture. - Superiority Burger (East Village): A fully vegetarian eatery famed for creative items like sweet-sour beets over jalapeño cream cheese on pretzels. These diverse additions amplify New York’s reputation as a global culinary destination and show the Michelin Guide’s continued celebration of creative, approachable dining.

article_content: Bernie Routledge, the former headteacher of Howell's School, an exclusive girls' boarding school in Denbigh, north Wales, claims he was unfairly dismissed. Routledge allegedly broke his own school's social networking rules by commenting on a Facebook page called the Bernie Routledge Appreciation Society (BRAS), which was set up by students from another school. An employment tribunal in Wrexham heard that Routledge interacted with pupils on this page for two days in 2009 while he was principal of Howell's School. He held the position for nine months before being dismissed in May 2011. The school, which is attended by boarders paying £18,000 a year, cited ten allegations of misconduct against Routledge, the most serious being social networking with children. During the hearing, Routledge's representative John Benson questioned trustee Robert Locke’s handling of the case. Benson asked why Locke never discussed the Facebook page with Routledge before suspending him and suggested there was a campaign to get rid of Routledge following an earlier boarding inspection. Locke admitted there were procedural flaws, including Routledge not being allowed to appeal. He said he contacted children's services and the police, who advised that the issue was not criminal and should be handled by the school. Routledge's partner, Helen Price—who was head of pastoral care at the school and pregnant at the time—was also dismissed and claims unfair dismissal. Locke, who dismissed Price following an investigation by his brother Alan Locke, said her sacking was due to her conduct during Routledge's disciplinary hearing and a breakdown in trust. He raised concerns about Price's relationship with Routledge, noting she was also the school's child protection officer and did not report any issues. Benson challenged why Price was never given a disciplinary hearing or informed of the outcome of her grievance hearing. Locke said the seriousness of allegations and concern for her pregnancy influenced their decision not to subject her to further investigation. Routledge had previously taught at The King's School in Chester before joining Howell's as deputy principal in 2010, later becoming principal. The employment tribunal is ongoing.

Routledge olevat rikkunud enda kehtestatud kooli sotsiaalmeediareegleid, kommenteerides Facebooki lehel nimega Bernie Routledge Appreciation Society (BRAS), mille lõid teise kooli õpilased. Wrexhami töövaidluskomisjonis kuuldi, et Routledge suhtles sellel lehel õpilastega kahe päeva jooksul 2009. aastal, kui ta oli Howell'si Kooli direktor. Ta oli selles ametis üheksa kuud kuni vallandamiseni 2011. aasta mais. Kooli internaadis elavad õpilased maksavad õppemaksuks 18 000 naela aastas ning Routledge'i vastu esitati kümme süüdistust väärkäitumises, millest tõsiseim oli suhtlus õpilastega sotsiaalmeedias. Kohtuasjas küsis Routledge'i esindaja John Benson kooli usaldusisiku Robert Locke'i juhtumit käsitlemise kohta. Benson uuris, miks Locke ei rääkinud Routledge'iga Facebooki lehest enne tema töölt kõrvaldamist ning väitis, et pärast eelmist internaadi inspekteerimist üritati Routledge'ist lahti saada. Locke tunnistas, et menetlusprotsessis oli puudujääke, sealhulgas see, et Routledge'ile ei võimaldatud apelleerimist. Ta ütles, et võttis ühendust lastekaitsega ja politseiga, kuid need asutused leidsid, et juhtum pole kriminaalne ja tuleks lahendada kooli poolt. Routledge'i partner Helen Price, kes oli kooli hoolekandest vastutav juht ja rase vallandamise ajal, vallandati samuti ning ta väidab, et temaga käituti ebaõiglaselt. Locke, kes vallandas Price'i pärast tema venna Alan Locke'i uurimist, ütles, et põhjus oli Price'i käitumine Routledge'i distsiplinaarkorral ning vastastikuse usalduse kadumine. Ta tõi esile mure Price'i suhte üle Routledge'iga, kuna viimane oli ka kooli laste kaitsja ega raporteerinud probleemidest. Locke sõnul mõjutas nende otsust tõsiste süüdistuste sisu ning soov vältida lisasurvet Price’ile tema raseduse tõttu. Enne Howell'si Kooli liitumist oli Routledge õpetajana töötanud The King's School'is Chesteris ning tema ametiks Howell'sis määrati algul direktori asetäitja 2010. aastal ja hiljem direktor. Töösuhete vaidluskomisjoni protsess jätkub.

article_content:
Co-hosts Sri Lanka became the first team to secure a place in the Cricket World Cup quarterfinals after defeating Zimbabwe by 139 runs on Thursday, thanks to a remarkable all-round performance from Tillakaratne Dilshan. Dilshan, named man-of-the-match, joined an elite group as just the 11th player to score a hundred and take four wickets in a 50-over international match.

Opening batsmen Dilshan and Upul Tharanga shared a World Cup record first-wicket partnership of 282 runs, leading Sri Lanka to a total of 327-6 in front of a home crowd at Pallekele Stadium in Kandy. Their stand shattered the previous record of 194 held by Pakistan's Saeed Anwar and Wajahatullah Wasti since 1999, and marked the fourth-highest partnership ever in a one-day international. Both openers scored centuries, a first in World Cup history, with Dilshan making 144 off 131 balls and Tharanga 133 from 141 deliveries. Zimbabwe’s captain Elton Chigumbura had opted to field first after winning the toss.

Tharanga was the first to be dismissed, falling near the end of the 45th over, and became the first of four wickets claimed by fast bowler Chris Mpofu. Despite a strong foundation, Zimbabwe restricted the 1996 champions to just 45 more runs in the final five overs.

In response, Zimbabwe made a solid start, reaching 116 runs before Muttiah Muralitharan, in his final match in his home city before retiring, broke the partnership by dismissing Regis Chakabva for 35. Zimbabwe then lost their last nine wickets for just 63 more runs, all out for 188 in 39 overs. Angelo Mathews took the wickets of Tatenda Taibu (4) and opener Brendan Taylor (80), while Dilshan contributed again by stumping Prosper Utseya (4) with the help of wicketkeeper Kumar Sangakkara. Dilshan then trapped Craig Ervine leg before wicket for 17 and had Greg Lamb caught at slip by Mahela Jayawardene. Although Jayawardene dropped a similar chance off Graeme Cremer the very next ball, Dilshan went on to dismiss Tinashe Panyangara lbw for a duck, finishing with extraordinary bowling figures of 4 wickets for 4 runs from three overs. Muralitharan bowled Chris Mpofu to end with 3-34.

"Dilshan has that magic touch with bat, ball and on the field," Sri Lanka skipper Kumar Sangakkara told reporters. "Murali is a champion. That's why he is rated the best in the world. When the tough times come, he stands up."

The victory put Sri Lanka at the top of Group A, one point ahead of second-placed New Zealand, whom Sri Lanka faces in their final group match on March 18. Zimbabwe are in fifth place, behind Pakistan and Australia, and face a tough challenge to advance after three losses in four matches. They must win their remaining games against Pakistan on March 14 and Kenya on March 20 to keep their quarterfinal hopes alive.

The tournament action now shifts to Group B, where Ireland look to follow up last week's shock victory over England by facing the West Indies in Chandigarh. Ireland lost to India on Sunday, while England, rebounding from that defeat with a win over South Africa, next face co-hosts Bangladesh in Chittagong.

Dilshan, kes valiti mängu parimaks, on alles 11. mängija, kes suudab ühes 50-ühepäevamängus lüüa sajandi ja võtta neli wicket'it.

Avamängijad Dilshan ja Upul Tharanga püstitasid MM-i rekordi, saavutades avavärava partnerluses 282 jooksu ning viisid Sri Lanka Kandy Pallekele staadionil kodupubliku ees 327-6 tulemuseni. Angelo Mathews võttis Tatenda Taibu (4) ja avamängija Brendan Taylori (80) wicket'id, Dilshan aitas wicketkeeper Kumar Sangakkara toel stumbata Prosper Utseya (4). Seejärel sai Dilshan Craig Ervine'i lbw-ga kätte (17) ning Greg Lambi võttis suurepäraselt slipis kinni Mahela Jayawardene. Kuigi Jayawardene järgmisel pallil Graeme Cremeri vastu sarnase võimaluse maha pillas, suuts Dilshan lõpuks Tinashe Panyangara lbw-ga välja lüüa – jooksuta. Dilshan lõpetas erakordse statistikaga: kolm üleminekut, neli wicket'it ja neli jooksu. Muralitharan lõpetas mängu Chris Mpofu välja löömisega (3-34).

"Dilshanil on maagiline puudutus nii kurika, palli kui väljakul," sõnas Sri Lanka kapten Kumar Sangakkara ajakirjanikele. "Murali on tšempion. Sellepärast teda maailma parimaks peetaksegi. Kui on tõelised rasked hetked, tõuseb tema esile."

See võit tõstis Sri Lanka A-alagrupis esikohale, ühe punktiga teise koha ees, kus on Uus-Meremaa, kellega kohtutakse viimases alagrupimängus 18. märtsil. Zimbabwe on viiendal kohal, jäädes maha Pakistanist ja Austraaliast, ning peab veerandfinaali lootuste säilitamiseks võitma viimased kaks mängu – Pakistani vastu 14. märtsil ja Keenia vastu 20. märtsil.

Edasine turniir liigub nüüd B-alagruppi, kus Iirimaa üritab eelmise nädala šokeerivat võitu Inglismaa üle korrata Lääne-Indiat alistades Chandigarhis. Iirimaa kaotas pühapäeval Indiale, samal ajal kui Inglismaa, pärast kaotust Indiale, tõusis võidule Lõuna-Aafrika üle ning järgmisena mängib nad kaasvõõrustajate Bangladeshiga Chittagongis.

Uniparts India Ltd., a small-cap company in the general sector, was established in 1994. As of September 30, 2023, promoters hold 65.66% of the company, Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) hold 3.33%, and Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) hold 11.04%. 

Uniparts India's key revenue segments for the year ending March 31, 2022 include forgings, scrap, export incentives, job work, and other operating revenue. For the quarter ending September 30, 2023, the company reported consolidated total income of Rs 294.70 crore, a decrease of 0.99% from the previous quarter (Rs 297.65 crore) and an 18.5% decline from the same quarter last year (Rs 361.58 crore). Net profit after tax for the latest quarter stood at Rs 33 crore. 

JM Financial has given a 'buy' recommendation on Uniparts India, setting a target price of Rs 750, while the current market price is Rs 549.15. 

Disclaimer: The stock recommendations above are provided by external parties and do not represent the views of The Economic Times. Readers are advised to consult a financial advisor before making investment decisions. 

In broader economic news, India's economy is projected to grow by 6.7% in the July-September quarter, according to a median forecast of ten economists, with much of the growth driven by the services sector. 

Additionally, telecom operators, chipmakers, network providers, and handset makers have expressed concerns about proposals to broadcast TV content directly to mobile phones without using a cellular data connection, citing the immaturity of the technology. 

The government is also considering increasing the threshold for criminal prosecution in GST evasion cases to Rs 3 crore from the current Rs 2 crore in a move aimed at reducing harassment and improving business ease.

Indian Continent Investment Limited (ICIL), a company based in Mauritius, has increased its investment in Airtel Africa by purchasing shares worth £57.25 million. According to a filing with the Nigerian Exchange Limited, ICIL bought 53.5 million shares of Airtel Africa at £1.07 each, with the transaction executed on the London Stock Exchange.

This move raised ICIL’s indirect ownership in Airtel Africa from 11.02% to 12.58%, meaning it now holds 473,071,861 shares. ICIL is linked with Shravin Bharti Mittal, Managing Director of Bharti Global Ltd, the investment arm of the Bharti family. Bharti Airtel remains the largest shareholder in Airtel Africa.

Meanwhile, Singapore Telecom International Pte Ltd reduced its stake in Airtel Africa to below 3%, down from 3.94%, after selling part of its shares, also on Monday.

On August 15, 2023, Airtel Africa also announced the cancellation of all its deferred shares with a nominal value of $0.50 each — a step approved at its annual general meeting on July 4, 2023, and later sanctioned by the High Court of England and Wales.

This reduction in share capital aims to increase distributable reserves for the company, which may enable future returns to shareholders through dividends, distributions, or share repurchases. Following this action, Airtel Africa reports its issued share capital as 3,758,151,504 ordinary shares, each with one vote.

Selle ostuga tõusis ICIL-i kaudne osalus Airtel Africas 11,02 protsendilt 12,58 protsendini, mistõttu on neil nüüd 473 071 861 aktsiat. ICIL on seotud Shravin Bharti Mittaliga, Bharti Global Ltd tegevjuhiga; see ettevõte on Bharti perekonna investeerimisüksus. Bharti Airtel on endiselt Airtel Africa suurim aktsionär.

Samal ajal vähendas Singapore Telecom International Pte Ltd oma osalust Airtel Africas alla kolme protsendi, olles varem 3,94%; osa aktsiatest müüdi samuti esmaspäeval.

15. augustil 2023 teatas Airtel Africa kõigi oma edasi lükatud 0,50-dollarilise nimiväärtusega aktsiate tühistamisest – see otsus kinnitati 4. juuli 2023. aasta üldkoosolekul ning hiljem kiitis selle heaks Inglismaa ja Walesi kõrge kohus.

Kapitali vähendamise eesmärk on suurendada ettevõtte jaotatavaid reserve, mis võimaldab tulevikus aktsionäridele teha väljamakseid, dividende või läbi viia aktsiate tagasiostu. Selle sammuga on Airtel Africa emiteeritud aktsiakapital nüüd 3 758 151 504 lihtaktsiat, igal aktsial on üks hääl.
