article_content: Nico Rosberg capped a remarkable week by winning the German Grand Prix at Hockenheim. However, Sunday's race was also notable for a frightening first-lap crash involving Felipe Massa. The Brazilian veteran was clipped from behind by McLaren's Kevin Magnussen, causing his Williams to flip spectacularly before coming to rest in the gravel. Initial safety concerns were quickly eased, as his team reported on Twitter that, 'Felipe is out of the car and heading back to the garage.' This incident marked the second consecutive race in which the 33-year-old Massa was involved in a first-lap accident, following a collision at the British Grand Prix after Kimi Raikkonen of Ferrari lost control. Earlier this season, Massa was also involved in a high-speed crash at the Canadian Grand Prix, where he accused Sergio Perez of dangerous driving as both ended up in the barriers. The safety car was deployed immediately after Massa's crash, but when racing resumed, Rosberg, starting from pole, maintained control and secured his seventh Formula 1 victory. Since retiring while leading at Silverstone, Rosberg married his long-time partner Vivian Sibold, extended his contract with Mercedes, and celebrated Germany's World Cup win. With the victory, Rosberg extended his lead over teammate Lewis Hamilton to 14 points in the championship standings. 'It's fantastic,' Rosberg said after the race. 'Winning at home is an amazing feeling.' Hamilton, who had enjoyed good luck at his home Grand Prix, faced difficulties in Germany. He crashed in qualifying because of a brake failure, resulting in a changed brake disc and a five-place grid penalty. Starting from 20th, he carved through the field and appeared to be on a two-stop strategy, potentially giving him a chance to challenge Rosberg. His second stop came on lap 32 of 67, but he pitted again seven laps later after Adrian Sutil spun his Sauber and was stranded on the track. Despite this, race officials chose not to deploy the safety car. Hamilton's engineering team called him in for a third pit stop. Hamilton still looked likely to overtake Valtteri Bottas for second place, but the Finn held firm under pressure to retain his position. Meanwhile, reigning four-time world champion Sebastian Vettel finished fourth, ahead of Ferrari's Fernando Alonso. Vettel’s teammate Daniel Ricciardo completed the top six.

Esialgsed mureküsimused tema ohutuse pärast hajusid kiiresti, kui tema meeskond teatas Twitteris: 'Felipe on autost väljas ja suundub garaaži.' article_content: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has cancelled a planned visit to Israel, citing what he described as its 'inhumane' war in Gaza. Addressing lawmakers in parliament on Wednesday, Erdogan criticized Israel’s bombing campaign in Gaza and expressed support for Hamas. Erdogan’s comments signal further deterioration in relations between Turkey and Israel, which have experienced recurring tensions over the years. The relationship previously suffered in 2010, after Israeli forces raided a Turkish ship carrying aid to Gaza, resulting in the deaths of ten civilians. Although diplomatic ties were restored in 2016, Turkey once again dismissed Israeli envoys in 2018 after a deadly crackdown on Palestinian protesters at the Gaza border. Recently, there had been signs of improving relations, including a meeting last month at the UN summit in New York between Erdogan and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The two leaders discussed potential cooperation in energy, technology, and cybersecurity. However, amid continued Israeli airstrikes in Gaza, which have killed more than 6,500 people according to reports and severely damaged infrastructure, Erdogan has adopted a more critical tone. 'Of course, we had good intentions, but [Netanyahu] abused them,' Erdogan said. 'If he had continued with good intentions, our relations might have been different, but now, unfortunately, this will not happen.' Erdogan, who has led Turkey for two decades, remains a vocal supporter of the Palestinian cause. He has condemned Israel’s actions since a deadly hospital explosion in Gaza on October 17. In a statement on Tuesday, he said the international community is failing to respond to what he called the Israeli regime’s unlawful attacks on civilians, and described the treatment of Gaza’s people as 'collective punishment.' Speaking to parliament on Wednesday, Erdogan referred to Hamas as 'liberators' defending their land and people. Israeli officials report that on October 7, Hamas fighters attacked Israel, killing at least 1,400 people and taking over 220 hostages. Erdogan is expected to attend a large pro-Palestinian rally in Istanbul this Saturday, organized by the ruling Justice and Development Party.

Erdogani sõnavõtud viitavad Türgi ja Iisraeli suhete uuele halvenemisele, mis on aastate jooksul olnud mitme krahhiga. Suhted katkesid 2010. aastal, kui Iisraeli väed ründasid Türgi laeva, mis vedas abi Gazasse, mille tagajärjel hukkus kümme tsiviilisikut. Kuigi diplomaatilised suhted taastati 2016. aastal, saatis Türgi 2018. aastal Iisraeli saadikud taas kodumaale pärast verist kokkupõrget Palestiina meeleavaldajatega Gaza piiril. Hiljuti oli märke suhete paranemisest, sealhulgas kohtumine eelmisel kuul ÜRO tippkohtumisel New Yorgis Erdogani ja Iisraeli peaministri Benjamin Netanyahuga, kus arutati võimalusi koostööks energia, tehnoloogia ja küberturvalisuse alal. Ent jätkuvad Iisraeli õhurünnakud Gazas, mis on teatanud teatel toonud kaasa üle 6 500 inimese surma ning rängalt kahjustanud infrastruktuuri, on muutnud Erdogani hinnanguid kriitilisemaks. 'Muidugi olid meil head kavatsused, aga [Netanyahu] kuritarvitas neid,' ütles Erdogan. 'Kui ta oleks jätkanud hea tahtega, oleksid meie suhted võinud olla teistsugused, aga nüüd, kahjuks, seda enam ei juhtu.' Erdogan, kes on juhtinud Türgit juba kaks aastakümmet, on jätkuvalt Palestiina asja häälekas toetaja. Ta on hukka mõistnud Iisraeli tegevuse pärast surmavat haiglaplahvatust Gazas 17. oktoobril. Teisipäevases avalduses ütles ta, et rahvusvaheline kogukond ei reageeri piisavalt sellele, mida ta nimetab Iisraeli režiimi ebaseaduslikeks rünnakuteks tsiviilelanike vastu, ning kirjeldas Gaza elanike olukorda 'kollektiivse karistusena'. Kolmapäeval parlamendi ees esinedes nimetas Erdogan Hamasi 'vabastajateks', kes kaitsevad oma maad ja rahvast. Iisraeli ametnike teatel ründasid Hamasi võitlejad 7. oktoobril Iisraeli, tappes vähemalt 1 400 inimest ja võttes üle 220 pantvangi. Erdogan peaks osalema suurel Palestiina toetusrongkäigul sel laupäeval Istanbulis, mille korraldab valitsev Õigluse ja Arengu Partei.

Alex Pelling and Lisa Gant, a couple from Manchester, launched a remarkable quest in 2011: to experience wedding ceremonies across the globe in search of the perfect setting. Instead of choosing a single venue to marry, they embraced the marriage traditions of each country along their route. Their journey, originally planned as a relocation to Australia, evolved into an odyssey exploring diverse wedding cultures.

Traveling in Peggy, their 27-year-old camper van, Alex and Lisa have participated in over 50 weddings in more than 36 countries in just two years. Each celebration stands out—from exchanging vows with breathtaking volcano views in Guatemala, arriving at a Colombian farmer-style wedding by donkey, to an underwater photography session after a Mayan ritual in Mexico.

They document every step on a widely-read blog with over a million views, and their Facebook page boasts more than 37,000 followers. Their story provides inspiration and practical insights for others seeking unique wedding ideas.

Their adventure began as Alex and Lisa, friends for eight years who became a couple in 2008, prepared to start anew. They rented out their home, sold Alex’s business, and traveled the world, relying on the hospitality of local communities and guidance from religious and cultural leaders.

The couple’s ceremonies have included everything from a drive-through wedding in Vegas, a Texan ranch set aglow with fairy lights, and a tram ride through Lisbon for a hilltop union, to traditional Turkish henna rituals and tribal blessings in Panama, adorned with tribal tattoos and beads. They have celebrated on horseback in Canada, amidst the vineyards of Quebec, atop bustling Moroccan rooftops, and even aboard a luxury yacht in Bora Bora.

Alex and Lisa strive to fully embrace each culture’s unique wedding customs, appreciating how love is celebrated worldwide. Their wedding attire has ranged from designer gowns to local garments like those worn in Chile. From ceremonies in a crashed airplane in Costa Rica, to Irish druids’ circles and lively American markets, every location offers new traditions.

Now at their 54th wedding, Lisa and Alex plan to continue seeking out even more destinations, with hopes to soon marry in Iraq, Iran, and Pakistan. Through their heartfelt storytelling, they encourage others to recognize—to celebrate—the universal power and diversity of love and marriage around the world.

Alex Pelling ja Lisa Gant, Manchesterist pärit paar, alustasid 2011. aastal erakordset teekonda: kogeda pulmatseremooniaid üle kogu maailma, et leida täiuslik koht abiellumiseks. Selle asemel, et piirduda ühe unistuste paigaga, otsustasid nad süveneda iga riigi abielutraditsioonidesse, kuhu jõudsid. Nende rännak, mis algselt oli mõeldud ümberasumisena Austraaliasse, kujunes ülemaailmseks pulmaseikluseks erinevate kultuuride ja tavadega tutvudes.

Oma 27-aastase matkaautoga Peggy on Alex ja Lisa kahe aasta jooksul osalenud enam kui 50 pulmatseremoonial rohkem kui 36 riigis. Iga pidustus on olnud omanäoline — nad on andnud tõotused vulkaanide taustal Guatemalas, saabunud eesli seljas Kolumbiasse talupojapulma ja osalenud pärast maiade tseremooniat Mehhikos veealusel fotosessioonil.

Oma seiklusi jagavad nad väga loetavas blogis (üle miljoni vaatamise), nende Facebooki lehel hoiab silma peal üle 37 000 jälgija. Nende lugu innustab ja annab praktilisi ideid neile, kes otsivad midagi erilist oma pulmapäevaks.

Seiklus sai alguse, kui Alex ja Lisa, kaheksa aastat sõbrad ja aastast 2008 paar, alustasid uue elu kavandamist. Nad üürisid välja oma kodu, müüsid Alexi ettevõtte ning usaldasid teekonnal tugi kohalikele kogukondadele ja kohalikelt usulistelt ning kultuurijuhtidelt saadud juhendamisele.

Pulmatseremooniad on olnud väga erinevaid: drive-in pulmad Las Vegases, haldjatuledega kaunistatud rantšo Texases, trammireis Lissaboni tipus toimuvale tseremooniale, traditsiooniline türgi hennarituaal ning hõimuõnnistused Panamas, kus neid ehtisid tätoveeringud ja helmed. Nad on abiellunud hobuse seljas Kanadas, Quebeci veinimõisas, Maroko katusepidudel ning isegi luksusjahil Bora Boral.

Alex ja Lisa soovivad kõiki kohalikke traditsioone tõeliselt kogeda ning hinnata, kuidas inimesed üle ilma armastust ja abielu tähistavad. Nende pulmakleit on vahel olnud disainermontaaž, vahel kohalik rahvarõivas, nagu Tšiilis. article_content: Taipei has kicked off the Taiwan Creative Content Fest (TCCF), spotlighting Taiwan’s ambition to become a global powerhouse in cultural industries through strengthened collaborations with France, South Korea, and Japan. Culture Minister Shih Che introduced the 'One Plus Four – T-Content Plan,' pledging NT$10 billion (about $311 million) to fuel creative innovation and talent development. Shih highlighted that after years of focusing on tech, Taiwan’s government is finally providing major support for the cultural content sector. The Taiwan Creative Content Agency (TAICCA), operational since 2019, is driving this momentum by offering funding to both local projects and international partners who team up with Taiwanese creators, via schemes like the Taiwan International Co-funding Program (TICP). TAICCA’s global strategy includes fresh agreements, starting with France—a long-term cultural collaborator—plus South Korea and Japan. At the TCCF opening, French CNC president Dominique Boutonnat previewed a cooperative deal soon to be signed between CNC and TAICCA. He cited several successful joint productions and ongoing initiatives enhancing Europe-Asia connections. Kadokawa Corporation CEO Takeshi Natsuno delivered a passionate keynote, underscoring Taiwan’s importance in Kadokawa’s overseas ventures. With 20% of revenue now coming from international operations, Kadokawa aims to boost its global content sources to 40% and, eventually, achieve a 50/50 domestic-international split. Natsuno praised Taiwan's government backing for creatives and contrasted it with Japan’s more limited approach. The first day of TCCF also saw TAICCA sign a memorandum of understanding with CJ ENM Hong Kong, Far EasTone, and TVBS, launching a multi-year fund to support and co-produce new works. This initiative promises not only investments but also guidance and industry networking to help projects with unique cultural perspectives reach broader audiences. All festivities are housed in Songshan Culture and Creative Park, a repurposed tobacco plant that now hosts content showcases, panels, and immersive experiences for attendees.
translated_content: Taipei’s toimus Taiwan Creative Content Fest (TCCF), mis toob esile Taiwani soovi saada ülemaailmseks kultuurisektori liidriks ning tugevdada koostööd Prantsusmaa, Lõuna-Korea ja Jaapaniga. Kultuuriminister Shih Che tutvustas uut algatust 'One Plus Four – T-Content Plan', millega toetatakse loomevaldkondi 10 miljardi NT$ (umbes 311 miljonit dollarit) ulatuses. Shih rõhutas, et nüüd on pärast aastaid tehnoloogia eelistamist fookuses kultuurisisu sektor. Taiwan Creative Content Agency (TAICCA), mis on tegutsenud alates 2019. aastast, annab loomesektorile hoogu, pakkudes rahastust nii kohalikele projektidele kui ka rahvusvahelistele partneritele, kes teevad koostööd Taiwani ettevõtetega, näiteks Taiwan International Co-funding Programiga (TICP). TAICCA rahvusvaheline strateegia tähendab uusi lepinguid, alustades Prantsusmaast (pikaajaline koostööpartner) ning hõlmates ka Lõuna-Korea ja Jaapani. TCCF avasündmusel mainis Prantsuse CNC president Dominique Boutonnat peatselt sõlmitavat ametlikku koostöölepet CNC ja TAICCA vahel, tuues esile edukaid ühisprojekte ning algatusi Euroopa ja Aasia vahelise koostöö jaoks. Kadokawa Corporationi tegevjuht Takeshi Natsuno rõhutas oma kõnes Taiwani tähtsust Kadokawa rahvusvaheliseks laienemiseks. Praegu pärineb 20% ettevõtte tuludest välismaalt ja eesmärk on kasvatada see näitaja 40%ni. Natsuno soovib saavutada 10 aasta pärast olukorra, kus ettevõtte sisu päritolu jaguneb võrdselt Jaapani ja muu maailma vahel. Ta kiitis Taiwani valitsuse tuge loomevaldkonnale, tuues kontrastiks Jaapani tagasihoidlikuma toetuse. Esimesel festivalipäeval allkirjastas TAICCA koostöömemorandumi CJ ENM Hong Kongi, Far EasTone’i ja TVBSiga, et käivitada mitmeaastane fond uute sisuprojektide toetuseks ning kaasproduktsioonideks. Programm pakub ka nõustamist ja väärtuslikke kontakte kultuuriliselt mitmekesiste projektide laiemaks levikuks. Kõik sündmused toimuvad Songshani kultuuri- ja loomemajanduse pargis, endises tubakavabrikus, millest on saanud keskus sisuturgudele, aruteludele ning kaasavatele kunstielamustele.

article_content: Elon Musk's artificial intelligence startup, xAI, will debut its first AI model to a select group this Saturday, according to Musk, who is also CEO of Tesla. This milestone follows nearly a year after OpenAI’s ChatGPT captivated users and businesses worldwide, sparking widespread adoption of generative AI. Musk co-founded OpenAI—the developer behind ChatGPT—in 2015, but he departed from the company's board in 2018. On his X social media platform, Musk claimed, 'In some important respects, it (xAI's new model) is the best that currently exists.' He added that once the new system, called Grok, leaves early beta testing, it will become available to all X Premium+ subscribers. Last week, X (formerly known as Twitter) introduced two subscription plans: a $16/month Premium+ tier for an ad-free experience and a $3/month basic option. A vocal critic of Big Tech's approach to artificial intelligence and its perceived censorship, Musk stated earlier this year that xAI aims to build a 'maximum truth-seeking AI' intended to understand the universe, rivalling products like Google’s Bard and Microsoft’s Bing AI. xAI’s team includes experts from Google’s DeepMind, Microsoft, and other top AI research organizations. Though X and xAI are separate entities, they work closely together, and xAI also collaborates with Tesla and other companies. In September, Oracle co-founder Larry Ellison, a close associate of Musk, announced xAI had signed a contract to train its model using Oracle’s cloud infrastructure.

Musk oli OpenAI – ChatGPT arendaja – kaasasutaja 2015. aastal, kuid lahkus ettevõtte juhatusest 2018. aastal. Oma X sotsiaalmeediaplatvormil kinnitas Musk: "Mõnes olulises mõttes on see (xAI uus mudel) parim hetkel olemasolevatest." Ta lisas, et kui uus süsteem Grok väljub varajasest beetatestist, on see kättesaadav kõikidele X Premium+ tellijatele. Möödunud nädalal tutvustas X (endise nimega Twitter) kahte uut tellimispaketti: 16-dollariline Premium+ tase reklaamivabadeks kasutuskogemusteks ja 3-dollariline põhitasand. Musk, kes on olnud suurte tehnoloogiafirmade AI-arenduste ja väidetava tsensuuri häälekas kriitik, ütles sel aastal, et xAI eesmärk on luua 'maksimaalselt tõde otsiv AI', mis püüab mõista universumi olemust ja konkureerida näiteks Google’i Bardi ning Microsofti Bing AI-ga. xAI meeskonda kuuluvad eksperdid Google’i DeepMindist, Microsoftist ja teistest tipptehisintellekti uurimisasutustest. Kuigi X ja xAI on eraldi ettevõtted, teevad nad tihedat koostööd ning xAI töötab koos ka Tesla ja teiste ettevõtetega. Septembris teatas Oracle’i kaasasutaja Larry Ellison, Muski lähedane sõber, et xAI sõlmis lepingu oma mudelite treenimiseks Oracle’i pilveserverite abil.

article_content: Across Europe, various towns and villages are tackling depopulation by offering financial incentives to attract new residents. These incentives can include grants for buying or renovating homes and subsidies for families willing to settle in these areas. In Albinen, Switzerland, families may receive up to $53,000 to relocate, provided they are Swiss citizens or hold a C residence permit. They must purchase a home and live there for at least 10 years. Sardinia, Italy, is granting up to €15,000 (about $16,000) to people moving into villages with fewer than 3,000 inhabitants, with over €45 million set aside for the initiative. Presicce-Acquarica in southern Italy offers €30,000 grants to those who buy and register a house as their primary residence, which can cover up to half the cost, including renovations. About 30% of the town's homes are eligible. Ponga, Spain, in the northwest, is providing British citizens £2,600 ($3,150) to live in the town for a minimum of five years, plus an additional sum for every child born there during that time. Calabria, Italy, also offers grants up to €28,000 (over $29,000) to individuals under 40 moving to villages with fewer than 2,000 residents, on the condition they start a business or find employment and relocate within 90 days of approval. Ireland encourages newcomers to its remote islands with grants of over €80,000 ($87,600) to restore empty homes built before 1993, as part of a larger plan to revive its offshore communities.

article_content: Some student-loan borrowers will receive relief after the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) and the state of New Jersey accused Sollers College, a for-profit school in New Jersey, of illegal practices. On Wednesday, the FTC announced that Sollers will cancel $3.4 million in student debt to settle allegations, which include falsely advertising job-placement rates. The FTC’s complaint stated that Sollers misrepresented its relationships with well-known companies as potential employers for graduates. The agency also alleged that Sollers offered unlawful income-share agreements (ISAs), requiring students to pay the school a fixed percentage of their future income to cover tuition costs. Between August 2018 and April 2021, Sollers entered into 392 ISAs that omitted required consumer protections by failing to notify borrowers of their rights. 'Sollers College used deceptive advertising to recruit students and bound them to multi-year income-share agreements that violated the law by excluding important borrower protections,' said Samuel Levine, director of the FTC’s Bureau of Consumer Protection. Under the settlement, all ISAs issued by the school are canceled. Sollers is obliged to notify all affected students within 15 days by email or written notice and cannot deny access to transcripts or diplomas because of outstanding debt. The school must also request credit bureaus Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion to remove related debts from students’ credit reports. The notification to students reads: 'We’re writing because you have an income share agreement with Sollers College. The Federal Trade Commission (FTC), the nation’s consumer protection agency, sued us for using deceptive ads and not informing you of some of your rights in our income share agreements.' Sollers College did not respond immediately to Insider’s request for comment. The FTC’s allegations have attracted attention from companies Sollers claimed as partners. For example, in 2022, Weill Cornell Medicine sent Sollers a cease-and-desist letter to remove its logo, insisting there was never a partnership. Aerotek also made a similar demand. The FTC also reported that about 90% of students with ISAs were either repaying or had defaulted and owed Sollers a fixed amount. Sollers referred defaulting students to debt collection agencies. Similar regulatory actions have occurred before. The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) recently sued Prehired, a career bootcamp, for allegedly misrepresenting the nature of its income-share agreements. According to the CFPB’s complaint, Prehired did not properly disclose loan costs and claimed that ISAs were not loans and did not create debt.
translated_content: Mõned üliõpilaslaenuvõtjad saavad leevendust pärast seda, kui USA Föderaalne Kaubanduskomisjon (FTC) ja New Jersey osariik süüdistasid Sollersi Kolledžit, kasumitaotluslikku kooli New Jerseys, ebaseaduslikes tegevustes. Kolmapäeval teatas FTC, et Sollers kustutab 3,4 miljoni dollari ulatuses üliõpilasvõlgu, et lahendada süüdistused, sealhulgas töölesaamise näitajate valereklaamimine. FTC kaebuses öeldakse, et Sollers kujutas ekslikult endast suhteid tuntud ettevõtetega, mille kaudu lõpetajad oleksid leidnud töökohti. Asutus väitis samuti, et Sollers pakkus ebaseaduslikke tulu jagamise lepinguid (ISA), mis nõudsid tudengitelt tulevase sissetuleku kindla protsendi maksmist õppemaksu katteks. Ajavahemikus august 2018 kuni aprill 2021 sõlmis Sollers 392 tulu jagamise lepingut, mis ei sisaldanud nõutavaid tarbijakaitseid ega teavitanud laenuvõtjaid nende õigustest. 'Sollersi Kolledž kasutas meelega eksitavat reklaami, et värvata üliõpilasi, ja sidus nad mitmeaastastesse tulu jagamise lepingutesse, mis rikkusid seadust, sest nendes puudusid olulised õigused,' ütles Samuel Levine, FTC tarbijakaitsebüroo direktor. Kokkuleppe kohaselt tühistatakse kõik kooli väljastatud ISA-d. Sollers peab kõiki mõjutatud üliõpilasi teavitama 15 päeva jooksul e-kirja või kirjaliku teatega ning ei tohi keelduda tunnistuste või diplomite väljastamisest võlgnevuse tõttu. Kool peab samuti taotlema krediidibüroodelt Experian, Equifax ja TransUnion asjaomaste võlgade eemaldamist tudengite krediidiraportitest. Teavitus üliõpilastele kõlab nii: 'Kirjutame teile, sest teil on Sollersi Kolledžiga tulu jagamise leping. Föderaalne Kaubanduskomisjon (FTC), riigi tarbijakaitse asutus, kaebas meid kohtusse, kuna kasutasime eksitavat reklaami ning ei teavitanud teid kõigist teie õigustest meie tulu jagamise lepingutes.' Sollersi Kolledž ei vastanud koheselt Insideri kommentaarisoovile. FTC süüdistused on köitnud tähelepanu ettevõtetelt, keda Sollers esitles partneritena. Näiteks saatis Weill Cornell Medicine 2022. aastal Sollersile käsu eemaldada nende logo, väites, et partnerlust ei olnud. Aerotek esitas samasuguse nõude. FTC teatas ka, et umbes 90% ISA lepinguga tudengitest kas maksavad parajasti või on võlgnevuses ning neil on nüüd kohustus Sollersile maksta kindel summa. Sollers suunas võlgu jäänud üliõpilased inkassofirmadesse. Sarnaseid regulatiivseid samme on varemgi tehtud. Tarbijakaitsebüroo (CFPB) kaebas hiljuti kohtusse karjäärikoolituse ettevõtte Prehired, väites, et nad esitasid oma tulu jagamise lepinguid eksitavalt. CFPB sõnul ei selgitanud Prehired laenude tegelikku maksumust piisavalt ja kinnitas ekslikult, et ISA-d pole laenud ega tekita võlga.

article_content: LONDON — Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov praised the strengthening relationship between Russia and North Korea during his two-day visit to Pyongyang, marking the 75th anniversary of diplomatic ties between the two countries. Lavrov arrived in Pyongyang on Wednesday after attending the Belt and Road Initiative forum in Beijing, which included President Vladimir Putin and leaders from Africa, Asia, the Middle East, and Latin America. Russian state television showed crowds welcoming Lavrov at Pyongyang airport despite the rain, with a reception featuring a group waving pom-poms. At a formal gathering hosted by the North Korean government, Lavrov expressed gratitude for North Korea's 'unwavering and principled support for Russia's actions in the context of the special military operation in Ukraine.' "We recognize that many countries around the world share similar assessments, but only a few, like the DPRK, openly declare their solidarity with Russia," Lavrov said. "This openness reflects the independence of governments who prioritize their national interests and do not yield to Western influence." Lavrov affirmed Russia's 'full support and solidarity' for North Korea's aspirations and highlighted their 'mutual solidarity and shared commitment.' He concluded, 'Here's to our friendship!' On Thursday, Lavrov met with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. According to Russian news agency TASS, the meeting lasted over an hour, though no additional details were released. Lavrov also held talks with North Korean Foreign Minister Choe Son Hui, declaring that the bilateral relationship had reached a 'new, strategic level.' Choe expressed hope that frequent meetings between the countries' foreign ministers would further strengthen their ties and demonstrate the ongoing development of the long-standing relationship. She emphasized that the discussions with Lavrov would help advance agreements made at the September summit between President Putin and Kim Jong Un. Lavrov's visit followed the anniversary of diplomatic relations and came shortly after the 'historic summit' at the Vostochny Cosmodrome between Putin and Kim. His trip also occurred days after the United States accused North Korea of transferring ammunition to Russia to bolster its military capabilities in Ukraine. US National Security Council spokesperson John Kirby announced that North Korea had sent over '1,000 containers' of munitions and military equipment to Russia between September 7 and October 1, shipped from Najin, North Korea, to Dunay, Russia, according to the White House. At the end of his visit, Lavrov laid flowers at a commemorative plaque for Andrey Karlov—former Russian Ambassador to Turkey and previously North Korea—who was assassinated in Ankara in 2016. Lavrov concluded his stay by meeting with staff at the Russian embassy in Pyongyang.
translated_content: LONDON — Venemaa välisminister Sergei Lavrov kiitis kahe riigi tugevnevaid suhteid kahepäevasel visiidil Põhja-Koreasse, millega tähistati Venemaa ja Põhja-Korea diplomaatiliste suhete 75. aastapäeva. Lavrov saabus Pyongyangi kolmapäeval pärast Pekingis toimunud Siiditee ja Maantee algatuse foorumit, kus osalesid ka president Vladimir Putin ning Aafrika, Aasia, Lähis-Ida ja Ladina-Ameerika juhid. Venemaa riigitelevisioon näitas rahvahulki, kes tervitasid Lavrovi vihmases Pyongyangis, kus teda võeti vastu pom-pomme lehvitava seltskonnaga. Ametlikul vastuvõtul, mille korraldas Põhja-Korea valitsus, avaldas Lavrov tänu Põhja-Koreale „vankumatu ja põhimõttelise toetuse eest Venemaa tegevusele Ukraina erioperatsiooni kontekstis“. „Mõistame, et paljud riigid üle maailma jagavad sarnaseid hinnanguid, kuid vaid vähesed, nagu DPRK, väljendavad oma solidaarsust Venemaaga avalikult,“ sõnas Lavrov. „See avatus peegeldab nende valitsuste iseseisvust, kes seavad esikohale oma rahvuslikud huvid ega allu lääneriikide mõjule.“ Lavrov kinnitas Venemaa „täielikku toetust ja solidaarsust“ Põhja-Korea püüdlustele ning rõhutas nende „vastastikust solidaarsust ja ühiseid eesmärke“. Ta lõpetas: „Meie sõprusele!“ Neljapäeval kohtus Lavrov Põhja-Korea juhi Kim Jong Uniga. Vene uudisteagentuuri TASS andmetel kestis kohtumine üle tunni, kuid täpsemat teavet ei avaldatud. Lavrov pidas ka läbirääkimisi Põhja-Korea välisministri Choe Son Hui'ga, kuulutades, et kahe riigi suhted on jõudnud „uuele, strateegilisele tasemele“. Choe avaldas lootust, et välisministrite sagedased kohtumised tugevdavad suhteid veelgi ja näitavad pikaajalise koostöö arengut. Ta rõhutas, et arutelud Lavroviga aitavad ellu viia septembrikuisel tippkohtumisel Putini ja Kim Jong Uni vahel saavutatud kokkuleppeid. Lavrovi visiit järgnes diplomaatiliste suhete aastapäevale ja toimus vahetult pärast „ajaloolist tippkohtumist“ Putini ja Kimiga Vostochny kosmodroomil. Visiit leidis aset ka päevadel, mil USA süüdistas Põhja-Koread laskemoona tarnimises Venemaale, et tugevdada Venemaa sõjalisi võimeid Ukrainas. USA riikliku julgeolekunõukogu pressiesindaja John Kirby teatas, et Põhja-Korea saatis Venemaale üle „1 000 konteineri“ laskemoona ja sõjatehnikat ajavahemikus 7. september kuni 1. oktoober — last saadeti Najinist (Põhja-Korea) Dunaysse (Venemaa), teatas Valge Maja. Visiidi lõppedes asetas Lavrov lilled mälestustahvlile Andrei Karlovile — Venemaa endisele suursaadikule Türgis ja varem Põhja-Koreas — kes mõrvati 2016. aastal Ankaras. Lavrov lõpetas visiidi kohtumisega Venemaa saatkonna töötajatega Pyongyangis.

article_content:
Apple TV+ may have a smaller subscriber base compared to giants like Netflix and Disney+, but it continues to punch above its weight in the streaming arena, capturing about 11% of the ad-free streaming market. This year, the company invested nearly $7 billion in original programming—about half of Netflix’s spend. Apple’s approach centers on securing top talent and granting significant creative freedom to filmmakers. For example, Martin Scorsese’s "Killers of the Flower Moon" was produced with a budget between $200 million and $250 million, while "The Morning Show" starring Reese Witherspoon runs around $150 million per season.

As some media companies scale back, Apple is expanding its content library and raising its monthly subscription from $6.99 to $9.99 to support this growth. Insider interviews and agency documents show Apple prefers content that’s commercial, star-studded, and hopeful, while avoiding divisive themes that could impact its global retail image. Series like "Ted Lasso" and "Platonic" showcase this preference for feel-good, widely appealing narratives.

Apple’s content priorities remain consistent even as Hollywood navigates post-writers’ strike recovery—focusing on relatable stories and steering clear of themes like religion or substance abuse. This cautious approach was cited in the split with Jon Stewart’s "The Problem," following disagreements about covering topics such as China and artificial intelligence.

Leaked agency documents indicate Apple is seeking stories that highlight humanity, empowering female leads, elevated young adult, comedy and science fiction content, but steering clear of graphic horror—although it’s open to innovative sci-fi/horror crossovers like "A Quiet Place." On the series front, Apple is looking to expand unscripted offerings, including quickly produced competition formats with high production values. Its drive in live sports—such as Major League Soccer and Baseball—is paralleled by a push for sports-centered unscripted content, like sports anthology series that appeal to broad audiences.

Thanks to backing from Apple’s overall business, Apple TV+ is less exposed to industry pressures and able to keep green-lighting big-budget films, such as "Killers of the Flower Moon" and Ridley Scott’s "Napoleon." Notably, Apple TV+ was the first streaming service to win an Oscar for Best Picture with "CODA" in 2022. Nevertheless, recent signals suggest growing fiscal prudence, with Apple scaling back on ultra-costly projects and placing tighter controls on per-episode budgets.

article_content:
For many mothers, balancing work and family means working double from home. While remote work offers flexibility—making school pickups, doctor’s appointments, and meal planning easier—it remains a temporary solution to the ongoing challenges faced by working moms. Even in households where responsibilities are shared, women typically take on more of the hands-on childcare and the so-called 'invisible load.'

Workplace experts and female executives told Insider that return-to-office (RTO) mandates can make it seem nearly impossible for mothers to excel in both their careers and family life. In a recent Reddit post, a working mother debated whether to take a remote job requiring monthly cross-country travel for several days. Even with triple to quadruple her previous salary, she worried the demands would be overwhelming for her family, especially with two young children.

As more organizations require employees to return to the office, the risk increases that mothers might leave the workforce—something that happened on a large scale during the pandemic. Each family’s situation is unique, making one-size-fits-all solutions ineffective. Experts suggest that employers, rather than assuming set remote days accommodate caregivers, should analyze data, welcome new ideas, and remain adaptable.

Kelly Resendez, EVP of Talent Acquisition at GoodLeap and cofounder of GoBundance Woman, encourages mothers to document their priorities instead of constantly proving their worth. Babson College professor Danna Greenberg stresses the importance of honesty and flexibility from both employees and employers for effective work and caregiving.

Wells Fargo economists have identified mothers with young children as a strength in today’s workforce, according to Insider’s Cork Gaines. Their increased workforce participation has significantly contributed to economic growth. However, many mothers work in order to afford the soaring cost of childcare, with Bank of America reporting an average monthly cost of over $700 in September—a 32% rise since 2019.

Rather than enforcing specific in-office days, Greenberg suggests that managers track office attendance to better manage teams and avoid sidelining mothers who work from home. This can ensure remote workers are not overlooked for important assignments or career advancement.

Resendez emphasizes the need for deliberate, informed return-to-office policies that assess both departmental requirements and employee input. Mandy McAllister, CEO of GoBundance Women, notes that advocating for one’s needs and proposing solutions are key to securing flexible arrangements.

Resendez adds that waiting for others to create the perfect career plan is unrealistic, underscoring the importance of personal initiative. Kelly Scheib, Chief People Officer at Crunchbase and mother of five, suggests leaders must be adaptable to employees’ diverse needs. She argues that rigid, prescriptive organizations may struggle in the future.

Tailoring approaches to individual employees helps them perform well, meet organizational goals, and proves especially critical for working mothers. Scheib observes that many RTO mandates overlook the realities for mothers, and inflexibility can harm both children and mothers’ mental health.

Paljudele emadele tähendab töö ja pereelu tasakaalustamine kodust töötamist topeltkoormusega. Kuigi kaugtöö pakub paindlikkust—lihtsustades laste kooliviimist, arstil käimist ja toiduvalmistamist—on see siiski ajutine lahendus pikaajalistele probleemidele, millega töötavad emad silmitsi seisavad. Isegi peredes, kus kohustusi jagatakse, jääb tihti naistele suurem osa otsesest laste eest hoolitsemisest ja niinimetatud 'nähtamatust koormusest.'

Töö- ja personalieksperdid ning naisjuhid tõdesid Insiderile, et kontorisse tagasikutsumise (RTO) nõuded võivad muuta emadel nii töö- kui ka pereelus edukaks olemise pea võimatuks. Hiljutises Redditi postituses arutas töötav ema, kas võtta vastu kaugtöö, mis tooks iga kuu mitu päeva lennureise üle Ameerika. Isegi kolme-neljakordse palga juures muretses ta, et kohustused võivad väikeste laste ema jaoks liiga koormavaks osutuda.

Mida rohkem ettevõtted nõuavad tagasipöördumist kontorisse, seda suurem on oht, et emad lahkuvad tööjõuturult—nagu toimus ulatuslikult pandeemia ajal. Iga perekond on unikaalne, mistõttu universaalsed lahendused ei toimi. Eksperdid soovitavad tööandjatel mitte eeldada, et üksikud kaugtööpäevad lahendavad kõik, vaid analüüsida andmeid, olla avatud värsketele ideedele ja säilitada paindlikkust.

GoodLeapi talendihangete asepresident ning GoBundance Woman'i kaasasutaja Kelly Resendez soovitab emadel dokumenteerida oma prioriteedid, mitte pidevalt tõestada oma väärtust. Babson College’i professor Danna Greenberg kinnitab, et edukaks tööks ja hoolitsemiseks on vaja mõlemapoolset ausust ja paindlikkust.

Wells Fargo ökonomistide hinnangul on väikelaste emadest kujunenud tugevus tänapäeva tööturul, selgub Insideri artiklist. Nende suurenenud tööhõive osakaal on aidanud märgatavalt kasvatada majandust. Paljud emad töötavad siiski peamiselt kasvavate lastehoiukulude katmiseks—Bank of America andmeil oli USA-s keskmine lasteaia kuumaks septembris üle 700 dollari, mis on 32% rohkem kui 2019. aastal.

Greenberg soovitab kontoripäevade asemel juhtidel jälgida, kes millal kohapeal töötab, et meeskondi teadlikumalt juhtida ja vältida, et kaugtööd tegevad emad jäävad tähtsatest ülesannetest ilma.

Resendez rõhutab läbimõeldud, osakonna vajadusi ja töötajate arvamust arvestava kontorisse naasmise poliitika olulisust. GoBundance Womeni tegevjuht Mandy McAllister toob välja, et enda vajaduste eest seismine ja lahenduste pakkumine aitab paremini jõuda mõlemaid osapooli rahuldava kokkuleppeni.

Resendez lisab, et täiuslikku karjääriplaani väljastpoolt oodata on – paraku – ebarealistlik, seega on oluline ise algatus võtta. Crunchbase’i personalijuht ja viie lapse ema Kelly Scheib juhib tähelepanu vajadusele kohandada juhte töötajate erinevate vajadustega; tema sõnul võivad jäigad organisatsioonid tulevikus hätta jääda.

Individuaalne lähenemine aitab töötajatel ja tööandjatel paremini oma eesmärke saavutada, mis on eriti oluline töötavate emade jaoks. Scheib leiab, et paljud RTO-nõuded jätavad arvestamata emade tegelikud vajadused ning paindlikkuse puudus mõjutab halvasti nii lapsi kui ka emade vaimset tervist.

The company formerly known as Twitter, now called X, held its first all-hands meeting on Thursday, marking one year since Elon Musk completed his $44 billion acquisition. However, neither Elon Musk nor CEO Linda Yaccarino attended in person at the San Francisco headquarters—they participated remotely, according to Fortune, citing an unnamed X employee. Yaccarino was reportedly in New York, while Musk was in Austin, Texas. Insider reached out to X for comment but did not receive an immediate response.

After taking over the company, one of Musk's first actions was to enforce a strict return-to-office policy, requiring staff to be in the office at least 40 hours per week. Despite this, for Thursday’s meeting, management joined virtually. Employees at the San Francisco HQ were served sandwiches from the upscale chain Mendocino Farms, reportedly costing around $15 each on DoorDash. Mendocino Farms also offers catering services, though prices are not listed online. The provision of these sandwiches is notable since Musk ended free lunches at the headquarters soon after his takeover. Musk has since announced on X that future all-hands meetings will be livestreamed on the platform.

article_content: Speaking at a Sino-Russian energy forum in China, Rosneft CEO Igor Sechin emphasized that Russian oil exports to China remain secure, as they do not pass through the conflict-ridden Middle East. He pointed out the significance of this arrangement given recent violence in the region—specifically the October 7 attack by Hamas on southern Israel, which resulted in Israel shutting down several energy installations and wider conflict in Gaza. With Russia’s relations strained with Western nations over the war in Ukraine, Moscow has been deepening ties with China both politically and economically. Russian President Vladimir Putin recently met with China’s leader, Xi Jinping, to reinforce these connections. According to Sechin, Russia has now overtaken Saudi Arabia as the largest oil supplier to China, delivering 75 million tonnes so far this year, marking a 25% increase over last year. China, the world’s second-biggest oil consumer, is now receiving almost 2 million barrels per day from Russia. Most of this oil travels via the Eastern Siberia-Pacific Ocean (ESPO) pipeline to the port of Kozmino, with Rosneft producing roughly 40% of all Russian oil. Sechin stated that the ESPO pipeline offers a more dependable route than oil tankers passing through volatile areas like the Strait of Hormuz or the Suez Canal, given ongoing geopolitical instability there. He also noted that fears of Middle East supply disruptions, including Iran’s call for an oil embargo on Israel, recently pushed global oil prices above $90 per barrel, though prices have moderated as anxieties lessened. Analysts report Israel imports around 250,000 barrels of oil daily, mainly from Kazakhstan, Azerbaijan, Iraq, and African states. Additionally, Sechin called for an increased use of the rouble and yuan in trade between Russia and China, and in transactions with third-party countries. He stressed that stronger cooperation between the Bank of Russia and the People's Bank of China would be essential for this effort.

article_content: Basketball legend Michael Jordan, now 50, is preparing to welcome his fourth child. His wife, 34-year-old Cuban-American model Yvette Prieto, is expecting, seven months after their Palm Beach, Florida, wedding. The couple, who met in a Miami nightclub in 2008, dated for five years before marrying. Their ceremony took place at the Episcopal Church of Bethesda-by-the-Sea on April 27, followed by a luxurious $10 million reception at Bear's Club in Jupiter, Florida. Notable guests at the star-packed event included Tiger Woods, Patrick Ewing, and Spike Lee. Entertainment was provided by stars like Usher, Robin Thicke, K’Jon, The Source band, and DJ MC Lyte. The couple shared their first dance to K'Jon's 'On the Ocean.' Their wedding set records for its extravagant tent, reportedly exceeding the size of Jordan’s 35,000-square-foot home. Prieto wore a bespoke J’Aton Couture gown, adorned with French silk, handmade lace, Swarovski crystals, and a dramatic cathedral train. Sources told People magazine the wedding had been in the works for months, with Jordan determined to grant Yvette her dream celebration. This child will be Jordan’s fourth; he shares three children with his former wife Juanita Vanoy, whom he divorced in 2006 after a 17-year marriage. His sons Jeffrey (24) and Marcus (22) both played basketball before choosing other directions. Daughter Jasmine (20), a Syracuse University student, has addressed public interest in her private life and emphasizes that, though proud of her family, she is her own person. Jordan has acknowledged the unique pressures his children face because of his fame, once telling them during his Hall of Fame induction, 'I wouldn’t want to be you guys.' The couple’s next chapter awaits as they prepare for their new arrival.

article_content: Colin Hodge, the previously anonymous co-founder of the Bang with Friends app, has now been publicly identified. The app, which Hodge created with Omri Mor, allows Facebook users to discreetly express interest in casual relationships with their friends by clicking a button beneath their profiles. A key feature is that users are only notified if their interest is mutual, ensuring privacy. According to Hodge, Bang with Friends has attracted over 1 million users, who log in around 70,000 times daily. He reports that the app has helped facilitate more than 200,000 matches. Hodge, who studied computer science at Cornell University, conceived the idea while working on another dating site, HeardAboutYou. He noted that female users often struggled to seek casual encounters without fear of being judged. The app's branding and approach were deliberately playful and straightforward. Hodge and Mor planned to reveal their involvement on a late-night talk show, but their identities were disclosed prematurely at an Internet Week event. Despite its success, Bang with Friends has faced setbacks. Its iOS app was recently removed from Apple's App Store for violating content guidelines related to objectionable content. Additionally, a privacy glitch led to some Facebook users unintentionally revealing their involvement with the app, depending on their privacy settings.

Oluline funktsioon on, et kasutajad saavad teate vaid siis, kui huvi on vastastikune, tagades privaatsuse. article_content: India’s continued oil and gas purchases from Russia have helped soften global markets and aided in controlling worldwide inflation, according to External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar. Speaking at the 'How a Billion People See the World' event at the Royal Over-Seas League in London, Jaishankar responded to questions about India’s independent approach despite Western sanctions on Russia following its invasion of Ukraine. Jaishankar emphasized the steady relationship between India and Russia, noting that Russia is not seen as a revisionist power in the East, unlike perceptions in the West. 'If we had not bought oil from Russia, global prices would have increased since we would have competed with Europe for the same supplies, and Europe would have outpriced us,' he explained. He also noted how, in the LNG market, supplies traditionally going to Asia have been diverted to Europe, causing smaller Asian countries to miss out. 'We have actually softened the oil and gas markets with our purchase policies and contributed to managing global inflation. Frankly, we should be thanked for this,' Jaishankar added. On India-Russia relations, Jaishankar highlighted their stability since the 1950s, suggesting that mutual recognition of the relationship’s importance helps maintain balance in the region. He pointed out that for countries east of Russia, it is considered a source of stability. Jaishankar stated that India’s position on Russia during the Ukraine conflict is influenced by over seventy years of shared history. He said that while he understands Western perspectives, India’s view is shaped by its past, noting that after independence, global reaction to its conflict with Pakistan lacked support. He commented: 'We have learned that, while people often speak of principles, actions are often shaped by interests. In this instance, India has a strong interest in preserving its relationship with Russia.' The Q&A session, organized by foreign policy agency Wilton Park, was Jaishankar’s final engagement during his five-day visit to the UK. The discussion also included India-China relations, ongoing diplomatic tensions with Canada, and social and political changes underway in India.

Esinedes Londoni Royal Over-Seas League'i üritusel "Kuidas miljard inimest maailma näeb", vastas Jaishankar küsimustele India iseseisva käitumise kohta, hoolimata Lääne sanktsioonidest Venemaa vastu pärast selle sissetungi Ukrainasse. Jaishankar rõhutas India ja Venemaa stabiilseid suhteid, märkides, et Venemaad ei peeta Idas revisionistlikuks jõuks, erinevalt Lääne arusaamadest. 'Kui me poleks Venemaalt naftat ostnud, oleksid maailmaturu hinnad tõusnud, sest oleksime koos Euroopaga konkureerinud samade tarnijate pärast, ning Euroopa oleks meid hinnaga üle löönud,' selgitas ta. Ta tõi välja, et LNG-turul on Aasiasse suunatud tarned suundunud otse Euroopasse, jättes väiksemad Aasia riigid ilma. 'Oleme oma ostupoliitikaga tegelikult pehmendanud nafta- ja gaasiturge ning aidanud hoida ülemaailmset inflatsiooni kontrolli all. Ausalt, meid võiks selle eest tänada,' lisas Jaishankar. India-Venemaa suhetest rääkides tõi Jaishankar esile nende stabiilsuse alates 1950. aastatest, viidates, et mõlemapoolse tähtsuse tunnistamine aitab piirkonnas tasakaalu hoida. Tema sõnul peetakse Venemaad idapoolsetes riikides stabiilsuse allikaks. Jaishankari sõnul on India seisukoht Venemaa suhtes Ukraina sõja ajal mõjutatud enam kui seitsmekümne aasta pikkusest ajaloost. Ta märkis, et kuigi mõistab Lääne vaateid, kujundab India seisukohta oma minevik, eriti kuna iseseisvumise järel jäi ta Pakistani konfliktis rahvusvahelise toeta. Ta lisas: 'Oleme õppinud, et põhimõtteid küll mainitakse palju, aga valdavalt kujundavad käitumist siiski huvid. Selles olukorras on Indial selge huvi hoida häid suhteid Venemaaga.' Arutelu hõlmas ka India ja Hiina suhteid, diplomaatilisi pingeid Kanadaga ning sotsiaalseid ja poliitilisi muutusi Indias.

article_content: Before I delve into the memories and admiration I have for my cousin’s time with the England team, I must say how disappointing it is that England managers never managed to fully harness the talent of Frank Lampard and Steven Gerrard together. With Paul Scholes in the mix, all three excelled at club level—yet, despite their immense talent, they didn’t bring home a European Championship or even reach a major final for England. Together, they've won 38 trophies with their clubs, but none for their country. Reflecting on Lampard’s England debut on October 10, 1999, at the Stadium of Light, the team included Tony Adams, Gareth Southgate, Alan Shearer, Paul Ince, Kieron Dyer, Steve Guppy, Martin Keown, and both my cousin and me. It was our first time playing together since childhood matches at our Grandad Harry’s. Our parents watched from the stands, even though Grandad couldn't make the journey. We only learned we’d be playing together the morning of the game. Frank was a 21-year-old West Ham midfielder, and manager Kevin Keegan handed him his debut against Belgium in Sunderland, with me right beside him. Notably, the Lampards became only the third father-son pairing to represent England, after the Cloughs and Easthams—a proud moment for Frank Senior and Pat. The match was tinged with sadness: a minute's silence was held for the victims of the Paddington rail disaster just five days earlier, and players wore black armbands in their memory. Once the match began, we went on to win 2–1, and I scored a memorable left-footed goal. Although Keegan later claimed he needed to get angry at Frank and me, I don’t remember it—but it did grab the headlines. Frank would go on to have a remarkable international career, earning 106 caps. I’ve always been proud of him and hope he cherishes memories of that debut as much as I do. Frank’s drive and improvement over the years stood out, influenced greatly by his dedicated father. My dad tells stories about Frank’s relentless solo training at West Ham, pushing his stamina and determination—the qualities that shaped his Premier League success. When Frank joined Manchester City after leaving Chelsea, his refusal to let age define him was clear. He’ll soon move to New York, but I suspect he’ll still make a difference at City. He’s built an outstanding career, and now is the right moment for him to retire from international football. It’s been over 14 years since we donned the England shirt together, yet those memories feel recent. Lampard’s England legacy is impressive: 106 caps (equal sixth all-time), 29 goals (ninth for England), 13 World Cup qualifier goals, three goals at Euro 2004, more than 7,600 minutes played, 40 World Cup shots, nine penalties converted out of eleven, and never being sent off. Truly a remarkable career.
translated_content: Enne kui räägin oma mälestustest ja austusest oma nõbu karjääri üle Inglismaa koondises, pean mainima, kui pettumust valmistav on, et Inglismaa peatreenerid ei leidnud kunagi viisi, kuidas Frank Lampardi ja Steven Gerrardi koos mängides nende potentsiaali täielikult ära kasutada. Koos Paul Scholesiga olid kõik kolm klubitasandil suurepärased – ent vaatamata kõrgele klassile ei võidetud Inglismaaga ei Euroopa meistrivõistlusi ega jõutud finaali. Ühiselt võideti klubides 38 karikat, kuid koondise eest mitte ühtegi. Mõeldes tagasi Lampardi Inglismaa debüüdi õhtule 10. oktoobril 1999 Stadium of Lightil, kuulusid meie meeskonda ka Tony Adams, Gareth Southgate, Alan Shearer, Paul Ince, Kieron Dyer, Steve Guppy, Martin Keown ning mina ja Frank. Esmakordselt mängisime pärast lapsepõlve aias toiminud vutimänge koos suurel areenil. Meie vanemad olid tribüünil, kuigi vanaisa seekord kohale ei jõudnud. Alles mängupäeva hommikul selgus, et läheme mõlemad platsile. Frank oli 21-aastane West Hami poolkaitsja ning peatreener Kevin Keegan andis talle esimese võimaluse Belgia vastu Sunderlandi staadionil, mina tema kõrval. Lampardid said alles kolmandaks isa-poja paariks Inglismaa koondise ajaloos, seda pärast Clough’e ja Easthameid – see oli väga uhke hetk Frank Seniori ja Pati jaoks. Mängu eel avaldati austust Paddingtoni rongiõnnetuse ohvritele minutilise leinaseisakuga, mängijad kandsid musti leinalinte. Pärast hetke vaikust võitsime Belgia 2–1, mina ise lõin vasakuga iluvärava. Ehkki Keegan väitis pärast mängu, et pidi meie peale karmimalt ütlema, ma seda eriti ei mäleta – küll aga jõudis see jutt uudistesse. Frankil kujunes rahvusvahelisest karjäärist tõeliselt muljetavaldav: ta kandis Inglismaa särki 106 korral. Olen tema üle alati uhke olnud ning loodan, et meenutame mõlemad seda debüüti suure soojusega. Franki sihikindlus ja pidev areng olid märkimisväärsed – selles mängis suurt rolli ka tema nõudlik isa. Mu oma isa jutustas, kuidas Frank harjutas West Hamis tihti üksi, et vastupidavust ja tahtejõudu kasvatada – need omadused viisidki ta Premier League’i tippu. Kui Frank pärast Chelseast lahkumist liitus Manchester Cityga, näitas ta, et vanus teda ei pidurda. Kuna ees ootab New York, usun et Citys suudab ta veelgi midagi olulist korda saata. Tal on erakordne karjäär ning nüüd on õige aeg rahvuskoondisest lahkuda. On möödas üle 14 aasta sellest, kui viimati Inglismaa särgis väljakul olime, kuid need mälestused on selged. Lampardi pärand Inglismaa eest: 106 mängu (jagab ajaloolist 6. kohta), 29 väravat (9. tulemus), 13 väravat MM-i valikmängudes, kolm väravat EM-finaalturniiril, üle 7600 mänguminuti, 40 lööki MMil, 9 penaltit 11-st, mitte ühtki punast kaarti. Tõeline jalgpallilegend.

Collecting accurate weather data in remote and challenging environments like polar regions and mountains is often difficult due to limited infrastructure and harsh conditions that make traditional weather stations hard to maintain. Drones can safely navigate these terrains, gathering and transmitting critical data, making them indispensable for filling data gaps. However, in-cloud drone flights present the challenge of icing caused by supercooled droplets, which can damage essential drone components.

To tackle this, Dr. Jun Inoue and Dr. Kazutoshi Sato from Japan's National Institute of Polar Research implemented onboard aerosol counters in drones during the Japanese Antarctic Research Expedition of 2022/2023. This research was published in Atmospheric Environment.

Aerosol counters, typically used to measure particle concentrations in the air, helped the researchers detect clouds during drone flights. According to Dr. Inoue, "Under usual conditions in our expedition, we typically observe concentrations of fewer than a thousand particles per liter. However, when we encounter icing conditions, we see concentrations of 5,000 particles per liter or even higher." This significant change allows drones to identify and respond to hazardous conditions in real-time.

During meteorological vertical profiling—gathering atmospheric data from different altitudes—the drones mostly move vertically. This helps operators decide more easily when to descend if icing is detected. The aerosol counter gives drone operators timely information to make safe decisions.

To validate this method, the scientists compared aerosol counter data with information from a shipboard lidar ceilometer, which measures cloud properties such as height and phase. They analyzed the attenuated backscatter coefficient (an indicator of how light bounces off clouds) and established a strong link between increased particle counts from aerosol counters and the presence of supercooled liquid clouds, based on 47 in-cloud drone flights.

The aerosol counters detected icing conditions in about half the flights, which sometimes reached up to 1,000 meters above sea level. This allowed drones to avoid dangerous icing situations.

Drones are proving to be valuable tools for studying the atmosphere in remote regions. According to Dr. Inoue, with continued innovation and collaboration, drone technology could revolutionize meteorological research and deepen our understanding of clouds, weather, and their broader effects.

Täpse ilmastikuandmete kogumine kaugemates ja keerulistes piirkondades, nagu polaaralad ja mäestikud, on sageli keeruline, sest seal puudub vajalik infrastruktuur ning karmid olud muudavad traditsiooniliste ilmajaamade hooldamise raskeks. Droonid saavad nendes tingimustes turvaliselt liikuda, kogudes ja edastades olulist teavet ning täites andmelünki. Siiski on pilvedes lendamine droonide jaoks keeruline jäätumise tõttu, mida põhjustavad alajahtunud veepiisad – see võib kahjustada drooni olulisi komponente.

Selle probleemi lahendamiseks integreerisid Jaapani Polaariuurimisinstituudi teadlased dr Jun Inoue ja dr Kazutoshi Sato droonidesse aerosooliarvestid 2022/2023. aasta Jaapani Antarktika teadusekspeditsiooni ajal. Uurimistöö avaldati ajakirjas Atmospheric Environment.

Tavaliselt kasutatakse aerosooliarvesteid õhus olevate osakeste hulga mõõtmiseks, kuid seekord aitasid need teadlastel tuvastada pilvi droonilendude ajal. "Tavalistes tingimustes näeme ekspeditsioonil alla tuhande osakese liitri kohta," selgitas dr Inoue. "Jäätumise korral võib osakeste hulk olla 5 000 või isegi enam liitri kohta." See suur erinevus võimaldab droonidel ohtlikud tingimused reaalajas tuvastada ja neile reageerida.

Meteoroloogilise vertikaalse profileerimise käigus lendavad droonid peamiselt vertikaalsuunas, võimaldades operaatoritel vajadusel jäätumise korral kiiremini laskuda. Aerosooliarvesti pakub droonipilootidele õigeaegset teavet turvaliste otsuste tegemiseks.

Meetodi usaldusväärsuse kontrollimiseks võrreldi aerosooliarvesti näite laeval asuva lidar-tüüpi tselomeetri andmetega, mis mõõdab pilvede omadusi nagu kõrgus ja koostis. Analüüsides valguse tagasipeegeldumist pilvedelt, leiti tugev seos suurenenud osakeste hulga ja alajahtunud pilvede esinemise vahel – seda näitasid 47 pilvlendu droonidega.

Aerosooliarvestid tuvastasid jäätumisolud umbes pooltes lendudest, kus kõrgus ulatus mõnikord 1 000 meetrini üle merepinna. See võimaldas vältida droonide sattumist ohtlikesse jäätumisoludesse.

Droonid on seega väärtuslik vahend atmosfääri uurimiseks kaugpiirkondades. Dr Inoue sõnul võib jätkuva innovatsiooni ja koostöö abil droonitehnoloogia arendada meteoroloogiat ja süvendada meie arusaama pilvedest, ilmast ning nende laiematest mõjudest.

Philip Barnwell, formerly headteacher at Woodside High School in Wood Green, north London, has received a lifelong ban from teaching following findings of a highly inappropriate relationship with a female student aged 15 at the time. Investigations revealed that Barnwell, then 36, supplied alcohol to the student—referred to as 'Pupil A'—invited her on trips, and permitted her to stay overnight and share his bed. The relationship started while she was still at the school and continued after her departure, ultimately leading to her pregnancy at age 17. After an initial investigation was discontinued in 2008 due to the pupil not participating, concerns resurfaced when Barnwell pursued further teaching opportunities, resulting in a professional conduct hearing.

The inquiry determined that Barnwell's repeated unsupervised contact with the student, including private communications and overnight stays, amounted to a severe breach of professional standards and a clear abuse of his position. Testimonies from other students and teachers, as well as observations of the two outside school, supported these findings. The panel deemed Barnwell’s actions deliberate, unacceptable, and incompatible with the teaching profession.

Barnwell has denied any misconduct, asserting that 'inappropriate relationship' lacks clear definition in guidelines. Nevertheless, Alan Meyrick from the Department for Education enforced a permanent teaching ban, citing Barnwell’s lack of insight into the seriousness or impact of his actions. The prohibition extends to all educational and youth settings in England. The panel emphasized the importance of protecting vulnerable pupils and upholding public confidence in schools. Barnwell retains the right to appeal the decision within 28 days before the High Court.

As the founder of Ares Corporation, I am dedicated to bridging the gap between traditional businesses and the emerging landscape of Web3. In today’s rapidly changing technological environment, Web3—a framework that relies on blockchain technology, decentralized networks, and digital assets—is fundamentally reshaping online operations and challenging longstanding business practices.

My mission is to help traditional businesses transition into this new paradigm and unlock the vast potential Web3 offers. While Web3 creates online spaces that are more decentralized, trustworthy, and user-focused, helping established businesses move into this arena is not without its challenges. The journey can be difficult, with significant hurdles to overcome, but it also offers valuable lessons along the way.

The Value of Decentralization and Shared Control

From early on, I recognized the transformative power of decentralized systems for business. However, I also understand how difficult it can be for traditional organizations, which often have rigid top-down structures, to relinquish control. Web3, by contrast, relies on collective decision-making and empowerment of users and participants. To fully leverage its benefits, stakeholders must be willing to share control and trust the community. Although this shift is not easy, it is essential for realizing the full potential of Web3.

Adopting Blockchain and Transparency

Blockchain technology is the foundation of Web3, ensuring trust and transparency through decentralized ledgers. Integrating blockchain into my business required a significant mindset shift—not just adopting new technology, but fundamentally changing how the business operates. Traditional enterprises often rely on intermediaries like banks or legal entities for trust and transactions; Web3 replaces these roles with smart contracts and consensus mechanisms. Success in this ecosystem requires understanding these tools and adapting business models accordingly. The transformation may lower costs and create new revenue streams through tokenization and participation in decentralized finance (DeFi). More than just a technical change, blockchain adoption can reimagine an organization’s competitiveness and growth in the Web3 era.

Community Building as a Core Element

Web3 flourishes through communities that are actively engaged in projects and platforms. Building a strong community around your Web3 initiative is as important as the technology itself. Engagement should be a two-way process—listening to feedback, ideas, and concerns from members demonstrates their value. Ongoing communication and transparency help build trust, turning participants into advocates who propel your project forward.

Regulatory Challenges and Opportunities

Web3’s evolution often outpaces regulatory frameworks, making compliance daunting for traditional businesses. Regulations differ widely by jurisdiction. Partnering with legal professionals who understand Web3 is vital. These challenges, however, also present opportunities. Early adopters from traditional industries can collaborate with regulators to help create fair, effective policies and contribute to a more inclusive Web3 ecosystem.

Looking Ahead

Web3 offers both significant opportunities and real challenges for established enterprises. Adoption requires adapting, learning, and a willingness to collaborate. My experience demonstrates that combining traditional business wisdom with Web3 innovations is not only possible but necessary. Beyond technology, this process involves transforming approaches to commerce, governance, and interaction. By seeking knowledge and starting your transition now, you can help shape a more decentralized, transparent, and user-centered future. Remember, adopting Web3 is an ongoing journey, not a final destination.

Ares Corporationi asutajana olen pühendunud silla loomisele traditsiooniliste ettevõtete ja Web3 uue maastiku vahel. Tänases kiiresti muutuvas tehnoloogiakeskkonnas kujundab Web3 – plokiahelal, detsentraliseeritud võrkudel ja digivaradel põhinev raamistik – põhjalikult ümber veebitegevusi ning seab väljakutseid seni kehtinud äritavadele.

Minu eesmärk on aidata traditsioonilistel ettevõtetel liikuda sellesse uude paradigmasse ja avada Web3 pakutav tohutu potentsiaal. Kuigi Web3 loob hajutatud, usaldusväärsemaid ning kasutajakesksemaid veebiruumid, pole traditsioonilistel ettevõtetel sellesse keskkonda sisenemine lihtne. See teekond võib olla keeruline, täis suuri takistusi, kuid tõotab ka väärtuslikke õppetunde.

Detsentraliseerimise ja jagatud juhtimise väärtus

Varakult nägin detsentraliseeritud süsteemide muutvat mõju ettevõtetele, aga mõistan, kui raske võib traditsioonilistel organisatsioonidel – kel sageli jäik ülal-alla struktuur – olla kontrollist loobuda. Web3 tugineb aga kollektiivsele otsustamisele ja kasutajate ning osalejate võimustamisele. Web3 eeliste saamiseks tuleb juhtimist jagada ja kogukonda usaldada. See pole lihtne muutus, kuid hädavajalik täieliku potentsiaali saavutamiseks.

Plokiahela ja läbipaistvuse omaksvõtt

Plokiahela tehnoloogia moodustab Web3 aluse, pakkudes usaldust ja läbipaistvust detsentraliseeritud pearaamatu kaudu. Plokiahela juurutamine minu ettevõttesse nõudis olulist mõtteviisi muutust – mitte ainult uue tehnoloogia omaksvõtmist, vaid kogu äritegevuse ümbermõtestamist. Traditsioonilised ettevõtted tuginevad tihti vahendajatele, nagu pangad võiõigusasutused, samas kui Web3 võtab kasutusele nutilepingud ja konsensusmehhanismid. Edu saavutamiseks tuleb neist tööriistadest aru saada ning oma ärimudelit vastavalt kohandada. Muutus võib vähendada kulusid ja avada uusi tuluvooge tokeniseerimise ja detsentraliseeritud finantslahenduste (DeFi) kaudu. Plokiahela kasutuselevõtt pole ainuüksi tehnoloogiline uuendus, vaid võib oluliselt tõsta ettevõtte konkurentsivõimet ja kasvupotentsiaali Web3 ajastul.

Kogukonna loomine kui võtmetegur

Web3 edule paneb aluse aktiivne kogukond projektide ja platvormide ümber. Tugeva kogukonna loomine on sama oluline kui tehnoloogia. Kaasamise puhul on oluline kahesuunaline suhtlus – tagasiside, ideede ja murede kuulamine näitab, et liikmeid väärtustatakse. Järjepidev suhtlus ja läbipaistvus aitavad usaldust kasvatada, muutes kogukonna liikmed projektide eestvedajateks.

Regulatiivsed väljakutsed ja võimalused

Web3 areneb sageli kiiremini kui regulatsioonid, muutes vastavuse tagamise traditsioonilistele ettevõtetele keeruliseks. Regulatsioonid on riigiti erinevad. Koostöö Web3-te tundvate õigusspetsialistidega on seega väga oluline. Need väljakutsed loovad aga ka võimalusi. Varased liitujad saavad partnerluses regulaatoritega aidata kujundada ausaid ja tõhusaid reegleid ning arendada kaasaegset Web3 ökosüsteemi.

Tulevikku vaadates

Web3 avab ettevõtetele nii suuri võimalusi kui ka märkimisväärseid väljakutseid. Kohanemiseks on vaja valmisolekut õppida ja teha koostööd. Minu kogemus näitab, et traditsioonilise äritarkuse ja Web3 uuenduste ühendamine on võimalik ja vajalik. See protsess tähendab rohkemat kui pelka tehnoloogilist muutust – muutma peab ka äri, juhtimist ja suhtlemist. Alusta teadmiste omandamist ning seda teekonda juba täna, et olla osa detsentraliseeritumast, läbipaistvamast ja inimkesksemast tulevikust. Pea meeles: Web3 on pidev arengutee, mitte lõppsihtpunkt.

Cypriot officials report a rise in Syrian refugees arriving from Lebanon, attributing the surge to Lebanon's struggles in managing migration amid fears of the Israel-Hamas conflict spreading regionally. In just one week, Cyprus received 458 Syrian refugees from Lebanon, according to authorities. As border skirmishes between Lebanon and Israel escalate, Cypriot authorities say they are preparing for a larger influx of asylum seekers.

On Saturday, several boats carrying migrants arrived on Cyprus’s shores. The first vessel from Lebanon brought 110 people, followed by another with 52, both heading towards the southeastern resort town of Ayia Napa. Later, two more boats carrying a combined 32 individuals were intercepted and directed to the southern port of Larnaca. That night, four more boats brought 194 Syrians to Cyprus, who were taken to the Pournara reception center near Nicosia.

Loizos Hadjivasiliou, an Interior Ministry official, told the Cyprus News Agency that the Pournara center has reached capacity, prompting the activation of an emergency plan to address the increased arrivals. These incidents follow the arrival of 264 Syrian refugees a week earlier, also from Lebanon.

Interior Minister Constantinos Ioannou accused Beirut of failing to control migration across the Mediterranean, citing Lebanon’s possible involvement in the Gaza conflict and its deteriorating conditions as factors undermining its ability to monitor its borders. Lebanon is currently home to approximately 805,000 UN-registered Syrian refugees, but officials believe the true figure might be as high as two million. According to UNHCR, about 90 percent of Syrian refugees in Lebanon live in extreme poverty. Lebanon's ongoing economic crisis has further prompted both refugees and Lebanese citizens to attempt sea crossings to escape the country.

Cyprus says it has become a ‘front-line country’ on the Mediterranean migrant route, with asylum seekers now making up about 6 percent of the republic’s 915,000-strong population—reportedly the highest proportion in the European Union. The government claims to have reduced irregular migrant arrivals by 50 percent since last year. However, in August, UNHCR expressed grave concern over Cyprus returning Syrian asylum seekers to Lebanon. UNHCR’s Lisa Abou Khaled noted that most of the 109 Syrians returned from Cyprus were subsequently deported to Syria after being investigated by the Lebanese army. The UNHCR office in Cyprus said deportations and cross-border transfers without proper legal safeguards contravene international and European law.

Cypriot authorities defend these actions, stating they are conducted lawfully under a 2004 bilateral agreement with Lebanon. In response to the migration surge, Cyprus has sought EU assistance and is co-financing the construction of a new reception center for up to 1,000 migrants, where asylum applications will be processed or reviewed.

Küprose ametnikud teatavad Süüriast pärit põgenike arvu kasvust, kes saabuvad Liibanonist, ning seovad selle kasvu Liibanoni raskustega rände haldamisel ja hirmuga Iisraeli-Hamasi konflikti laienemise ees. Ametivõimude sõnul saabus Küprosele ainuüksi ühe nädala jooksul Liibanonist 458 Süüria põgenikku. Kuna piiritülid Liibanoni ja Iisraeli vahel hoogustuvad, valmistuvad Küprose ametnikud veelgi suuremaks varjupaigataotlejate sissevooluks.

Laupäeval saabus Küprose rannikule mitu põgenikelaeva. Esimene alus tõi Liibanonist 110 inimest, sellele järgnes teine, mille pardal oli veel 52 inimest. Mõlemad laevad suundusid idaosas asuvasse Ayia Napa kuurortlinna. Hiljem peeti kinni veel kaks alust kokku 32 inimesega, kes toimetati Larnaca lõunasadamasse. Samal õhtul saabus neli laeva, millega toodi 194 Süüria inimest Pournara vastuvõtukeskusesse Nikosia lähedal.

Siseministeeriumi ametnik Loizos Hadjivasiliou ütles Küprose uudisteagentuurile, et Pournara keskus on täis ning käivitatud on hädaolukorra plaan suurema saabujate hulga käsitlemiseks. Need juhtumid järgnesid nädal varem Liibanonist saabunud 264 Süüria põgenikule.

Siseminister Constantinos Ioannou süüdistas Beirutit Vahemere rände ebapiisavas kontrollis, viidates Liibanoni võimalikele seostele Gaza konfliktiga ning riigi keerulisele olukorrale, mis muudab piirivalve keerulisemaks. Liibanonis elab praegu umbes 805 000 ÜRO-s registreeritud Süüria põgenikku, kuid ametnike hinnangul võib tegelik arv ulatuda kahe miljonini. ÜRO pagulasameti (UNHCR) andmetel elab umbes 90% Liibanonis viibivatest Süüria põgenikest äärmises vaesuses. Liibanoni majanduskriis on suurendanud nii pagulaste kui ka kohalike elanike püüdu mereteed pidi riigist lahkuda.

Küpros väidab, et neist on saanud Vahemere rändeteel esmane sihtriik, sest varjupaigataotlejad moodustavad umbes 6% vabariigi 915 000 elanikust — Euroopa Liidu riikide seas suurim osakaal. Valitsus väidab, et ebaseaduslike migrantide saabumine on võrreldes mullusega 50% vähenenud. Samas avaldas ÜRO pagulasamet augustis sügavat muret seoses Süüria varjupaigataotlejate tagasisaatmisega Liibanoni. UNHCR-i Liibanoni esindaja Lisa Abou Khaled märkis, et enamik Küproselt tagasisaadetud 109 süürlasest saadeti pärast Liibanoni armee läbivaatamist Süüriasse. UNHCR-i Küprose esindus rõhutas, et tagasisaatmised ja üleviimised ilma rahvusvahelise kaitset vajavate isikute seaduslike tagatisteta rikuvad rahvusvahelist ja Euroopa õigust.

Küprose ametnikud kaitsevad oma tegutsemist, öeldes, et need toimingud viiakse läbi õiguspäraselt vastavalt 2004. aasta kahepoolsele kokkuleppele Liibanoniga. Vastusena suurenenud rändesurvele otsib Küpros abi Euroopa Liidult ja koos rahastatakse kuni 1000 inimese mahutava vastuvõtukeskuse ehitamist, kus vaadatakse üle varjupaigataotlused.
