article_content: When the United States Postal Service announced it would stop delivering mail on Saturdays, many people who find email overwhelming might have felt a bit envious—imagine getting two days off from incoming messages. Unlike traditional mail though, email is now an around-the-clock presence. However, a new app called Mailbox aims to make managing your email easier. Mailbox is a much-anticipated iPhone app designed to tackle overflowing inboxes using simple gesture controls and a notable 'Snooze' function. As of Thursday, it is available on the Apple App Store after months of previews and praise from beta testers. Developed by Orchestra, a two-year-old startup based in Palo Alto, California, Mailbox builds on the typical mobile mail app look but adds intuitive swipe gestures for organizing and prioritizing emails. According to Gentry Underwood, founder and CEO of Orchestra, the company started with the belief that people treat email like an ineffective to-do list. Mailbox lets users quickly clear out non-urgent messages to focus on what matters. It uses four main gestures: a partial right swipe archives a message, a full right swipe deletes it, a long left swipe adds it to a list, and a short left swipe brings up a Snooze option. The Snooze feature allows users to postpone messages for customizable periods, including options like later today, tomorrow, next week, or a specific date. Snoozed messages are hidden from the inbox until the selected time, making email management less overwhelming. Archived and snoozed messages are stored in dedicated tabs, ensuring that nothing is permanently lost. This approach is inspired by the 'Inbox Zero' method, popularized by productivity expert Merlin Mann, which aims to maintain a clutter-free inbox. The article emphasizes that modern email is overloaded with both personal and automated messages, which can make traditional email clients overwhelming. Mailbox's gesture-based controls are designed to make sorting emails fast and even enjoyable. A third of Mailbox’s beta testers reportedly achieve Inbox Zero at least once a week, which helps users focus on immediate tasks rather than being distracted by postponed items. Mailbox's design was partly influenced by the 'Clear' to-do app, known for its innovative gesture-based interface. Like Clear, Mailbox takes some getting used to, but the gestures quickly become second nature. Currently, Mailbox is only available for iPhones and works solely with Gmail accounts. The company is intentionally focused on mobile simplicity before expanding features. Users can join a waitlist within the app to gain access. Orchestra plans to expand Mailbox in the future, possibly including paid versions, support for more email clients, Android support, and advanced automation. Ultimately, the team may develop a desktop version, but their present priority is to create a great, efficient mobile email experience.
translated_content: Kui Ameerika Ühendriikide Postiteenus teatas, et lõpetab laupäeviti kirjade kohaletoimetamise, võisid paljud, kellele e-post tundub väsitav, tunda väikest kadedust – kujutlege kahte päeva ilma uute sõnumiteta. Erinevalt tavapostist on e-post aga ööpäevaringselt kohal. Uus rakendus nimega Mailbox aitab siiski meilide haldamist kergemaks muuta. Mailbox on kauaoodatud iPhone’i rakendus, mis aitab korrastada täis postkaste lihtsate žestide ja tähelepanuväärse 'Edasilükkamise' funktsiooniga. Alates neljapäevast on rakendus pärast mitmekuulist eelvaadet ja beetakasutajate kiitust lõpuks Apple’i App Store’is saadaval. Mailboxi arendas Orchestra – kaheaastane Palo Altos, Californias asuv idufirma –, mis toob tuttava mobiilse meiliprogrammi välimuse koos mugavate žestipõhiste lahendustega meilide korrastamiseks ja tähtsustamiseks. Orchestra asutaja ja tegevjuhi Gentry Underwoodi sõnul alustasid nad uskumusest, et inimesed kasutavad e-posti sageli ebatõhusa ülesandeloendina. Mailbox võimaldab kiirelt eemaldada mitteolulised sõnumid, et keskenduda tähtsamale. Kasutuses on neli peamist žesti: kerge paremale viipamine arhiveerib kirja, täielik paremale liigutus kustutab selle, pikk vasakule lohistus lisab meili nimekirja ning lühike vasakule viipamine käivitab edasilükkamise funktsiooni. 'Edasilükkamine' võimaldab sõnumeid edasi lükata erinevateks ajavahemikeks – näiteks hilisemaks tänaseks, homme, järgmiseks nädalaks või kindlale kuupäevale. Nii kaovad need kirjad postkastist kuni määratud ajani, muutes haldamise vähem stressirohkeks. Arhiveeritud ja edasi lükatud kirjad salvestatakse eraldi sakkidesse, seega miski ei kao jäädavalt. See lähenemine on inspireeritud Merlin Manni populariseeritud meetodist 'Tühi postkast', mille eesmärgiks on hoida postkast korras. Artikkel rõhutab, et tänapäeval on e-post üle koormatud nii isiklike kui ka automaatsõnumitega, mistõttu on traditsioonilised meiliprogrammid sageli ebamugavad. Mailboxi žestipõhised funktsioonid muudavad sorteerimise kiiremaks ja isegi nauditavaks. Kolmandik Mailboxi beetatestijatest jõuab vähemalt korra nädalas tühja postkastini, mis aitab keskenduda ainult vajalikele ülesannetele. Mailboxi disain on saanud inspiratsiooni ka 'Cleari' rakendusest, mis paistab silma uuendusliku žestikasutusega. Nagu Cleari puhul, muutuvad ka Mailboxi žestid kiiresti loomulikuks pärast lühikest harjumisfaasi. Praegu töötab Mailbox ainult iPhone’is ja Gmaili kontodega. Ettevõte keskendub teadlikult mobiilsele lihtsusele enne täiendavate võimaluste vabastamist. Rakenduse kaudu saab liituda ootenimekirjaga. Orchestra plaanib tulevikus Mailboxi arendada: võimalikud on tasulised versioonid, tugi teistele meiliteenustele, Androidi tugi ning targemad automatiseerimisvõimalused. Lõpuks võib tulla ka lauaarvutiversioon, ent hetkel on fookus suurepärase ja tõhusa mobiilirakenduse loomisel.

article_content: Greece has ushered in a new political era by electing Syriza, a left-wing party opposed to austerity, to form the government. Alexis Tsipras took office as prime minister on Monday, partnering with the right-wing Independent Greeks to build a coalition. Tsipras has promised to put an end to austerity measures and seek new terms for Greece’s European Union bailout. Since 2010, Greece has received €240 billion in financial assistance, but that support came with strict conditions from the IMF, European Commission, and European Central Bank—including tax hikes, pension freezes, restrictions on early retirement, and substantial cuts to public sector pay. Syriza’s campaign, built on seeking debt relief and rolling back unpopular budget cuts, resonated with voters weary of prolonged hardship. However, this stance has sparked concerns about Greece’s standing in the eurozone. Syriza's unexpected win is sending ripples through southern Europe, where similar anti-austerity and populist movements—like Italy’s Five Star Movement and Spain’s Podemos—are gaining traction. On election night, Tsipras, who is 40, rallied supporters by declaring Greece had reclaimed its dignity and would move forward with conviction and hope. The markets are keeping a close watch on developments, and European policies remain firm. Benoît Cœuré, from the ECB’s executive board, told CNN that obligations must be honored. He emphasized that bailout funds were provided by European governments, making it a matter for negotiation with those authorities—not the ECB directly. EU Commission spokesman Margaritis Schinas noted the EU’s respect for the Greek electorate and expressed readiness to collaborate with the new government on ongoing reforms. Despite painful cutbacks, Greece has made notable economic progress, but challenges remain. Austerity has taken a harsh toll: unemployment has reached 28%, salaries and pensions have fallen, and retirement has been delayed. The previous prime minister, Antonis Samaras, defended his crisis management, remarking that he had stabilized Greece and preserved its place in the EU and euro. Meanwhile, Piraeus Bank CEO Anthimos Thomopoulos described the timing as favorable for Syriza, pointing to improving economic indicators, a shift in European conditions, and supportive policies from the European Central Bank. He viewed the transition as an opportunity for both Greece and its new government. Tsipras suggested that Syriza’s victory might inspire anti-austerity efforts across Europe, framing their win as meaningful beyond Greek borders. Nevertheless, it remains uncertain how the party’s plans to renegotiate bailout terms will unfold and what effect this will have on Greece’s relationship with its European partners.
translated_content: Kreeka alustas uut poliitilist ajajärku, valides võimule vasakpoolsest parteist Syriza, mis on rangete kokkuhoiumeetmete vastu. Alexis Tsipras astus esmaspäeval peaministrina ametisse, tehes valitsuskoalitsiooni parempoolse Iseseisvad Kreeklased parteiga. Tsipras on lubanud lõpetada karmid kärped ja taotleda Kreekale Euroopa Liidu abipaketi uued tingimused. Alates 2010. aastast on Kreeka saanud 240 miljardit eurot abi, kuid selle eelduseks olid ranged meetmed Rahvusvaheliselt Valuutafondilt, Euroopa Komisjonilt ja Euroopa Keskpangalt – sealhulgas maksutõusud, pensionide külmutamine, varasema pensionilemineku piirangud ja ulatuslikud avaliku sektori palkade kärped. Syriza kampaania keskendus võlalõdvenduse taotlemisele ning ebapopulaarsete kärbete tagasikeeramisele, mis kõnetas kriisist väsinud valijaid. Selline seisukoht on aga tekitanud muret Kreeka positsiooni pärast euroalal. Syriza ootamatu võit saadab laineid läbi Lõuna-Euroopa, kus kogub hoogu mitu sarnast kokkuhoiuvastast ning populistlikku liikumist – näiteks Itaalia Viie Tähe Liikumine ja Hispaania Podemos. Valimisõhtul kinnitas 40-aastane Tsipras toetajatele, et Kreeka on tagasi saanud väärikuse ning liigub edasi enesekindlalt ja lootusrikkalt. article_content: The CEO and cofounder of the Cyber Leadership Institute leads a rapidly growing community of cyber leaders spanning more than 50 countries. Generative AI emerged as a major technology at the end of 2022, with tools like GPT-4, ChatGPT, AlphaCode, Midjourney, Bard, and more, quickly moving from hype to widespread adoption. Seen as the most significant technological breakthrough since social media, generative AI can create text, images, and sounds based on brief user prompts. This innovation continues to transform industries, enabling tasks such as handling emails, preparing taxes, composing music, writing business materials, debugging code, drafting blueprints, and even offering health advice. In ISACA’s Generative AI Survey, more than 2,000 digital trust professionals participated, with 85% agreeing that generative AI will increase human productivity. Another analysis predicts generative AI could add as much as $15.7 trillion to the global economy by 2030, surpassing the current outputs of China and India combined. Yet as businesses embrace these opportunities, new and significant risks also arise. The ISACA survey notes many challenges—three major ones are ambiguous policies, unclear regulations, and cultural pushback.  Clear leadership direction is essential. Executives should set clear policies for the safe use of generative AI. ISACA’s survey found only 28% of organizations currently allow the use of generative AI, and 35% were uncertain. Ignoring or banning generative AI may encourage employees to sidestep governance, exposing the organization to security and privacy issues. Organizations also risk losing ambitious employees to competitors who are more innovative. CEOs should provide a clear message on the responsible adoption of generative AI that aligns with organizational goals. It’s important for leadership to develop thorough AI usage policies that reflect the organization's risk tolerance. Policies should at minimum: 1. Create guidelines for protecting intellectual property, including copyrights and patents. 2. Require qualified human review of AI-generated outputs for accuracy and originality before important decisions or public release. 3. Forbid entering confidential data into public AI platforms unless protection is guaranteed. 4. Define acceptable, ethical, and legal uses of AI.  Understanding legal implications follows policy creation. Legal teams should clarify how laws governing AI use impact the business. Failing to consider legal risks has already resulted in lawsuits in the U.S. over unauthorized use of copyrighted data in AI training. For international organizations, differing regulations add complexity. Some global regulatory actions include: - China’s regulator requiring government review of AI chat tools and enforcing law-compliant training data. - The EU's development of top-down rules banning some high-risk AI uses. - U.S. White House efforts to gather public feedback for future policy advice.  Executives should consider: 1. What AI-specific legal risks exist in current and future markets? 2. Can legal guidelines be translated into everyday business processes effectively? 3. Does internal legal expertise suffice, or is outside help required? 4. Are risk policies being updated to reflect new AI laws, balancing innovation against potential downsides?  Training gaps present another challenge: only 6% of organizations provide AI training to all staff, while 45% worry AI could replace jobs. Without addressing these fears, organizations risk resistance that may hinder program success. Management should prioritize employee upskilling and adapt workforce strategies for evolving needs. Identifying areas where AI can enhance—not just replace—human work is key. A lasting transformation comes from cultivating a culture of continuous learning and providing incentives for employee development.  Looking to the future, the World Economic Forum predicts generative AI will drive major changes in economies and job markets. To capitalize on benefits, managers must ensure AI initiatives align with organizational risk thresholds.  Forbes Business Council is a leading networking group for business owners and executives.

Juhtkond peaks kehtestama selged reeglid generatiivse AI turvaliseks kasutamiseks. ISACA uuring näitas, et ainult 28% organisatsioonidest lubab ametlikult generatiivset AI-d kasutada, 35% vastajatest oli ebakindel. Keelama konfidentsiaalse info lisamise avalikele AI platvormidele, kui andmekaitset ei saa tagada. 4. Selgitama lubatud, eetilise ja seadusliku AI kasutuse.  Õiguslike nüansside mõistmine järgneb poliitika kehtestamisele. Õigusosakonnad peaksid selgitama, kuidas AI kasutamist reguleerivad seadused ettevõtet mõjutavad. Juhtkond peaks arutama: 1. Millised AI-ga seotud juriidilised riskid on olemas meie praegustel ja potentsiaalsetel turgudel? 2. Kas õigusnõuded saab tõhusalt integreerida igapäevastesse äriprotsessidesse? 3. Kas meie sisemine õigusekspertiis on piisav või on vaja väliseid nõustajaid? 4. Kas meie riskipoliitikaid uuendatakse vastavalt uutele AI seadustele, et tasakaalustada innovatsiooni ja võimalikke riske?  Teine probleem on koolituse puudumine: ainult 6% organisatsioonidest pakub kõigile töötajatele AI-alast koolitust ning 45% kardab töökohtade asendumist AI-ga. Nende hirmude eiramine võib põhjustada töötajate vastuseisu, mis võib programmi edu ohustada. Juhtkond peaks seadma prioriteediks oskuste arendamise ja kohandama tööjõu strateegiat muutuva vajaduse järgi. Oluline on leida tööd, kus AI täiendab, mitte lihtsalt asendab, inimtööjõudu. Püsivate muudatuste eelduseks on pideva õppe kultuuri kujundamine ja töötajate arengu motiveerimine.  Tulevikku vaadates, Maailma Majandusfoorum prognoosib generatiivse AI tõttu suuri muudatusi majandustes ja tööturul. Kasu maksimeerimiseks peavad juhid kindlustama, et AI algatused on kooskõlas organisatsiooni riskitaluvusega.  Forbes Business Council on üheks juhtivaks ärijuhtide ja omanike võrgustikuks.

article_content: Colombia’s principal rebel group has agreed to release French journalist Romeo Langlois, who has been held as a 'prisoner of war' for around two weeks. The group proposes that a committee—composed of Piedad Cordoba (a prominent human rights activist and ex-senator), a representative for French President-elect Francois Hollande, and the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC)—manage the logistics of his release. Cordoba is recognised for her significant involvement in previous hostage negotiations, most recently facilitating the release of the last 10 security force hostages held by the rebels. The ICRC, through spokesman Daniel Munoz, expressed readiness to assist, confirming their logistical support is available nation-wide as soon as a time and place are decided. President Juan Manuel Santos reiterated the Colombian government’s commitment to securing Langlois’ safe and rapid release. He further stated, ‘If the rebels genuinely want to show goodwill, just share his location and we will collect him at once.’ Langlois, who has documented Colombia’s conflict for over a decade for France 24, was taken during a rebel attack while embedded with soldiers. The assault led to the deaths of a sergeant, two soldiers, and a police officer, and left six others wounded, according to the Ministry of National Defense. An official inquiry into the incident on April 28 is planned, with Defense Minister Juan Carlos Pinzon and Army Commander Gen. Alejandro Navas expected to be present. Although FARC’s strength has waned in recent years, the group continues to engage in kidnappings and armed attacks. Former captives have described harsh jungle conditions, including being restrained, forced on long marches, and exposed to extreme weather. Last month, FARC released what they said were their last government hostages, mostly military and police personnel. In February, they pledged to stop kidnapping civilians for ransom, but did not address political abductions or clarify the situation regarding existing civilian captives.

article_content:
During Thursday night's debate, Vice President Joe Biden and Rep. Paul Ryan (R-Wis.) discussed the Affordable Care Act (ACA). Ryan reiterated President Barack Obama's promise: "If you like your health care plan, you can keep it," but challenged it by stating: "Try telling that to the 20 million people projected to lose their health insurance if Obamacare goes through, or the 7.4 million seniors who are going to lose it."

Ryan's reference to 20 million Americans possibly losing health coverage under the ACA comes from a government analysis from March. The Congressional Budget Office (CBO) and the Joint Committee on Taxation (JCT) evaluated multiple scenarios, ranging from 20 million people potentially losing employer-based coverage, to a net increase of 3 million people gaining insurance.

CBO and JCT concluded that a sharp decline in employment-based health insurance due to the ACA is unlikely, and that if such a decline occurred, the cost impact would not be dramatic.

The 7.4 million figure concerns seniors enrolled in Medicare Advantage plans — private plans meant to increase competition in Medicare, but which ended up costing more. The Obama administration planned to cut back these plans. According to a 2010 Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services paper, when changes are fully implemented in 2017, 7.4 million fewer people may enroll in Medicare Advantage than without the ACA. However, as Princeton health economist Uwe Reinhardt notes, these individuals would still be covered under traditional Medicare, not left uninsured.

Furthermore, people losing employer-based insurance could independently purchase plans through exchanges, often with help from federal subsidies.

In conclusion, it is unlikely that 20 million Americans will lose their health insurance because of the ACA, and it is not accurate to state that 7.4 million seniors will lose their coverage.

Neljapäevaõhtusel debatil arutasid asepresident Joe Biden ja esindajatekoja liige Paul Ryan (R-Wis.) taskukohase tervishoiu seadust (ACA). Ryan viitas valitsuse märtsikuisele analüüsile, mille järgi võiks ACA tõttu kuni 20 miljonit ameeriklast kaotada tööandjapõhise kindlustuse, kuid samas hinnati mitmeid stsenaariume, mille seas oli ka võimalus, et kindlustuskaitsega inimeste arv hoopis kasvab kuni 3 miljoni võrra. Sellise järelduseni jõudsid Kongressi Eelarvebüroo (CBO) ja Maksustamise Ühiskomitee (JCT).

CBO ja JCT leidsid, et töökohapõhise tervisekindlustuse järsk langus ACA tõttu on ebatõenäoline ning isegi kui see juhtuks, ei tooks see seadusele olulisi lisakulusid.

7,4 miljoni suurune number puudutab eakaid, kes kasutavad Medicare Advantage'i – eraettevõtetele suunatud plaane, mis algselt pidid suurendama konkurentsi Medicares, kuid muutusid kallimaks. Obama administratsioon otsustas nende plaanide arvu vähendada. 2010. aasta Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services raporti järgi väheneb nende plaanidega liitunute hulk 2017. aastaks, kui muudatused täielikult jõustuvad, ligikaudu poole võrra – see tähendab 7,4 miljonit inimest. Princetoni tervisemajandusteadlase Uwe Reinhardti sõnul ei jää need inimesed siiski kindlustuseta, vaid saavad vajadusel traditsioonilise Medicare'i kaudu jätkuvalt ravi.

Lisaks saavad tööandjapõhise kindlustuse kaotajad osta isikliku poliisi läbi kindlustusvahetuse, tihti ka föderaalsete toetustega.

Kokkuvõttes on ebatõenäoline, et ACA tõttu jääb 20 miljonit ameeriklast ilma tervisekindlustuseta, ning pole õige väita, et 7,4 miljonit eakat kaotaksid oma kaitse.

article_content: South Korea, Japan, and the United States jointly issued a statement on Thursday strongly condemning North Korea for supplying arms to Russia, confirming that several such deliveries have already taken place. Both Russia and North Korea are subject to international sanctions—Moscow for its invasion of Ukraine, and Pyongyang for its nuclear weapons programs. In September, North Korean leader Kim Jong Un and Russian President Vladimir Putin held a high-profile summit in Russia’s Far East, stoking Western concerns that Pyongyang might provide Moscow with weapons for use in the conflict in Ukraine. The three allies emphasized that North Korea’s provision of military equipment and munitions to Russia for use against Ukraine represents a serious violation. 'Such weapons deliveries, several of which we now confirm have been completed, will significantly increase the human toll of Russia’s war of aggression,' the joint statement read. During his visit to Russia, Kim Jong Un proclaimed that ties with Moscow were North Korea’s 'number one priority.' U.S. officials and experts believe Pyongyang is seeking military assistance from Russia in return—including satellite technology and upgrades to its outdated military equipment. North Korea attempted twice this year to launch a military spy satellite into orbit, but both attempts failed. The joint statement further alleged that Pyongyang is seeking to bolster its own military capabilities in exchange for supporting Russia and warned that any arms transfers to or from North Korea would violate multiple UN Security Council resolutions—resolutions that Russia itself had supported. The allies also voiced concerns about the potential transfer of nuclear or ballistic missile-related technology to North Korea. In August, leaders from Japan, South Korea, and the U.S. met at Camp David, agreeing on a multi-year plan to deepen defense cooperation, conduct regular joint military exercises, and share real-time intelligence on North Korea. Kim Jong Un has described the growing defense alignment among the U.S., Japan, and South Korea as the 'worst actual threat' facing North Korea.

article_content: How does a team celebrate a vital home victory over their title rivals? In Denmark, Brondby’s women’s football team marked the occasion with humor, sharing a playful photo featuring their bare backsides. Brondby edged out Fortuna Hjorring 3-2 at home on Sunday, extending their lead atop the Danish EliteDivisionen to five points after 14 matches. Right back Theresa Nielsen later posted a photo on Instagram, capturing the team’s spirited celebration in the changing room—three players cheekily revealing their behinds. Nielsen, who has 62 caps for Denmark, captioned the image: ‘Who the girls? 3-2 win against Fortuna today. An incredibly important and beautiful victory. Unity is huge. Thanks again for the spectacular support—it’s not something everyone can boast about. PS: When the end is good, everything is good. #vivandtidag #godrøvgodweekend #brøndby #bifkvinder #sammenhold #danmarksbedstefans.’ Nielsen is also known for her performances with Denmark during the UEFA Women’s Euro 2013 qualifiers.

article_content: A special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) created to fund Donald Trump's social media company has returned over $500 million in investor funds. The reversal came after Trump Media was unable to provide adequate financial disclosures, making further investment untenable. As a result, investors declined to proceed with the funding. Devin Nunes, CEO of Trump Media, stated that the termination was in the best interests of equity holders. Digital World Acquisition Corp. (DWAC) previously raised a $1 billion PIPE (private investment in public equity) in 2022, but failed to complete its merger with Trump Media by the September deadline, following regulatory delays. This allowed PIPE investors to cancel their commitments. In a press release, Nunes described the termination of the PIPE as a key step toward finalizing the merger with DWAC. However, company representatives did not address questions regarding why terminating the PIPE at this stage would be beneficial. Some observers remain skeptical about the company's communications and leadership.
translated_content: Eriotstarbega omandamisselts (SPAC), mis loodi Donald Trumpi sotsiaalmeedia ettevõtte rahastamiseks, tagastas investoritele üle 500 miljoni dollari. Otsus tehti pärast seda, kui Trump Media ei suutnud esitada piisavaid finantsandmeid, mis muutis investeeringu edasiarendamise võimatuks. Selle tulemusena otsustasid investorid rahastamisest loobuda. Trump Media tegevjuht Devin Nunes ütles, et investeeringu lõpetamine oli aktsionäride parimates huvides. Digital World Acquisition Corp. (DWAC) kaasas 2022. aastal varem 1 miljardi dollari suuruse PIPE-i (privaatne investeering avalikku aktsiakapitali), kuid ei suutnud Trump Media ühinemist septembri tähtajaks lõpule viia, kuna regulatiivsed protsessid viibisid. See andis PIPE investoritele õiguse oma kohustusi tühistada. Pressiteates nimetas Nunes PIPE lõpetamist oluliseks sammuks ühinemise lõpuleviimiseks DWAC-iga. Samas ei vastanud ettevõtte esindajad küsimustele, miks just selles etapis PIPE-i lõpetamist ettevõttele kasulikuks peetakse. Mõned vaatlejad jäävad ettevõtte kommunikatsiooni ja juhtimise suhtes skeptiliseks.

article_content: Robert Black, a Trump supporter from Miami, Florida, recently told MSNBC viewers that he believes a civil war is coming to America. In a video shared by journalist Aaron Rupar, Black claimed it was inevitable and obvious. He said that, once former President Trump returns to office, Trump would track down and imprison his opponents for allegedly violating the Constitution, possibly with the assistance of law enforcement. Black asserted that, to his knowledge, the police have "not been corrupted yet." The article's author notes the dangerous nature of such rhetoric, referencing the tragic consequences of the Rwandan Civil War as a cautionary example.

Blacki sõnul ei ole politseid tema teada veel „ära rikutud“. Artikli autor juhib tähelepanu sellise retoorika ohtlikkusele, tuues hoiatava näiteks Rwanda kodusõja ja selle traagilised tagajärjed.

article_content: Andy Murray will need to overcome a tough draw if he is to win his first French Open title. The Wimbledon champion, seeded seventh, is in the same half as Rafael Nadal, the undisputed king of clay and eight-time Roland Garros winner. They could potentially meet in the semi-finals. Murray may also face Australian Open champion Stanislas Wawrinka in the quarter-finals. Murray, who missed last year's French Open due to back surgery, begins his campaign against Kazakhstan's Andrey Golubev. The two have met only once before, in the final at St Petersburg in 2008, which Murray won comfortably 6-1, 6-1. Golubev, now ranked 55 (formerly as high as 33), recently defeated Wawrinka in the Davis Cup. If Murray gets past Golubev, he will face either Australia's Marinko Matosevic or German-Jamaican Dustin Brown in the next round, with German Philipp Kohlschreiber as a potential round three opponent. On the other side, defending champion Nadal starts against American wild card Robby Ginepri and could play Austrian Dominic Thiem in the second round. Second seed Novak Djokovic meets Portugal's Joao Sousa, while Roger Federer will play Lukas Lacko. Federer and Djokovic could potentially face each other in the semi-finals. In the women's draw, reigning champion Serena Williams opens against France's Alize Lim, a friend from Patrick Mouratoglou's academy. Lim tweeted about speaking with Serena, who said she doesn't look at the draw. Serena might play her sister Venus in the third round, although she first faces a challenging match against 17-year-old Swiss player Belinda Bencic, the reigning junior champion. Williams is seeded to potentially face a quarter-final rematch against Maria Sharapova, last year's finalist. Second seed Li Na takes on Frenchwoman Kristina Mladenovic in round one. Play at Roland Garros, the year's second Grand Slam, begins on Sunday.

article_content: Rouge Sucette, meaning 'red lollipop' in French, is a new red wine blend designed to attract younger wine drinkers. Created by French drinks company Haussmann Famille, this innovative wine contains 75% grapes, with the remainder made up of water, sugar, and cola flavoring. Breaking with tradition, Rouge Sucette aims to appeal to what marketers call the 'Coke generation'—younger consumers who typically prefer sweeter beverages, such as spirits mixed with soft drinks. With an alcohol content of 9% ABV, the wine is part of Haussmann Famille’s latest product range, which also features Passion Fruit and Grape Fruit flavored blends. The company recommends enjoying Rouge Sucette ice-cold, especially during warm summer months. Priced at 2.95 euros per bottle, the wine became available this week and is hoped to become a popular choice at French barbecues and summer parties. Pauline Lacombe, Marketing Director of Haussmann Famille, describes the wine as having a surprising but balanced taste, where the bitterness of wine pairs harmoniously with the sweetness of cola. Lacombe highlights the playful packaging, featuring a lollipop-shaped label, and notes that the product is particularly aimed at young adults and women. The Rouge Sucette recipe was developed in collaboration with a Bordeaux-based laboratory specializing in aromas. Despite France’s long-standing reputation for traditional wine culture, flavored wines have gained popularity, with a predicted 30 million bottles consumed in 2013. The company also sees potential for success in Britain, where sugar consumption has increased by 31% since 1990, with the average person now consuming 700 grams of sugar per week.

The upcoming US-India 2+2 ministerial dialogue in New Delhi is set to further strengthen the robust partnership between the two countries, particularly in defense, according to Farwa Aamer, Director of South Asia Initiatives at the Asia Society Policy Institute. Taking place amid an evolving global landscape, this meeting provides a platform for both nations to reaffirm their commitment to a shared vision of a free and open Indo-Pacific.

US Secretary of State Antony Blinken and Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin will join India’s External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar and Defence Minister Rajnath Singh for this fifth edition of the dialogue. Aamer notes that the timing is crucial, given ongoing crises such as the war in Ukraine and the Israel-Hamas conflict. While these issues do not directly involve the US-India relationship, they form the backdrop of strategic discussions and likely will be addressed as they test the international order that both nations support.

On the Israel-Hamas issue, India is increasingly aligned with the Quad countries, reflecting its deeper engagement with like-minded partners on major global challenges, Aamer observed. She also mentioned potential US calls for India’s cooperation in the Canadian probe and reiterated that, while diplomatic tensions may arise, such issues are unlikely to derail the overall positive trajectory of bilateral ties.

Beyond defense, the two sides are expected to expand cooperation across numerous areas, including climate, energy, health, counterterrorism, education, and people-to-people exchanges. There will be a special focus on technology transfer and co-production initiatives, such as the Initiative on Critical and Emerging Technology (iCET) and the India-US Defense Acceleration Ecosystem (INDUS-X), highlighting the importance of innovation in military capabilities.

The urgency of scaling up climate action ahead of COP28 is also expected to be a key agenda item, with India calling on developed countries to become carbon-negative by 2050—a gesture underscoring shared climate responsibilities. Additionally, lessons from this dialogue may shape subsequent US engagements with regional partners like Korea and Indonesia.

Aamer also pointed out the significance of concurrent diplomatic events, such as the forthcoming APEC summit and next year’s general elections in both India and the US. While Prime Minister Modi is unlikely to attend the APEC summit due to domestic commitments, President Biden’s anticipated meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping on the sidelines could impact US-India relations. India’s perspective on such developments remains crucial, especially given evolving dynamics in the Indo-Pacific and India’s complex relationship with China.

Iisraeli-Hamasi konflikti osas on India üha enam ühel meelel Quad'i riikidega, mis peegeldab tema tugevamat koostööd samameelsete partneritega rahvusvaheliste väljakutsete lahendamisel. Kaitsevaldkonnast laiemalt laieneb koostöö kliima, energia, tervishoiu, terrorismivastase võitluse, hariduse ning inimestevaheliste suhete valdkonda. Eriti rõhutatakse tehnoloogia ülekannet ja ühistootmist, näiteks kriitiliste ja arenevate tehnoloogiate algatus (iCET) ning India-USA kaitsekiirenduse ökosüsteem (INDUS-X), rõhutades innovatsiooni tähtsust sõjaliste võimekuste arendamisel.

Samuti on fookuses COP28 eel kliimameetmete tõhustamine, kus India kutsub arenenud riike saavutama süsinikunegatiivsus aastaks 2050 – märkimaks ühise vastutuse tähtsust. Selle dialoogi tulemused võivad kujundada USA järgmist koostööd piirkondlike partneritega nagu Korea ja Indoneesia.

Aamer tõi esile ka olulised paralleelsed sündmused, nagu peagi toimuv APECi tippkohtumine ning järgmise aasta üldvalimised Indias ja USA-s. Kuna peaminister Modi ei pruugi koduste kohustuste tõttu isiklikult APECil osaleda, võib president Bideni oodatav kohtumine Hiina presidendi Xi Jinpingiga tippkohtumise serval mõjutada India-USA suhteid. India seisukoht nendes arengutes on tähtis, arvestades muutlikke olusid Indo-Vaikse ookeani piirkonnas ja India keerulisi suhteid Hiinaga.

article_content: Published by Mark Prigg on February 19, 2014, and updated on February 20, 2014. A new study has explored how people in different cities around the world take selfies, finding variations in posing styles and expressions. Researchers analyzed 656,000 Instagram photos taken between December 4 and December 12, 2013, from New York City, Moscow, Berlin, Bangkok, and São Paulo. The study found that women take more selfies than men, particularly in Moscow where women posted selfies 4.6 times more frequently than men. Women also tend to strike more expressive and extreme poses; for example, the average head tilt among women was 12.3°, compared to 8.2° for men. In São Paulo, women showed the most pronounced head tilts, averaging 16.9°. Younger people are more likely to take selfies—the youngest average age is in Bangkok (21 years), while the oldest is in New York City (25.3 years). Mood analysis of the photos showed that people in Bangkok and São Paulo appear happiest, with average smile scores of 0.68 and 0.64, respectively. People in Moscow were found to smile the least, with an average score of 0.53. Despite the perception of widespread selfie-taking, only 3-5% of the examined photos were actually selfies. The research team used Amazon's Mechanical Turk to have workers identify selfies and estimate the age and gender of the subjects in the photos. Alise Tifentale of The City University of New York noted that selfies reflect a specific, contemporary mode of self-expression enabled by technology and social media. 'Selfie' was chosen as Oxford Dictionaries' international Word of the Year in 2013, marking its cultural significance. The Selfiecity project also showcased collages of selfies as part of its research promotion.
translated_content: Artikli avaldas Mark Prigg 19. veebruaril 2014 ja uuendas 20. veebruaril 2014. Uus uuring uuris, kuidas inimesed erinevates maailma linnades selfisid teevad, tuues esile erinevused poosides ja näoilmetes. Teadlased analüüsisid 656 000 Instagrami fotot, mis olid tehtud ajavahemikus 4.–12. detsember 2013 New Yorgis, Moskvas, Berliinis, Bangkokis ja São Paulos. Uuring näitas, et naised teevad rohkem selfisid kui mehed, eriti Moskvas, kus naised postitasid selfisid 4,6 korda rohkem kui mehed. Naised võtavad ka väljendusrikkamaid ja ekstreemsemaid poose; näiteks oli naiste keskmine pea kalle 12,3°, meeste puhul aga 8,2°. São Paulos oli naiste peakallete keskmine lausa 16,9°. Nooremad inimesed kalduvad rohkem selfisid tegema — noorim keskmine vanus on Bangkokis (21 aastat), vanim New Yorgis (25,3 aastat). Meeleoluanalüüs näitas, et Bangkokis ja São Paulos olid inimesed kõige rõõmsamad (keskmised naeratuseskoorid vastavalt 0,68 ja 0,64), Moskvas aga kõige vähem naeratavad (skoor 0,53). Vaatamata levinud arvamusele moodustasid selfid vaid 3–5% vaadeldud fotodest. Uurimisrühm kasutas Amazoni Mechanical Turkit, et töötajad tuvastaksid selfisid ning hindaksid fotodel olevate inimeste vanust ja sugu. Alise Tifentale New Yorgi Linnaülikoolist märkis, et selfid kajastavad tänapäevast tehnoloogia ja sotsiaalmeedia toel kujunenud eneseväljendusviisi. 'Selfie' valiti Oxford Dictionariesi poolt 2013. aasta rahvusvaheliseks aasta sõnaks, mis rõhutab selle kultuurilist tähtsust. Selfiecity projekt esitles uurimistöö raames ka selfide kollaaže.

article_content: Tubi is one of the most extensive streaming services, offering over 50,000 movies and television shows. As a free ad-supported streaming television (FAST) service, users can sign up for a free account and watch movies with occasional ads. For October, sci-fi is the featured genre on Tubi, making it the perfect time to enjoy thrilling and suspenseful films during the Halloween season. Here are three essential sci-fi movies to watch on Tubi this October. First up is Prometheus, a prequel to the Alien franchise that marks the return of director Ridley Scott. The film follows scientist Elizabeth Shaw (Noomi Rapace), who leads an expedition funded by Peter Weyland (Guy Pearce), CEO of Weyland Corp, to a distant planet after discovering a star map that might reveal humanity's origins. Upon arrival, their mission turns disastrous when extraterrestrial creatures threaten the crew. Prometheus is available to stream on Tubi. Next is Escape from New York, directed by John Carpenter, one of the most influential sci-fi and horror filmmakers of the late '70s and early '80s. Released in 1981, the film introduces Kurt Russell as Snake Plissken, an antihero in a dystopian 1997 where Manhattan has been converted into a maximum-security prison. After Air Force One is hijacked and President John Harker (Donald Pleasence) is held hostage, Snake, an ex-special forces operative convicted of robbery, is given a chance for pardon if he can rescue the president. However, he's injected with an explosive device set to detonate in 22 hours if he fails. Escape from New York can be streamed on Tubi. Finally, Demolition Man sees Sylvester Stallone transition from his iconic roles in the '70s and '80s to sci-fi action in the early '90s. In 2032, the city of San Angeles is a seemingly utopian society where crime is nonexistent, and criminals are cryogenically frozen. When Simon Phoenix (Wesley Snipes), a dangerous murderer from the 1990s, is unexpectedly released from cryo-prison and wreaks havoc, only John Spartan (Stallone)—the officer who originally apprehended him—can stop him. The LAPD thaws and reinstates Spartan, who uses his traditional methods to pursue Phoenix, despite challenges like the puzzling 'three seashells.' Demolition Man is also streaming on Tubi.

Filmis juhib teadlane Elizabeth Shaw (Noomi Rapace) ekspeditsiooni, mida rahastab Weyland Corpi tegevjuht Peter Weyland (Guy Pearce), pärast seda, kui nad avastavad tähekaardi, mis võib selgitada inimkonna päritolu. Lavastaja John Carpenter oli 1970ndate lõpu ja 1980ndate alguse üks mõjukamaid ulme- ja õudusfilmitegijaid. 1981. aastal ilmunud film tutvustab Kurt Russelli tegelaskuju Snake Plisskenit, anti-kangelast düstoopilises 1997. aastas, kus Manhattanist on saanud kõrgeima turvalisusega vangla. Kui Air Force One kaaperdatakse ja president John Harker (Donald Pleasence) võetakse pantvangi, pakutakse Snake’ile, endisele eriüksuslasele, kes on vangis varguse eest, võimalust saada armu – kui ta päästab presidendi. Viimasena on nimekirjas Demolition Man, kus Sylvester Stallone astub 1990ndate alguses üle ikoonilistest rollidest ulmelisse märulifilmi. Aastal 2032 on San Angeles näiliselt ideaalne ühiskond, kus kuritegevus puudub ja kurjategijad on külmutatud. Kui ohtlik mõrvar Simon Phoenix (Wesley Snipes) 1990ndatest äkitselt taas ellu äratatakse ja linna laastab, saab teda peatada vaid John Spartan (Stallone) – sama politseinik, kes ta algselt kinni püüdis. article_content: Billboards asserting that civil rights leader Martin Luther King Jr. was a Republican were recently posted in predominantly black neighborhoods of Dallas, Houston, and Austin, Texas, causing anger among some residents. The billboards, installed by the conservative organization RagingElephants.org, encouraged African-Americans to 'Vote Republican!' and drew criticism for being 'disrespectful.' Historically, black voters have supported the Democratic Party in larger numbers than the Republican Party. Claver Kamau-Imani, founder of RagingElephants.org, claimed he has documents proving Dr. King was a Republican and believes that the billboards, which read 'Martin Luther King Jr was a Republican. Vote Republican!', will motivate more African-Americans to join the party. Kamau-Imani told CBS Dallas, 'The use of Dr. King, because of his status as a community icon, we feel would be most effective. That’s why we used it. We have the documentation to back the claims we’re making on the billboard.' In 2008, Dr. King's son, Martin Luther King III, responded: 'It is disingenuous to imply that my father was a Republican. He never endorsed any presidential candidate, and there is certainly no evidence that he ever even voted for a Republican. It is even more outrageous to suggest he would support the Republican Party of today, which has spent so much time and effort trying to suppress African-American votes in Florida and many other states.' Dallas resident Aaron Carswell criticized the billboards, stating, 'It’s a bit disrespectful for what Martin Luther King stood for, and who he was. To use his name in a political fashion is a bit disrespectful.' As U.S. demographics shift, Republicans have focused outreach efforts on Hispanic voters, while African-Americans have largely supported President Barack Obama. Black Republicans have remained uncommon in Congress. Of the 26 black Republican House members since 1870, most served during the post-Civil War Reconstruction era. Mia Love's campaign to become the first black Republican woman elected to Congress in Utah has made her a prominent symbol of Republican Party diversity this election cycle. The daughter of Haitian immigrants, Love prefers to highlight her policies over her race or gender. Love said, 'I was elected mayor not because of my race or gender, not because I wear high heels, but because of the policies I put in place.' Polls indicate that Love held a slight lead over her six-term Democratic opponent in Utah. Love’s speech at the Republican National Convention referenced civil rights leaders Martin Luther King Jr. and Rosa Parks. Her parents arrived in the U.S. in the early 1970s and became citizens in 1984. Love, a married mother of three and a Mormon, is the only woman among eleven black Republican House candidates in the November 6 election, and is a tea party favorite. Republicans have focused on Love’s conservative stances and policy agenda rather than her race. Rep. Tim Scott of South Carolina, one of two black Republicans currently in the House, stated, 'We need a party that is diverse based on our issues and not based on simply trying to find greater variety in the complexion.'
translated_content: Stendid, mis väitsid, et kodanikuõiguste eest seisnud Martin Luther King Jr oli vabariiklane, ilmusid hiljuti Dallase, Houstoni ja Austini peamiselt mustanahalistesse linnaosadesse, tekitades mõnevõrra pahameelt. Konservatiivse organisatsiooni RagingElephants.org paigaldatud plakatid kutsusid afroameeriklasi üles 'Hääleta vabariiklaste poolt!' ning pälvisid kriitikat kui 'lugupidamatud'. Ajalooliselt on mustanahalised valijad suuremal määral toetanud Demokraatlikku Parteid kui Vabariiklikku Parteid. RagingElephants.org-i asutaja Claver Kamau-Imani väitis, et tal on dokumendid, mis tõestavad, et dr King oli vabariiklane, ning usub, et plakatid sõnumiga 'Martin Luther King Jr oli vabariiklane. Hääleta vabariiklaste poolt!' julgustavad rohkem afroameeriklasi parteiga liituma. Kamau-Imani ütles CBS Dallasile: 'Dr Kingi kasutamine, kuna ta on kogukonna ikoon, oli meie arvates kõige mõjusam. Sellepärast kasutasimegi teda. Meil on dokumentatsioon, mis kinnitab väiteid, mida plakatitel esitame.' 2008. aastal reageeris dr Kingi poeg Martin Luther King III: 'On eksitav väita, et mu isa oli vabariiklane. Ta ei toetanud kunagi ühtegi presidendikandidaati ega ole kindlasti teadaolevalt vabariiklase poolt hääletanud. Isegi rohkem on vale eeldada, et ta toetaks tänast Vabariiklikku Parteid, mis on kulutanud palju aega ja energiat mustanahaliste valijate häälte mahasurumiseks Floridas ja paljudes teistes osariikides.' Dallase elanik Aaron Carswell kritiseeris plakateid, öeldes: 'See on mõnevõrra lugupidamatu selle suhtes, mille eest Martin Luther King seisis ja kes ta oli. Tema nime poliitilisel eesmärgil kasutamine on veidi lugupidamatu.' USA demograafia muutudes on vabariiklased keskendunud rohkem hispaanlastest valijatele, samal ajal kui afroameeriklased on valdavalt toetanud Barack Obamat. Mustanahalised vabariiklased on Kongressis haruldased. 1870. aastast alates on olnud vaid 26 mustanahalisest vabariiklasest esindajatekoja liiget, neist suurem osa töötas taastamisajal. Mia Love'i kampaania saada esimeseks mustanahaliseks vabariiklasest naiseks Kongressis Utah's on muutnud ta sel valimistsüklil Vabariikliku Partei mitmekesisuse sümboliks. Haitilt pärit immigrantide tütar Love rõhutab pigem oma poliitikat, mitte rassi või sugu. Love ütles: 'Mind valiti linnapeaks mitte rassi ega soo tõttu, mitte sellepärast, et kannan kõrgeid kontsi, vaid sellepärast, millist poliitikat ellu viisin.' Küsitlused näitasid, et Love juhtis oma kuue ametiajaga demokraatist vastaskandidaadi ees Utah's. Love'i kõnes Vabariikliku Partei rahvuskongressil mainiti kodanikuõiguste eest seisnud Martin Luther King Jr-i ja Rosa Parksi. Tema vanemad saabusid USA-sse 1970. aastate alguses ja said kodanikuks 1984. Love, kolme lapse ema, mormoon ja teepidude liikumise soosik, on ainus naine üheteistkümne mustanahalisest vabariiklasest kongressikandidaadi seas tänavustel novembrivalimistel. Vabariiklased on keskendunud Love'i konservatiivsetele seisukohtadele ja poliitilisele programmile, mitte tema rassile. Lõuna-Carolinast pärit Tim Scott, üks kahest praegu Kongressis olevast mustanahalisest vabariiklasest, märkis: 'Me vajame parteid, mis oleks mitmekesine oma teemade, mitte ainult naha värvi poolest.'

article_content: England secured their place at Euro 2024 after defeating reigning champions Italy 3-1 at Wembley on Tuesday. Gareth Southgate’s team needed just a point to guarantee qualification for next year’s tournament in Germany but went behind early to a goal from Gianluca Scamacca. Jude Bellingham delivered an outstanding performance for England, earning a penalty with a powerful run, which Harry Kane converted before halftime to equalize. Bellingham was also influential in setting up Marcus Rashford’s goal after the break. Kane then scored again in the latter stages, registering his 61st goal for England. With two games remaining and five wins out of six qualifiers, unbeaten England will finish top of Group C. Italy, under coach Luciano Spalletti, are in third place and three points behind Ukraine, making their path to automatic qualification uncertain. Italy have, however, secured a play-off place, with matches against North Macedonia and Ukraine still to play. England have lost only once in their last 63 Euro and World Cup qualifiers. While qualifying has become routine under Southgate, his ultimate test will be to secure England's first men’s international trophy since 1966. England suffered a penalty shoot-out defeat by Italy in the Euro 2020 final at Wembley, but have since beaten the Italians twice in the current qualifying group. Southgate believes his side is now more complete than before, and with talents like Kane and Bellingham, expectations are high for success in Germany.

Jude Bellingham mängis Inglismaa eest suurepäraselt, teenides tugeva läbimurdega penalti, mille Harry Kane realiseeris poolaja eel. Bellingham aitas kaasa ka Marcus Rashfordi väravale pärast vaheaega. Kane lõi lõpuhetkedel veel ühe värava, jõudes Inglismaa eest 61 väravani. Kahe mängu enne lõppu, olles võitnud kuuest mängust viis ning jäädes kaotuseta, tagab Inglismaa C-alagrupi esikoha. Luciano Spalletti juhendatav Itaalia on kolmandal kohal ning jääb Ukrainast maha kolme punktiga, mis muudab nende automaatse edasipääsu ebaselgeks. Itaalia on see-eest taganud koha üleminekumängudel ning neil seisavad ees mängud Põhja-Makedoonia ja Ukrainaga. Inglismaa on viimase 63 EM- ja MM-kvalifikatsioonimängu jooksul kaotanud vaid korra. Kuigi Southgate’i käe all on kvalifitseerumine muutunud tavaliseks, seisab peatreeneri ees ülesanne tuua Inglismaale esimene meeste tiitel alates 1966. aastast. Inglismaa kaotas Itaalia vastu 2020. aasta EM-finaalis Wembley’l penaltitega, kuid on käimasolevas kvalifikatsioonigrupis itaallasi juba kaks korda võitnud. Southgate usub, et tema meeskond on nüüd terviklikum ja tänu Kane’i ning Bellinghami mängule loodetakse Saksamaal suurt edu.

article_content: During a rugby match between South Africa and the USA at Nelson Mandela Bay Stadium in Port Elizabeth, a spectator ran onto the field and tackled American player Perry Baker. The incident took place during the HSBC Sevens World Series. Cameras captured the moment when the intruder, dressed in white shorts and a blue T-shirt, tackled Baker to the ground. In response, Perry Baker kicked the intruder in the stomach while he was lying on the field. Another American player pushed the intruder, prompting him to leave after getting back on his feet. South Africa went on to defeat the US 26-0. Following the game, Baker, 28, apologized on Twitter for his actions, saying, 'I would like to apologize for my actions. I hope that my greatest fan is well. Boy they do love their rugby down here.' Public opinion regarding Baker's actions was divided on social media. Some defended Baker, arguing the intruder brought the reaction upon himself, while others criticized Baker's behavior as unsportsmanlike. Supporter Tim Walsh tweeted, 'No need to apologise, was a split second decision. He got off lightly, should have kicked him twice.' By contrast, Danny Beasley tweeted, 'you should be kicked out. Feral dogs don't deserve that treatment. Typical arrogant p****! #onyabike.' Perry Baker, originally from Daytona Beach, Florida, is a 6-foot-one, 180-pound athlete. He started his career with the Arena Football League's Pittsburgh Power before switching to rugby and joining the Eagles Sevens team in pursuit of his Olympic dream.

article_content: NEW DELHI: Team director Mohammad Hafeez has emphasized that Pakistan's centrally contracted players must prioritize national team duty over franchise cricket. His remarks came after fast bowler Haris Rauf chose not to participate in Pakistan's Test tour of Australia. Rauf, recognized for his white-ball cricket skills and with limited Test experience (having played only one Test and nine first-class matches), declined the opportunity to play in Australia's three-Test series. Instead, the 30-year-old is awaiting approval from the Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) to join the Melbourne Stars in the Big Bash League. "For all centrally contracted and domestic contracted players, the top priority is Pakistan," former captain Hafeez told reporters on Tuesday. "The purpose of offering contracts to 20-25 players is to ensure their availability for the national team," he said. "Now, there are parallel opportunities in franchise leagues, and we've seen this during the Asia Cup and World Cup—issues of fatigue, injuries, and performance dips due to heavy workloads." Hafeez is part of a new team management formed after Pakistan failed to reach the semi-finals of this year's 50-over World Cup in India. He added that the cricket board would consider players' workloads ahead of next year's T20 World Cup before granting No Objection Certificates (NOC) for participation in lucrative franchise leagues worldwide. "Looking toward the T20 World Cup, the NOC policy will be based on Pakistan's needs," Hafeez explained. "If Pakistan requires fit players, we must monitor their workloads. The primary focus and commitment should be to Pakistan. Franchise opportunities will only be considered if they align with national interests." (With inputs from Reuters)

Rauf, tuntud oma valgepallikriketi oskuste ja vähese testikogemusega (ta on mänginud ainult ühes testis ja üheksas esmaklassi kohtumises), loobus võimalusest osaleda Austraalia kolme testmängu seerias. Selle asemel ootab 30-aastane Pakistani Kriketiliidult (PCB) luba liituda Melbourne Starsiga Austraalia Big Bash League’is. "Kõigi keskse ja kodumaise lepinguga mängijate jaoks on kõrgeim prioriteet Pakistan," ütles endine kapten Hafeez teisipäeval ajakirjanikele. "Lepingu pakkumise eesmärk 20-25 mängijale on tagada nende saadavus koondisele," selgitas ta. "Nüüd on paralleelsed võimalused frantsiisiliigades ja nägime seda nii Asia Cupil kui ka maailmameistrivõistlustel—väsimus, vigastused ja esinemise langus liigse töökoormuse tõttu." Hafeez kuulub uude juhtkonda, mis moodustati pärast seda, kui Pakistan ei jõudnud selle aasta 50-oversi MM-i poolfinaali Indias. Ta lisas, et kriketiliit arvestab järgmise aasta T20 MM-i eel mängijate töökoormusega enne, kui lubab NOC’d osalemiseks tulusates frantsiisiliigades üle maailma. "Vaadates T20 maailmameistrivõistluse suunas, põhineb NOC-poliitika Pakistani vajadustel," selgitas Hafeez. "Kui Pakistan vajab terveid ja heas vormis mängijaid, tuleb töökoormus hoolega jälgida. Fookus ja pühendumine peab olema Pakistanil. Frantsiisivõimalusi kaalutakse vaid siis, kui need ei lähe vastuollu koondise huvidega." (Allikas: Reuters)

article_content: A family dispute in Ohio has gained widespread attention after video evidence emerged showing a 10-year-old girl with cerebral palsy allegedly being mocked by her neighbors at the school bus stop. For the past year, Hope Holcomb’s family claims their next-door neighbors, William Bailey and his nine-year-old son Joseph, have been imitating Hope’s movements in front of her classmates each day after school. Hope’s grandmother filmed the incidents, which the family says clearly show ongoing mockery and cruelty. Hope’s mother, Tricia Knight, told Fox that the situation began last year, making Hope miserable and reluctant to ride the school bus as a result of the teasing. The Knights allege the mocking escalated when Joseph Bailey's father joined in. Michael Knight, Hope’s father, expressed disbelief that an adult would tease a child with a disability, stating that Hope now dreads going to school. William Bailey, who has five children, claims his actions were in retaliation, stating that the Knights had previously mocked his son Joseph, who has seizures and ADHD. Bailey claims he reacted after the Knight children called his son derogatory names and asserts his actions were meant as a defense. Mrs. Bailey echoed that their son’s actions were not intended to insult Hope. Both families acknowledge a long-standing, sometimes tense relationship, with regular interactions between their children. Neighbors, such as Ray Burdette, expressed frustration with the ongoing feud—describing how the children previously played together. Both the Knights and Baileys report the issue to local authorities; however, local police say that while several complaints have been made, no charges have been filed. Despite the current hostilities, both families have spoken of affection for each other’s children and hope to resolve their differences. In the meantime, Hope’s family has made T-shirts reading 'STOP the bullying' to raise awareness about the issue.

Hope Holcombi pere väidab, et nende kõrvalelavate naabrite, William Bailey ja tema üheksa-aastase poja Josephi, poolt on Hope liikumist igapäevaselt matkides teda koolikaaslaste ees terve aasta jooksul pilatud. World Champion Ronnie O'Sullivan expressed frustration after being distracted by noise from the BBC's new arena-based studio during his semi-final against Barry Hawkins at the World Snooker Championship. O'Sullivan gestured towards the studio after overhearing conversations between former champions John Parrott and Stephen Hendry and presenter Jason Mohammad in the first frame of their best-of-33 match.

This marks the first time the BBC has set up its studio inside Sheffield's Crucible Theatre for the semi-finals and final. Tournament director Mike Ganley reminded all guests of the importance of maintaining silence during play, emphasizing that even commentators are accustomed to keeping quiet in such settings.

Despite the interruption, O'Sullivan shrugged off the distraction, building a commanding 6-2 lead after the first session as he aims to defend his title and claim a sixth World Championship. Hawkins, who lost to O'Sullivan in last year's final, will need to maintain focus to stay in contention.

O'Sullivan viipas stuudio poole pärast seda, kui kuulis, kuidas endised tšempionid John Parrott ja Stephen Hendry vestlesid saatejuht Jason Mohammadiga parima 33 freimi kohtumise avaraamis.

Sling TV, the third-largest live streaming service in the United States, has announced several new features designed to improve the user experience. Live sports scores are now available for additional leagues, including college football and basketball, the NFL, NBA, NHL, and Major League Baseball. Users can now easily access team statistics such as records, seedings, and rankings, along with live game clocks and scores, integrated into both the home screen and video player.

The platform now supports Apple ID for purchasing Sling subscriptions and managing transactions, purchases, and add-ons with Apple Pay. Subscribing to recommended content has become more seamless, whether it appears in search results, on the homepage, or through partner platforms.

User profiles are now available on all devices, allowing up to five profiles per account. Each profile can be labeled and color-coded to personalize favorites, shows, movies, and recordings.

"Our top priority at Sling is to provide our customers with the best television experience possible. We want to put people in charge of their entertainment," said Gary Schanman, executive vice president and group president of Dish Video Services. "We strive to deliver innovative functions that elevate the viewing experience and offer personalized features and menus so customers can control what, how, and when they watch content on our service."

As of October 2023, Sling TV had just over two million subscribers, about half as many as the second-largest provider in the U.S., Hulu With Live TV. Sling offers a free service without account registration and basic paid plans starting at $40 per month, sometimes with first-month discounts. However, there is currently no free trial available.

article_content: The Biden administration remains committed to student loan forgiveness, progressing efforts even after legal setbacks earlier this year. Multiple programs have already provided tens of billions in relief, with more initiatives underway that will impact millions of borrowers across the nation. Earlier this month, the Department of Education announced it would assist at least 2.7 million borrowers affected by widespread loan servicing mistakes during the resumption of repayments. These errors, which included delayed or incorrect billing statements, resulted in over 800,000 delinquencies by November. To remedy this, impacted borrowers will be placed in administrative forbearance, temporarily suspending their payments. Unlike in the past, these forbearance periods will count toward forgiveness under Income-Driven Repayment (IDR) and Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) programs. Eligible borrowers may also qualify for waived interest and receive refunds for incorrect payments. This week, Senate Republicans attempted to overturn President Biden’s new SAVE income-driven repayment plan, but the vote narrowly failed 49-50. Described by officials as the most affordable repayment plan to date, SAVE has already enrolled 5.5 million borrowers. The plan reduces monthly payments and shortens the pathway to loan forgiveness for many. Critics argued that SAVE acts as an indirect form of broad loan cancellation, but the effort to repeal it was unsuccessful. President Biden pledged to veto any repeal measure. Almost one million borrowers have already received forgiveness through the temporary IDR Account Adjustment initiative, which grants additional credit toward loan cancellation. The Department of Education is updating these adjustments every two months, with the latest approvals in September. Some borrowers must consolidate their loans by December 31, 2023, to qualify or maximize benefits, and advocacy groups are urging an extension of this deadline. Simultaneously, the administration is developing a new forgiveness program using the Higher Education Act’s ‘compromise and settlement’ authority. Draft regulations highlight four main borrower groups who could benefit: those with very old loans, individuals eligible for other forgiveness programs who haven’t applied, former students of predatory schools, and those whose loan balances now exceed original amounts due to interest. Further relief based on borrower hardship is under discussion, with rules expected after committee meetings in December. Borrowers should continue monitoring eligibility requirements and updates, as deadlines and regulations may still change.

Need vead, sealhulgas hilinenud või valed arveldused, tõid novembriks kaasa üle 800 000 võlgnevuse. Probleemi lahendamiseks viiakse mõjutatud laenuvõtjad administratiivsesse maksepuhkusesse, mil makseid ei nõuta. Erinevalt varasemast arvestatakse neid puhkuseperioode nüüd õppelaenude andestamiseks IDR- ja PSLF-programmides. Abikõlblikud saavad ka intresside tühistamise ja valesti tehtud maksete tagastuse. Sel nädalal proovisid senati vabariiklased tühistada president Biden'i SAVEt, uut sissetulekupõhist tagasimakse plaani, kuid hääletus kukkus napilt läbi (49-50). Ametnike sõnul on SAVE seni kõige taskukohasem plaan ja sinna on registreerinud juba 5,5 miljonit laenuvõtjat. Plaan langetab igakuiseid makseid ning teeb andestuseni jõudmise kiiremini võimalikuks. Kriitikud väitsid, et plaan on kaudne viis laenuandestuseks, kuid tühistamine ei saanud toetust. Biden lubas samuti veto panna, juhul kui tühistamine oleks läbi läinud. Peaaegu miljon laenuvõtjat on juba saanud andestust ajutise IDR-konto korrigeerimise programmis, mis annab täiendavat arvestust kustutamiseks. Ministeerium uuendab neid andmeid iga kahe kuu järel, viimased otsused langetati septembris. Kvalifitseerumiseks või suurema kasu saamiseks peavad mõned laenuvõtjad konsolideerima laenud hiljemalt 31. detsembriks 2023. Eestkõnelejad kutsuvad üles selle tähtaja pikendamisele. Samaaegselt töötab administratsioon uue õppelaenude andestusprogrammi kallal, kasutades Kõrgharidusseaduse kompromissi ja kokkuleppe volitusi. Eelnõus on välja toodud neli põhilist laenuvõtjate gruppi: väga vanade laenudega, teistele programmidele kvalifitseeruvad ent kandideerimata jätnud, petlike koolide lõpetanud ning need, kelle laenude jääk on kasvanud kõrgemaks kui algne summa. Raskustes olevatele laenuvõtjatele kavandatakse lisatoetust, kuid see vajab veel arutelu; reeglid täpsustatakse pärast detsembri kohtumisi. Laenuvõtjatel soovitatakse nõuete ning muudatustega jooksvalt kursis olla, kuna tähtajad ja reeglid võivad veel muutuda.

Jigarthanda Double X, directed by Karthik Subbaraj, premiered in theaters on November 10. The action drama stars Raghava Lawrence and SJ Suryah, with Nimisha Sajayan and Sanchana Natarajan in key supporting roles. The film features music by Santhosh Narayanan. On its second day, Jigarthanda Double X grossed Rs 4.5 crore, surpassing its opening day collection of Rs 1.75 crore, for a total of Rs 6.25 crore in two days.

A sequel to the 2014 acclaimed film Jigarthanda (which starred Bobby Simha and Siddharth), Jigarthanda Double X presents a new storyline while maintaining the gangster drama concept. Set in 1975, the film tells the story of a filmmaker and a gangster who join forces to create a western movie. Director Karthik Subbaraj has expressed that the movie aims to provide a satisfying experience for fans.

The film faced box office competition from Japan, starring Karthi. On its first day, Japan collected more than Jigarthanda Double X. However, after Japan received negative reviews, theaters increased the number of shows for Jigarthanda Double X.

Have you ever met the Queen? She’s known to ride often. Mzee’s eyes lit up at the idea. "She should come here and ride with me! She likes polo, too, but we don’t get to play that much out here," he added, grinning. 

For Mzee—whose real name is David—there’s no shortage of adventure closer to home in Kenya’s stunning Chyulu Hills. While polo may be rare, the real thrill was just around the corner for me.

“Look, look!” he whispered, standing in the stirrups. Galloping into the open: Mawingu, my horse, with Mzee in the golden evening light on the savannah. Suddenly, crashing through the brush, came a massive elephant, its grey back unbothered by spiny shrubs, separated from us by just a thin strip of grass.

The Chyulu Hills stretch a hundred kilometers, a line of volcanic mountains cut by wide, grassy plains dotted with thorny acacia trees. Despite being a national park, they remain relatively unknown compared to the famous Maasai Mara to the west and wildlife-rich Tsavo to the east. Here, you’re unlikely to see crowds of safari vehicles—or anyone else. Instead, you’ll find plenty of animals.

Within moments of landing in Chyulu—after a short bush plane flight from Nairobi—we’d already spotted a pair of honking wildebeest, a wary oryx herd, and a dazzle (the real name!) of peacefully grazing zebras. A giraffe stepped delicately through the brush—a magical sight. In the evening at ol Donyo Lodge, a group of local Maasai came down the hills to dance for us.

While observing wildlife from a game vehicle is enjoyable, nothing compares to the feeling of a horseback safari. My horse, Mawingu (which means "cloud" in the local Maa language, named for his creamy coat), was lively and alert, making a perfect partner as we tried to spot as much wildlife as possible—and keep pace with the zebras! Mzee—honored by younger men with the Swahili title for "grandfather"—is a knowledgeable guide and a true animal expert.

Ol Donyo Lodge itself is run by the entertaining Ray and Alyssa. Modern and stylish, combining Masai influences, the lodge sits on a private reserve, with its own stables and warm, welcoming staff. My room was enormous, with a private deck and my own plunge pool. From there, I watched giraffes and elephants visiting the nearby watering hole, scattering smaller animals as they passed.

Balloon rides offer another way to view buffalo and gazelle. And with help from Daniel, our expert Maasai guide in the Mara, we even spotted a dik dik—an adorable, tiny antelope—within minutes. The wildlife in Maasai Mara includes the Big Five, hippos, cheetahs, and so much more. During the annual Great Migration, over a million wildebeest and zebras stream across the plains and rivers—a breathtaking spectacle.

Back at Ol Donyo, I also explored the enormous fossilized lava tubes—requiring sturdy shoes and a sense of adventure! Winding down rocky slopes, avoiding fig roots, and brushing past bats, we emerged from the dark tunnels to find cold drinks and delicious "bities"—small Kenyan canapés like banana and bacon bites, macadamia nuts, and goat cheese toasts. They tasted even better after a fast ride across the plains.

Horseback safaris brought us closer to wildlife than I had imagined: sitting quietly while a giraffe ambled by, spotting a shy jackal, or holding still as an elephant wandered past. Thankfully, despite Mzee’s assurance that if an elephant charged, we’d just ride away, we never had to test that!

Big cats are rare in the Chyulu Hills—good for riders, but the Mara offers plenty of lions, cheetahs, and leopards. With Daniel’s expertise as a guide, wildlife sightings came quickly. At Encounter Mara camp, run by Colin and Chala, nights were filled with the sounds of lions hunting and wildebeest stirring. Mara Toto camp near the Mara River provided stunning views of the migration, and an early morning balloon ride revealed the vast herds below.

Kenya’s marvels don’t end with the savannah. I finished my trip relaxing on the white-sand Indian Ocean beaches of Watamu at Medina Palms—a tranquil resort with unbeatable ocean views. 

The Chyulu Hills, hidden and less-traveled, proved truly special—a hidden gem overshadowed by Mount Kilimanjaro and home to incredible wildlife. Perhaps one day, Mzee will play polo with the Queen. For now, he’ll have to settle for enjoying the elephants pass by.

If you’re intrigued: Travemail stayed at Ol Donyo Lodge (Chyulu Hills) from £366 ($615) per room, per night. In the Maasai Mara, rooms at Encounter Mara start at £268 ($450) per person, per night, and Mara Toto from £372 ($625) per person, per night. In Watamu, Medina Palms’ beachfront rooms start at £70 ($121) per person, per night. Return flights from London to Kenya with Kenya Airways begin at £732.41 ($1,228); internal private flights with Boskovic Air Charters Ltd from £1,840 ($3,082) for up to 12 people; Nairobi to Malindi with Air Kenya from £106 ($179) one way. Balloon safaris cost $450—including a champagne breakfast.

Kas olete kunagi kohtunud kuningannaga? Ta pidavat sageli ratsutama. Mzee silmad lõid ideest särama. "Ta võiks siia tulla ja minuga koos ratsutada! Talle meeldib ka polo, aga siin meil seda eriti tihti pole," ütles ta rõõmsalt.

Mzee ehk tegeliku nimega David leiab oma kodu lähedal Kenyas kauneis Chyulu mägedes küllaga seiklusi. Polo võib olla haruldane, kuid tõeline elamus oli mulle kohe nurga taga ootamas.

"Vaata, vaata!" sosistas ta ja tõusis sadulas püsti. Galopp savannis: Mawingu, minu hobune, Mzee seltsis kuldse õhtuvalguse käes. Äkitselt ragistas põõsastes hiiglaslik elevant, tema hall selg okaste suhtes ükskõikne, meie vahel vaid kitsas rohulapp.

Chyulu mäed ulatuvad ligi saja kilomeetrini, olles vulkaaniliste mägede ahelas laiu rohumaade ja okkaliste akaatsiate vahel. Kuigi see on rahvuspark, jääb see lääne pool asuva kuulsa Maasai Mara ja ida pool asuva loomade poolest rikkaliku Tsavo kõrval tahaplaanile. Siin ei kogune massiliselt safariautosid—võid olla ainus külastaja. Loomi seevastu jätkub küllaga.

Mõni hetk pärast maandumist Chyulusse—lühikese lennuga Nairobist—olime juba märganud paari häälekalt huikavat gnuud, kartlikku orükside gruppi ning karja rahulikult nosivaid sebrasid (jah, just nimelt dazzle!). Kaelkirjak kõndis võsast elegantselt läbi—ilus vaatepilt. Õhtuse ol Donyo Lodge’i peal astusid kohalikud Maasai mäest alla, et külalistele tantsida.

Loomade vaatlemine safariautost on omaette elamus, kuid ratsasafaril saab loodus tunduvalt lähemale. Minu hobune Mawingu (kohaliku maa keeles tähendab see "pilve," tema koorekarva naha tõttu) oli kiire ja tähelepanelik, sobides suurepäraselt, et võimalikult palju loomi näha ja sebradega koos savannis kihutada! Mzee—nooremate poolt aupaklikult vanaisaks kutsutud—on kogenud teejuht ja loomade asjatundja.

Ol Donyo Lodge’i veavad rõõmsameelsed Ray ja Alyssa. Moodsad mugavused ja masai stiil loovad seal erilise õhkkonna, lodge asub erakaitsealal ning omab oma talli ja sõbralikku personali. Minu tuba oli suur, privaatse terrassi ja isikliku basseiniga. Sealt jälgisin, kuidas kaelkirjakud ja elevandid veejoomiskohta külastasid, väiksemaid loomi eemale peletades.

Õhupallilend avab suurepärased vaated pühvlitele ja gasellidele. Maasai giid Danieli abiga leidsime Maasai Maras dik-diki—pisikese armsa antiloobi—vaid minutitega. Maasai Mara loomariik hõlmab "Big Five’i", jõehobusid, gepardeid ja palju muud. Suure rände ajal liigub üle miljoni gnuu ja sebra üle rohumaade ja jõgede—võrratu vaatepilt.

Ol Donyos avastasin ka hiiglaslikud kivistunud laavatunnelid—seal vaja tugevamaid kingi ja seiklushimu! Kivitükkidest kaetud rajal, viigipuude juuri vältides ja nahkhiiri kohtudes, jõudsime pimedatest tunnelitest välja päikesevalgusse, kus ootasid jahutavad joogid ja maitsvad "bities"—banaani-peekoni ampsud, makadaamiapähklid ning kitsejuustusaiad. Parimad tundusid need pärast tormakat ratsasõitu üle tasandike.

Ratsasafaril jõudsin loomadele lähemale, kui arvasin: istusin vaikselt, kui kaelkirjak möödus, märkasin arglikku šaakalit või tardusin, kui elevant mööda kõndis. Õnneks ei pidanud Mzee lubadust, et vajadusel elevandi eest minema kihutame, kordagi proovile panema!

Suurkasse kohtab Chyulu mägedes harva—see on hea ratsanikele, kuid Maras ootab lõvisid, gepardeid ja leoparde küllaga. Danieli teadmised tagasid kiire loomavaatlemise. Encounter Mara laagris, mida juhivad Colin ja Chala, täitsid ööd lõvide ja gnuude hääled. Mara Toto laagrist Mara jõe ääres avanes erakordne vaade rändele ning varahommikune õhupallilend näitas all laiuvaid loomakarju.

Keenia loodusrõõmud ei piirdu savanniga: reisi lõpetasin India ookeani valgetel randadel Watamus, Medina Palmsi kuurordis, mis pakub imelist merevaadet.

Kuid just vähemkäidud Chyulu mäed jäid eredalt meelde—varjatud pärl Kilimanjaro läheduses ja kodu suurepärasele loodusele. Võib-olla mängib Mzee kunagi kuningannaga polo; seni jälgime koos elevante.

Kui see jutt tekitas isu: Travemail peatus Chyulu mägede Ol Donyo Lodge’is (al 366 £ ehk 615 dollarit tuba/öö). Maasai Maras Encounter Mara laagris, hinnad al 268 £ (450 dollarit) inimese kohta/öö, ning Mara Toto laagris al 372 £ (625 dollarit) inimene/öö. Watamus Medina Palmsi rannavaatega tuba 70 £ (121 dollarit) inimene/öö. Kenya Airwaysi lennud Londonist algavad 732,41 £ (1 228 dollarit); Boskovic Air Chartersi siselennud al 1 840 £ (3 082 dollarit) kuni 12 inimesele; Nairobi–Malindi Air Kenyaga al 106 £ (179 dollarit) üks suund. Õhupallilend maksab 450 dollarit ja sisaldab vahuveini hommikusööki.

article_content: Wayne May and his wife, Alicia Muller May, both American diplomats, were expelled from India in response to the U.S. removing an Indian envoy, further complicating a diplomatic conflict. The situation worsened after the couple's Facebook posts, in which they made offensive and critical remarks about Indian culture, society, and everyday life, came to public attention. Alicia Muller May faced particular backlash for suggesting on social media that Indian vegetarians were responsible for sexual assaults—comments she said did not apply to Westerners. Additional posts described India as a 'zoo' and mocked religious symbols, at one point referring to a sacred cow as 'stupid.' Other comments from the couple denigrated the health and diets of local people compared to their pet dog. Indian media outlets widely reported these statements, intensifying public indignation and calling the remarks 'astonishingly offensive.' The U.S. State Department promptly clarified that the comments reflected only the Mays' personal opinions and not the stance of the United States. The broader dispute originated with the arrest of Indian diplomat Devyani Khobragade in New York, who was accused of visa fraud and underpaying her domestic assistant, Sangeeta Richard. Although Khobragade eventually received diplomatic immunity and returned to India, the case triggered India to demand the recall of an American diplomat in New Delhi. This episode has created significant tension between the U.S. and India, allies with substantial economic and strategic connections. Analysts caution that further escalation could harm both countries. Much of the response in India is driven by the perception that Khobragade was treated in a humiliating way, including a strip search, which U.S. authorities say is standard procedure.
