article_content: JABALPUR: Rajkaran Baraua has achieved a remarkable milestone. Despite having no permanent home, family, savings, or stable job, the 56-year-old now proudly says, "But I have a degree." After 25 years of relentless effort, he completed his MSc in Mathematics. For nearly half his life, Rajkaran pursued his dream of a master's degree in maths, facing failure 23 times. Balancing double shifts as a security guard and various odd jobs, he kept his passion alive and finally succeeded in 2021. "I had to celebrate alone. I jumped, gave myself a high five, but couldn't share my joy because my employers would use my story to discipline their children. I didn’t want to embarrass them, so I kept my happiness private," Rajkaran explained to TOI on Monday. "But now that I have left that job, I can finally tell people." A Times of India article in 2015 provided a much-needed lift. "After failing my 18th attempt, I was disheartened. But once the report was published, people viewed me differently. TV channels came looking for me. That was a huge motivation," he shared. Currently, Rajkaran works all night as a security guard for Rs 5,000 each month, and also helps at a bungalow in exchange for food, shelter, and Rs 1,500. "Making ends meet is difficult, but over the last 25 years, I spent nearly Rs 2 lakh on books, exam fees, and related costs to get my MSc in maths," he said. "All I ever wanted was to pass and be called a postgraduate in mathematics." Asked why he didn't marry, Rajkaran replied, "Who would marry me? Besides, I was married to my dream." Times View: This heartwarming story demonstrates the power of persistence and the importance of never giving up—an inspiration to all. What sparked his obsession with a maths degree? "After my MA in 1996, I visited a school and interacted with students. Teachers appreciated how I taught maths, inspiring me to pursue a postgraduate degree. Back then, you could choose an elective for MSc, so I applied to Jabalpur's Rani Durgavati University in 1996 and was accepted," he recalled. "I didn’t anticipate how challenging it would be, nor that it would become a 25-year journey," he laughed. "In 1997, I sat for my first MSc exam and failed. For a decade, I’d only pass one out of five subjects, but I never gave up. I ignored what others said and focused on my goal. Gradually, I started passing two. Finally, during the Covid-19 pandemic in 2020, I cleared the first year, and in 2021, I passed the second. I was elated." What has he learned? "Effort and patience. They can help you overcome anything," Rajkaran said.
translated_content: JABALPUR: Rajkaran Baraua on saavutanud märkimisväärse verstaposti. Tal ei ole püsivat kodu, perekonda, sääste ega stabiilset tööd, kuid 56-aastane mees ütleb nüüd uhkusega: "Aga mul on kraad." 25 aastat kestnud väsimatu pingutuse järel lõpetas ta oma matemaatika magistriõpingud. Peaaegu pool elu unistas Rajkaran magistriastmest matemaatikas, kohtas 23 korda eksamil ebaõnnestumist. Töötades valvekaitsjana kahel vahetusel ja tehes erinevaid juhutöid, hoidis ta oma kirge elus ning saavutas lõpuks edu 2021. aastal. "Pidin tähistama üksi. Hüppasin, andsin endale viis, kuid ei saanud rõõmu teistega jagada, sest tööandjad kasutasid minu lugu oma laste õpetamiseks. Ma ei tahtnud neid piinlikkusse panna, seetõttu hoidsin oma õnne enda teada," selgitas Rajkaran TOI-le esmaspäeval. "Aga nüüd, kui olen selle töö lõpetanud, saan sellest lõpuks rääkida." 2015. aastal ilmunud Times of India artikkel andis vajaliku tõuke. "Pärast oma 18. katsel läbikukkumist olin ma rusutud. Aga kui artikkel avaldati, suhtusid inimesed minusse teisiti. Telekanalid tulid mind otsima. See oli suur motivatsioon," jagas ta. Praegu töötab Rajkaran öösiti valvekaitsjana, teenides 5 000 ruupiat kuus, ja aitab ka bungalos toidu, peavarju ning 1 500 ruupia eest. "Ots otsaga kokkusaamine on raske, aga viimase 25 aasta jooksul kulutasin peaaegu 2 lakh ruupiat raamatutele, eksamitasudele ja muudele seotud kuludele, et saada magistrikraad matemaatikas," ütles ta. "Kõik, mida ma tahtsin, oli eksam läbida ja saada matemaatika magistriks." Kui küsiti, miks ta ei abiellunud, vastas Rajkaran: "Kes oleks mind võtnud? Pealegi olin abielus oma unistusega." Times View: See südantsoojendav lugu näitab püsivuse jõudu ja mitte allaandmise tähtsust – inspiratsioon kõigile. Mis ajendas teda matemaatika magistrikraadi taotlema? "Pärast seda, kui sain 1996. aastal magistriõppe lõpetatud, külastasin kooli ja suhtlesin õpilastega. Õpetajad kiitsid, kuidas ma lastele matemaatikat õpetasin, ja see inspireeris mind magistrikraadi omandama. Tollal sai õppida matemaatika magistrit valikainega, nii et kandideerisin 1996. aastal Jabalpuri Rani Durgavati Ülikooli ja mind võeti vastu," meenutas ta. "Ma ei osanud aimata, kui raske see on, ega et sellest saab 25 aastat kestev teekond," naeris ta. "1997. aastal tegin oma esimese matemaatika magistrieksami ja kukkusin läbi. Järgmise kümne aasta jooksul läbisin korraga vaid ühe viiest ainest, kuid ei andnud kunagi alla. Ma ei hoolinud, mida teised ütlesid, keskendusin oma eesmärgile. Järk-järgult hakkasin saama kaks ainet sooritatud. Lõpuks, Covid-19 pandeemia ajal 2020. aastal läbisin esimese kursuse ning 2021. aastal teise. Ma olin vaimustuses." Mida ta sellest õppis? "Pingutus ja kannatlikkus – need aitavad sind kõigest läbi," ütles Rajkaran.

article_content: All-in-one desktop computers, or AIO PCs, offer the user-friendly setup and compactness of a laptop but with the performance and large displays of desktops. While their popularity has dipped in recent years, they remain great options for anyone wanting a complete computing package without breaking the bank—especially if space is limited. AIOs combine the main computer components, a large screen, keyboard, and mouse all in one package, which means setup is simple and saves space. Even with bigger displays, many AIOs are now sleek and can fit into tight spaces like home offices. These systems are available on both Windows and Mac platforms. Apple’s only current AIO is the 24-inch iMac powered by the M3 chip, which can be customized with different RAM and storage options, and comes in several colors, ranging in price from Rs 1,34,900 to Rs 1,74,900 in India. Windows users have a wider variety to choose from, with brands such as Microsoft, Asus, HP, Dell, and Lenovo offering models with features like touch displays, compact designs, or dedicated graphic cards for higher performance. For shoppers on a budget, the ASUS Vivo AiO V222 is an attractive deal at Rs 31,990, with its 21.5-inch edge-to-edge display, Intel Pentium Silver J5040 processor, 8GB RAM, 256GB SSD, and a premium gold design, all running Windows 11. HP offers an alternative at Rs 34,990, providing a similar setup but with 512GB of storage. Lenovo’s IdeaCentre AIO 3 Gen 6 is another value choice, boasting a 24-inch full-HD touchscreen, AMD Ryzen 3 3250U, 8GB RAM, and a 512GB SSD—all in a unique design. For a premium option, Microsoft’s Surface Studio pairs an elegant metal build with an ultra-high resolution (4500x3000) touchscreen. It comes with Windows 10 Pro and can be upgraded to Windows 11, appealing to users who need both design and cutting-edge visual performance.

article_content:
As Iranians prepare to vote in their presidential election—with only six candidates approved by the Supreme Leader and Guardian Council—a separate, free election is unfolding online. The 'We Choose' campaign harnesses technology and the Internet to offer Iranians a space to express their true political preferences, free from the Islamic regime’s restrictions.

Russian chess grandmaster Garry Kasparov leads the 'We Choose' campaign, supported by a committee of internationally recognized former officials, human rights advocates, and technology experts. Kasparov emphasizes the importance of genuine, periodic elections as outlined in the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, to which Iran is a signatory. He argues that the official system in Iran does not facilitate true democratic choice and that this campaign gives Iranians an alternative platform to express their will.

After the contentious 2009 Iranian election—marked by fraud allegations and harsh crackdowns—this virtual initiative offers an avenue for civic engagement. Srdja Popovic, a Serbian activist known for nonviolent strategies, notes that entities like 'We Choose' are a 'low-risk tactic' for people living under repressive rule. Popovic's guidance has influenced many Iranian activists.

Reza Ghazinouri, who fled Iran after the 2009 election, shares the widespread disappointment among Iranians who feel excluded from a fair, monitored process. Many see hope in 'We Choose,' which features 20 candidates representing diverse viewpoints, including Mir Hossein Mousavi and Mehdi Karroubi (reformists under house arrest), Reza Pahlavi (exiled heir), Maryam Rajavi (opposition figure), Nasrin Sotoudeh (imprisoned human rights lawyer), and disqualified candidates Ali Akbar Hashemi-Rafsanjani and Esfandiar Rahim Mashaei.

A similar virtual voting project was run in Russia in 2012, headed by Kasparov and Leonid Volkov, drawing over 80,000 participants. To ensure voter safety, the Iranian platform uses advanced cybersecurity—including technology from Phil Zimmermann’s Silent Circle—to protect anonymity and voting integrity. Iranians can cast their virtual ballots via SMS, despite the government’s increasing limits on mobile and internet access.

Some Iranian government-linked sites and news agencies have condemned the campaign, labeling it a foreign plot, but supporters say it empowers ordinary citizens and highlights the importance of innovative democratic solutions. In the campaign’s first days, hundreds of votes were cast and organizers addressed technical obstacles with community input.

The 'We Choose' virtual election lasts until June 13, with results revealed alongside Iran’s official vote. Kasparov hopes it sends a message of hope and demonstrates new ways to operationalize democracy where traditional expression is repressed.

Kui iraanlased valmistuvad presidendivalimisteks, kus Ülemjuht ja Järelevalvenõukogu on heaks kiitnud vaid kuus kandidaati, toimub samal ajal internetis vaba alternatiivvalimine. Kampaania „Meie Valime“ kasutab tehnoloogiat ja internetti, et anda iraanlastele võimalus väljendada oma tõelisi poliitilisi eelistusi väljaspool islamirežiimi piiranguid.

Venemaa maletšempion Garri Kasparov juhib „Meie Valime“ kampaaniat koos rahvusvaheliselt tunnustatud endiste riigiametnike, inimõiguste kaitsjate ja tehnoloogiaekspertidega. Kasparov rõhutab ehtsate, korrapäraste valimiste tähtsust, nagu on kirjas inimõiguste ülddeklaratsioonis, millele ka Iraan on alla kirjutanud. Tema sõnul ei võimalda Iraani ametlik süsteem tõelist demokraatlikku valikut ning kampaania pakub iraanlastele teistmoodi platvormi oma arvamuse avaldamiseks.

2009. aasta Iraani vaidlusaluste valimiste järel, millele järgnesid valepettuse süüdistused ja karmid mahasurumised, pakub see virtuaalne algatus väljundi kodanikule osalemiseks. Serbia aktivist Srdja Popovic, tuntud oma vägivallatute strateegiate poolest, märgib, et „Meie Valime“ sarnased algatused on „madala riskiga taktika“ repressiivses režiimis elavatele inimestele. Popovici nõuandeid on kasutanud paljud Iraani aktivistid.

Reza Ghazinouri, kes lahkus Iraanist pärast 2009. aasta valimisi, väljendab pettumust, mida tunnevad paljud iraanlased, kelle arvates neid ausasse ja iseseisvalt jälgitavasse protsessi ei kaasata. Paljud näevad lootust just „Meie Valime“ kampaanias, mille 20 kandidaati esindavad mitmesuguseid vaatenurki – sealhulgas koduarestis olevad reformistid Mir Hossein Mousavi ja Mehdi Karroubi, pagendatud troonipärija Reza Pahlavi, vastuoluline poliitik Maryam Rajavi, vangistatud inimõiguste advokaat Nasrin Sotoudeh ning diskvalifitseeritud kandidaadid Ali Akbar Hashemi-Rafsanjani ja Esfandiar Rahim Mashaei.

Sarnane virtuaalne hääletus toimus ka Venemaal 2012. aastal Kasparovi ja Leonid Volkovi juhtimisel, kus osales üle 80 000 inimese. Iranlaste virtuaalne valimisplatvorm kasutab tipptasemel küberturvalisust – sh Phil Zimmermanni ettevõtte Silent Circle tehnoloogiat –, et tagada valijate anonüümsus ja hääletamise usaldusväärsus. Valija saab oma virtuaalse hääle anda SMS-i teel, isegi kui riik piirab mobiili- ja internetikasutust.

Mõned Iraani valitsusega seotud veebilehed ja uudisteagentuurid on kampaania hukka mõistnud ja nimetanud seda välisriikide vandenõuks, kuid toetajad väidavad, et see annab tavainimestele uusi võimalusi ja tõstab esile demokraatia jaoks oluliste uuenduslike lahenduste vajaduse. Esimestel päevadel pärast valimiste algust anti sadu hääli ning korraldajad lahendasid tehnilised probleemid koostöös kogukonnaga.

„Meie Valime“ virtuaalvalimine kestab kuni 13. juunini ning tulemused avaldatakse koos Iraani ametlike valimistega. Kasparov loodab, et see annab iraanlastele lootust ja näitab, kuidas demokraatiat saab rakendada ka seal, kus traditsiooniline eneseväljendus on allasurutud.

article_content: For those in their 30s or older, Prince William’s recent engagement to Kate Middleton brought back memories of Prince Charles and Lady Diana Spencer’s famous 1981 announcement. The way William and Kate posed for photographers—even the iconic sapphire ring, once Diana’s—closely resembled the scene from the past. Media coverage was just as intense, spotlighting every detail from the dress designer to the couple’s family histories. This time, however, the 24/7 news cycle meant the story dominated even more, providing a temporary break from negative headlines. Amid Britain’s economic struggles, the news lifted people’s spirits, reminiscent of how the country rallied during tough times thirty years ago. The upcoming royal wedding is seen as an opportunity for national celebration, with Kate’s wearing of Diana’s ring capturing public affection just as Diana did. Yet there are clear distinctions. Charles and Diana knew little about each other when they got engaged. Diana, only 19, came from a divided aristocratic family, had limited world experience, and was unprepared for royal life’s public pressure. Charles, after public speculation over his romantic life, faced pressure to marry and did so after intense media attention focused on Diana. With hindsight, their marriage seemed troubled from the outset, marked by emotional uncertainty. In contrast, William and Kate were friends and companions at university before dating, building an eight-year relationship that observers consider authentic. At 28, Kate comes from a supportive, stable background, is well-educated, and has held a job, while their romance grew largely outside the public spotlight. Since the Diana era, the monarchy has established clearer boundaries with the media, learning from past missteps. Kate steps into royal life well-prepared, already familiar with media scrutiny. She has shown herself to be strong, discreet, and committed, handling attention to her background with poise. Whereas Diana’s popularity once overshadowed Charles, sometimes straining their relationship, William’s charisma means he stands comfortably as a public figure. Kate is expected to complement, not outshine, him. William’s desire to remain relevant, supported by Kate’s steady personality, marks them as a promising modern partnership. While the failure of Charles and Diana’s marriage threatened the monarchy, many observers believe William and Kate’s union could help secure the institution’s future. (Commentary by Penny Junor)

Diana, toona vaid 19, pärines keerulisest, aristokraatlikust perest, oli vähe kogenud ning polnud kuninglikuks eluks valmis. Kate astub kuninglikku ellu teadlikult ja hästi ettevalmistatuna, olles juba harjunud avalikkuse suure tähelepanuga. Ta on näidanud enda tugevust, diskreetsust ja pühendumust ning käsitleb tähelepanu oma päritolule enesekindlalt. Kui Diana populaarsus mõnikord varjutas Charlesi ja tekitas nende suhtes pingeid, siis Williami karisma loob temast endas särava avaliku figuuri. Williami soov olla avaliku elu tegelasena oluline, koos Kate’i stabiilse iseloomuga, loob neist lootustandva kaasaegse paari. Kui Charlesi ja Diana abielu lagunemine peaaegu lõhkus monarhia, siis paljude arvates aitab Williami ja Kate’i liit trooniperekonna tulevikku kindlustada. (Kommentaar: Penny Junor)

article_content: Amid economic challenges in China, shoppers are being more conservative with their money, putting the usual excitement around Singles' Day—the country's biggest e-commerce event—into question. Singles' Day, popularized by Alibaba, usually brings significant sales and heavily discounted prices as the event approaches on November 11. This year, though, concerns about jobs and the property market loom large, leading many to wonder if sales will reach previous heights. According to a Bain & Company survey, more than three-quarters of respondents plan to scale back or keep their spending steady during this Singles' Day, mainly due to unease over where the economy is headed. For small business owners like Shi Gengchen in Beijing, sales have dropped to 40% of what they were before the pandemic, prompting him—and many others—to watch their spending closely. Before COVID-19 struck, shoppers enthusiastically participated in Singles' Day, with Alibaba generating $38 billion in sales in just one day in 2019. Now, consumers have shifted towards buying more essential items rather than splurging on luxuries. Market researcher Shaun Rein observes that buzz for Singles' Day has faded; ongoing deals throughout the year mean most people expect discounts only on everyday goods like toiletries right now. Spending habits are changing: shoppers are prioritizing necessities. Hu Min, who works in a convenience store, confines her purchases to basics, a trend she sees among customers, too. Others, like insurance worker Gao Di, say they are more intentional, only buying products if they truly need them, even if they're not personally feeling the downturn. To attract budget-minded buyers, e-commerce sites such as Tmall, JD.com, and Pinduoduo are advertising record-low prices. These tactics appear effective—with JD.com reporting heightened orders and user counts, and many brands hitting significant sales benchmarks. Lu Fei from JD.com notes that the data points to steady demand for products like electronics and appliances, although shoppers are making more rational decisions. Alibaba says many brands doubled their merchandise value over last year, and new records were set for package deliveries: over 640 million parcels handled—a 15.8% increase from last year. Despite some reduction in spending on costly items, consultant Jacob Cooke points out that China's middle and upper classes are still eager to buy goods related to health, experiences, and lifestyle, such as vitamins, pet supplies, and activewear.

Ralph Lauren (NYSE: RL), a global designer and distributor of premium lifestyle products, is set to report its fiscal second-quarter results on November 8. The company is expected to slightly surpass revenue and earnings projections for Q2 2024. For the full fiscal year, Ralph Lauren forecasts low single-digit revenue growth compared to the prior year, with operating margins for Q2 expected between 9.5% and 10%. The ongoing "Next Great Chapter: Accelerate" strategy aims for mid-to-high single-digit annual revenue growth over the next three years.

RL shares have seen little movement over the past three years and have underperformed the S&P 500. From early 2021 to now, the stock has fluctuated around $105, while the S&P 500 has gained about 15%. Ralph Lauren’s stock delivered returns of 15% in 2021, -11% in 2022, and 9% in 2023, consistently trailing the index during those years. Such underperformance is common even among large consumer and tech names. In contrast, the Trefis High Quality Portfolio has outperformed the S&P each year in this period, offering better returns with less volatility.

Currently, RL shares are valued at $124 by some analysts, about 9% above their current trading price. For Q2 2024, expected revenue is $1.65 billion, modestly ahead of consensus. In Q1 2024, Ralph Lauren posted $1.5 billion in revenue, a 0.4% year-over-year increase, with growth in Asia Pacific and Europe balancing a North American decline. Inventory rose slightly to $1.2 billion, supporting expansion in Asia and Europe, while declining in North America. The company closed the quarter with $1.7 billion in cash and investments and $1.1 billion in debt. The full-year 2024 revenue forecast stands at $6.6 billion, a 2% rise year-over-year.

Q2 2024 expected earnings per share are $1.94, a small beat over consensus. Q1 saw adjusted net income of $158 million ($2.34 per share), compared to $1.88 a year earlier. Adjusted gross margin improved by 80 basis points to 68.8%, led by higher prices, lower freight costs, and a positive shift in sales mix, offsetting cost and currency challenges.

Based on a projected EPS of $9.42 and a P/E ratio of 13.1 for fiscal 2024, Trefis places RL’s fair value at $124 per share. Peer comparison tools are available for further insight. With continued macroeconomic uncertainty, the outlook for RL's market outperformance remains in question.

article_content: Marina Granovskaia, a longtime trusted associate of Chelsea owner Roman Abramovich, has been officially appointed to Chelsea's executive board. She is the first woman to hold such a position at the club. Granovskaia has played a key behind-the-scenes role at Chelsea for years, acting as Abramovich’s chief of staff across his various business interests and handling important negotiations, including high-profile player transfers. Her appointment formalizes an unofficial role she has held since 2010, during which she attended board meetings and consulted senior players on major club matters. She joins chairman Bruce Buck, CEO Ron Gourlay, and director Eugene Tenenbaum on the board. Granovskaia now ranks among a select group of powerful female executives in football, alongside Karren Brady of West Ham, Margaret Byrne of Sunderland, and Carolyn Radford of Mansfield. Karren Brady is known as West Ham’s vice-chairman and the ‘First Lady of football.’ Margaret Byrne became Sunderland’s chief executive in 2011 and sits on the FA Council. Carolyn Radford became CEO of Mansfield in 2011, becoming the youngest woman to lead a football club at the time. Granovskaia's swift access to Abramovich makes her a key contact point for the board when he is unavailable. She has been involved in key transfers, including the signings of David Luiz and Fernando Torres in 2011. Her official appointment is not expected to change club operations but instead formalizes her existing influence.

article_content: Cassandra Lynn Hensley, a former Playboy Playmate best known for her appearance as Miss February 2006, died at 34 from a suspected overdose. She was found unresponsive in the bathtub of a friend's home in Los Angeles on Wednesday. Police report that, while foul play is not suspected, the investigation into her death continues. Originally from Ferron, Utah, Hensley had recently been living in northern Virginia and was visiting Los Angeles when she died. Her friend found her unconscious and called police, suggesting a possible overdose, though no specific substances have been identified. Attempts by emergency responders to revive her were unsuccessful. Continuing her modeling career after her Playboy centerfold, Hensley was recently named 'Angel of the Month' by Metropolis Nights magazine. She participated in a variety of modeling projects, event hosting, and was involved with the Playboy Mansion. In a recent interview, she spoke about ongoing opportunities in the industry beyond Playboy and encouraged younger women to pursue modeling in a thoughtful way. Friends and former classmates described Hensley as outgoing, sometimes rebellious, and noted she had a challenging childhood with frequent moves and difficulties in school. Her school friend Aaron Arrington remembered her as lively and facing hardships while growing up. Known as 'Butterfly' because of her five butterfly tattoos, Hensley picked up new hobbies like motorcycling and often shared personal updates and photos on social media, including images from event hosting and time with her dog. Her social media feeds were updated daily, including horoscope posts even after her death. Cassandra Lynn Hensley is remembered for her energetic presence, dedication to her profession, and active role in the modeling and events sectors up to her untimely passing.

article_content: England's hopes of defending their Cricket World Cup title are effectively over after a heavy eight-wicket loss to Sri Lanka left them ninth in the standings. Coach Matthew Mott stated that the team would now be playing for pride in the remainder of the tournament. England was bowled out for 156 runs in a low-scoring match, suffering their fourth defeat in five games. They now sit above only the Netherlands—who are the only non-Test playing team—in the 10-team competition. Although mathematically still in contention, captain Jos Buttler admitted that a series of 'miracles' would be required for England to reach the semifinals. Mott conceded that given the team's poor net run rate and the competitive nature of the group, England's World Cup campaign is effectively finished. He told the BBC, 'It's over now, I think. I'm not a mathematician, but with our net rate and too many teams who are going to take games off each other, we have to come to terms with that. From now, we're playing for a lot of pride.' He went on to acknowledge the team's disappointment, stating, 'We've let our fans, families, and supporters down. We haven't performed at our best, and that's what you're judged on in professional sport. We must use this as a learning opportunity.' Mott stopped short of declaring the end of an era for England's ODI side, but said the result was a missed opportunity following their T20 World Cup success last year. 'Every time you play a World Cup you know it could be your last; they don't come along very often,' he added. 'In the last 12 to 18 months, we've succeeded in the T20 World Cup but struggled here. We need to get better.' 'The next major event is the T20 World Cup in June 2024, and we need to make sure our preparation is the best it can be, with the aim of delivering a much stronger performance.'

article_content: All travelers coming to the United States from Liberia, Sierra Leone, or Guinea, the three West African countries most affected by the Ebola outbreak, will now be screened for the disease at one of five designated airports, according to the Homeland Security Department on Tuesday. DHS Secretary Jeh Johnson stated, 'All passengers arriving in the United States whose travel begins in Liberia, Sierra Leone, or Guinea will be required to enter through one of the five airports equipped with enhanced screening and additional resources.' White House Press Secretary Josh Earnest said the new procedures would take effect starting Wednesday. A new Gallup poll indicates that Ebola is now among the top ten concerns for Americans, tying with the ISIS threat and ranking higher than general terrorism. Customs and Border Protection currently performs screenings, such as the one in Chicago, for arrivals from or via Sierra Leone, Liberia, or Guinea. Now, all travelers from these countries must enter through one of the five designated airports where screening takes place. Passengers can be seen in the arrivals area at John F. Kennedy International Airport in New York after health screening measures were implemented. Earlier this month, officials at New York’s Kennedy, Newark Liberty, Washington’s Dulles, Chicago’s O’Hare, and Atlanta’s Hartsfield-Jackson airports began screening people arriving from West Africa. The screening process includes the use of no-touch thermometers to check for elevated temperatures, a possible symptom of Ebola infection. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention is collaborating with DHS on these screenings. There are no direct flights from West Africa to the US. Around 94 percent of the approximately 150 daily travelers from West Africa to the US already arrive at one of the five designated airports. The new rules aim to include the remaining 4 percent. Secretary Johnson added that measures are in place to identify and screen anyone entering the US by land, sea, or air who is believed to have been in Liberia, Sierra Leone, or Guinea in the previous 21 days. When asked why the policy was not implemented immediately with the initial screening rollout, Earnest described Tuesday’s announcement as an example of 'creative policymaking.' He explained that DHS needed to coordinate with airlines to ensure all relevant passengers went through specific entry points, involving considerable planning and cooperation. DHS now screens anyone entering the US with a possible recent presence in Liberia, Sierra Leone, or Guinea. Concern about Ebola-infected travelers has grown since Thomas Eric Duncan, a Liberian man, traveled from the region to Dallas last month and became the first person in the US diagnosed with Ebola. He died on October 8. Following Duncan’s diagnosis, two nurses who cared for him were also diagnosed with Ebola. Some members of Congress have urged President Barack Obama to impose a temporary ban on travel from West Africa. House Judiciary Committee Chairman Bob Goodlatte, a Virginia Republican, praised the new screening measures but reiterated his call for a travel ban. Goodlatte stated, 'President Obama has a real solution at his disposal under current law and can use it at any time to temporarily ban foreign nationals from entering the United States from Ebola-affected countries.' Senator Chuck Schumer, a New York Democrat, described the expansion as 'an added layer of protection against Ebola entering our country.'

Sisejulgeoleku minister Jeh Johnson ütles: 'Kõik reisijad, kelle teekond algab Libeerias, Sierra Leones või Guineas, peavad sisenema Ameerika Ühendriikidesse läbi ühe viiest lennujaamast, kus on olemas täiustatud sõeluuringud ja täiendavad ressursid.' Valge Maja pressiesindaja Josh Earnest ütles, et uued protseduurid jõustuvad alates kolmapäevast. Uus Gallupi küsitlus näitab, et Ebola on nüüd üks kümnest suurimast murest ameeriklaste jaoks, olles samal tasemel ISIS-e ohuga ja kõrgemal kui terrorism üldiselt. USA tolli- ja piirivalveamet viib praegu läbi sõeluuringuid, näiteks Chicagos, reisijatele, kes saabuvad või kelle teekond on läbinud Sierra Leone, Libeeria või Guinea. Nüüdsest peavad kõik nimetatud riikidest saabujad sisenema läbi viie määratud lennujaama, kus toimub kontroll. Reisijad on nähtavad New Yorgi John F. Kennedy rahvusvahelise lennujaama saabumisalas pärast tervisekontrollide kehtestamist. Juba varem sel kuul alustasid ametnikud sõeluuringuid New Yorgi Kennedy, Newark Liberty, Washingtoni Dullese, Chicago O’Hare'i ja Atlanta Hartsfield-Jacksoni lennujaamades Lääne-Aafrikast saabuvatele inimestele. Sõeluuring hõlmab kontaktivabade termomeetrite kasutamist palaviku tuvastamiseks, mis võib olla Ebolale iseloomulik sümptom. Haiguste Kontrolli ja Tõrje Keskus teeb selles koostööd Sisejulgeoleku ministeeriumiga. Lääne-Aafrikast ei ole otselende USA-sse. Umbes 94 protsenti ligi 150st Lääne-Aafrikast päevas reisivast inimesest saabub juba läbi ühe viiest nimetatud lennujaamast. Uute reeglitega püütakse hõlmata ka ülejäänud 4 protsenti. Minister Johnson lisas, et on olemas meetmed, et tuvastada ja kontrollida kõiki, kes sisenevad USA-sse maismaal, merel või õhus ja keda on alust arvata olevat viimase 21 päeva jooksul Libeerias, Sierra Leones või Guineas. Küsimusele, miks poliitika kohe koos esialgse sõeluuringute käivitamisega kehtima ei hakanud, nimetas Earnest teisipäevast teadaannet 'loovaks poliitikaks'. Tema sõnul tuli Sisejulgeoleku ministeeriumil koordineerida lennufirmadega, et kõik vajalikud reisijad läbiksid kindlad kontrollpunktid, mis nõudis mitmekülgset planeerimist ja koostööd. DHS kontrollib nüüd kõiki, kelle puhul on alust arvata, et nad on viimastel nädalatel viibinud Libeerias, Sierra Leones või Guineas. Mure Ebolaga nakatunud reisijate pärast kasvas, kui Thomas Eric Duncan, Libeeriast pärit mees, reisis eelmisel kuul Dallasesse ja temast sai esimene Ebolasse diagnoositud inimene USAs. Ta suri 8. oktoobril. Pärast Duncani diagnoosi haigestusid Ebolasse ka kaks õde, kes teda ravisid. Mõned Kongressi liikmed on kutsunud president Barack Obamat üles kehtestama ajutist reisikeeldu Lääne-Aafrikast. Esindajatekoja õiguskomisjoni esimees Bob Goodlatte, Virginia vabariiklane, kiitis uusi sõeluuringumeetmeid, kuid kordas üleskutset reisikeelule. Goodlatte ütles: 'President Obamal on kehtivate seaduste raames olemas tõhus lahendus ja saab igal ajal kasutada õigust keelata ajutiselt Ebolaga seotud riikidest pärit välismaalased USA-sse sisenemast.' Senator Chuck Schumer, New Yorgi demokraat, nimetas meetme laiendamist 'täiendavaks kaitsekihiks, mis aitab Ebolal meie riiki mitte jõuda.'

article_content: The Color Purple, a landmark work in literature and film, tells the story of Celie, a young Black woman facing abuse in the early 20th century. Originally Alice Walker’s Pulitzer Prize-winning 1982 novel, the narrative has been adapted into Steven Spielberg’s 1985 film, a mid-2000s Broadway musical, and a Tony-winning revival. When filmmaker Blitz Bazawule was invited to direct the 2023 film musical, he was initially cautious, wondering what new perspective he could offer to such a frequently adapted story. Speaking at Deadline’s Contenders Film: Los Angeles event, Bazawule described approaching the project with reverence, viewing The Color Purple as 'sacred work' vital to many people's journeys of healing. Bazawule returned to Walker’s novel for inspiration. Reading Celie’s opening line, "Dear God," he realized the potential of highlighting Celie’s imagination. He argued that trauma survivors are often mischaracterized as passive, when in reality, they actively navigate and process their experiences. Bazawule intended to draw viewers deeply into Celie’s rich inner world, distinguishing this adaptation from previous versions. Fantasia Barrino, who portrayed Celie on Broadway in 2007-08, initially hesitated to reprise her role due to personal challenges she faced during her stage performance. However, Bazawule’s vision—focusing on Celie’s imagination and resilience—convinced her to return for the film adaptation. Barrino is joined by Taraji P. Henson, Danielle Brooks, Corey Hawkins, and Colman Domingo. Producers for the film include Steven Spielberg, Oprah Winfrey, Scott Sanders, and Quincy Jones, with Warner Bros. set to release the movie on Christmas Day.

Alice Walkeri Pulitzeri preemiaga pärjatud 1982. aasta romaanist on tehtud Steven Spielbergi 1985. aasta film, Broadway muusikal 2000ndate alguses ja Tony auhinna saanud lavastus. Kui režissöör Blitz Bazawule kutsuti lavastama 2023. aasta muusikalifilmi, oli ta alguses ettevaatlik ega olnud kindel, millist uut vaatenurka pakkuda nii sageli tõlgendatud loole. Deadline’i Contenders Film: Los Angeles üritusel ütles Bazawule, et võttis projekti vastu suure austusega, nimetades “The Color Purple’it” pühalikuks teoseks, mis on paljude inimeste tervenemise teel märkimisväärne. Inspiratsiooni leidmiseks pöördus Bazawule tagasi Walkeri romaani juurde. Celie avasõnade “Kallis Jumal” lugemisel mõistis ta, kui oluline on rõhutada Celie kujutlusvõimet. Ta tõi välja, et trauma kogenud inimesi peetakse sageli ekslikult passiivseks, kuigi tegelikult töötavad nad aktiivselt oma kogemustega. Bazawule eesmärk oli vaatajad Celie sisemaailma viia ning sellega eristada seda tõlgendust varasematest. Fantasia Barrino, kes kehastas Celie't Broadwayl aastatel 2007–08, kõhkles algselt rolli uuesti mängimises, sest tal oli laval perioodil isiklikult raske. Ent Bazawule visioon, mis keskendus Celie kujutlusvõimele ja tugevusele, veenis teda siiski rolli filmis vastu võtma. Barrinole astuvad kõrvalosades üles Taraji P. Henson, Danielle Brooks, Corey Hawkins ja Colman Domingo. Filmi produtsendid on Steven Spielberg, Oprah Winfrey, Scott Sanders ja Quincy Jones ning Warner Bros. toob filmi kinodesse jõuludel.

article_content: Deloitte's recent report, 'Uncovering Culture,' created in partnership with the Meltzer Center for Diversity, Inclusion, and Belonging at the NYU School of Law, starts with a probing question: 'What pressure might your organization place on people to minimize their identities?' The answer is higher and more widespread than many expect. The official term for this behavior is 'covering,' which refers to ways people feel compelled to downplay certain parts of their identity. 'We first conducted this research 10 years ago, and the issue of covering remains largely unchanged,' says Kwasi Mitchell, Chief Purpose and DEI Officer at Deloitte. According to the report, 60% of U.S. workers say they have covered at work in the past 12 months, and 63% report covering even before starting a new job. Mitchell emphasizes that Deloitte’s DEI institute focuses on practical steps managers can take to improve organizational culture, and this collaboration with Professor Kenji Yoshino is an important first outcome. Yoshino coined the term 'covering' in his 2006 book, 'Covering: The Hidden Assault on Our Civil Rights.' The report identifies four main types of covering: appearance-based, advocacy-based, affiliation-based, and association-based. These types play out in various ways. For example, not mentioning caregiver responsibilities is affiliation-based covering. People also cover aspects like immigration status, age, religion, socioeconomic status, education, gender, disability, race, and military status. Mitchell notes that appearance-based and affiliation-based covering are the most common. However, people often engage in different kinds of covering without even realizing it, like association-based covering—choosing not to interact much with those who share one’s background at work. Determining whether covering is conscious or subconscious is difficult, as most data comes from self-reporting. However, the report found that leaders—from C-suite executives to senior managers—report covering at the highest rates (67%). Mitchell explains that since executives are often highly visible, they might feel more pressure to cover aspects such as socioeconomic background, disability, mental health challenges, or age. The report shows that marginalized groups, including Black and Asian women, also cover more at work. Covering can be learned from society at a young age and is also influenced by workplace culture. Reasons given include wanting to avoid stereotypes, fearing judgment, or advancing at work. Mitchell adds that not all covering is negative. Sometimes it aligns with organizational values. For instance, an organization supporting caregivers should encourage open discussion, while someone whose views clash with company values might not be expected to share all aspects of their identity. Organizations interested in changing their covering culture should start by understanding their current environment. Leaders should ask employees what expectations make them feel unable to bring their whole selves to work. One effective method is sharing stories. Storytelling helps people better understand leaders and colleagues who might otherwise hide aspects of themselves. Ultimately, building a culture of allyship and psychological safety is key, and inclusion should be treated as an ongoing process. As Mitchell says, 'An organization’s self-awareness is a never-ending journey.'
translated_content: Deloitte'i värske aruanne 'Uncovering Culture', koostöös NYU õigusteaduskonna Meltzeri mitmekesisuse, kaasamise ja kuuluvuse keskusega, algab intrigeeriva küsimusega: 'Millist survet avaldab sinu organisatsioon inimestele oma identiteedi varjamiseks?' Vastus on palju laiem ja enamlevinum, kui arvata võiks. Seda käitumist nimetatakse ametlikult 'katmiseks' (inglise keeles covering), mis tähendab, et inimesed tunnevad vajadust mingid enda identiteedi osad tahaplaanile suruda. 'Uurisime seda teemat esmakordselt 10 aastat tagasi ning katmise probleem pole peaaegu muutunud,' ütleb Deloitte'i eesmärgipõhine tegevus- ja mitmekesisusjuht Kwasi Mitchell. Aruande kohaselt väidab 60% USA töötajatest, et nad on viimase 12 kuu jooksul tööl oma identiteeti varjanud ning 63% teevad seda juba enne uue töö alustamist. Mitchell rõhutab, et Deloitte’i mitmekesisuse instituut keskendub praktilistele sammudele, mida juhid saavad organisatsioonikultuuri parandamiseks rakendada, ja see koostöö professor Kenji Yoshinoga on oluline esimene samm. Yoshino tõi mõiste 'katmine' kasutusele 2006. aasta raamatus 'Covering: The Hidden Assault on Our Civil Rights'. Aruandes eristatakse neli peamist katmise tüüpi: välimuse-, eestkoste-, kuuluvus- ja seosepõhine katmine. Need tüübid ilmnevad erinevalt. Näiteks oma hoolduskohustustest mitte rääkimine on kuuluvuspõhine katmine. Inimesed varjavad tööl sageli ka oma immigratsioonistaatust, vanust, religiooni, sotsiaalset tausta, haridust, sugu, puudega olemist, rassi ja sõjaväelist staatust. Mitchelli sõnul on kõige levinumad välimuse- ja kuuluvuspõhine katmine. Sageli teevad inimesed katmist isegi teadmata, näiteks seosepõhiselt – suhtlemine teiste omataolistega on töökohal piiratud. Raske on öelda, kas katmine on teadlik või alateadlik, sest enamasti põhineb info enesehinnangul. Siiski leiti aruandes, et juhid – tipp- ja keskastmejuhid – katavad end kõige sagedamini (67%). Mitchell selgitab, et juhid tunnevad suuremat survet varjata näiteks oma majanduslikku tausta, võimalikku puuet, vaimseid raskusi või vanust, sest nad on väga nähtavad. Aruanne näitab, et marginaliseeritud rühmad nagu mustanahalised ja aasia naised katavad töökohal oma identiteeti rohkem. Katmist õpitakse sageli ühiskonnast juba lapsena ning seda tugevdab ka töökoha kultuur. Selle põhjustena mainitakse soovi vältida stereotüüpe, hirmu hinnangute ees või soovi edeneda. Mitchell lisab, et katmine ei ole alati negatiivne. Mõnikord käib see kokku organisatsiooni väärtustega. Näiteks hooldajaid toetav ettevõte võiks julgustada avatud arutelu, kuid kui mõne töötaja vaated lähevad vastuollu firma väärtustega, ei pea ta kõike avaldama. Katmise kultuuri muutmiseks peaks organisatsioon alustama oma praeguse olukorra mõistmisest. Juhid võiksid uurida, millised ootused takistavad töötajatel täielikult endana tööl olla. Tõhus on lugude jagamine: see aitab mõista nii juhte kui kolleege, kes end varjavad. Kokkuvõttes on tähtis soodustada liitlassuhteid ja psühholoogilist turvatunnet ning kaasamine peab olema pidev protsess. Mitchelli sõnul on 'organisatsiooni eneseteadlikkus lõputu teekond.'

article_content: After rumors surfaced that OpenAI, led by CEO Sam Altman, had enlisted former Apple designer Jony Ive for a secret hardware project, Altman clarified that he has no intention of competing directly with the smartphone market. According to Insider, Altman made these remarks during The Wall Street Journal’s Tech Live event. He stated that while he shares ideas with Jony Ive, any potential hardware concepts are still at a very early stage. Altman emphasized that he does not believe any AI device would surpass the popularity of the iPhone, saying he has 'no interest in trying to compete with a smartphone' because it is already 'phenomenal at what it does.' During an interview with the Wall Street Journal’s Joana Stern, Altman said, 'There is something great to do, but I don’t know what it is yet.' He acknowledged that every significant new technology can inspire new computing platforms and that he has many ideas, but they are all in the nascent phase. Rumors about a possible OpenAI hardware project started in September, with reports that Altman approached Jony Ive, Apple's former Chief Design Officer, to collaborate. Ive, who was behind the design of the iPhone, iPad, and iMac, left Apple in 2019 after 27 years. Shortly after, it was reported that OpenAI had raised $1 billion for the project, with investment from SoftBank CEO Masayoshi Son, who also proposed involving Arm, a chip designer, in which SoftBank holds a 90% stake. According to the Financial Times, Altman and Ive aimed to develop a device offering a more 'natural and intuitive way' to interact with AI, with one source dubbing it the 'iPhone of artificial intelligence.' Despite the nickname, Altman’s comments suggest they are not seeking to reinvent the iPhone, but rather to create a transformative AI device in the same spirit. Meanwhile, the smartphone market is experiencing a decline. Canalys, a tech market analysis firm, reported last month that smartphone sales in North America have dropped significantly. iPhone sales are down 22% year-over-year, with an estimated 12% decline in 2023. These figures, especially following the launch of the iPhone 15, may signal consumer fatigue with incremental smartphone improvements.
translated_content: Pärast kuulujutte, et OpenAI tegevjuht Sam Altman kaasas endise Apple’i disaineri Jony Ive’i salajase riistvaraprojekti jaoks, selgitas Altman, et tal pole kavatsust nutitelefonide turuga otseselt konkureerida. Insideri andmetel tegi Altman need märkused The Wall Street Journali Tech Live üritusel. Ta ütles, et kuigi tal on Jony Ive’iga ideid, on kõik võimalikud riistvarakontseptsioonid alles väga varases staadiumis. Altman rõhutas, et ta ei usu, et mõni tehisintellekti seade suudaks iPhone’i populaarsust ületada, öeldes, et tal 'pole huvi proovida nutitelefoniga konkureerida', sest see on juba 'fenomenaalselt hea selles, mida see teeb.' The Wall Street Journali Joana Sterni intervjuus ütles Altman: 'On midagi suurt, mida teha, aga ma ei tea veel, mis see on.' Ta tunnistas, et iga uus oluline tehnoloogia võib innustada uusi arvutiplatvorme ja tal on palju ideid, kuid need on alles algstaadiumis. Kuulujutud võimalikust OpenAI riistvaraprojektist said alguse septembris, kui levis info, et Altman pöördus koostööks Jony Ive’i poole, kes oli Apple’i peadisainer. Ive, kes kujundas iPhone’i, iPadi ja iMaci, lahkus Apple’ist 2019. aastal pärast 27 aastat. Varsti pärast seda teatati, et OpenAI kogus selleks projektiks miljard dollarit SoftBanki juhi Masayoshi Soni investeeringuga, kes pakkus välja ka kiibitootja Armi kaasamist, milles SoftBankil on 90% osalus. Financial Timesi teatel soovisid Altman ja Ive arendada seadet, mis võimaldab tehisintellektiga loomulikumat ja intuitiivsemat suhtlust. Üks allikas nimetas seda 'tehisintellekti iPhone’iks.' Hoolimata sellest hüüdnimetusest viitavad Altmanni kommentaarid, et nad ei plaani iPhone’i otseselt ümber leiutada, vaid luua hoopis murrangulise tehisintellekti-seadme iPhone’i vaimus. Samas nutitelefonide turg on languses. Tehnoloogiaturu analüüsifirma Canalys teatas eelmisel kuul, et Põhja-Ameerikas on nutitelefonide müük märkimisväärselt langenud. iPhone’i müük on aastaga langenud 22% ja 2023. aastaks ennustatakse 12% langust. Need arvud, eriti iPhone 15 väljaandmise järel, võivad viidata tarbijate väsimusele järjekordsest väikeste uuendustega nutitelefonist.

article_content: Kelly Briggs, an Aboriginal blogger who contributes to outlets like Crikey and The Guardian, has spoken publicly about facing racial bias while searching for housing in Moree, a town in north-western New South Wales. After experiencing repeated rental application rejections due to her skin color, Briggs ultimately relied on a white friend to secure a home for her. She told the Sydney Morning Herald that racism is so ingrained in Moree society that it often goes unnoticed. Others in the local Aboriginal community reportedly encounter similar challenges securing accommodation. Briggs, the mother of two and a business governance diploma holder, also revealed a two-year struggle with unemployment. On her personal blog, The Koori Woman, she recounted being wrongly accused of shoplifting by a security guard in a Sydney pharmacy, describing the humiliation and lack of an apology. She described the ongoing emotional toll of such treatment, saying she is continually singled out, followed in stores, and not given the benefit of the doubt enjoyed by non-Indigenous Australians. To support herself through her writing, Briggs launched a fundraising campaign and spoke out about her housing ordeal after the release of the government’s Overcoming Indigenous Disadvantage report. The latest government report indicates a sharp increase in Indigenous incarceration, with adult imprisonment rates more than doubling from 2000 to 2013, and young Indigenous people being far more likely than their non-Indigenous peers to be imprisoned. Despite these concerning findings, the federal government declined to introduce new justice targets, which has drawn criticism from opposition parties such as Labor and the Greens. Indigenous Affairs Minister Nigel Scullion argued that practical action, not targets, should be the priority, with attention focused on improving school attendance and adult employment. Opposition figures such as Shane Neumann and Nova Peris argue that the government’s approach neglects urgent problems. The report further highlights an increase in hospitalizations for self-harm among Indigenous Australians and persistent high levels of psychological distress. Progress has been observed in some areas, like decreasing child mortality, longer life expectancy, and improved full-time employment rates among Indigenous adults. However, literacy, numeracy, and family violence rates remain largely unchanged. Key data points include a slight narrowing of the life expectancy gap, halved infant mortality rates, but little to no progress in educational benchmarks for reading, writing, and numeracy, as well as increases in self-harm and imprisonment rates. While there are signs of advancement, substantial gaps and setbacks persist, leading to ongoing demands for stronger government intervention.
translated_content: Kelly Briggs, aborigeenide blogija, kes kirjutab väljaannetele nagu Crikey ja The Guardian, on avalikult rääkinud, kuidas ta on Moree linnas Uus-Lõuna-Walesi loodeosas kokku puutunud rassilise eelarvamusega eluaseme otsimisel. Pärast seda, kui tema üürisoovid lükati nahavärvi tõttu korduvalt tagasi, pidi Briggs lõpuks paluma valgel sõbral talle kodu üürida. Ta ütles Sydney Morning Heraldile, et rassism on Moree ühiskonnas nii juurdunud, et see jääb tihti märkamata. Ka teised kohalikud aborigeenid seisavad sarnaste takistuste ees eluaseme leidmisel. Briggs, kahe lapse ema ja ärikorralduse diplomiga, on samuti paljastanud, et tal on olnud raske kahe aasta jooksul tööd leida. Oma isiklikus blogis The Koori Woman meenutas ta, kuidas turvatöötaja Sydneys apteegis teda valesti varguses süüdistas ning kirjeldas sellele järgnenud alandust ja vabanduse puudumist. Ta rääkis selle kohtlemise kestvast emotsionaalsest mõjust, öeldes, et teda eristatakse pidevalt, jälgitakse kauplustes ning talle ei anta sama usaldust või kahtluse kasuks tõlgendust nagu teistele austraallastele. Enda kirjutiste toel elatise teenimiseks käivitas Briggs annetuskampaania ning rääkis oma eluasemeraskustest pärast valitsuse raporti „Põlisrahvaste ebasoodsa olukorra ületamine“ avaldamist. Raporti järgi on aborigeenide vangistamine järsult kasvanud: täiskasvanute vangistamismäär on 2000–2013 üle kahe korra suurenenud ning noored aborigeenid satuvad oluliselt tõenäolisemalt vangi kui mitte-aborigeenidest noored. Nendest murettekitavatest faktidest hoolimata keeldus föderaalvalitsus uute õigluseesmärkide seadmisest, mis tõi kaasa kriitikat Tööparteilt ja Rohelistelt. Põlisrahvaste asjade minister Nigel Scullion arvas, et tähtsam on praktiline tegutsemine, prioriteediks koolis käimine ja täiskasvanute töö. Opositsiooni esindajad nagu Shane Neumann ja Nova Peris leidsid, et valitsuse lähenemine jätab olulised probleemid tähelepanuta. Raport rõhutab ka aborigeenide enesevigastamise hospitaliseerimise tõusu ja jätkuvalt kõrget psühholoogilist stressi. On täheldatud mõningaid edusamme: vähenenud laste suremus, pikenenud eluiga ja kasvanud põlisrahvaste täistööajaga tööhõive. Kuid lugemis-, kirjutamis- ja perevägivalla osas on muutused olnud väikesed või puuduvad. Olulised andmed: eluiga lõhe on veidi kahanenud, imikusuremus on poole võrra vähenenud, aga haridustulemustes pole suurt muutust ning enesevigastamise ja vangistamise määrad on tõusnud. Kuigi mõnes valdkonnas on toimunud edasiminek, püsivad olulised lõhed ja tagasilöögid, mistõttu nõutakse jätkuvalt otsustavat valitsuse tegutsemist.

article_content: ‘Whip It!’ imagines what might have happened if Juno had attended a quirky high school like Napoleon Dynamite’s, with a mother who dreamed of her daughter becoming a beauty queen, as in Little Miss Sunshine. However, instead of following her mother’s wishes, she laces up roller skates. Ellen Page stars as Bliss, a witty, independent teen who joins a roller derby team in Austin called the Hurl Scouts. On the rink, she adopts the name Babe Ruthless, channeling her energy into speed rather than brute force. Bliss sneaks away from her conservative parents—played by Marcia Gay Harden, a postal worker, and Daniel Stern, a laid-back beer lover—to find acceptance and excitement with her new teammates. Juliette Lewis plays the team's main rival, but the film presents conflicts in a light, comedic way rather than as serious threats. Directed by Drew Barrymore, who also appears as Smashley Simpson, ‘Whip It!’ has a playful, ‘grrrl-power’ vibe and focuses more on fun than on real athletic competition. Barrymore leads the charge in the movie’s energetic and youthful mayhem. Entertainment Weekly gave the film a grade of C+.

article_content: Gaining weight can harm heart health, even for individuals who are not overweight, according to new research from the University of Oxford. The study reveals that for every five-unit increase in body mass index (BMI) in women, the risk of developing coronary heart disease (CHD) rises by 23%—a risk equivalent to aging by two and a half years. BMI, a measure of weight relative to height, is considered 'normal' by the World Health Organization when between 18.5 and 25. Oxford researchers tracked the health of 1.2 million women in England and Scotland for over a decade. They found that the risk of CHD climbed consistently with BMI, not just with age, and that small increases in BMI raised the risk even among those not considered obese. For example, one in eleven lean, middle-aged women (average BMI 21) will either be hospitalized for or die from CHD between the ages of 55 and 74. For obese women (average BMI 34), this risk rises to one in six. Study author Dr. Dexter Canoy emphasized that even small, incremental increases in BMI elevate the risk of CHD, and this effect is evident in women across all weight categories. He noted that modest BMI changes, combined with not smoking, avoiding excessive alcohol, and maintaining physical activity, could greatly reduce the incidence of CHD. Other recent studies highlighted that sedentary lifestyles also pose significant health risks. One such study followed 63,048 middle-aged men and found that those sitting for more than four hours a day had a higher risk of chronic illnesses such as heart disease, diabetes, and cancer. Participants who sat for six or more hours were notably more likely to have diabetes. Though the study focused on men, researchers believe the results are relevant to women as well. According to Professor Richard Rosenkranz of Kansas State University, the risk of chronic disease increases the longer people spend sitting. Individuals who sit for more than eight hours daily face the greatest health risks. Prior research involving 222,000 people demonstrated that prolonged sitting increases the risk of dying within three years, even among those who are otherwise physically active.
translated_content: Kaalutõus võib kahjustada südame tervist isegi neil, kes pole ülekaalulised, selgub Oxfordi ülikooli uuest uuringust. Uuringust selgub, et iga viie kehamassiindeksi (KMI) ühiku suurenemise korral naistel tõuseb tõenäosus haigestuda pärgarteri haigusesse (PAH) 23% võrra—see on risk, mis on võrdne kahe ja poole aasta vananemisega. KMI on kehakaalu ja pikkuse suhe ning Maailma Terviseorganisatsiooni hinnangul on normaalne KMI vahemikus 18,5 kuni 25. Oxfordi teadlased jälgisid enam kui kümne aasta jooksul 1,2 miljoni Inglismaa ja Šotimaa naise tervist. Nad leidsid, et PAH-i risk tõuseb pidevalt koos KMI-ga, mitte ainult vanusega, ning isegi väikesed KMI suurenemised suurendasid riski ka neil, keda ei peeta ülekaaluliseks. Näiteks ühel üheteistkümnest saledast keskikka jõudvast naisest (keskmine KMI 21) kas hospitaliseeritakse või nad surevad PAH-i tõttu vanuses 55 kuni 74 aastat. Rasvunud naiste puhul (keskmine KMI 34) tõuseb see risk ühele kuuest. Uuringu autor dr Dexter Canoy rõhutas, et isegi väikesed, järkjärgulised KMI suurenemised tõstavad PAH-i riski ning see puudutab eri kehakaalu kategooriates olevaid naisi. Ta märkis, et tagasihoidlikud muutused KMI-s koos suitsetamisest hoidumise, liigse alkoholitarbimise vältimise ning füüsiliselt aktiivse elustiiliga võivad oluliselt vähendada PAH sagedust. Teised hiljutised uuringud toovad välja, et ka istuv eluviis kujutab endast tõsist terviseriski. Ühes uuringus jälgiti 63 048 keskealist meest ning selgus, et need, kes istusid päevas üle nelja tunni, olid vastuvõtlikumad südamehaigustele, diabeedile ja kasvajatele. Need, kes istusid kuus või enam tundi päevas, olid oluliselt altimad haigestuma diabeeti. Kuigi uuring keskendus meestele, usuvad teadlased, et tulemused laienevad ka naistele. Kansas State'i ülikooli professor Richard Rosenkranz tõi välja, et krooniliste haiguste risk suureneb, mida kauem inimesed istuvad. Kõige suuremasse riskirühma kuuluvad need, kes istuvad päevas üle kaheksa tunni. Varasem uuring 222 000 inimesega näitas, et pikaajaline istumine suurendab kolme aasta jooksul suremise riski isegi neil, kes on muidu füüsiliselt aktiivsed.

article_content: The Anambra State Government has announced a new round of polio vaccinations for children, aiming to prevent the spread of the virus following a recent outbreak in neighbouring Enugu State. Dr. Afam Obidike, the state’s Commissioner for Health, revealed plans for this second phase of immunization at a press event in Akwa. The vaccination campaign, led by the Anambra State Primary Health Care Development Agency in cooperation with the World Health Organisation and other partners, will build on the success of a previous campaign held in September, where 2.3 million children under five were immunized. This new phase is scheduled from November 11 to 14 and will cover all 21 local government areas. The state has received more than two million vaccine doses to ensure every eligible child between 0-59 months is reached. Alongside polio vaccination, routine immunizations and child birth registrations will be offered during the four days, allowing the government to improve healthcare planning and data collection. Dr. Obidike stressed the importance of vaccination for children’s health and asked parents, guardians, and caregivers to present their children for immunization. He assured that all vaccines provided are safe and free of charge, and asked the public to report any health worker who requests payment. WHO’s state coordinator, Dr. Adamu Abdul-Nasir, praised Anambra State for exceeding vaccination targets in the first phase, leading the South-East region in coverage. He noted that, for this second phase, WHO is offering logistical support and allowances for over 9,000 health workers who will be visiting homes, churches, markets, and schools, including hard-to-reach areas. Executive Secretary of ASPHCDA, Chisom Uchem, confirmed the arrival of vaccine doses and emphasized the goal to surpass previous achievements by ensuring comprehensive coverage throughout the state. The media was encouraged to raise awareness of the campaign’s significance so that more families are reached and children stay healthy.

Osariigi terviseminister Dr. Afam Obidike tutvustas selle immuniseerimiskampaania teist faasi pressikonverentsil Akwas. Uus voor toimub 11.–14. novembrini ning hõlmab kõiki 21 kohalikku omavalitsust. Osariik on saanud üle kahe miljoni vaktsiinidoosi, et jõuda iga sobiliku 0–59 kuu vanuse lapseni. Poliovaktsiini kõrval pakutakse nelja päeva jooksul ka tavapärast immuniseerimist ning laste sünniregistreerimist, mis aitab valitsusel paremini tervishoiu planeerimist ja andmete kogumist. Dr. Obidike rõhutas vaktsineerimise olulisust laste tervisele ja palus vanematel ning hooldajatel tuua lapsed immuniseerimisele. WHO osariigi koordinaator dr Adamu Abdul-Nasir tunnustas Anambrat, et esimene etapp ületas vaktsineerimise eesmärgid ja oli Lõuna-Ida piirkonnas kõrgeima katvusega. Ta tõi välja, et teises voorus toetab WHO osariiki logistikaga ning üle 9 000 tervishoiutöötaja kulude hüvitamisega – vaktsineerijad külastavad kodusid, kirikuid, turge ja koole, sealhulgas raskesti ligipääsetavaid piirkondi. ASPHCDA täitevsekretär Chisom Uchem kinnitas, et vaktsiinidoosid on saabunud ning rõhutas eesmärki varasemat etappi ületada, tagades kogu osariigis laialdase katvuse. India's economic growth for fiscal year 2024 (FY24) is projected to remain robust, outpacing other major economies, according to the Finance Ministry. The ministry noted that a swift turnaround in US interest rate expectations, falling US 10-year Treasury yields, and lower global oil prices are encouraging developments for India and other emerging markets. However, the ministry cautioned that risks from persistent price pressures remain, keeping the government and the Reserve Bank of India vigilant.

In its October monthly economic report, the ministry reported retail inflation had eased to a four-month low of 4.87%, comfortably within the targeted 2-6% range. Falling global crude oil prices and continued moderation in core inflation are expected to help control inflation further.

The report underscored India's medium-term prospects, backed by ongoing public investment in infrastructure and advancements in digital public services. Still, it warned of potential external challenges, including the need to constantly monitor external financial flows due to their effect on the rupee and balance of payments. Full transmission of monetary policy may also dampen domestic demand, the ministry added.

Since May 2022, the central bank has raised the policy repo rate by a cumulative 250 basis points to 6.5%. Lending rates on new loans have climbed 187 basis points, and on outstanding loans, by 105 basis points. Nonetheless, India's growth for FY24 is expected to remain a positive outlier globally.

On the supply side, the ministry cited strong performance, while on the demand side, private final consumption expenditure is the leading growth driver. Rural demand maintained sequential momentum in the second quarter of FY24, helped by stable grain incomes and moderating price pressures. Manufacturing growth is being propelled by higher production and rising sales. Meanwhile, services activity continues to expand, supported by robust demand and a surge in new businesses. The services sector remains optimistic, bolstered in part by a recovery in tourism and hospitality.

The government is on track to meet its FY24 fiscal deficit target of 5.9% of GDP, thanks to strong revenue collection and prudent spending. An emphasis on capital expenditure throughout the year has also stimulated private investment. The festive season has further lifted consumption demand. Higher household savings, falling unemployment rates, rising real estate prices, and stronger equity markets are all underpinning consumption, the ministry noted.

October merchandise exports saw their highest growth in 11 months, and services exports also stayed strong. Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs), who were net sellers in October, became net buyers in early November.

Separately, the income tax department has uncovered almost ₹10,000 crore in tax evasion by online sellers using social media platforms like Instagram and Facebook, sending notices to 45 brands with more investigations underway. Meanwhile, over 20,000 GST notices since 2022 are prompting companies to review their tax compliance before mergers and acquisitions.

In another development, Nawaz Modi, the estranged wife of Raymond managing director Gautam Singhania, alleged that Singhania assaulted her and one of their daughters during a domestic dispute two months ago.

India majanduskasv 2024. eelarveaastal (FY24) on eeldatavasti tugev ja ületab teiste suuremate majanduste kasvu, teatas rahandusministeerium. Ministeerium märkis, et kiire pööre USA intressimäärade ootustes, langev USA 10-aastane riigivõlakirjade tootlus ja madalamad ülemaailmsed naftahinnad on soodsad arengud nii Indiale kui ka teistele arenevatele turgudele. Samas hoiatas ministeerium, et püsivad hinnasurved kujutavad endast endiselt riski, mistõttu on nii valitsus kui ka India keskpank valvsad.

Oktoobrikuu majandusaruandes teatas ministeerium, et jaemüügi inflatsioon oli langenud nelja kuu madalaimale tasemele, 4,87%-ni, jäädes mugavalt valitsuse seatud 2–6% vahemikku. Langevad toornafta maailmaturuhinnad ja põhihindade jätkuv leevenemine peaksid inflatsiooni täiendavalt kontrolli all hoidma.

Aruandes rõhutati India keskpikka väljavaadet, mida toetavad püsivad avaliku sektori investeeringud infrastruktuuri ja edusammud digitaalse avaliku teenuse arendamisel. Samas hoiatati võimalike välismõjude eest, rõhutades vajadust pidevalt jälgida välisfinantsvooge nende mõju tõttu ruupia väärtusele ja maksebilansile. Rahapoliitika täielik mõju võib samuti sisemaist nõudlust jahutada, lisas ministeerium.

Alates 2022. aasta maist on keskpank tõstnud repomäära kokku 250 baaspunkti võrra, 6,5%-ni. Uute laenude intressimäärad on tõusnud 187 baaspunkti ja olemasolevate laenude omad 105 baaspunkti võrra. Sellest hoolimata oodatakse India majanduskasvu FY24-s endiselt maailma mastaabis positiivseks erandiks jäävat.

Pakkumise poolelt tõi ministeerium välja tugeva soorituse, samas kui nõudluse poolel on peamiseks kasvuallikaks erasektori lõpptarbimise kulutused. Maaelu nõudlus säilitas teises kvartalis järjestikuse hoogu tänu stabiilsetele teraviljatuludele ja mõõdukale hinnasurvele. Tööstustoodangu kasvu veavad ülespoole suurenev tootmine ja kasvavad müüginumbrid. Samal ajal laieneb ka teenindussektor, mida toetab tugev nõudlus ja uute ettevõtete lisandumine. Teenindussektori meeleolud on jätkuvalt positiivsed, mida toetab muu hulgas turismi ja hotellinduse taastumine.

Valitsus püsib kursil täita FY24 eelarveperioodi puudujäägi siht 5,9% SKPst, tänu tugevale tulude laekumisele ja arukale kuluhaldusele. Aasta jooksul rõhutatud kapitaliinvesteeringud on samuti elavdanud erasektori investeeringuid. Pidulik hooaeg on täiendavalt kasvatanud tarbimisnõudlust. Kasvavad leibkonna säästud, vähenev töötus, tõusvad kinnisvarahinnad ja tugevamad aktsiaturud toetavad kõik tarbimist, märkis ministeerium.

Kaubaekspordi kasv oktoobris oli kõrgeim viimase 11 kuu jooksul ja teenuste eksport jäi samuti tugevaks. Välisinvestorid, kes olid oktoobris olnud netomüüjad, muutusid novembri alguseks netoostjateks.

Erinevas kontekstis avastas maksuamet peaaegu 10 000 krooni väärtuses maksupettusi sotsiaalmeedia platvorme kasutavate internetimüüjate seas, saates 45 brändile välja teavitused ja uurides jätkuvalt rohkemate ettevõtete tegevust. Samuti sunnivad üle 20 000 GST teavituse alates 2022. aastast ettevõtteid enne ühinemisi ja ülevõtmisi maksukohustusi põhjalikumalt kontrollima.

Lisaks väitis Nawaz Modi, Raymondi juhatuse esimehe Gautam Singhania lahus elav abikaasa, et Singhania ründas teda ja üht nende tütart kahe kuu eest aset leidnud peretüli käigus.

article_content: A Border Security Force (BSF) jawan deployed for election duty lost his life after a grenade in his possession accidentally detonated in Chhattisgarh’s Dantewada district on Sunday, according to police. The incident occurred as a team from the BSF’s 70th battalion, stationed at Katekalyan police station for the elections, was about to begin a search operation. As the patrolling team was moving out from the police station, a hand grenade kept in a pouch worn by head constable Balbeer Chand exploded. Chand sustained severe injuries and was immediately transported to Dantewada district hospital, where doctors declared him dead. He was a resident of Himachal Pradesh, and his family has been informed. An accidental death case has been registered, and further investigation is in progress. Dantewada is one of 20 assembly constituencies voting in the first phase of the two-phase elections set for November 7. To bolster security in the Naxalite-affected Bastar division, which includes Dantewada, additional paramilitary forces have been deployed.

Juhtum leidis aset, kui BSFi 70. pataljoni meeskond, mis oli Katekalyani politseijaamas valimiste tagamiseks, valmistus alustama otsinguoperatsiooni. Patrullmeeskond lahkus parasjagu politseijaama hoonest, kui vanemkonstaabel Balbeer Chandi vöökotis olnud käsigranaat plahvatas. Chand sai raskeid vigastusi ning viidi kohe Dantewada maakonnahaiglasse, kus arstid kuulutasid ta surnuks. Ta oli pärit Himachal Pradeshist ja tema perekonda on teavitatud. Juhtunu kohta on alustatud õnnetusjuhtumi menetlust ning uurimine jätkub. Dantewada on üks 20-st valimisringkonnast, kus esimeses kahest valimisvoorust toimub hääletamine 7. novembril. Turvalisuse tugevdamiseks Naxaliitide mõjualas Bastari piirkonnas, kuhu kuulub ka Dantewada, on kohale toodud lisajõude.

article_content: Electric cars are widely regarded as the future of transportation, but challenges remain that deter many car buyers. Issues include limited range, heavy and expensive batteries, and lengthy charging times. However, several companies claim to be on the verge of solving many—if not all—of these problems. Toyota, in particular, has stated it may be close to a major breakthrough. Other automakers are collaborating with various battery manufacturers on this emerging technology.  The anticipated innovation is called a 'solid-state battery.' Yet, like many highly-promoted, world-changing technologies, its launch has been repeatedly described as just a few years away for some time. Companies including Stellantis, Hyundai, and Volkswagen have also partnered with firms working on solid-state batteries. This technology promises batteries that are smaller and lighter while delivering more power, and could be safer by reducing the risk of fires in crashes.  Solid-state batteries also come with their own hurdles, and they are not the sole approach to achieving lighter, cheaper, and faster-charging electric vehicles. The primary difference between solid-state batteries and the currently used lithium-ion batteries is the electrolyte. Lithium-ion batteries use a liquid electrolyte, while solid-state batteries use a solid one. The solid electrolyte could enhance safety, since punctures in traditional batteries could cause uncontrolled energy release and fires. Solids are generally denser than liquids, so the solid electrolyte may take up less space, allowing for smaller battery cells.  Additionally, some companies are exploring other strategies to make batteries smaller, lighter, and faster-charging. The major challenge for automakers and their battery partners is producing these advanced batteries economically and at scale, to make electric cars affordable. Meanwhile, established battery technologies continue to evolve, with established manufacturing methods still in use. The field remains highly competitive, with several startups developing batteries using varied chemical combinations and structures.  "There’s still no clearly superior technology," said William Kephart, a battery researcher at consulting firm P3 Group. Fast charging—an important consumer demand—remains a challenge for solid-state batteries, because lithium ions generally move slower through a solid than a liquid, which can extend charging times and affect vehicle acceleration.  Quantumscape, a solid-state battery company, claims its batteries—which use some liquid components but not for the electrolyte—can charge faster than conventional lithium-ion batteries, based on tests. Kephart noted, however, that solid-state batteries often contain more lithium, making them more expensive. Lithium prices are expected to decline as supply increases, but solid-state batteries may remain costlier than alternatives in the near term.  Factorial, backed by investors such as Stellantis and Mercedes, reports that its solid-state battery technology uses less lithium than typical batteries, potentially lowering costs as production expands. 'We think the costing actually will be competitive because lithium is not a scarce material,' said Factorial CEO Siyu Huang. Quantumscape says its battery design eliminates graphite, which can further reduce expenses and carbon emissions during manufacturing.  At the same time, some companies are enhancing existing liquid-electrolyte batteries; for example, OneD Battery Sciences—supported by GM—proposes adding silicon to the battery, a change that could substantially improve performance at lower costs. Their process requires minimal changes to current production, leading to less disruption and expense for manufacturers.  Other firms are working on semi-solid state batteries, which combine elements of both battery types, aiming to deliver some benefits of solid-state technology without entirely moving away from fluid-based designs.  Ultimately, a single battery technology is unlikely to dominate all electric vehicles, according to GM spokesperson Phil Lienert. Battery selection will likely be tailored to each vehicle and specific market, similar to how different engines are used in various models and regions. GM’s Ultium vehicle platform was engineered to accommodate multiple battery types. 'When you have a large, diverse customer base like ours, you need to offer multiple solutions that can coexist within the same basic design framework,' he said.
translated_content: Elektriautosid peetakse laialdaselt transpordi tulevikuks, kuid ostjaid heidutavad jätkuvalt mitmed väljakutsed. Probleemide hulka kuuluvad piiratud sõiduulatus, rasked ja kallid akud ning pikk laadimisaeg. Siiski väidavad mitmed ettevõtted, et on lähedal nende probleemide lahendamisele. Toyota on öelnud, et neil võib olla käimas suur läbimurre. Ka teised autotootjad teevad koostööd erinevate akutootjatega selle uue tehnoloogia arendamiseks.  Oodatav uuendus on nn tahkisaku. Ent nagu paljude teiste suurelt reklaamitud tehnoloogiate puhul, on selle turule jõudmist juba mõnda aega kirjeldatud kui vaid mõne aasta kaugusel olevat. Stellantis, Hyundai ja Volkswagen on samuti teinud koostööd ettevõtetega, kes arendavad tahkisakusid. See tehnoloogia lubab väiksemaid ja kergemaid akusid, mis annavad rohkem energiat ning võivad olla ohutumad, vähendades tuleohtu avariide korral.  Samas kaasnevad tahkisakudega ka omad raskused ning need pole ainus viis, kuidas saavutada kergemaid, odavamaid ja kiiremini laetavaid elektrisõidukeid. Peamine erinevus praegu kasutatavate liitiumioonakude ja tahkisakude vahel on elektrolüüt. Liitiumioonakudes kasutatakse vedelat elektrolüüti, tahkisakudes aga tahket. Tahke elektrolüüt võib tõsta ohutust, kuna traditsiooniliste akude purunemisel võib tekkida kontrollimatu energiaeraldus ja tulekahju. Üldiselt on tahked materjalid tihedamad kui vedelad, seega võib tahke elektrolüüt võtta vähem ruumi ning lubada väiksemaid akuelemente.  Lisaks uurivad mõned ettevõtted muid strateegiaid, et muuta akusid väiksemaks, kergemaks ja kiiremini laetavaks. Suurim väljakutse autotootjatele ja nende akupartneritele on nende kõrgtehnoloogiliste akude tootmine majanduslikult ja ulatuslikult, et elektriautod muutuksid taskukohaseks. Samal ajal arendatakse edasi ka olemasolevaid akutehnoloogiaid, kasutades juba väljakujunenud tootmisvõimalusi. Ala on väga konkurentsitihe, kus paljud idufirmad arendavad erineva keemilise koosseisu ja struktuuriga akusid.  „Praegu pole veel ühest esilekerkivat tehnoloogiat,” ütles William Kephart, akude teadlane konsultatsioonifirmast P3 Group. Oluline tarbija vajadus – kiire laadimine – on tahkisakude puhul endiselt väljakutse, sest liitiumioonid liiguvad tahkes materjalis aeglasemalt kui vedelikus, pikendades laadimisaega ja mõjutades sõiduki kiirendust.  Tahkisakusid arendav ettevõte Quantumscape väidab, et nende akud – mis kasutavad küll veidi vedelikku, ent mitte elektrolüüdina – suudavad testide põhjal laadida kiiremini kui tavalised liitiumioonakud. Kephart märkis siiski, et tahkisakud sisaldavad sageli rohkem liitiumi, mis muudab need kallimaks. Liitiumi hinnad peaksid pakkumise kasvades küll langema, kuid lähiajal võivad tahkisakud alternatiividest siiski kallimaks jääda.  Stellantise ja Mercedese poolt toetatud Factorial väidab, et nende tahkisakutehnoloogia kasutab vähem liitiumi kui tüüpilised akud, mis võib tootmise kasvu korral kulusid vähendada. „Me usume, et kulud võivad jääda konkurentsivõimeliseks, sest liitium ei ole defitsiitne materjal,” ütles Factoriali tegevjuht Siyu Huang. Quantumscape väidab, et nende akudisain välistab grafiidi, mis võib samuti kulusid ning süsinikuheidet tootmisel vähendada.  Samal ajal täiustavad mõned ettevõtted olemasolevaid vedela elektrolüüdiga akusid; näiteks OneD Battery Sciences, kelle investoriks on ka GM, pakub akule ränilisandi kasutamise lahendust. See muudatus võib oluliselt parandada jõudlust ning vähendada kulusid. Nende meetod nõuab tootmises minimaalseid muudatusi ja toob tootjatele kaasa vähem häireid ning kulusid.  Teised ettevõtted töötavad välja pool-tahkisakusid, mis ühendavad mõlema akuliigi omadusi, pakkudes osaliselt tahkisakude eeliseid, ent jäävad vedelal põhineva lahenduse juurde.  Tõenäoliselt ei hakka ükski akutehnoloogia domineerima kõikides elektrisõidukites, tõdes GM-i esindaja Phil Lienert. Aku valik sõltub mudelist ja turust, nagu ka erinevad mootorid erinevates piirkondades. GM-i Ultium-platvorm võimaldab kasutada mitut akuliiki. „Kui sul on nii suur ja mitmekesine kliendibaas nagu meil, tuleb pakkuda erinevaid lahendusi, mis saavad samal platvormil koos eksisteerida,” märkis ta.
