article_content: A new spin-off titled The Boys: Mexico is in development, with Diego Luna and Gael Garcia Bernal attached as executive producers and potentially as stars. This announcement arrives after Gen V, another spin-off set at a college, was renewed for a second season and ahead of the upcoming The Boys season 4. There is currently no confirmed release date or detailed plot synopsis for The Boys: Mexico, other than that it will take place in the same universe as The Boys, but set in Mexico. The original show is known for its US-centric approach, focusing on superheroes assigned to American cities by the company Vought and often reflecting aspects of American politics and culture. Notably, the character Homelander is widely regarded as an allegorical figure similar to Donald Trump. Diego Luna, most recently acclaimed for Andor, and Gael Garcia Bernal, recognized for works like Werewolf by Night and Station Eleven, bring significant talent to the project as prominent Mexican actors. Some fans and commentators have expressed concern that expanding The Boys universe into new regions might dilute its sharp satire, making it similar to the superhero universes it originally parodied. However, Amazon is eager to capitalize on the continued success of The Boys and Gen V. While the title The Boys: Mexico has raised some eyebrows, Luna and Bernal's involvement is expected to generate considerable interest. There is also a hope among some fans for a more innovative series name.

George Galloway has consulted his lawyers regarding Jemima Khan's claim that he converted to Islam in a 'phantom' ceremony over a decade ago. Khan stated that the maverick MP participated in a 'shahadah' conversion ceremony attended by members of the Muslim Association of Great Britain. Jemima Khan, who converted to Islam before her marriage to cricketer Imran Khan, asserted in a New Statesman article that she knows someone who attended the event in north-west London. Galloway, recently elected as MP for Bradford West, has denied that any such ceremony took place.

In response to the New Statesman, Galloway released a statement: 'The further allegations from the New Statesman following my rebuttal move this issue into the domain of defamation. Jemima Khan questioned me on tape about this supposed ceremony in Kilburn, and I told her it was untrue—whoever told her so was not truthful. There is no reference to this exchange in the New Statesman article, which relies on it. As they now dispute my denial, the matter is with my solicitor.'

Although Galloway has been widely described as Catholic in the media, there has been speculation about his religion, as he has not explicitly denied being Muslim. Ahead of his recent by-election victory, a letter (which Galloway denies authoring) was distributed to voters, highlighting his support for Palestine, his advocacy for Kashmir, and his abstinence from alcohol. The letter stated, 'God knows who is a Muslim. And He knows who is not. Instinctively so do you.'

Galloway also took to Twitter to firmly deny Khan's claims regarding his religious conversion. Jemima Khan responded on social media, questioning, 'what's wrong with being a Muslim?' In her New Statesman article, she wrote, 'George Galloway, MP for Bradford West, is a Muslim. He converted more than ten years ago in a ceremony at a hotel in Kilburn, north-west London, attended by members of the Muslim Association of Great Britain. Those close to him know this. The rest of the world, including his Muslim constituents, does not.'

During the interview, Khan told Galloway she knew someone who attended his 'shahadah' and asked, 'so you converted?' Reportedly, Galloway replied, 'I can't answer that. God knows who is a Muslim.' The two shared a halal meal during the interview. When sworn in as MP, Galloway opted for affirmation rather than swearing on a religious text. He explained: 'People ask why I affirmed in Parliament. The answer is: I had to take an oath of allegiance I do not believe in, to the Queen and her heirs, and I cannot do so on a holy book. Nothing further should be read into the affirmation.'

Galloway called the article full of 'deliberate falsehoods' and 'schoolgirl errors.' He tweeted: 'No such ceremony ever happened, in Kilburn or anywhere else.' He also stated, 'The opening paragraph of Jemima Khan's article in the New Statesman, referring to an alleged conversion ceremony, is totally untrue. Moreover, I told her it was incorrect when she asked. I have never attended any such ceremony in Kilburn, Karachi, or Kathmandu. It is simply and categorically untrue.'

The New Statesman issued a strong rebuttal, stating, 'It is notable that Galloway does not deny being a Muslim convert—and he did not do so when asked during the interview, which is recorded. Contrary to his press release, he did not deny the ceremony took place when questioned in the interview—this is also on tape. Furthermore, he did not clarify how, by his own admission, he entered a 'nikah' (Muslim marriage ceremony), even though a non-Muslim man cannot marry a Muslim woman under Islamic law.'

Galloway continues to deny participating in any conversion ceremony, although questions regarding his religious beliefs persist.

George Galloway on pöördunud oma advokaatide poole seoses Jemima Khani väitega, et ta pöördus rohkem kui kümme aastat tagasi „fantoomtseremoonial“ islamiusku. Khan väitis, et värvikas parlamendiliige osales „shahadah“ pöördumistseremoonial, kus olid kohal Suurbritannia Islami Assotsiatsiooni liikmed. Jemima Khan, kes pöördus islamiusku enne abiellumist kriketimängija Imran Khaniga, kirjutas New Statesmani artiklis, et ta tunneb kedagi, kes osales sündmusel Loode-Londonis. Hiljuti Bradford Westi parlamendiliikmeks valitud Galloway eitas, et sellist tseremooniat oleks toimunud.

Vastuseks New Statesmanile andis Galloway teada: „New Statesmani täiendavad süüdistused pärast minu ümberlükkamist tõstavad selle küsimuse laimu kategooriasse. Jemima Khan küsis minult lindil selle oletatava Kilburni tseremoonia kohta ja ma ütlesin, et see pole tõsi—see, kes seda talle rääkis, rääkis valet. Selles New Statesmani artiklis sellele vestlusele ei viidata, kuigi see on aluseks. Nüüd, kui nad minu eitust vaidlustavad, on asi minu advokaadi käsutuses.“

Ehkki meedias on Gallowayd enamasti kirjeldatud kui katoliiklast, on tema religiooni osas spekulatsioone, kuna ta pole moslemiks olemist selgesõnaliselt eitanud. Enne hiljutist valimisvõitu saadeti valijatele kiri (mille autor olemist Galloway eitas), milles rõhutati tema toetust Palestiinale, tegutsemist Kashmiri vabaduse eest ja alkoholist loobumist. Selles kirjas seisis: „Jumal teab, kes on moslem. Ja Ta teab, kes ei ole. Instinktiivselt tead seda ka sina.“

Galloway lükkas Twitteris jõuliselt tagasi Khani väited tema religioosse pöördumise kohta. Jemima Khan vastas sotsiaalmeedias: „Mis on moslemina olemises halba?“ Oma New Statesmani artiklis kirjutas ta: „George Galloway, Bradford Westi parlamendiliige, on moslem. Ta pöördus üle kümne aasta tagasi islamiusku tseremoonial Kilburnis, Loode-Londonis, kus olid kohal Suurbritannia Islami Assotsiatsiooni liikmed. Tema lähedased teavad seda. Ülejäänud maailm, kaasa arvatud tema moslemitest valijad, seda aga ei tea.“

Intervjuu ajal ütles Khan Gallowayle, et ta tunneb kedagi, kes käis tema „shahada“-tseremoonial, ja küsis: „Niisiis, sa pöördusid?“ Väidetavalt vastas Galloway: „Ma ei saa sellele vastata. Jumal teab, kes on moslem.“ Nad sõid intervjuu käigus halal-toitu. Parlamendiliikmeks kinnitamisel valis Galloway vande andmise asemel kinnituse. Ta ütles: „Inimesed küsivad, miks ma parlamendis kinnituse andsin. Vastus on: ma pidin andma ustavusvande kuningannale ja tema järglastele, millesse ma ei usu, ning ma ei saanud seda teha püha raamatu peal. Sellest ei tohiks midagi rohkemat järeldada.“

Galloway nimetas artiklit „tahtlikult valelikuks“ ja „koolitüdrukulike vigadega“ täidetuks. Ta säutsus: „Sellist tseremooniat pole kunagi toimunud, ei Kilburnis ega mujal.“ Ta lisas: „Jemima Khani New Statesmani artikli avalõik, mis viitab oletatavale pöördumistseremooniale, on täiesti vale. Ütlesin talle ka, et see ei vasta tõele. Ma pole kunagi osalenud sellisel tseremoonial Kilburnis, Karachis ega Kathmandus. See on lihtsalt ja kategooriliselt vale.“

New Statesman vastas tugeva kommentaariga: „On märkimisväärne, et Galloway ei eita moslemiks pöördumist—ning ta ei teinud seda ka intervjuu salvestuse ajal. Vastupidiselt tema pressiteatele ei eitanud ta tseremooniat, kui selle kohta küsiti—ka see on lindil. Lisaks ta ei selgitanud, kuidas ta sõlmis nikaahi (islamist abielutseremoonia), kuigi islami seaduste järgi ei või mitte-moslemist mees abielluda moslemist naisega.“

Galloway jätkab mistahes pöördumisega seotud tseremooniate eiramist, kuid küsimused tema isikliku usutunnistuse kohta ei vaibu.

article_content: Arnold Schwarzenegger revealed that before starting his Hollywood career, he worked with multiple coaches, including an accent-reduction specialist, in an effort to lose his prominent Austrian accent. Despite extensive sessions designed to help him master American English pronunciation, he could not fully eliminate his accent. He discussed details about practicing challenging words, such as distinguishing 'three' from 'sree,' and learning to correctly say 'wine' instead of 'vine.' While these exercises were valuable, Schwarzenegger’s unmistakable accent persisted. Interestingly, this accent became the reason director James Cameron cast him as the Terminator. Cameron felt that Schwarzenegger's distinctive, mechanical-sounding speech fit the cyborg role perfectly. Schwarzenegger first became a major action star with 'Conan the Barbarian' in 1982, and his breakthrough continued with 'The Terminator' in 1984. Over his career, what was once considered a limitation instead became an essential part of his on-screen identity. Most recently, Schwarzenegger appeared in Netflix's 'FUBAR' and was the subject of the documentary series 'Arnold.'
translated_content: Arnold Schwarzenegger avaldas, et enne Hollywoodi karjääri algust töötas ta mitme juhendajaga, sealhulgas aktsendi vähendamise spetsialistiga, et proovida vabaneda oma tugevalt Austria aktsendist. Vaatamata paljudele tundidele Ameerika inglise keele häälduse õppimisel ei õnnestunud tal aktsendist täielikult vabaneda. Ta meenutas, kuidas harjutas korduvalt keeruliste sõnade, nagu 'three' ja 'sree,' eristamist ning õppis õigesti ütlema 'wine' asemel 'vine.' Kuigi need harjutused olid kasulikud, jäi Schwarzeneggeri äratuntav aktsent alles. Huvitaval kombel sai tema aktsendist hoopis põhjus, miks režissöör James Cameron valis ta Terminaatori rolli. article_content:
Efforts continued Friday to address the severe flooding that has affected Colorado, including ongoing airlifts of stranded residents, discoveries of oil spills, and a warning to residents of one town to avoid tap water due to E. coli contamination. As of Friday, the number of confirmed deaths remained at seven statewide, with three more people presumed dead in Larimer County. Authorities reported that 82 individuals in the county were still unaccounted for as of Friday afternoon.

The flooding has caused extensive damage to buildings, roads, bridges, and Colorado's natural environment. 'We're about to embark on a rebuilding effort that is truly epic in scale,' Governor John Hickenlooper stated. Oil and gas leaks have occurred in various lakes, rivers, and streams, although no fracking operations were taking place when flooding began, according to Colorado's Oil and Gas Association. By Friday morning, about 70% of the affected area remained unassessed, but state officials were monitoring 11 sites with signs of oil and gas spills. At least five significant oil releases were reported, including two confirmed in the South Platte River near Evans. Four incidents involved the release of approximately 22,000 gallons of oil, and production equipment at a PDC Energy site was largely washed away. The extent of fuel lost in that incident is unknown. An aerial survey also found up to two dozen overturned fuel tanks.

Tap water was shut off for Lyons—a town of about 2,000 people 17 miles north of Boulder—after tests revealed the presence of E. coli bacteria. While many E. coli strains are harmless, they can cause illness if present in water, as explained by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. 'There has been a breach, and we don't want you using any of the water,' said Lyons administrator Victoria Simonsen. 'It's critical we get that back up and get it disinfected before we would want any of you to be back.'

These environmental and public health concerns follow record rainfall that began September 12 in mountainous areas north of Denver. Some areas received over nine inches of rain in one day, and rainfall totals reached 18.1 inches in Boulder County and 15.6 inches in Adams County. The intense rain triggered flash floods, which transformed canyons into raging torrents and left hundreds stranded. More than a week later, many remained isolated, as floodwaters destroyed roads and bridges. Rescuers resumed airlifts Friday to evacuate those trapped. Larimer County authorities reported that nearly 1,200 people had been airlifted from the mountains by Thursday, with nearly 200 more opting to remain. In total, over 5,300 people have been evacuated across nearly 2,000 square miles and 17 counties. Preliminary estimates indicate that approximately 1,900 homes have been destroyed and 16,000 more damaged. The flooding also damaged 50 bridges and 200 miles of roads, with repair costs estimated at $135 million.

Governor Hickenlooper signed an executive order Friday authorizing $20 million in state funds—on top of a previously approved $6 million—to help address the aftermath of the floods. 

CNN's Matt Smith contributed to this report.

Reedel jätkusid jõupingutused Colorado ulatuslike üleujutuste tagajärgedega tegelemiseks, sealhulgas õhutranspordiga päästetööd, avastatud naftareostused ja ühe linna elanike hoiatamine vältida kraanivee kasutamist E. coli bakteriga saastumise tõttu. Reedeks oli kinnitatud seitse hukkunut kogu osariigis ning Larimeri maakonnas arvatakse hukkunud olevat veel kolm inimest. Võimude andmetel oli seal reede pärastlõunal veel 82 inimest teadmata kadunud.

Üleujutused on põhjustanud ulatuslikke kahjusid hoonetele, teedele, sildadele ja Colorado looduskeskkonnale. 'Ees seisab tõeliselt mastaapne taastamistöö,' ütles kuberner John Hickenlooper. Mitmes järves, jões ja ojas on juhtunud nafta- ja gaasilekkeid, kuid Colorado nafta- ja gaasitööstuse ühenduse teatel üleujutuse ajal frakkimist ei toimunud. Reedeks oli umbes 70% kahjustatud alast veel hindamata, kuid ametnikud jälgisid 11 paika, kus olid märgid nafta- või gaasilekkest. Teatati vähemalt viiest suuremast naftareostusest, kaasa arvatud kahest kinnitatusest South Platte'i jões Evans'i lähedal. Neljas juhtumis lekkis umbes 22 000 gallonit naftat ja ühe PDC Energy tootmisplatsi seadmed uhtus üleujutus minema. Selle juhtumi kütusekaotus on teadmata. Õhuseirel avastati veel kuni kaks tosinat ümber läinud kütusepaaki.

Lyonsis – umbes 2000 elanikuga linnas, mis asub Boulderi linnast 27 km põhja pool – lülitati kraanivesi välja pärast E. coli bakteri leidmist veest. Kuigi paljud E. coli tüved on ohutud, võivad nad vees põhjustada haigusi, selgitas USA haiguste kontrolli ja ennetamise keskus. 'On toimunud rikkumine ja me ei taha, et kasutaksite vett,' ütles Lyonsi haldur Victoria Simonsen. 'On väga oluline, et saaksime vee taas töökorda ja desinfitseerida enne, kui elanikud saavad naasta.'

Nimetatud keskkonna- ja rahvatervise probleemid järgnesid rekordvihmadele, mis algasid 12. septembril Denverist põhja pool mägedes. Mõnes kohas sadas ööpäevaga üle üheksa tolli vihma ning kokku sadas Boulderi maakonnas 46 cm ja Adamsi maakonnas 40 cm. Äärmuslik sadu tekitas kiiruputusi, mis muutsid kanjonid tormilisteks vooludeks ning jätsid sajad inimesed lõksu. Nädal hiljem olid paljud endiselt eraldatud, kuna üleujutusveed olid lõhkunud teid ja sildu. Reedel jätkasid päästjad õhutransporti lõksus inimestele. Larimeri maakonna ametnike andmetel oli neljapäevaks õhutranspordiga evakueeritud ligi 1200 inimest, ligi 200 otsustasid jääda. Kokku on evakueeritud üle 5300 inimese ligi 5200 ruutkilomeetri suuruselt alalt 17 maakonnas. Esialgsetel hinnangutel on hävinud umbes 1900 kodu ja veel 16 000 said kahjustusi. Üleujutus kahjustas ka 50 silda ja 320 km teid, paranduskulud on hinnanguliselt vähemalt 135 miljonit dollarit.

Kuberner Hickenlooper allkirjastas reedel korralduse eraldada üleujutuste tagajärgedega tegelemiseks veel 20 miljonit dollarit osariigi vahendeid – lisaks eelnevalt heaks kiidetud 6 miljonile dollarile.

article_content: The Niger State Emergency Management Agency (NSEMA) has released the names and photographs of some of the victims recovered after a fatal boat accident on Monday morning. Speaking with The PUNCH, NSEMA spokesperson Hussaine Ibrahim stated that Murna Ezekiel was identified as being from Kebbi State, while Bilyaminu Kontagora, Dauda Alhassan Kasabu, and Iliya Kpchra Busuru were all from Niger State. Ibrahim also reported that two more bodies were recovered from the river on Wednesday morning, with their identities to be released pending confirmation. The boat, carrying passengers from Kasabu village in Agwara Local Government Area, Niger State, to Yauri in Kebbi State, capsized on Monday morning due to heavy rain and strong winds. NSEMA attributed the accident to a combination of water hyacinth and powerful waves. Search and rescue operations, conducted by local divers and boat owners under supervision of the agency's desk officer in Agwara, have continued since the incident. However, the ongoing rains and severe winds have hampered recovery efforts. Ibrahim assured that the agency would provide further updates as more information becomes available.

article_content: A corporate jet crash in western Germany on Sunday resulted in the deaths of all four people on board, according to police. The plane crashed near the town of Trier and burst into flames upon impact, witnesses reported. Authorities are investigating the cause of the crash. Local fire officials told German public broadcaster ZDF that the aircraft struck a power pole. At the time of the accident, the area was covered in dense fog, ZDF noted. The jet had originated from England and was scheduled to land at a small airfield in Föhren. The two passengers and two crew members aboard the Cessna Citation jet are believed to have been German nationals. CNN's Sara Mazloumsaki contributed to this report.

Kohalikud tuletõrjujad ütlesid Saksamaa avalik-õiguslikule ringhäälingule ZDF, et lennuk tabas elektriposti. Õnnetuse toimumise ajal oli piirkonnas tihe udu, märkis ZDF. Lennuk oli startinud Inglismaalt ja pidi maanduma väikesel lennuväljal Föhrenis. Kahe reisija ja kahe meeskonnaliikme kohta Cessna Citation lennukis arvatakse, et nad olid Saksamaa kodanikud. CNN-i raportile andis oma panuse Sara Mazloumsaki.

A public dispute has erupted between Segolene Royal, former partner of French President Francois Hollande, and his current partner, Valerie Trierweiler. Royal, who is running for parliament in La Rochelle, demanded respect from Trierweiler after the First Lady tweeted support for Royal’s election rival, Olivier Falorni. French media likened the situation to a soap opera, referring to it as 'Dallas at the Elysee Palace.'

Royal, visibly upset, addressed the controversy at a political rally, stating she felt deeply hurt by Trierweiler’s comments and called for respect for herself as both a politician and the mother of Hollande’s children. She emphasized the impact the dispute had on her family, especially her children.

After Trierweiler’s tweet, which wished Falorni luck and praised his commitment to La Rochelle, Prime Minister Jean-Marc Ayrault publicly admonished Trierweiler, stating that everyone should know their place, and noted how the role of the President’s partner is traditionally discreet.

Trierweiler declined to apologize, dismissing claims of jealousy and arguing that her support for Falorni was not a betrayal. She insisted that the situation had been blown out of proportion by the media and denied any mixing of public and private affairs.

French media and Socialist Party insiders described the episode as damaging for Hollande, suggesting it weakened his image and exposed internal party rifts. Some questioned Trierweiler’s motivation and highlighted long-standing tensions between her and Royal.

article_content: The United States, long considered to view the Super Bowl as its main football event, has made significant progress in embracing 'soccer.' The 2014 FIFA World Cup in Brazil marks the first time U.S. fans are widely engaged—twenty years after hosting the tournament in 1994. This year, instead of struggling to generate support for the U.S. Men's National Team (USMNT), fan parks have been filled to capacity, and even turning eager supporters away. A pre-tournament survey of 19 countries sending fans to Brazil showed the U.S. as one of just four nations expecting to win the World Cup, alongside Argentina, Brazil, and Spain. While this optimism might have been a bit high, the USMNT performed well enough to almost secure a place in the final 16, outplaying teams like Portugal and Ghana, which were seen as stronger opponents. A draw against Germany in the final group game would guarantee their advancement, and a win might see the U.S. leading their group and facing possibly favorable matchups in the knockout stages. The fans’ excitement is evident. More than seven years after David Beckham moved to LA Galaxy—ushering in new attention to American soccer—the sport is finally capturing imaginations across the country. Even the absence of star Landon Donovan has not lessened this enthusiasm. Celebrities like Will Ferrell have been seen cheerleading at events, and American ticket sales for World Cup games total 196,838—second only to the host nation. Viewing figures have reached all-time highs, beginning to compete with traditional U.S. sports. While Major League Soccer (MLS) still trails the national team in popularity, there's growth. David Beckham will soon launch a new Miami-based MLS team. Star signings like David Villa for New York City FC and the potential arrival of Frank Lampard point to growing stature. While the 1994 U.S.-hosted World Cup had the best attendance, this year’s match against Portugal drew over 20 million American viewers. Coach Jurgen Klinsmann, facing his home nation Germany, encouraged fans with a letter to excuse them from work for an ‘important cause.’ Support for the USMNT is transforming ‘soccer’ into ‘football’ in American hearts. Fans celebrated wildly when John Brooks scored a late winner against Ghana but were disappointed by Portugal's late equalizer by Silvestre Varela after a Cristiano Ronaldo assist. If the U.S. manages a win or a draw against Germany, more emotional fan scenes are expected across the country.

Sel aastal on USMNT (USA meeste koondise) toetajad täitnud fännipargid täis ning soovijatel ei ole alati sissepääsu. Turniiri eel tehtud uuring 19 Brasiiliasse reisinud riigi seas näitas, et USA oli üks neljast rahvusest, kelle fännid uskusid võitu MM-il—koos Argentina, Brasiilia ja Hispaaniaga. Ehkki optimism oli kõrge, suutis USMNT mängida hästi ning oli väga lähedal 16 parema hulka pääsemisele, edestades oodatust tugevaid Portugali ja Ghana meeskondi. Viik Saksamaaga viimases alagrupimängus tagaks edasipääsu ning võit võiks tähendada alagrupi esikohta ja soodsat vastast playoff’is. Fännide entusiasm on ilmne. Üle seitsme aasta pärast David Beckhami liitumist LA Galaxyga—mis tõi Ameerika jalgpallile tähelepanu—on spordiala lõpuks haaramas fännide kujutlusvõimet. Telerivaatajate arvud on püstitanud rekordeid, konkureerides juba traditsiooniliste spordialadega. MLS pole küll veel sama populaarne kui koondis, kuid kasvutrend on selge. David Beckham avab peagi uue Miami MLS-i klubi. Tähtmängijad nagu David Villa (New York City FC-s) ning saabuv Frank Lampard näitavad liiga kasvavat mõju. article_content: Piper Hansen, a 23-year-old recent college graduate, has just begun her first full-time job at a YMCA office in Louisville, Kentucky. While she finds her role rewarding, transitioning to a full-time schedule has been a difficult adjustment. Hansen’s workday typically runs from 10 a.m. to 7 p.m., with her mornings starting around 7 a.m. After work, her evenings are spent walking her dog, making dinner, and preparing for the next day, leaving her with little personal time before getting to bed around 11 p.m. Her feelings reflect a larger conversation sparked by a viral video, where a Gen Z worker voiced concerns over the 40-hour workweek and its impact on life outside of work. Reactions to the video were divided—some sympathized with the struggle, while others criticized Gen Z for not adapting. Hansen recognizes that long work hours are common but questions whether it should remain this way. Despite efforts to spend time with friends and pursue hobbies, she often finds herself too tired or pressed for time. Although Hansen enjoys her job, she is concerned by the prospect of repeating this routine for decades. A coworker’s comment about working another 45 years left her uneasy. She hopes for more flexible work options, such as remote work or a hybrid schedule, to create more room for personal life. While she’s seen others benefit from flexible arrangements, for now she continues seeking ways to balance her professional responsibilities with her personal interests during the limited free time she has.

Pärast tööpäeva veedab ta õhtuid koeraga jalutades, õhtusööki valmistades ja järgmiseks päevaks ette valmistudes, jättes endale enne magamaminekut umbes kell 23 vähe isiklikku aega. Tema tunded kajastuvad laiemas arutelus, mille vallandas viiruslik video, kus üks Z-põlvkonna töötaja avaldas muret 40-tunnise töönädala tõttu vaba aja puudumise üle. Videole reageeriti mitmeti — mõned olid kaastundlikud, teised kritiseerisid noort põlvkonda kohanemisraskuste pärast. Hansen tunnistab, et pikad tööpäevad on tavalised, kuid küsib, kas see peakski nii olema. Kuigi ta püüab leida aega sõprade ja hobide jaoks, segab seda sageli väsimus ja ajapuudus. Kuigi Hansenile tema töö meeldib, teeb teda murelikuks mõte sama rutiini kordamisest aastakümneteks. Töötaja kommentaar, et seda tuleb teha veel 45 aastat, tekitas temas ebakindlust. Kuigi ta on näinud, et teised saavad paindlikest töötingimustest kasu, otsib ta praegu endiselt viise, kuidas töö- ja eraelu piiratud vaba aega paremini tasakaalustada.

Alison Baker, 59, who spent over two decades leading drink-drive awareness courses for Devon County Council, has been convicted of drink-driving. The incident took place after Baker drove to a local garage in Exeter, Devon, twice in one morning to purchase wine. When tested, she had 104mg of alcohol per 100ml of breath—almost three times the legal limit of 35mg.

Garage worker Devon Greening alerted authorities after observing signs of intoxication on Baker’s second visit. Police arrived at her home, where she was unsteady and needed support to stand. Baker claimed she had only drunk a small amount of wine after driving home, but the court did not accept her explanation.

Baker argued her high alcohol reading was the result of drinking after driving, but District Judge Stephen Nicholls found her guilty and imposed an interim driving ban pending sentencing. Throughout the trial, Baker admitted using alcohol for pain relief due to arthritis and recounted drinking until she passed out, sometimes hiding alcohol from her husband. 

Prosecutor Sarah Hornblower emphasized that although Baker did not challenge the high alcohol measurement, she maintained she wasn't over the limit when driving. The judge determined she had consumed most of her first bottle before her second trip. Once a vocal advocate against drink-driving, Baker now faces those same legal and personal consequences herself.

Juhtum leidis aset Exeteris, Devonis, kui Baker sõitis ühel hommikul kahel korral kohalikku tanklasse veini ostma. Politseiuuring näitas tema väljahingatavas õhus 104 mg alkoholi 100 ml kohta – ligi kolm korda üle seadusliku piirmäära (35 mg).

Tanklatöötaja Devon Greening kutsus võimud kohale pärast seda, kui märkas Bakeri teisel külastusel joobe märke. Politsei saabus tema koju, kus Baker oli ilmselgelt ebastabiilne ja vajas püsti püsimiseks tuge. Baker väitis, et jõi veidi veini alles pärast kojujõudmist, kuid kohus tema juttu ei uskunud.

Baker põhjendas oma kõrget alkoholisisaldust joomisega pärast autojuhtimist, kuid kohtunik Stephen Nicholls tunnistas ta süüdi ning määras talle ajutise sõidukeelu kuni järgmise kuu jooksul tehtava lõpliku otsuseni. Kohtuprotsessil tunnistas Baker, et tarvitas alkoholi artriidist tingitud valu leevendamiseks ning jõi aeg-ajalt teadvuseni, sageli peites jooki oma abikaasa eest.

Prokurör Sarah Hornblower tõi välja, et ehkki Baker ei vaidlustanud kõrget alkoholiproovi tulemust, väitis ta siiski, et polnud auto juhtimise ajal piirnormist üle. Kohtunik leidis, et ta oli suurema osa esimesest veinipudelist ära joonud enne teist tanklakülastust. Kordne joobes juhtimise ennetaja seisab nüüd silmitsi karistustega, mille eest ta ise teisi hoiatas.

article_content: Nicholas Fenney, a 56-year-old photographer, has been issued a restraining order preventing him from coming within five metres of supermarket worker Samantha Bryce, aged 22, following concerns of unwanted attention. Fenney became fixated on Bryce after she served him at Tesco in Tetbury, Gloucestershire. According to evidence presented at Gloucester Crown Court, Fenney gave Bryce a calendar featuring his duck photographs, addressed to her, and later sent an inappropriate Valentine's card depicting rabbits with a note stating 'I love you.' Bryce reported feeling uncomfortable and informed her parents after Fenney gave her his contact information. Bryce described three notable encounters: receiving the envelope with the calendar, Fenney making personal comments about her horse, and later receiving the disturbing Valentine's card. The card was addressed to 'Samantha Janssen' and contained suggestive imagery. Bryce stated she was not Danish and found the card's content disturbing. Fenney also filed a complaint with Tesco’s head office, making unsupported claims about staff behavior towards Bryce. Bryce stated she had never been reprimanded or mistreated at work. In court, Fenney asserted that his contact with Bryce was innocent and based on misunderstandings. He denied knowing her surname at the time, claimed she had encouraged his interest, and said he acted out of concern after allegedly hearing inappropriate comments directed at her, which the court found unsubstantiated. The court concluded that while Fenney’s behavior was unreasonable and caused distress, it did not meet the legal definition of harassment or stalking. Judge William Hart stated Fenney held a delusional view regarding his relationship with Bryce. Despite overturning the harassment conviction, the court imposed a two-year restraining order barring Fenney from contacting or approaching Bryce. Judge Hart highlighted Bryce's credibility as a witness, rejected Fenney's version of events, and emphasized the necessity of protective measures for Bryce. Fenney maintains that he did not harass Bryce and believes his actions were misinterpreted.

Fenney muutus Brycest kinnisidee all kannatavaks pärast seda, kui Bryce teda Tetbury Tesco poes Gloucestershire’is teenindas. Bryce kirjeldas kolme olulist kokkupuudet: kalendriga ümbriku saamist, Fenney isiklikke kommentaare tema hobuse kohta ning hiljem vastu võetud häirivat sõbrapäevakaarti. A new report for London Mayor Boris Johnson, written by Lord Darzi, proposes a system enabling mothers who experience poor care in NHS maternity units to enforce financial penalties on hospitals. According to the proposal, women could ensure that 12.5% of a hospital's payment for childbirth—around £275 out of the standard £2,200—can be withheld if they are dissatisfied with the service. The retained funds would remain with local GP commissioners and would be reinvested to improve maternity services.

This recommendation is part of a wider effort to shift significant powers from NHS managers to patients. The concept is inspired by the right to withhold a tip after unsatisfactory service in a restaurant. The proposal comes amid growing concerns about NHS maternity care quality, which has suffered from a shortage of at least 3,000 midwives. Surveys show that a quarter of NHS patients felt abandoned during childbirth, while 40% were dissatisfied with their maternity care.

The initiative was developed by Lord Darzi, a leading surgeon and former Labour health minister, through the London Health Commission. The plan suggests piloting the policy in London, where satisfaction with maternity care is among the lowest in the country. Over half of new mothers in London reportedly wait at least 12 weeks for an initial antenatal assessment, and London's maternal mortality rate is double the UK average, with 70% of direct maternal deaths linked to failings in care. If successful, the plan may be expanded across England.

Mark Johnson, professor of obstetrics at Chelsea and Westminster Hospital, welcomed the proposal and said it would make maternity budgets more responsive, supporting higher quality, patient-centered care. Lord Darzi noted that allowing patients to control a part of hospital funding would make care more responsive to individual experiences, while preserving the NHS’s commitment to free care at the point of need.

Lord Darzi, a pioneer of minimally invasive surgical techniques, was knighted for his work in the NHS and appointed to the House of Lords in 2007.

article_content: Mumbai experienced light rain showers and thunder early Sunday morning, bringing a cool breeze to the city. Fortunately, the rainfall did not disrupt road traffic or local train services. According to the India Meteorological Department (IMD), the Colaba observatory in south Mumbai registered 9.2 mm of rain, while the Santacruz observatory, representing the suburbs, recorded 5.2 mm over the past 24 hours. Other parts of Maharashtra, such as the north central districts and the Konkan region, also saw rainfall. IMD officials explained that the rains were due to westerly disturbances and winds coming from the Bay of Bengal. They added that a strong trough line—usually associated with north India—contributed to the showers in Maharashtra. Despite the precipitation, the weather remained pleasant, and there were no significant disruptions to daily life.

India Meteoroloogiaosakonna (IMD) andmetel registreeris Colaba vaatlusjaam Lõuna-Mumbais 9,2 mm vihma ning Santacruz eeslinnades 5,2 mm viimase 24 tunni jooksul. Vihma sadas ka mitmel pool mujal Maharashtras, sealhulgas põhja-keskpiirkonnas ja Konkanis. IMD ametnikud selgitasid, et vihma põhjustasid läänepoolt saabuvad häired ja Bengali lahelt pärit tuuled. article_content: At the G20 virtual summit, Prime Minister Narendra Modi emphasized the need to stop the Israel-Hamas conflict from becoming a broader regional war and welcomed news of 50 hostages set to be released from Gaza. He expressed hope for the freedom of all remaining hostages, calling for peaceful solutions. Russian President Vladimir Putin, attending his first G20 in two years, stressed the tragedy of the Ukraine conflict and urged the search for a quick resolution. Modi announced the launch of a new Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) Repository that includes 50 platforms from 16 countries. He proposed a Social Impact Fund to expand DPI adoption in the Global South, pledging an initial $25 million from India and inviting other countries to contribute. India will hand over the G20 presidency to Brazil on December 1. US President Joe Biden was absent due to Thanksgiving, and China was represented by its Prime Minister. Other G20 leaders, such as Canada’s PM, attended. Modi condemned terrorism and the killing of civilians, stressed the importance of timely humanitarian aid, and called for united efforts against violence. He also addressed the rapid growth of artificial intelligence, advocating for strong regulations to ensure it benefits society and remains safe. India’s G20 presidency was noteworthy for including the African Union as a full member, which Modi described as a moment of pride for the country. Other updates included high demand for IPOs such as Tata Technologies, Flair Writing Industries, and Gandhar Oil Refinery, which were fully subscribed shortly after opening. IndiGo airline plans to target business travelers with new premium services. Since the inception of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC), over 26,000 insolvency cases, totaling nearly ₹9.33 lakh crore in defaults, have been withdrawn prior to legal review.

article_content: Comedian Alan Davies has apologized to Lord McAlpine for a tweet that wrongly accused the former Conservative Party deputy chairman of being a paedophile. Davies, best known for his role in the BBC crime drama Jonathan Creek, has agreed to pay £15,000 in damages, which will be donated to the Chelsea Pensioners at Lord McAlpine’s request. Lord McAlpine began libel proceedings against Davies after online speculation last November suggested that a senior politician would be exposed as a paedophile on BBC Newsnight. Davies paid damages to Lord McAlpine after he re-tweeted a message to his 400,000 followers that falsely identified Lord McAlpine as the alleged individual. In court, Davies’ lawyer, Steve Hudson, said: 'Mr Davies withdraws the allegation unreservedly, and sincerely apologises to Lord McAlpine for the distress his tweet caused.' Lord McAlpine’s lawyer, Andrew Reid, noted that harmful effects from the tweet persist: 'Mr Davies has irresponsibly fueled the actions of internet trolls who act as though they are immune from prosecution.' On Tuesday, Sally Bercow, wife of the Speaker, also publicly apologised and agreed to pay £15,000 to Lord McAlpine in response to her own defamatory tweet.

Lord McAlpine alustas laimumenetlust Davies’i vastu pärast eelmisel novembril aset leidnud internetispekulatsioone, mille kohaselt pidi üks juhtiv poliitik paljastatama kui pedofiil BBC Newsnight saates. Davies maksis Lord McAlpine’ile kahjutasu pärast seda, kui ta oma 400 000 jälgijale edasi säutsus sõnumi, mis ekslikult nimetas Lord McAlpine’i süüdistatavaks. Kohtus ütles Davies’i advokaat Steve Hudson: 'Härra Davies võtab süüdistuse täielikult tagasi ning vabandab siiralt Lord McAlpine’i ees selle tekitatud kahju ja mure pärast.' Lord McAlpine’i advokaat Andrew Reid märkis, et säutsu kahjulik mõju püsib: 'Härra Davies on vastutustundetult õhutanud internetitrollide tegevust, kes justkui tegutseksid karistuseta.' Teisipäeval vabandas ka spiikri abikaasa Sally Bercow avalikult ja nõustus maksma Lord McAlpine’ile £15 000, vastutasuks oma laimava säutsu eest.

article_content: A collection of images taken aboard the International Space Station (ISS) has been compiled into a time-lapse video, depicting Earth from space over five and a half months. Astronauts spent 165 days in orbit before returning to Earth last month, landing on the steppe of Kazakhstan. Among the crew was Alexander Gerst, a German astronaut with the European Space Agency, who installed cameras throughout the station to capture images of Earth in remarkable detail. After returning to Earth, the 38-year-old compiled 12,500 images to create a stunning visual record of the planet from space. The photographs include breathtaking views of oceans and cloud formations, as well as more poignant images, such as a snapshot of the conflict in Gaza between Israeli and Palestinian fighters. In one image, amber rockets flare over the city—an image Gerst described as 'the saddest photo yet' in a Twitter post in July. The video captures city lights shining at night, as seen from 200 miles above the planet, with astronauts of different nationalities on board. The collection also includes rare, detailed views of the ISS itself. The spacecraft's solar panels can be seen throughout the time-lapse, while images show clouds forming over the sea below. After landing in Kazakhstan in November, Gerst reflected on his 165 days in orbit and the extraordinary images captured during the mission. One striking photo shows sunlight piercing over Earth's edge, bathing the planet in blue and green hues as seen from the Space Station.

Meeskonda kuulus ka sakslasest Euroopa Kosmoseagentuuri astronaut Alexander Gerst, kes paigaldas jaama erinevatesse osadesse kaamerad, et jäädvustada Maad erakordse detailsusega. article_content: A surveillance device used by the FBI called the 'Stingray' has been criticized by the Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF), an American digital rights organization, for being invasive and potentially unconstitutional. Stingray devices function by impersonating a mobile phone tower, causing phones to unknowingly connect to them even if a call is not in progress. This lets users eavesdrop on phone calls and pinpoint someone's location to within two meters. Although originally intended for terrorism-related investigations, the EFF warns that Stingrays are now widely used by the FBI in routine law enforcement cases. The EFF labels the Stingray as 'an unconstitutional, all-you-can-eat data buffet,' arguing it collects data on thousands of innocent people. As an example, when the Los Angeles Police Department (LAPD) obtained a Department of Homeland Security grant in 2006 to purchase a Stingray, it was intended for 'regional terrorism investigations.' However, EFF and documents obtained by the First Amendment Coalition show that LAPD used the Stingray at least 21 times over four months in 2012 for various criminal investigations, not limited to terrorism cases. According to LA Weekly, Stingrays were used in over 13 percent of 155 LAPD mobile phone cases between June and September 2012, including in investigations of burglary, drugs, and murder. The EFF's report states that using the Stingray is another example of the U.S. government expanding surveillance powers over ordinary citizens under the pretense of combating terrorism. They warn that Stingrays grant police 'general warrant' powers, which the Fourth Amendment of the U.S. Constitution was specifically designed to prohibit. Critics say police searching for a particular person can inadvertently collect data from many innocent people's mobile phones. The EFF also references a Slate article mentioning internal FBI guidance that questions whether Stingray use complies with the Communications Act, which generally bans interfering with communications signals. FBI statements emphasize that all investigative tools are used in accordance with the Constitution, federal laws, and Department of Justice policies, and that investigations are subject to oversight. The FBI also states that gathering location information is crucial for law enforcement, and details about the technology used are classified as 'Law Enforcement Sensitive' to prevent criminals from evading investigations.
translated_content: FBI poolt kasutatav jälgimisseade nimega 'Stingray' on saanud kriitikat Ameerika digitaalseid õigusi kaitsvalt organisatsioonilt Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF), kuna seade on pealetükkiv ja potentsiaalselt põhiseadusevastane. Stingray-seadmed toimivad teeseldes mobiilimastina, sundides telefone nendega ühendust looma ka siis, kui kõnet ei toimu. See võimaldab kasutajatel pealt kuulata kõnesid ja määrata inimese asukoha kahe meetri täpsusega. Kuigi algselt oli Stingray mõeldud terrorismiga seotud uurimisteks, hoiatab EFF, et FBI kasutab seda nüüd laialdaselt tavapärastes kriminaalasjades. EFF nimetab Stingrayd 'põhiseadusevastaseks andme-büfeeks', väites, et seade kogub andmeid tuhandete süütute inimeste kohta. Näiteks, kui Los Angelese politseijaoskond (LAPD) sai 2006. aastal USA Sisejulgeolekuministeeriumi toetuse Stingray ostmiseks, oli eesmärk kasutada seda 'regionaalsete terrorismi-uurimiste' jaoks. EFF ja First Amendment Coalitioni andmete kohaselt kasutas LAPD siiski nelja kuu jooksul 2012. aastal Stingrayd vähemalt 21 korral erinevates kriminaaluurimistes, mitte ainult terrorismijuhtumites. LA Weekly teatel kasutati Stingrayd üle 13% 155 LAPD mobiiltelefonide uurimisjuhtumitest 2012. aasta juunist septembrini, sealhulgas varguste, narko- ja mõrvajuhtumite puhul. EFF raportis märgitakse, et Stingray kasutamine on järjekordne näide sellest, kuidas USA valitsus laiendab jälgimisõigusi tavakodanike suhtes terrorismiohu ettekäändel. Nad hoiatavad, et Stingray annab politseile 'üldise orderi' õigused, mille vastu USA põhiseaduse neljas parandus on spetsiaalselt suunatud. Kriitikud leiavad, et konkreetse isiku otsimine võib politseil kogemata kaasa tuua paljude süütute inimeste mobiilide andmete kogumise. EFF viitab ka Slate'i artiklile, milles mainitakse FBI sisemist juhendit ning seatakse kahtluse alla Stingray seaduslikkus, sest Communications Act keelab tavaliselt sideteenuste häirimise. FBI väidab, et kõik uurimisvahendid on kooskõlas põhiseaduse, föderaalseaduste ja Justiitsministeeriumi eeskirjadega ning uurimised alluvad järelevalvele. Samuti rõhutab FBI, et asukohaandmete kogumine on õiguskaitse jaoks oluline, ja teavet kasutatavate seadmete kohta peetakse 'õiguskaitse tundlikuks', et kurjategijad ei saaks tõkestada õiguspäraseid uurimisi.

article_content: A team of scientists led by Dr. Claudia Keller Valsecchi at the Institute of Molecular Biology in Mainz has identified SOA, a protein that regulates X chromosome gene activity in male malaria mosquitoes. This discovery advances knowledge of how gender-based gene expression is balanced on a molecular level. The research, published in Nature and involving partners from Germany, France, and the Netherlands, found that SOA boosts X chromosome genes only in male mosquitoes, offsetting their single X chromosome. Female mosquitoes produce little to no functional SOA. Malaria, a deadly disease primarily spread by Anopheles mosquitoes, continues to threaten millions, especially in Africa. Only female mosquitoes bite humans, as they require blood to produce eggs, making them the main carriers of malaria. Lead researcher Agata Kalita noted that while balancing sex chromosome gene expression is essential in some species, in mosquitoes it is not strictly necessary for development, though SOA does give males an early benefit. Senior researcher Dr. M. Felicia Basilicata highlighted that understanding these genetic mechanisms helps illuminate sex-specific differences relevant to various human diseases. The scientists suggest that these findings may help in designing genetic modifications that reduce female mosquito numbers, potentially contributing to malaria control.

See avastus aitab süvendada arusaama sellest, kuidas soospetsiifiline geeniekspressioon molekulaarsel tasandil tasakaalustub. Ajakirjas Nature ilmunud uuringus, kus osalesid partnerid Saksamaalt, Prantsusmaalt ja Hollandist, selgus, et SOA suurendab X-kromosoomi geenide aktiivsust vaid isastel sääskedel, tasakaalustades nende ühe X-kromosoomi mõju. Emastel sääskedel toodetakse vaid vähesel määral mittetoimivat SOA-d. Malaariat, mis on eluohtlik haigus ning mida levitavad peamiselt Anopheles’e sääsed, ohustab endiselt miljoneid inimesi, eriti Aafrikas. Ainult emased sääsed hammustavad inimesi, kuna nad vajavad verd munade tootmiseks, mistõttu on nad peamised malaaria kandjad. Juhtivteadur Agata Kalita märkis, et kuigi mõne liigi arengus on sugukromosoomide geeniekspressiooni tasakaal oluline, pole see sääskede puhul rangelt vajalik, kuid SOA annab isastele sääskedele siiski eelise. Vanemteadur dr M. Felicia Basilicata tõi esile, et nende geneetiliste mehhanismide mõistmine aitab paremini selgitada sugudevahelisi erinevusi, mis mõjutavad ka inimeste tervist. Teadlaste hinnangul võivad need teadmised aidata geenitehnoloogia abil vähendada emaste sääskede arvu, mis võiks oluliselt panustada malaaria tõrjesse.

In recent years, private equity has poured significant investments into the U.S. healthcare sector, acquiring hospitals, medical practices, and disease management companies. While these deals have proven lucrative for investors, critics worry about their effect on patient care and service quality.

A vivid example is nursing homes, where investments soared from $5 billion in 2000 to more than $100 billion today. Investigative reports, such as one highlighted in The Atlantic, reveal that private equity-backed nursing home chains sometimes seek cost savings by cutting staff and increasing the use of sedating drugs. Data from the National Bureau of Economic Research points to about 22,500 premature deaths in these facilities between 2005 and 2017 before COVID-19, attributing the increase to understaffing and compromised care standards.

This situation leads to questions about the view of Adam Smith, regarded as the father of modern economics. Although Smith championed free markets in his influential book The Wealth of Nations, he also recognized markets’ shortcomings, particularly in providing public goods. Smith was critical of 'rent-seeking'—profiteering without societal benefit—and tasked government with ensuring vital services like justice, education, and public works.

Healthcare, in Smith’s era, looked very different. Still, he recognized the societal value of health and its ties to a productive workforce. Smith argued that education and the prevention of diseases were worthy of government focus and saw poverty as a major barrier to good health, observing that children from poor families suffered higher mortality rates due to limited resources.

If alive today, Smith might not reject private involvement in healthcare, but he would likely insist that public welfare take priority and endorse regulation wherever business interests risk public health.

Viimastel aastatel on erakapitali ettevõtted teinud suuri investeeringuid USA tervishoiusektorisse, ostes haiglaid, arstipraksiseid ja haiguste juhtimisega seotud ettevõtteid. Need tehingud on toonud investoritele tulu, kuid on tekitanud palju kriitikat seoses mõjudega patsientide hooldusele ning teenuse kvaliteedile.

Erakordselt kiire kasv on toimunud hooldekodude valdkonnas, kus investeeringud kasvasid 2000. aasta 5 miljardilt dollarilt üle 100 miljardi dollarini tänapäeval. Uurimusartiklid, nagu näiteks The Atlanticus ilmunud lugu, märgivad, et erakapitali omanduses hooldekodudes püütakse tihti kokku hoida personali arvelt ning kasutatakse sagedamini rahusteid. National Bureau of Economic Research’i andmetel põhjustas see aastatel 2005–2017 enne COVID-19 kriisi umbes 22 500 enneaegset surma, põhjuseks personali vähesus ja langenud hooldusstandardid.

See arutelu tõstatab küsimuse, kuidas suhtuks sellesse olukorda majandusteaduse suurkuju Adam Smith. Smith propageeris oma tähtteoses „Rahvaste rikkuse olemusest ja põhjustest“ vabaturgu, kuid leidis ka, et turgudel on piirangud – eriti avalike hüvede pakkumise osas. Ta oli „rent-seeking’u” ehk kasuahnusest ilma ühiskondliku väärtuseta kriitiline ning nägi valitsuse rolli oluliste teenuste, nagu õigusemõistmise, hariduse ja avalike tööde, tagamises.

Smith’i ajal oli tervishoid praegusest väga erinev, kuid ta mõistis tervise rolli ühiskonna ja tööjõu heaolus. Ta leidis, et nii haridusele kui haiguste ennetamisele peaks riik tähelepanu pöörama ning nägi vaesust takistusena heale tervisele – vaestel lastel oli kõrgem suremus, kuna puudusid vahendid esmavajaduste rahuldamiseks.

Kui Smith elaks tänapäeval, ei oleks ta tõenäoliselt erasektori kaasamise vastu, kuid arvaks, et avalikku huvi tuleb kaitsta ja reguleerida neid kohti, kus ärilised huvid võivad rahvatervist kahjustada.

After her divorce from Charles Saatchi, Nigella Lawson requested to keep only the contents of her beloved kitchen. The 53-year-old TV chef, who was married to the art dealer for over a decade, reportedly asked her local fishmonger, Rex Goldsmith of Chelsea Fishmonger, as well as friends, to help with the process of moving out her cooking appliances, according to her friend and photographer Nathaniel Goldberg. To express gratitude to those who supported her during a challenging year—including her lawyers, agent, make-up artist, and the fishmonger—Nigella hosted a special party.

In interviews, Nigella has explained that she avidly follows her local fishmonger on Twitter to check the day’s catch and places her order before heading over. Goldberg, who photographed her for Vogue, described Nigella as finding the wealth and social pressures of her marriage difficult. Despite enjoying the finer things in life, like good food and quality household items, she is not spoiled, Goldberg noted. "She walked away from her marriage asking for nothing but her kitchen, which says a lot about her character."

Nathaniel also observed that Nigella is slowly returning to normal life and taking pleasure in her routines again following the turbulence of her divorce. He recalled how much her life changed after meeting Saatchi at The Ivy in April 2000, including increased anxiety and a more isolated lifestyle. While their relationship was marked by affection, it was often influenced by Saatchi’s varying moods, making home life unpredictable. According to Goldberg, Nigella is now finding comfort and joy once again.

Coaching centers in Kota, northern India, are now subject to stricter regulations after a rise in student suicides. BBC Hindi’s Vineet Khare reports that many students who come to Kota to prepare for competitive entrance exams experience overwhelming pressure to succeed.

Vijay (name changed), 21, has failed the medical entrance exam three times. Like many others, he believed that enrolling in an expensive coaching center in Kota would help him pass. The city, known for its billboards featuring top-scoring students, attracts over 200,000 students annually, some as young as 13, who live in hostels or rented accommodations while preparing for entrance to prestigious medical and engineering colleges.

With twelve large coaching centers and at least fifty smaller ones, Kota has built a reputation for helping students face India’s fiercely competitive exams. Admission to top colleges is a significant source of pride, and failure often carries stigma. Centers charge over 100,000 rupees (about $1,200) per year, which is a considerable amount for many families.

Vijay’s family lives in a rural area and struggles financially. His father is a farmer, and Vijay feared disappointing his parents. He admits he lied to them about his poor results and, after failing a second time, suffered from anxiety and physical symptoms, eventually contemplating suicide. “I felt I had no options left. I thought I’d wasted my parents’ money and damaged their reputation,” he says. Bollywood actress Deepika Padukone’s openness about her own depression inspired him to seek help. Vijay is now receiving psychiatric treatment and focusing on taking life one day at a time.

Other students report facing similar struggles: living alone, academic pressure, family expectations, peer competition, and long study hours. Police data show that over 100 students have died by suicide in Kota in the last 10 years, with at least 25 such cases in 2023—the highest in a single year. One girl’s recent death during the reporter’s visit highlights the tragedy; her father said she had not expressed distress but was aware of other suicides.

A Hindustan Times analysis found most 2023 suicides involved boys under 18 from low-income, rural families preparing for medical exams. Adarsh Raj, 18, from a farming family, also ended his life; his uncle attributes this to depression caused by low grades.

Support is available through the AASRA helpline (India), Befrienders Worldwide (global), and the BBC Action Line (UK).

In response, Rajasthan’s government released new guidelines: coaching centers should not admit students below grade nine (age 14), should refrain from publicizing test results, and must emphasize mental health programs. Additional support measures include helpline posters and a team led by police officer Chandrasheel, who monitors students for signs of distress.

The World Health Organization identifies suicide as the fourth leading cause of death among 15- to 29-year-olds worldwide. In India, over 13,000 students died by suicide in 2021, a 4.5% increase from 2020.

Large class sizes—sometimes up to 300 students—can leave individuals feeling isolated. The Covid-19 pandemic and lockdowns have reduced students’ resilience, says Nitin Vijay, director of a leading coaching institute. Education expert Urmil Bakshi blames both commercialization and the pandemic for the crisis, citing students’ inability to form friendships due to fierce competition.

Kota’s economy is bolstered by over 3,500 hostels and many rental units. Yet, accommodations can be cramped; Arnav Anurag, 18, describes his room as suffocating but remains focused on his goals.

The new rules require mandatory mental health training for hostel staff, teachers, and managers, and include provisions for easier student exits and refunds.

Vijay believes a cultural shift is needed. “Parents should encourage children to follow their passions. Life is more important than any exam.”

Põhja-India linnas Kotas on juhenduskeskused sattunud rangemate piirangute alla pärast õpilaste enesetappude tõusu. BBC Hindi ajakirjanik Vineet Khare vahendab, et paljud õppurid, kes tulevad Kotasse, et valmistuda raskeimateks sisseastumiskatseteks, kogevad suurt survet õnnestuda.

Vijay (nimi muudetud), 21, on meditsiini sisseastumieksami juba kolm korda läbi kukkunud. Nagu paljud teisedki, lootis ta, et kulukas Kota juhenduskeskus aitab tal eksami läbida. Linn on tuntud stendide poolest, mis näitavad edukate õpilaste nimesid ja saavutusi. Igal aastal tuleb Kotasse üle 200 000 õpilase, mõni vaid 13-aastane, kes elavad hostelites või üürikorterites ja valmistuvad mainekate kõrgkoolide katseteks.

Kotas on 12 suurt ning vähemalt 50 väiksemat juhenduskeskust, mis aitavad õpilastel konkursil silma paista. Parimasse kõrgkooli pääsemine on paljude peredele uhkuseasi, ent läbikukkumine on häbiasi. Keskused küsivad aastas üle 100 000 ruupia (u 1 200 $), mis on paljudele peredele suur koormus.

Vijay pere elab maal ja neil on raske toime tulla. Isa on talunik ja Viijay kartis vanemaid alt vedada. Ta tunnistab, et valetas vanematele halvade tulemuste kohta ning pärast teist ebaõnnestumist tekkisid tal ärevus ja füüsilised vaevused, nii et ta mõtles isegi enesetapule. „Tundsin, et mul pole enam valikuid. Arvasin, et olen vanemate raha raisanud ja nende mainet kahjustanud,“ meenutab ta. Bollywoodi staar Deepika Padukone, kes on rääkinud avalikult oma depressioonist, inspireeris teda abi otsima. Nüüd saab Vijay psühhiaatrilist abi ja katsub elada päev korraga.

Ka teised õpilased kirjeldavad, kuidas üksildus, kõrged ootused, kaaslaste surve, tihe konkurents ja pikad õppepäevad neid mõjutavad. Politsei andmetel on Kotas viimasel kümnel aastal endalt elu võtnud üle 100 õpilase, neist vähemalt 25 sel aastal – senine rekord. Ühe tüdruku hiljutine enesetapp loo autori visiidi ajal tõi teema eriti valusalt esile; tema isa sõnul polnud tütar kaevanud, kuid teadis linnas toimuvatest enesetappudest.

Hindustan Timesi andmetel olid enamiku 2023. aasta enesetappude ohvrid alla 18-aastased poisid vaestest maapiirkondadest, kes valmistusid meditsiinikatseteks. Adarsh Raj, 18, talunikupojana, tegi samuti enesetapu; tema onu arvab, et põhjuseks oli madalate hinnete põhjustatud depressioon.

Abi leidmiseks saab pöörduda AASRA (India) või Befrienders Worldwide (ülemaailmne) tugiliinide poole, samuti BBC Action Line'i (ÜK) kaudu.

Kasvanud ohvrite tõttu on Rajasthani osariigi valitsus kehtestanud uued juhendid: juhenduskeskused ei tohiks võtta alla 9. klassi (14-aastaseid), eksamitulemusi ei tohi avalikult jagada ning vaja on rõhku panna vaimse tervise programmidele. Lisaks paigaldatakse rohkem helpline'i plakateid ning politseiohvitseri Chandrasheeli juhitav meeskond jälgib õppurite heaolu.

Maailma Terviseorganisatsiooni hinnangul on enesetapp 15–29-aastaste hulgas maailmas neljas surmapõhjus. Indias sooritas 2021. aastal enesetapu üle 13 000 õpilase, mis teeb 4,5% kasvu võrreldes aasta varasemaga.

Tänu kuni 300-liikmelistele klassidele võidakse õppurid tunda end üksildastena. Covid-19 pandeemia vähendas noorte stressitaluvust, tõdeb juhtiva juhenduskeskuse direktor Nitin Vijay. Haridusspetsialist Urmil Bakshi näeb põhjuseid nii pandeemias kui ka juhenduse kommertsialiseerumises – konkurents pärsib sõprussuhete kujunemist.

Kota majandus sõltub enam kui 3 500 hostelist ja tuhandetest üürikorterist. Elutingimused on sageli kitsad; Arnav Anurag, 18, kirjeldab oma elukohta kui „ahistavat“, kuid on eesmärgi suhtes pühendunud.

Uued reeglid nõuavad vaimse tervisealast koolitust kõigile personaliliikmetele ning lihtsamaid väljumise ja tagasimakse võimalusi õpilastele.

Vijay leiab, et vaja on ka laiemat mõtteviisi muutust: „Vanemad peaksid lapsi innustama oma kirele järgnema. Elu on tähtsam kui ükski eksam.”

article_content: Nikola Tesla may have died alone and in poverty, but today, influential supporters are working to preserve his legacy. Among them is cartoonist Matthew Inman, the creator behind 'The Oatmeal.' Using his widely read web comic, Inman launched an initiative to transform Tesla's former laboratory in Shoreham, New York, into a museum. Tesla, who lived from 1856 to 1943, was responsible for foundational innovations in AC power and held over 100 patents, according to the Tesla Memorial Society of New York. In collaboration with the nonprofit Tesla Science Center at Wardenclyffe, Inman helped spark broad interest in the museum project. In a humorous and candid comic, Inman praised Tesla as vastly superior to the more famous Thomas Edison. Through Indiegogo, a crowdfunding website, Inman and the nonprofit raised over $1.3 million in 2012. While this was enough to secure ownership of the laboratory, more funds were needed to turn it into a museum. This week, Inman reached out to Elon Musk, CEO of SpaceX and Tesla Motors—which takes its name from the inventor. Inman published another 'Oatmeal' comic enthusiastically reviewing his Tesla Model S, followed by a direct appeal to Musk. He noted that while Musk owes nothing, Tesla Motors benefits from Tesla’s name and technology, and the community would appreciate some help in return. Inman pointed out that, while Tesla automobiles feature AC induction motors and the Tesla name, Nikola Tesla’s family was not involved in founding the car company. The Tesla Memorial Society of New York credits Nikola Tesla with the invention of the AC induction motor, a technology he sold to Westinghouse in 1888. Inman likened the use of Tesla’s name to a hypothetical future company using 'Steve Jobs' without his family’s involvement. During the museum’s initial fundraising, Musk donated $2,500, according to Inman. However, about $8 million more is needed for the museum to open. On Twitter, Inman asked Musk for support, to which Musk replied, '@Oatmeal I would be happy to help.' It remains unclear exactly how much Musk plans to contribute. Still, for admirers of Nikola Tesla, the possibility of Musk’s support is encouraging.

Tesla (1856–1943) vastutas vahelduvvoolu (AC) tehnoloogia põhjalike uuenduste eest ning tal oli üle 100 patendi, viidates New Yorgi Tesla Memoriaalühingule. Koostöös mittetulundusühinguga Tesla Teaduskeskus Wardenclyffes aitas Inman tekitada muuseumiprojekti vastu laiaulatuslikku huvi. Naljakas ja vahetus koomiksis kiitis Inman Teslat märksa tuntumast Thomas Edisonist tunduvalt üle. Indiegogo ühisrahastusplatvormi kaudu kogusid Inman ja mittetulundusühing 2012. aastal üle 1,3 miljoni dollari. Kuigi sellest piisas labori omandamiseks, vajas muuseumiks muutmine lisaraha. Sel nädalal pöördus Inman Elon Muski, SpaceXi ja Tesla Motorsi tegevjuhi poole – viimane neist on saanud oma nime leiutaja Tesla järgi. Ta märkis, et Musk ei võlgne midagi, kuid Tesla Motors kasutab Tesla nime ja tehnoloogiat ning kogukond hindaks väikest abi vastu. Inman tõi välja, et kuigi Tesla autod kasutavad AC induktsioonmootoreid ja kannavad Tesla nime, polnud Nikola Tesla perekond autoettevõtte loomisesse kaasatud. New Yorgi Tesla Memoriaalühing omistab Nikola Teslale AC induktsioonmootori leiutamise, mille ta müüs Westinghouse’ile 1888. aastal. Inman tõi näiteks, et see oleks nagu tulevikus firma, mis kasutab Steve Jobsi nime ilma tema perekonna osaluseta. Muzeumi esialgse rahakogumise ajal annetas Musk Inmani sõnul 2500 dollarit. Praegu pole selge, kui palju Musk tegelikult annetab. Sellegipoolest on Tesla austajate jaoks mõte Muski abist innustav.

article_content: Nottingham Forest failed to score for the first time this season, settling for a 0-0 draw against Millwall. Having previously netted 20 goals in nine games—including five versus Fulham—Forest’s impressive run was halted by Millwall's solid defense. They remain top of the Championship despite this result. It was a hard-fought and physical encounter with five yellow cards shown between the sides. Millwall ended Forest’s streak, forcing the league leaders to share the points. Martyn Woolford missed a close-range effort for Millwall, and Mathias Ranegie was denied by a quick save from Forest goalkeeper Karl Darlow. Forest had their chances, notably when Michail Antonio’s cross almost sneaked in but was clawed away by Millwall goalkeeper David Forde. Later, Britt Assombalonga nearly scored, but his header was saved on the line. Bookings were issued to Beevers and Williams (Millwall), as well as Lansbury, Mancienne, and Darlow (Forest), reflecting the game’s intensity. The match ended goalless, leaving Forest unbeaten in six wins and three draws so far this season, with Stuart Pearce in charge.

Vaatamata sellele on Forest endiselt Championshipi liider. Kohtumine oli karm ja füüsiline, mõlemale tiimile anti kokku viis kollast kaarti. Forest lõi samuti ohtlikke võimalusi – silmapaistvaim neist oli Michail Antonio tsenderdus, mis oleks peaaegu sisse läinud, kuid Millwalli väravavaht David Forde tõrjus. article_content: Photographer Leonard Freed documented the daily work of New York City police officers in the 1970s, a time when the city was close to bankruptcy and faced rising crime. His photographs capture events such as a police raid on a drug-related 'shooting gallery' in an old Harlem building, searches for wanted men, and the arrest of political protesters on the streets. Freed's work provides a behind-the-scenes look at law enforcement during an era of social unrest. Notable images include officers surrounding an ill man on a city street while waiting for a hospital wagon, and a policeman preparing a report with a typewriter in the 9th Police Precinct. These photographs were first published in the Sunday Times in March 1973 under the controversial headline 'Thugs, Mugs, Drugs; City In Terror.' This led to media disputes, including a lawsuit from the New York Daily News and criticism from the New York Times, as well as then-Mayor John Lindsay, who argued the depiction was unfair to the city. Despite the controversy, Freed intended his project as a sociological study rather than to provoke or offend. He wanted to show the public the reality of police work, describing police officers as symbols of 'society's efforts to control itself.' Freed joined officers on patrol for his project, which was later displayed at the Museum of the City of New York. He also photographed significant subjects outside New York, including the Ku Klux Klan in 1988 and the Berlin Wall in 1989. According to Freed, understanding the true nature of police officers is important, as their work reflects broader societal challenges and values.
translated_content: Fotograaf Leonard Freed dokumenteeris 1970. aastatel New Yorgi politseinike igapäevatööd ajal, mil linn oli peaaegu pankrotis ja kuritegevus kasvas. Tema fotodel on jäädvustatud näiteks politsei haarang narkootikumidega seotud „laskegaleriis” vanas Harlemi hoones, tagaotsitavate meeste otsimine ning poliitiliste protestijate vahistamine tänavatel. Freedi töö annab kulissidetaguse pilgu õiguskaitsetööle ühiskondliku rahutuse perioodil. Märkimisväärsed on pildid politseinikest, kes ümbritsevad haigestunud meest linnatänaval haiglaauto ootuses, ning politseinikust, kes koostab kirjutusmasinaga raportit 9. politseiprefektuuris. Need fotod avaldati esmakordselt Sunday Times'is 1973. aasta märtsis vastuolulise pealkirjaga „Thugs, Mugs, Drugs; City In Terror”. See tõi kaasa meediavaidlused, sealhulgas kohtuasja New York Daily Newsilt ning kriitika New York Times'ilt ja toonase linnapea John Lindsaylt, kes leidis, et kujutamine on linnale ebaõiglane. Vaatamata vastuoludele kavatses Freed projekti pigem sotsioloogilise uurimusena, mitte provotseerimise või solvamisena. Ta soovis avalikkusele näidata politseitöö tegelikkust, nimetades politseinikke „ühiskonna enesekontrolli sümboliteks”. Freed liitus patrullivate politseinikega oma projekti jaoks, mille tulemused olid hiljem välja pandud New Yorgi Linna Muuseumis. Ta pildistas olulisi teemasid ka väljaspool New Yorki, sealhulgas Ku Klux Klani 1988. aastal ja Berliini müüri 1989. aastal. Freedi sõnul on oluline mõista, millised politseiametnikud tegelikult on, sest nende töö peegeldab laiemalt ühiskondlikke pingeid ja väärtusi.

In today’s highly competitive digital world, simply having a website isn’t enough—it needs to be visually engaging and professionally crafted. Working with skilled web designers is crucial, as building an effective website demands expertise and precision. To get the most out of your collaboration, consider these five strategies for working with web design professionals:

1. Prioritize Clear Communication: Effective communication is key in any business project, especially when it comes to web design. Provide your design team with thorough instructions—define your goals, describe your audience, and clarify your expectations for the look and feel of the site. Clear direction enables designers to align the website with your business objectives. Regular meetings and feedback loops foster collaboration and result in a stronger finished site.

2. Highlight What Sets You Apart: Make sure your website reflects your unique brand identity. Template-based or generic sites rarely make a big impact. Professional web designers are adept at crafting personalized, impactful websites tailored specifically to your business. Custom designs help capture visitor attention and improve engagement, which can drive sales.

3. Center Design on User Experience: A great website is user-friendly, easy to navigate, and appealing. Collaborate closely with your designers to prioritize intuitive interfaces, quick-loading pages, and mobile compatibility. Professionals understand the importance of seamless user experiences and can help your site deliver them.

4. Embrace New Design Trends and Technologies: The digital landscape is continuously evolving. By teaming up with experienced web designers, you can ensure your site incorporates the latest features and design approaches, like responsive layouts and minimalist aesthetics. Staying updated keeps your website looking modern and engaging.

5. Maintain and Update Regularly: Website creation doesn’t end at launch. Long-term value comes from consistent upkeep—updating content, implementing security fixes, and making performance improvements. Professional web designers can manage ongoing maintenance to keep your website secure, current, and effective.

Following these strategies will help your business thrive in today’s digital marketplace and let you fully benefit from partnering with professional web designers.

Tänapäeva tugevas digikonkurentsis ei piisa lihtsalt veebilehest—see peab olema pilkupüüdev ja professionaalselt kujundatud. Koostöö kogenud veebidisaineritega on väga oluline, kuna hea veebilehe loomine vajab teadmisi ja täpsust. Parima tulemuse saamiseks võta arvesse neid viit strateegiat koostöös veebidisaini professionaalidega:

1. Pane rõhku selgele suhtlusele: Tõhus suhtlus on iga äriprojekti alus, ka veebidisainis. Anna oma disaineritele põhjalikud juhised—tutvusta eesmärke, sihtgruppi ning visiooni veebilehe välimuse kohta. Nõnda saavad disainerid luua veebilehe, mis toetab su ärieesmärke. Regulaarne tagasiside ja koosolekud parandavad koostööd ning aitavad saavutada parima tulemuse.

2. Too esile oma ettevõtte eripära: Veendu, et su veebileht peegeldab ettevõtte ainulaadsust. Templaadi-põhised lahendused ei jäta sageli kestvat muljet. Professionaalsed veebidisainerid oskavad luua just sinu ettevõttele sobivaid ning silmapaistvaid veebilehti. Isikupärane disain aitab hoida külastajaid ning soodustab ettevõtte edu.

3. Pane kasutajakogemus esiplaanile: Hea veebileht on kasutajasõbralik, selge ja visuaalselt meeldiv. Tehke disaineritega tihedat koostööd, et veebileht oleks lihtsalt navigeeritav, kiire laadimisega ja mobiilisõbralik. Spetsialistid aitavad luua sujuva kasutajakogemuse, mis hoiab külastajad lehel.

4. Jälgi uusi trende ja tehnoloogiaid: Digimaailm muutub kiirelt. Koostöö professionaalidega aitab hoida veebilehe kaasaegse ja värskena, lisades uusi disainilahendusi nagu responsiivne kujundus või minimalistlikud elemendid. Nii jääb su koduleht alati ajakohaseks ja silmapaistvaks.

5. Hoolda ja uuenda pidevalt: Veebilehe loomine pole ühekordne projekt. Pikaajalise edu tagab järjepidev hooldus, sisu uuendamine, turvapaigad ja jõudluse täiustamine. Spetsialistide tugi teeb su veebilehe jätkuvalt turvaliseks, kaasaegseks ja toimivaks.

Nende strateegiate rakendamine aitab su ettevõttel edukalt digimaailmas läbi lüüa ning saada maksimaalset väärtust professionaalsete veebidisaineritega koostööst.

Sheikh Hassan Nasrallah, the leader of Lebanon's Shia militant group Hezbollah, has claimed responsibility for sending a drone into Israeli airspace last week, stating that the drone was manufactured in Iran. Speaking on Hezbollah’s television channel, Nasrallah said the drone flew over “sensitive sites” in Israel and was assembled by a specialized Hezbollah team, adding that Lebanese people should feel proud of this accomplishment.

The Israeli air force shot down the unmanned aerial vehicle on Saturday over the northern Negev desert, the Israeli Defense Forces reported. According to military spokesperson Avital Leibovich, the drone entered Israeli airspace from over Gaza and was not carrying any weapons or explosives.

Nasrallah asserted that Hezbollah has previously flown drones over Israel and could do so again whenever it chooses. “This mission was not the first, and God willing, it will not be the last,” he said. When asked about Nasrallah’s comments, a senior Israeli official, speaking anonymously, dismissed them, saying, “His statement is not worth commenting on.”

Micah Zenko, a drone expert with the Council on Foreign Relations, noted that Hezbollah has operated drones over Israel for years, and described this particular incident as insignificant. Zenko characterized Nasrallah’s rhetoric as mostly bluster, explaining that Israeli forces often monitor these drones’ movements and do not always shoot them down. He also remarked on the limited technological sophistication of such drones, calling them “crude” and primarily suitable for surveillance, with no capacity to carry armaments. It remains unclear whether Iranian-manufactured drones are capable of real-time surveillance.

Nasrallah said the purpose of the drone mission was to demonstrate Hezbollah’s capabilities and to send a timely message.

Nasrallah rääkis Hezbollah’ telekanalis, et droon lendas üle “tundlike paikade” Iisraelis ning selle pani kokku spetsiaalne Hezbollah’ meeskond. article_content: Choosing to get a tattoo is a major decision, and selecting a design to wear for life can be even more challenging. However, many are now turning to Jay Freestyle, a tattoo artist in Amsterdam known for creating unique designs entirely through improvisation. Jay’s innovative methods result in striking and soulful artworks that are permanently etched onto clients' skin. While his tattoos appear to be meticulously planned, they are actually products of his spontaneous creativity. Jay excels at blending floating shadows, varying line weights, precise proportions, and expert color techniques, all without pre-sketching. At 29, the South African-born, self-taught artist crafts each design in real time while working with his clients. Drawing inspiration from traditional painting techniques like watercolor and liquid ink, he fuses them with contemporary and graphic elements. article_content: A 20-year-old man, Alexandre 'Mozart' Nicolas, drowned in a Florida canal while trying to escape from police custody after he was arrested for driving a stolen car. The incident took place around 5 p.m. on Saturday near Biscayne Boulevard in North Miami Beach. Police stopped Nicolas in a parking lot and handcuffed him; he then ran across eight lanes of heavy traffic and jumped into a canal with his hands restrained. A Sunny Isles Beach police officer entered the water in an attempt to rescue him, but was unable to save him. Nicolas was transported to Aventura Hospital, where he was pronounced dead. Friends and family were shocked by the news. Nicolas, a graduate of Alonzo and Tracy Mourning High School, was remembered as cheerful and close to his family. He was nicknamed 'Mozart' for his passion for music. Former classmate Frank Quiroz told WSVN that Nicolas was well-liked and a good student. Sam Goldberg, who was with Nicolas at a restaurant about an hour before the incident, described him as sociable and friendly, though financially struggling. Goldberg said Nicolas enjoyed expensive things and was a supportive friend. The police stop occurred at the parking lot of Area Code 55, a Brazilian steakhouse at 16375 Biscayne Boulevard. Miami-Dade police said they pulled over Nicolas after a scanner identified the license plate on his older model Mercedes-Benz as stolen. Nicolas reportedly did not have a criminal record. After being ordered out of the car and handcuffed, he attempted to escape. Detective Roy Rutland of Miami-Dade police stated that officers had probable cause for the arrest after identifying the vehicle as stolen. The Florida Department of Law Enforcement database shows Nicolas was charged that Saturday with a non-moving traffic violation and driving with a suspended license. Police have not commented on why Nicolas tried to run. The investigation is now led by Miami-Dade police and will be reviewed by the state attorney’s office to determine if police acted appropriately.
